jobs.title: Actuarial Services Director
jobs.description:
The Actuarial Services Director is an important role responsible for actuarial and analytical modeling and forecasting within Privia’s Healthcare Economics department.  In partnership with the SVP, Health Care Economics, this leader uses industry standard actuarial and analytics methods and principles to develop and maintain projection models and analyses to guide and inform Privia Health’s VBC strategy.  This role requires both a knowledge of healthcare and VBC business models and an aptitude in the analytic tools appropriate for modeling and analyzing business scenarios, including forecasting and sensitivity testing.

Primary Job Duties

• Use actuarial and analytical methods to analyze business problems and opportunities to inform solutions and strategic direction
• Develop detailed understanding of value based care and pay for performance programs, including researching of an evolving VBC landscape of program design and regulation
• Serve as a subject-matter expert on Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) and other government and payer programs. Work to understand the underpinnings of alternate methodologies such as LEAD or MA to inform direction and analysis.
• Develop and maintain models used to manage the financial considerations of Privia’s VBC portfolio of programs. Use analytic techniques to do complex analysis and sensitivity testing on program financial performance
• Maintain models and tracking tools for forecasting and projecting current and future year forecasts and performance models. Perform scenario testing and variability analysis of program components
• Assist with quarterly reporting and auditing of program performance, maintaining accurate and timely completion of regular reporting. Use deep program knowledge to model and forecast performance
• Develop an understanding of Privia’s partner benchmarking tools and recommend changes or updates as business needs evolve. Use partner tools to assist with new business development opportunities
• Provide analytical support for VBC-related operations as needed, including cost and utilization, referral network management, and quality improvement initiatives. Advance tool sets and dashboards used.
• Construction of actuarial and analytic deliverables, including presentations and exhibits, for communicating performance to technical and non-technical audiences
• Work cross functionally with key stakeholders, within Health Care Economics teams and Privia at large, to influence strategic direction and management
• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Advanced degree (FSA/ASA, or PhD/Masters) in a quantitative field such as Actuarial Science, Economics, Statistics, or Finance, with a foundation in healthcare economics. Actuarial credentials preferred but not required.
• Knowledge and expertise of healthcare claims and related data sources. Understanding of payment methodologies and payer landscape.
• Expertise and understanding of managed care principles, including VBC program design and performance.
• 8+ years of experience in financial planning, forecast modeling, and healthcare program evaluation required
• Expertise in leveraging payer claims and/or EMR data to drive actionable insights and business problem solving
• Expert understanding of spreadsheet modeling and actuarial model architecture (Microsoft Excel)
• Proficiency in using coding to manage and summarize large datasets of healthcare claims and encounter data (SQL, Snowflake preferred)
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build analytic deliverables to convey complex findings to diverse audiences
• Strong strategic thinking, problem solving, and leadership capabilities.

The salary range for this role is $180,000.00-$220,000.00 in base pay and exclusive of any bonuses or benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance, 401K, paid time off, and other wellness programs). This role is also eligible for an annual bonus targeted at 20% and restricted stock units. The base pay offered will be determined based on relevant factors such as experience, education, and geographic location.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

﻿Technical Requirements (for remote workers only, not applicable for onsite/in office work):

In order to successfully work remotely, supporting our patients and providers, we require a minimum of 5 MBPS for Download Speed and 3 MBPS for the Upload Speed. This should be acquired prior to the start of your employment. The best measure of your internet speed is to use online speed tests like https://www.speedtest.net/. This gives you an update as to how fast data transfer is with your internet connection and if it meets the minimum speed requirements. Work with your internet provider if you have questions about your connection. Employees who regularly work from home offices are eligible for expense reimbursement to offset this cost.

We understand that healthcare is local and we are better when our people are a reflection of the communities that we serve. Our goal is to encourage people to pursue all opportunities regardless of their age, color, national origin, physical or mental (dis)ability, race, religion, gender, sex, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
• Partner closely with internal business stakeholders and shadow frontline end users (clinical operations, care coordinators, administrative teams) to uncover operational friction and understand strategic business needs. • 2 to 4 years of software product management experience. Skilled at creating end-to-end process flowcharts, workflow diagrams, and low-fidelity prototypes/wireframes to make complex problems visual and easy to understand.
• Proven ability to scope problems, author crisp user stories with robust acceptance criteria, define functional edge cases, and run an active delivery backlog.
• Natural product instinct and curiosity. Ability to watch a teammate navigate a clunky, manual workaround and intuitively envision a simpler, more elegant digital workflow.
• Comfort querying datasets, reviewing error patterns, and manipulating spreadsheets to validate assumptions, measure adoption, and baseline operational friction.
• High emotional intelligence and active listening skills. Proven ability to bridge the gap between frontline clinical/operations teammates, Epic configuration analysts, and technical engineers with clarity and empathy.
• Ability to see the bigger picture, understanding how a configuration tweak or data change upstream impacts downstream users, interfaces, and operational teams.
• High comfort with ambiguity. Ability to untangle messy problems, make sound judgment calls, and determine clear next steps without having all the information or waiting for a playbook.

jobs.title: Genetic Counselor, Bioinformatics Laboratory Services, Full-Time, Days (Remote: IL, IA, IN, MO and WI)
jobs.description:
The Genetic Counselor, Laboratory Services reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines, and all other regulatory and accreditation standards

This is a laboratory-based, non-patient-facing position that serves as the primary laboratory resource for genetic and genomic test utilization management, insurance authorization review, medical necessity documentation, reimbursement support, and payer appeals. The role collaborates with laboratory leadership, ordering providers, revenue cycle teams, and payers to ensure appropriate utilization of genetic testing, optimize reimbursement, reduce denials, and support patient access to medically necessary testing.

This position functions as a liaison between laboratory operations, clinicians, patients, and payers, providing expertise in genetics, genomic testing guidelines, medical necessity justification, and reimbursement requirements. This aligns with a need for a laboratory-based genetic counselor focused on test appropriateness, pre-authorization review, denial management, and payment appeals rather than through direct patient interaction.

Responsibilities:

Test Utilization and Clinical Review:

• Review genetic and genomic testing requests for appropriateness based on clinical indications, diagnosis codes, evidence-based guidelines, and payer requirements.
• Evaluate patient history, clinical documentation, family history, and provider orders to determine medical necessity.
• Collaborate with ordering providers to ensure appropriate test selection and documentation.
• Assist in the development of laboratory testing algorithms and utilization management programs.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for genetic testing workflows and best practices.

Insurance Pre-Authorization Management:

• Review payer requirements for genetic and genomic testing.
• Initiate, coordinate, and track insurance pre-authorizations.
• Obtain and submit supporting clinical documentation required for authorization approval.
• Communicate authorization requirements and outcomes to providers and laboratory staff.
• Monitor authorization turnaround times and identify process improvement opportunities.

Denial Management and Appeals:

• Review denied claims related to genetic and genomic testing.
• Identify and track denial trends involving medical necessity, documentation, coding, and authorization requirements.
• Prepare and submit first level and subsequent payer appeals.
• Draft clinical justification letters supporting medical necessity.
• Collaborate with physicians, laboratory directors, and revenue cycle teams to obtain supporting documentation.
• Track appeal outcomes and reimbursement recovery metrics.
• Develop strategies to reduce future denials and improve reimbursement performance.

Medical Necessity and Peer-to-Peer Support:

• Develop evidence-based medical necessity documentation supporting genetic and genomic testing.
• Coordinate peer-to-peer reviews with insurance medical directors.
• Represent laboratory clinical rationale during payer review discussions.
• Prepare laboratory directors and ordering providers with supporting literature, guidelines, and clinical evidence.
• Maintain documentation supporting payer decisions and appeal outcomes.

Financial Stewardship:

• Support laboratory revenue integrity initiatives through denial prevention and reimbursement optimization.
• Analyze payer denial trends and financial impact.
• Generate reports related to pre-authorizations, denials, appeals, and reimbursement performance.
• Recommend process improvements that improve reimbursement and patient access.

Regulatory and Quality Responsibilities

• Maintain compliance with applicable regulatory, accreditation, and payer requirements.
• Participate in quality improvement initiatives related to genetic testing utilization and reimbursement.
• Develop policies and procedures related to authorization, medical necessity review, and appeals management.
• Assist with educational initiatives for providers, laboratory personnel, and revenue cycle staff.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• Master's Degree in Genetic Counseling from an accredited program.

Licensure:

• Licensure as required by the Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) as regulated under the Genetic Counselor Licensing Act (225 ILCS 135.

Certification:

• Board Certified or Board Eligible Genetic Counselor through the American Board of Genetic Counseling (ABGC).

Preferred:

• Three or more years of genetic counseling experience.
• Experience with molecular diagnostics, genomics, precision medicine, or laboratory operations.
• Experience with insurance pre-authorizations and payer reimbursement processes.
• Experience preparing medical necessity documentation and payer appeals.
• Experience participating in peer-to-peer reviews.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)
jobs.description:
As a Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP), you’ll play a vital role in supporting the people who make that possible; our dedicated employees. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to managers and employees alike, blending strategic HR insight with hands-on partnership. You’ll drive HR strategies, coach leaders on employee relations and performance, manage investigations, guide policy and compliance, support workforce planning, and contribute to data-driven decisions that shape organizational growth. In this role, you’ll ensure our teams feel supported, empowered, and connected to our mission.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Employee & Leadership Relationships: Build trusted relationships with managers and employees across assigned business units, serving as a strategic and approachable HR resource.
• Leadership Coaching & Development: Coach leaders on employee relations, performance management, team development, and change management to support effective leadership and organizational success.
• Leader Onboarding & HR Guidance: Lead onboarding for new leaders and provide ongoing guidance related to HR policies, benefits, compliance, and other employment-related matters.
• Employee Relations & Investigations: Manage employee relations matters and investigations, track grievances, assess concerns, and provide actionable recommendations to support fair and consistent resolutions.
• HR Collaboration & Support: Partner with HR colleagues to deliver consistent, proactive, and solution-oriented support while ensuring alignment with organizational policies and practices.

MUST HAVE:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
• HRBP Experience: 3+ years of HR Business Partner experience supporting large, non-exempt populations (250–500+ employees).
• HR Knowledge & Expertise: Strong knowledge of employee relations, performance management, and compensation, with experience across core HR functions, including high-volume recruiting and organizational development, and skills in investigations, coaching, employee development, and change/project management.
• Microsoft 365 & Power BI: Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint), with the ability to analyze data and present actionable insights; Power BI experience a plus.
• HR Compliance: Strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws, multi-state compliance, and diversity & inclusion.

NICE TO HAVE:

• HR Leadership: Ability to influence and support leaders through coaching and performance management; prior leadership or mentoring experience is a plus, especially when partnering with operations.
• HR Technology Expertise: Experience with HRIS platforms such as Workday, UltiPro (Ultimate Software), or similar systems, along with familiarity with ATS and LMS platforms (e.g., Relias, Cornerstone).
• Industry Experience: Background in healthcare, human services, or other regulated, multi-state environments preferred.
• Professional Certifications: SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR.
• Additional credentials: In Coaching, Mediation, or Project Management (PMP, CAPM)

SKILLS CRITICAL FOR SUCCESS:

• Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Connects people strategy to business goals, uses data and insights to assess workforce trends, and makes sound decisions aligned with company values and strategy.
• Relationship Building & Influence: Builds trust quickly, fosters collaboration, coaches leaders, and communicates HR guidance clearly to employees and management.
• Emotional Intelligence & Problem Solving: Navigates sensitive situations with professionalism and empathy, resolves conflicts constructively, and brings innovative solutions to complex workforce challenges.
• Adaptability & Change Agility: Thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments, supporting others through transitions while maintaining focus on outcomes and continuous improvement.
• Leadership & Coaching: Partners with leaders to mentor and develop teams, promoting engagement, accountability, and a high-performance culture.
• Organization & Project Management: Manages multiple priorities and initiatives across business units with attention to detail, efficiency, and accuracy.
• Compliance & Integrity: Ensures adherence to employment laws, regulations, and company policies while maintaining confidentiality and credibility.
• Technical & HR Systems Proficiency: Leverages HR technology to streamline processes, improve decision-making, and enhance workforce management.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS ROLE:

If you’re a people-focused professional, this role lets you make a real impact. You’ll partner with leaders to shape culture, strengthen teams, and drive business outcomes through people-centered strategies. Join a collaborative HR team that values innovation, learning, and genuine connection.

jobs.title: Nursing Education & Simulation Specialist
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

Collaborating with academic partners, faculty and staff, the Nursing Education & Simulation Specialist supports all clinical skills lab and simulation learning experiences for BSN students. A primary responsibility of this role is assisting in the development and implementation of detailed, clinically based simulation scenarios, including the use of high-fidelity patient simulators, to enhance clinical judgment, patient management, critical thinking, patient safety, and quality of care. Using evidence-based simulation methodologies in an in-person learning environment, the Specialist creates engaging and realistic learning experiences that prepare students for clinical practice.

In addition to simulation-based education, the Specialist provides individualized and small-group academic support, assesses learning needs, develops remediation strategies, and delivers academic coaching to promote student success, retention, progression, and NCLEX-RN readiness. The Specialist also collaborates with faculty on simulation design and debriefing, supports simulation laboratory operations and equipment, and ensures laboratory and simulation activities align with program outcomes, accreditation standards, and best practices in nursing education.

To support success in the role, new hires receive comprehensive onboarding and robust training aligned with the International Nursing Association for Clinical Simulation and Learning (INACSL) Standards of Best Practice, providing a strong foundation in simulation design, facilitation, debriefing, and simulation-based education.

This is a 100% onsite position with occasional evening and weekend hours required to support student learning, laboratory operations, and simulation activities.

Responsibilities

• Facilitate clinical skills lab and simulation-based learning experiences for BSN students, including laboratory preparation, equipment maintenance, supply management, and simulation set-up and breakdown.
• Assist in developing, implementing, and evaluating detailed clinically based simulation scenarios, including the use of high-fidelity patient simulators, while collaborating with faculty on simulation design, facilitation, debriefing, and evaluation to ensure alignment with course outcomes and nursing education best practices.
• Coordinate and supervise clinical skills lab and simulation experiences to ensure students have the opportunity to meet course and program learning outcomes.
• Provide individualized and small-group academic coaching, tutoring, and remediation to support student success, retention, progression, and NCLEX-RN readiness.
• Assess student learning needs and develop targeted remediation plans and strategies to improve academic and clinical performance.
• Maintain current knowledge of nursing practice, clinical education, simulation methodologies, and NCLEX-RN testing standards to effectively support student learning.
• Staff and oversee open lab sessions, providing guidance and feedback as students practice and remediate technical nursing skills.
• Monitor, document, and communicate student academic and clinical progress to faculty and academic leadership as appropriate.
• Participate in outreach and intervention efforts for students identified as academically at risk.
• Support simulation laboratory operations, equipment, technology, and supplies to ensure a safe, effective, and realistic learning environment.
• Demonstrate professionalism and accountability by delivering exceptional service to students, faculty, staff, and external partners through effective communication, collaboration, and a student-centered approach.
• Participate in ongoing professional development, including training aligned with the International Nursing Association for Clinical Simulation and Learning (INACSL) Standards of Best Practice.
• Comply with all institutional policies, procedures, and standards.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN) required.
• Master's Degree in Nursing (MSN), Nursing Education, or a related field preferred.
• Active, unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license required.
• BLS Provider certification required; BLS Instructor certification preferred or required within a designated timeframe.
• ACLS and/or PALS certification preferred.
• Experience in Medical-Surgical (Med-Surg), Emergency Department (ED), Emergency Room (ER), Critical Care (ICU), Progressive Care (PCU), Telemetry, or other acute care settings is highly preferred.
• Minimum of 1-3 years of clinical nursing experience required; experience in nursing education, clinical instruction, skills laboratory, simulation, student support services or preceptor, mentor, tutor is highly desirable.
• Experience facilitating simulation-based education and/or clinical learning experiences, including the use of high-fidelity patient simulators, preferred.
• Knowledge of simulation design, facilitation, debriefing, and evaluation principles; familiarity with INACSL Standards of Best Practice preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to provide academic coaching, remediation, tutoring, and student support to promote retention, progression, and NCLEX-RN readiness.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage students, faculty, and academic partners in both individual and group settings.
• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds.
• Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) and the ability to learn simulation technologies and educational software.
• Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced academic environment.
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as a member of a multidisciplinary team while supporting a positive, student-centered learning environment.
• Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings and weekends, to support laboratory operations, simulation activities, and student learning needs.

jobs.title: Slitter Operator (1st Shift)
jobs.description:
RRD's De Pere location is seeking a reliable, mechanically inclined Rewinder / Slitter Operator to join our production team. In this role, you will safely set up, operate, and adjust slitting and rewinding machinery to convert rolls to precise customer specifications. You will serve as the first line of defense for quality, ensuring our downstream presses receive defect-free materials on schedule.

This is a great opportunity for a hands-on operator who takes pride in precision, works well independently, and wants to grow within a modern manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Machine Operation & Setup

• Safely set up, change over, and operate slitter/rewinder machinery handling master rolls up to 59” wide with multiple cuts.
• Perform basic mechanical adjustments, knife changes, and fine-tuning to maintain optimal running speed and cut quality.
• Operate downstream auxiliary equipment, hand/power tools, precision measuring devices, and material handling equipment (e.g., pallet jacks).
• Troubleshoot routine mechanical and web-handling issues promptly to minimize downtime.

Quality Control & Documentation

• Inspect finished rolls continuously for dimensional accuracy, slit quality, tension, and material defects.
• Identify and isolate non-conforming materials; take immediate corrective action to resolve quality issues.
• Maintain a solid understanding of various paper grades, substrates, and finished product specifications.
• Accurately log production data, scrap rates, downtime, and quality records into internal tracking systems.

Safety & Plant Standards

• Adhere strictly to all company safety protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) rules, and PPE standards.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free workstation (5S standards).
• Collaborate proactively with machine leads, supervisors, and downstream press operators.

Required:

• Prior machine operating experience in a manufacturing, converting, packaging, or printing environment (slitter/rewinder experience strongly preferred).
• Mechanical aptitude with the ability to use standard hand tools, measuring tapes, and basic diagnostic tools.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to read job orders, blueprints, and tolerance specifications.
• Basic math and computer skills for production data entry.
• Demonstrated reliability, punctuality, and ability to work effectively with minimal supervision.

Preferred:

• Direct experience handling rolls up to 60” width and operating multi-knife slitting systems.
• Familiarity with web handling, tension controls, and various paper/film substrates.
• Experience operating manual or motorized pallet jacks and roll handling lifters.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

• Mobility: Ability to stand and walk on concrete floors for the duration of a shift.
• Dexterity: Continuous use of hands, wrists, and arms for machine controls, tool operation, and material handling.
• Movement: Frequent bending, stooping, kneeling, reaching, and crouching.
• Lifting: Regularly lift, carry, and maneuver up to 25 lbs; occasionally lift or move more
• Vision: Strong near-vision and color perception required to identify fine material defects and verify cuts against close tolerances.

***Climate Controlled Environment***

The salary range for this role at the noted RRD location is $17.00- $22.44/ hour. At Deloitte, we want everyone to feel they can be themselves and to thrive at work—in every country, in everything we do, every day. We aim to create a workplace where everyone is treated fairly and with respect, including reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. We seek to create and leverage our diverse workforce to build an inclusive environment across the African continent.

We actively support the inclusion of people with disabilities and embrace neurodiversity in the workplace. We recognise and value the unique strengths that neurodivergent individuals bring, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

If you require reasonable accommodations in relation to your disability and neurodiverse needs during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments to suit your individual needs.

Note: The list of tasks / duties and responsibilities contained in this document is not necessarily exhaustive.  Deloitte may ask the employee to carry out additional duties or responsibilities, which may fall reasonably within the ambit of the role profile, depending on operational requirements.

Be careful of Recruitment Scams: Fraudsters or employment scammers often pose as legitimate recruiters, employers, recruitment consultants or job placement firms, advertising false job opportunities through email, text messages and WhatsApp messages. They aim to cheat jobseekers out of money or to steal personal information.

To help you look out for potential recruitment scams, here are some Red Flags:

• Upfront Payment Requests: Deloitte will never ask for any upfront payment for background checks, job training, or supplies.
• Requests for Personal Information: Be wary if you are asked for sensitive personal information, especially early in the recruitment process and without a clear need for it. Fraudulent links or contractual documents may require the provision of sensitive personal data or copy documents (e.g., government issued numbers or identity documents, passports or passport numbers, bank account statements or numbers, parent’s data) that may be used for identity fraud. Do not provide or send any of these documents or data. Please note we will never ask for photographs at any stage of the recruitment process.
• Unprofessional Communication: Scammers may communicate in an unprofessional manner. Their messages may be filled with poor grammar and spelling errors. The look and feel may not be consistent with the Deloitte corporate brand.

If you're unsure, make direct contact with Deloitte using our official contact details. Be careful not to use any contact details provided in the suspicious job advertisement or email.

jobs.title: CNC Machinist
jobs.description:
Pyrotek's CNC Machinist is responsible for producing machined parts by programming, setting up, and operating a computer numerical control (CNC) machine, maintaining quality and safety standards, keeping records, and maintaining equipment and supplies.

This position is eligible for a $1500 sign on bonus.  $750 paid out at 90 days / $750 paid out at 180 days.

Monday - Friday, 6:00 am - 2:00 pm

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

• Adhere to production schedules by studying work orders, blueprints, engineering plans, material specifications, locations, and machining parameters, and interpret complex geometric dimensions and tolerances (GD&T).
• Effectively operate CNC machines by entering instructions, including zero and reference points, setting tool registers, offsets, compensation, and conditional switches. Apply basic math, geometry, trigonometry, and proving parts to determine calculating requirements, using G-code and/or conversational programming, as needed.
• Correctly set-up CNC machines by programming, editing, installing, and adjusting tools, attachments, collets, bushings, stops, and indicating parts with minimal to no assistance.
• Safely load raw material by lifting stock into position, and verify setting by measuring positions, first-run part and sample work pieces, and adhering to international standards.
• Ensure part(s) specifications by observing drilling, grooving and cutting, including turning, and facing. Take measurements to identify malfunctions, apply troubleshooting techniques, as needed, and take corrective measures by adjusting and editing existing programs, and replacing worn tools.
• Continuously follow and adhere to all quality assurance procedures and processes.
• Properly maintain equipment by completing preventive maintenance requirements, following manufacturer user instructions, appropriately troubleshooting malfunctions, and reporting issues for repairs timely.
• Regularly educate and train other machinists on production, programming, troubleshooting and maintenance policies and procedures to ensure consistency and accuracy of parts and pieces.
• Maintain continuity among work shifts by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities, and continuing needs; document actions by completing production and quality logs.
• Achieve organizational goals by accepting ownership of new and different requests and exploring opportunities for continuous improvements.

Education/Experience

High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED)/Test Assessing Secondary Completion (TASC), plus a minimum of five (5) years of experience as a CNC Machinist or successful completion of a certificated machining program; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

• Technical Skills. Ability to set up machines from scratch, touch off all tools, and write basic programs on CNC machine controller. Knowledge and ability to figure proper feeds and speeds of tooling for best life utilization. Knowledge of a wide variety of materials, hardness, and grades. Working knowledge of over-head crane, hoist, and lift tables. Ability to effectively use precise measuring tools such as mics, calipers, height gage, thread gage, bore gage, plug gage, and/or CMM is a plus.
• Training Skills. Ability to provide balanced coaching and guidance to ensure the development and validation of proficiencies in machining techniques and standard operating procedures.
• Communications Skills. Ability to speak clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations, listen, obtain clarification, and respond well to questions.

Platform Distribution and Partnerships is a division of NBCUniversal's media group responsible for the distribution and monetization of the company’s multi-billion-dollar linear and streaming services portfolio to pay-tv providers, NBC broadcast affiliates, consumer technology platforms and devices, and consumer brands. A key revenue-generator, the division is comprised of content distribution, affiliate relations, and strategic partnerships across NBC, Peacock, Bravo, Telemundo, and various FAST channels.

The Senior Director, Platform Distribution & Partnerships will report to the Senior Vice President, Platform Distribution & Partnerships and lead a team responsible for managing and growing v/MVPD, Peacock and FAST distribution. This role oversees the negotiation, execution, and ongoing management of distribution agreements across major v/MVPD, Peacock and FAST partners for NBCU’s portfolio of media assets. The Senior Director will drive strategic partner initiatives from incubation through implementation, ensuring strong execution and alignment with business objectives. This is a highly cross-functional role with touchpoints across Marketing, Product, Technology, Legal, Finance, Decision Sciences, Ad Sales, and Operations, requiring deep collaboration to maximize partner impact and optimize distribution strategies.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Negotiations and execution of distribution agreements for services across a diverse portfolio of partners, including v/MVPD, DTC and FAST partners.
• Oversee and manage a team, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to maximize performance and impact.
• Develop and implement comprehensive partnership strategies to drive subscriber acquisition, engagement, and revenue growth for NBCU’s suite of products.
• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with distribution partners, serving as a key point of contact to align on mutual goals, drive execution, and resolve challenges.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders – including marketing, product, content, finance, and legal – to support partnership initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and deliver on key business objectives.
• Analyze market trends, competitive dynamics, and platform performance to identify new growth opportunities, refine strategies, and inform decision-making.
• Structure, model, and evaluate partnership agreements to optimize terms and drive measurable business impact, balancing short-term objectives with long-term strategic positioning.
• Act as a thought leader within the organization, influencing internal stakeholders and advocating for innovative distribution approaches to maximize reach and engagement.
• Represent NBCUniversal at external meetings, industry events, and partner engagements, reinforcing the company’s position as a leader in media distribution.

• 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or digital media distribution within the television, film, or streaming industry.
• Extensive experience negotiating complex distribution agreements and managing high-profile partner relationships.
• Direct experience with v/MVPD and DTC agreements and negotiations.
• Demonstrated knowledge of the media landscape, business models, and evolving consumer behaviors in television and digital media.
• Proven ability to lead teams, fostering professional growth and a high-performance culture.
• Demonstrated strong understanding of the entertainment industry and NBCUniversal’s content and distribution ecosystem.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to effectively present to senior leadership and external partners.
• Ability to operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment, demonstrating adaptability and resilience.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Designer - Solar PV & Battery Energy Storage Systems
jobs.description:
Timmons Group is seeking a Senior Electrical Designer to join our Energy team supporting utility-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects.

The successful candidate will provide electrical drafting and design support throughout conceptual, preliminary, and final design. This position will work closely with project engineers and project managers to develop complete and coordinated design packages for renewable energy projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Develop electrical design drawings for utility-scale PV and BESS projects using AutoCAD.
• Prepare and revise electrical site plans, equipment layouts, one-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, grounding plans, underground conduit and cable plans, and installation details.
• Develop medium-voltage collector system layouts, including equipment locations, underground cable routing, trenching, conduit requirements, and overhead medium-voltage collection and interconnection lines.
• Develop overhead medium-voltage line layouts, including pole locations, conductor routing, line crossings, equipment locations, and transitions between overhead and underground systems.
• Prepare plans, profiles, details, material schedules, and other design documentation for overhead and underground medium-voltage systems.
• Develop BESS equipment layouts and electrical interconnections, including batteries, inverters/power conversion systems (PCS), transformers, switchgear, and other balance-of-system equipment.
• Develop PV electrical layouts including inverter locations, medium-voltage equipment, DC collection systems, and AC collection systems.
• Prepare equipment schedules, cable schedules, bills of materials, construction details, and other project deliverables.
• Coordinate electrical drawings with civil, structural, substation, SCADA, and other project disciplines.
• Coordinate overhead medium-voltage designs with civil/site layouts, access roads, utilities, environmental constraints, and other project infrastructure.
• Incorporate engineering calculations, equipment vendor information, client standards, markups, sketches, and engineering direction into design documents.
• Assist with development of issued-for-construction drawing packages.
• Review drawings for accuracy, consistency, constructability, and compliance with project standards.
• Work independently on design assignments while coordinating closely with the project engineer and project manager.
• Assist with CADD standards, drawing organization, and mentoring less-experienced designers and CADD users.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Associate degree or technical certificate in computer-aided drafting/design, engineering technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum of five years of electrical drafting/design experience, preferably involving utility-scale solar, BESS, power generation, substations, or other power-delivery projects.
• Proficiency with AutoCAD and experience developing multi-sheet electrical construction drawing packages.
• Working knowledge of electrical equipment, conduit and cable routing, grounding, and medium-voltage electrical systems.
• Ability to interpret electrical one-line diagrams, engineering markups, equipment drawings, and vendor documentation.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Ability to manage multiple design assignments and work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary project team.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience designing utility-scale solar PV and/or BESS facilities.
• Experience with 34.5 kV or similar medium-voltage collector systems.
• Experience with overhead medium-voltage distribution or collector systems, including pole layouts, conductor routing, line crossings, and overhead-to-underground transitions.
• Familiarity with overhead line design considerations including clearances, pole loading, guying, conductor selection, and utility design standards.
• Experience developing IFC-level renewable energy drawing packages.
• Familiarity with PV inverters, BESS PCS equipment, medium-voltage transformers, switchgear, collection systems, and equipment vendor drawings.
• Experience coordinating electrical designs with civil/site design and substation/interconnection design.
• AutoCAD Civil 3D, MicroStation, or other relevant design software experience is a plus.

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Solar PV & Battery Energy Storage Systems
jobs.description:
Timmons Group is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Energy team supporting utility-scale solar photovoltaic (PV) and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects.

The successful candidate will serve as a senior technical resource responsible for the electrical engineering and design of utility-scale PV and BESS facilities from conceptual and preliminary design through issued-for-construction (IFC) documents and construction support. This position will focus on electrical system design, engineering calculations, equipment application, technical review, and multidisciplinary design coordination.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with medium-voltage power systems and be capable of independently developing and reviewing complex electrical designs while providing technical guidance to other engineers and designers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Perform and lead the electrical engineering and design of utility-scale PV and BESS projects from conceptual design through IFC and construction support.
• Develop and review electrical one-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, equipment layouts, grounding plans, cable schedules, details, specifications, and construction documents.
• Design PV electrical systems including:DC collection systemsModule stringing and DC conductor sizingInverter systemsInverter loading and DC/AC configurationLow-voltage AC systemsMedium-voltage collection systemsGrounding and bondingAuxiliary power systemsElectrical balance-of-system equipment
• Design BESS electrical systems including:Battery and power conversion system (PCS) interfacesPCS and inverter configurationsMedium-voltage transformersSwitchgear and switchboardsMedium-voltage collection systemsStation and auxiliary powerGrounding and bondingElectrical balance-of-system equipment
• Develop underground and overhead medium-voltage collection systems, including system configuration, routing, conductor and cable sizing, equipment locations, pole layouts, risers, and overhead-to-underground transitions.
• Perform and review electrical engineering calculations, including:Cable and conductor sizingCable ampacity and thermal analysisVoltage dropLoad flowShort-circuit calculationsGrounding calculations and studiesEquipment ratings and applicationTransformer sizingAuxiliary load calculationsAC and DC system losses
• Develop electrical equipment requirements and technical specifications for inverters, PCS equipment, transformers, switchgear, reclosers, breakers, disconnects, cables, conductors, and other major electrical equipment.
• Review manufacturer drawings, equipment data sheets, technical submittals, and vendor documentation for compliance with project requirements.
• Evaluate equipment configurations and electrical design alternatives and provide recommendations based on system performance, constructability, reliability, and cost.
• Coordinate electrical interfaces with project substations, gen-tie systems, utility interconnections, protection and controls, SCADA/communications systems, and other project infrastructure.
• Coordinate electrical designs with civil, structural, geotechnical, substation, transmission, and other engineering disciplines.
• Apply applicable electrical codes, standards, utility requirements, and project-specific technical requirements to the design.
• Perform senior-level technical reviews of electrical calculations, drawings, specifications, equipment schedules, studies, and other engineering deliverables.
• Participate in design reviews and ensure electrical designs are complete, coordinated, constructable, and technically sound.
• Identify and resolve complex electrical design issues during engineering and construction.
• Respond to RFIs, review electrical submittals, and provide technical support during project construction and commissioning.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to electrical engineers and designers.
• Assist with the development and continuous improvement of electrical design standards, calculation templates, design tools, details, specifications, and QA/QC procedures.

Skills/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from an accredited engineering program.
• Minimum of 7 years of electrical engineering experience, with progressively increasing technical responsibility.
• Demonstrated electrical engineering experience with utility-scale solar PV, BESS, power generation, substations, industrial power systems, or other medium- and high-voltage power systems.
• Strong working knowledge of medium-voltage power distribution and collection systems.
• Experience developing and reviewing electrical calculations, one-line diagrams, equipment layouts, collection systems, grounding systems, cable schedules, wiring diagrams, specifications, and construction documents.
• Working knowledge of electrical equipment including transformers, switchgear, breakers, reclosers, disconnect switches, inverters, PCS equipment, cables, conductors, and grounding systems.
• Strong understanding of electrical engineering principles and applicable industry codes and standards.
• Ability to independently develop technical solutions and exercise sound engineering judgment.
• Ability to review the work of engineers and designers and provide clear technical direction.
• Strong technical communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with other engineering disciplines, equipment vendors, contractors, and clients.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.
• Direct electrical engineering experience with utility-scale solar PV and/or BESS projects.
• Experience designing projects from conceptual engineering through IFC design and construction support.
• Experience with 34.5 kV or similar medium-voltage collector systems.
• Experience with both underground and overhead medium-voltage collection systems.
• Detailed knowledge of PV inverters, BESS PCS equipment, battery systems, medium-voltage transformers, switchgear, reclosers, and associated electrical balance-of-system equipment.
• Experience performing or reviewing:Load flow studiesShort-circuit studiesCable ampacity studiesGrounding studiesVoltage-drop calculationsEquipment-duty evaluations
• Experience with industry-standard electrical analysis tools such as ETAP, CYMCAP, or equivalent power-system modeling software.
• Experience applying the National Electrical Code (NEC), National Electrical Safety Code (NESC), IEEE standards, and applicable utility requirements to renewable-energy projects.
• Experience coordinating electrical designs with substation, utility interconnection, protection and controls, SCADA, civil, structural, and transmission engineering disciplines.
• Experience providing technical mentorship and reviewing the work of junior electrical engineers and designers.

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, patient, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace. Candidates must share a commitment to our company’s Vision, Mission and Shared Values.

jobs.title: Solar PV Design & Optimization Engineer
jobs.description:
Timmons Group is seeking an experienced Solar PV Design & Optimization Engineer to join our Energy Division. This position will focus on the design, development, and optimization of utility-scale solar PV layouts. The successful candidate will combine PV system design knowledge with energy modeling to evaluate layout alternatives, equipment configurations, and site constraints and develop efficient, constructible, high-performing PV designs.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and optimize utility-scale solar PV layouts from conceptual design through detailed engineering.
• Evaluate site constraints, topography, grading, setbacks, environmental constraints, and equipment requirements to maximize developable capacity and energy production.
• Optimize key PV design parameters, including:Module and tracker selectionRow and table configurationRow spacing and ground coverage ratio (GCR)DC/AC ratioInverter loadingModule string sizing and configurationTracker block and inverter/PCS configurationsEquipment placement
• Develop and maintain PVsyst models to support layout development and design optimization.
• Evaluate the effects of terrain, near shading, electrical losses, mismatch, soiling, weather data, and other loss assumptions on energy production.
• Perform sensitivity analyses to understand the production impacts of alternative layouts and design configurations.
• Work closely with Timmons Group’s civil and electrical engineering teams to balance energy production, grading, constructability, electrical design, and overall project efficiency.
• Coordinate PV layouts with roads, stormwater facilities, substations, collection systems, wetlands, buffers, and other site constraints.
• Evaluate module, inverter, and tracker technologies and incorporate manufacturer-specific requirements into project designs.
• Support preliminary DC collection design, stringing, inverter loading, and equipment sizing.
• Review client, developer, and EPC layouts and identify opportunities for improved site utilization or performance.
• Support projects from feasibility and conceptual layout through IFC engineering.
• Develop and improve internal PV design, modeling, optimization, and QA/QC standards.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 4+ years of utility-scale solar PV design, layout, modeling, or engineering experience.
• Strong experience developing and optimizing utility-scale PV layouts.
• Proficiency with PVsyst.
• Strong understanding of:Single-axis tracker systemsPV modules and invertersDC collection systemsModule stringingDC/AC ratios and inverter loadingGCR and row spacingTerrain and shading effectsElectrical and system losses
• Ability to understand and work with topographic, environmental, civil, and electrical design constraints.
• Ability to evaluate layout alternatives based on more than MW capacity alone, considering energy production, grading, constructability, and electrical implications.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary civil and electrical engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced experience with PVsyst and utility-scale PV energy modeling.
• Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS, or specialized solar layout/design software.
• Experience with tracker manufacturer layout requirements and design tools.
• Experience with Python, pvlib, or other tools used for PV analysis or design automation.

• Experience supporting EPC, developer, EoR, or Owner’s Engineer projects.

jobs.title: Signals Discipline Lead  (Rail / Transit)
jobs.description:
AECOM Transportation in Philadelphia, PA is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Signals Discipline Lead with experience in rail and transit signal systems. The successful candidate will support the design, development, and implementation of signal engineering solutions for rail and transit infrastructure projects. The role includes preparing design drawings, technical specifications, and performing field investigations under the guidance of senior engineering staff or project managers.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the planning, design, and delivery of rail and transit signal systems through conceptual, preliminary, final design, and construction support phases for light rail, commuter rail, heavy rail, and freight rail projects.
• Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and engineering oversight to mid-level and junior engineers, designers, and CAD staff, including performing QA/QC reviews and supporting staff development.
• Develop signal design packages including signal layouts, interlocking plans, control line diagrams, route and aspect charts, cable routing plans, signal house layouts, equipment location plans, and associated construction documents.
• Design and analyze wayside signal systems, interlockings, switch machine systems, train detection systems, vital and non-vital logic, and highway-rail grade crossing warning systems in accordance with industry standards and client requirements.
• Prepare engineering calculations, technical specifications, bills of materials, cost estimates, design reports, and other technical documentation required to support project delivery.
• Coordinate signal system interfaces with traction power, communications, SCADA, OCS, train control, track, civil, roadway, station, and utility systems to ensure successful multidisciplinary integration.
• Support the design, integration, testing, and commissioning of conventional signaling, Positive Train Control (PTC), Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC), Automatic Train Protection (ATP), and Automatic Train Control (ATC) systems.
• Support project planning and execution activities, including scope development, resource forecasting, schedule management, technical risk assessment, proposal preparation, fee development, and business development efforts.
• Conduct field investigations, site inspections, diagnostic reviews, testing, commissioning, cutovers, and construction support activities, including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and supporting revenue service implementation.
• Interface with clients, railroads, contractors, regulatory agencies, and project stakeholders while ensuring compliance with FRA, FTA, AREMA, MUTCD, railroad owner standards, and applicable safety, quality, and environmental requirements.
• Lead factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, cutover planning, and revenue service implementation activities for signal, train control, and grade crossing systems.
• Develop signal design criteria, standards, specifications, engineer’s cost estimates, and evaluate alternative technical solutions and value engineering opportunities to improve safety, reliability, constructability, and lifecycle costs.
• Support and coordinate highway-rail grade crossings, traffic signal preemption and transit signal priority (TSP) systems, while interfacing with FRA, railroads, transit agencies, roadway authorities, utility owners, and other project stakeholders throughout project development and implementation.
• Assist in leading the growth and development of the Signals practice, including recruiting, staff development, succession planning, resource management, and technical capability enhancement.
• Serve as the technical point of contact for signal engineering projects and support multidisciplinary coordination across traction power, communications, systems integration, and other rail disciplines.
• Support proposal development, technical presentations, client engagement, and strategic business development efforts to expand the Signals practice and strengthen client relationships.
• Develop and maintain signal engineering standards, specifications, design criteria, lessons learned, and best practices to promote consistency and technical excellence across projects.
• Provide technical leadership for major corridor modernization, expansion, and state-of-good-repair programs while ensuring quality, constructability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field plus 8 years of relevant experience in rail signal design, testing, or construction or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure or ability and willingness to obtain within two years of hire.
• Experience with AREMA guidelines, FRA regulations, and signal design practices.
• Experience with CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, MicroStation)
• Experience with reading and programming logic and vital logic equations.
• Experience working with microprocessor-based vital logic controllers such as ElectroLogIXS and Microlock II.
• Experience with the working principles of DC and AC track circuits.
• Experience with CAB signaling design and coded track circuits, audio frequency track circuits, and phase shift overlay circuits.

Preferred Experience :

• 12 years of relevant experience in rail signal design, testing, or construction.
• Working knowledge of legacy and modern interlocking systems.
• Familiarity with signal vendors (e.g., Siemens, Alstom, Hitachi, Wabtec).
• Knowledge of relay or microprocessor-based interlocking systems.
• Field or construction support experience including signal cutover or testing.
• Professional Engineer(PE) License.
• Project Management Professional(PMP) License.
• Strong problem-solving, written communication, and documentation skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.

• We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States. Sponsorship may be available for current visa holders in the United States.
• Relocation assistance may be available for this role.

jobs.title: Assistant City Solicitor – Commercial Law Unit – Pensions and Finance Division
jobs.description:
The City of Philadelphia Law Department seeks a licensed attorney to join the Commercial Law Unit’s Pensions and Finance Division.  The ideal candidate is expected to perform the following duties:

• Advise and represent City departments, in particular, the City’s Finance Director, Pension Board, Sinking Fund, Treasurer’s Office, and Commerce Department, including the Offices of Economic Opportunity and Business Impact & Economic Advancement;

• Provide legal counsel on contract issues, particularly with respect to legal questions arising from the Philadelphia Code, Home Rule Charter, securities and banking laws, and other applicable areas of law;

• Draft, review, and negotiate terms and conditions for a variety of contracts for the procurement of professional services, investment management agreements, limited partnership agreements and side letters, and municipal financing transactions;

• Help develop, draft, and review Requests for Proposals, statements of work for professional service contracts.

Essential Functions

The functions listed below are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or essential functions. Duties may be modified, assigned, or reassigned as operational needs evolve, consistent with applicable law.

• Drafting all manner of contracts, transactional documents, side letters, NDAs, and other agreements;

• Communicating with City business stakeholders and subject matter experts, vendors, and others involved in business and commercial law matters;

• Conducting research, drafting legal opinions, and analyzing legal issues related to commercial law;

• Interpreting laws, rulings, and regulations for individuals and government agencies, including the Philadelphia Code, the Philadelphia Home Rule Charter, procurement law, and securities and banking laws;

• Analyzing the risk profile of proposed transactions in consult with the City’s Division of Risk Management;

• Provide guidance on various complex financing and contracting matters;

• Reviewing, evaluating, and periodically updating form contract and solicitation documents to account for changes in the law, improve legal terms and conditions, and improve the quality of contract documents; and

• Performing administrative functions related to the practice of law.

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Knowledge of laws, legal codes, government regulations, executive orders, agency rules and process.

• Ability to analyze large amounts of information, determine relevant facts, and propose viable solutions.

• Ability to find what applicable laws and regulations apply to a specific matter.

• Ability to handle time-sensitive, complex negotiations with sophisticated opposing counsel.

• Ability to draft and negotiate nuanced language adhering to City legal and policy framework.

• Ability to communicate information and ideas in writing in a concise and diplomatic manner. Must be able to clearly present and explain complex legal matters to large groups and high-level officials and employ diplomacy in challenging situations.

• Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to work on teams and collaborate with colleagues and clients.

• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity in the office that values all individuals and respects difference.

• Excellent research and writing skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to identify and analyze legal issues within complex fact patterns.

• Ability to organize and maintain a high-volume workload.

• Ability to work independently.

Continued employment of attorneys not admitted to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania within six (6) months of hire is at the discretion of the Law Department.

jobs.title: Office Coordinator
jobs.description:
About On Board Experiential (OBE)

OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly-but-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.

We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Office Coordinator plays a key role in creating a welcoming, organized, and efficient workplace experience for employees and guests. This position is responsible for supporting day-to-day office operations, including facilities coordination, vendor management, supply and inventory oversight, workspace upkeep, and employee experience initiatives. The Office Coordinator serves as a local point of contact for office-related needs and helps ensure the office remains a productive, professional, and engaging environment.

This is a part-time, non-exempt position based in our New York City office. The ideal candidate is highly organized, service-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities independently. They enjoy creating exceptional workplace experiences, solving problems, and partnering across teams to support both employees and the overall success of the office.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a highly organized, professional, and service-oriented team member who thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in keeping people, processes, and operations running smoothly.

You enjoy supporting a wide range of responsibilities, including office operations, employee onboarding, administrative coordination, executive support, and employee experience initiatives. No task is too small, and you approach your work with professionalism, sound judgment, and attention to detail.

You build strong relationships across teams, navigate varying priorities with professionalism, and remain adaptable in a dynamic environment.

You are proactive in identifying process improvements and leveraging technology, including AI-powered tools, to streamline administrative work and improve efficiency. You also enjoy supporting team events, outings, and workplace initiatives that strengthen culture and connection.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Office Operations & Maintenance

• Manage incoming office deliveries and distribute items to employees

• Coordinate general office maintenance (HVAC, restrooms, etc.) by liaising with building management

• Oversee upkeep of office equipment and appliances (coffee machine, water dispenser, air purifiers, filter replacements)

• Supervise the maintenance and alteration of office areas and equipment, as well as layout, arrangement and housekeeping of office facilities.

• Initiate corrective actions as needed to ensure smooth office operations and a safe working environment

• Process incoming and outgoing mail communications, both internally and externally, maintaining professional image

• Proactively look for opportunities to improve operational efficiency by leveraging AI and technology tools to automate routine administrative and coordination tasks.

Supplies & Inventory Management

• Order and restock office supplies (snacks, beverages, paper goods, etc.)

• Negotiate and execute the purchase of office supplies, furniture, and office equipment to obtain the best deals possible without sacrificing quality and within approval limits

• Maintain organization and inventory of supply areas, including the office supply closet and IT storage shelves

Workspace Upkeep

• Ensure the office is presentable for employees and guests (e.g., clear hallways, tidy conference rooms)

• Support cleanliness and organization of the storage spaces

• Ensure conference rooms are prepared in advance of client meetings

Office Coordination

• Update and maintain the desk assignments and capacity grids, as applicable

• Assist with office moves and space reconfigurations

• Create and maintain a directory of key office contacts and vendors (names, roles, phone numbers)

• Manage office build-out, maintaining good vendor/contractor relationships and timely follow-up

Employee Experience Initiatives

• Coordinate “Together Tuesday” lunch orders via DoorDash business account

• Provide catering or procure refreshments as requested for special occasions and office events

• Contribute ideas and support initiatives that enhance the employee office experience (monthly b-day, new hire welcoming)

• Plan and budget for office outings and culture building activities

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Education & Experience

• 1-2 years of experience in office administration, office coordination, workplace experience, hospitality, facilities coordination, administrative support, or related roles

• High school diploma or equivalent - required; associate or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hospitality, Communications, Human Resources, Event Management, or a related field – preferred

• Experience coordinating vendors, supplies, facilities requests, and/or office services

• Experience managing multiple priorities and working independently in a fast-paced environment

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Exceptional organizational and time management skills

• Ability to prioritize competing request and manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Strong attention to detail and follow-through

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive relationship across all levels of the organization

• Service-oriented mindset with a focus on creating a welcoming and professional office environment

• Ability to identify issues proactively and implement practical solutions

• Sound judgment and ability to escalate issues appropriately

• Comfortable working independently and making day-to-day decisions within established guidelines

• Ability to coordinate with building management, vendors, contractors, and service providers

• Understanding of basic office operations, facilities maintenance, and workplace safety practices

• Proficiency with Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word)

• Ability to learn new systems and technologies quickly

• Natural curiosity—the drive to always be learning and growing, professionally and personally.

Other Qualities & Skills

• Passion for creating a positive employee experience

• Ability to anticipate office needs before issues arise

• Strong hospitality mindset and attention to presentation

• Comfortable partnering with senior leaders while supporting employees at all levels

• Flexible and comfortable in a dynamic, fast-changing environment

• Willingness to support occasional special projects, office events, and workplace initiatives

• Ability to lift and move packages and office supplies up to 25 pounds

• Ability to walk throughout the office and perform routine office inspections and inventory checks

• Willingness to work a hybrid schedule (up to 4 days in office).

Work Schedule

• This is a part-time position scheduled for approximately 24 hours per week and is primarily based in our New York office.

• The anticipated schedule is Monday and Wednesday from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. and Tuesday and Thursday from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional flexibility may be required to support company events, team meetings, or other business needs.

Compensation Range: $25.00 - $35.00 hour. This is the pay range OBE believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the level of experience, relevant skills, professional certifications, market pay, and demand for the role. OBE reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Revenue Accounting
jobs.description:
POS-34053

Senior Manager, Technical Revenue Accounting (Individual Contributor)

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Technical Revenue Accounting to be the company's deepest ASC 606 technical resource below the Director of Revenue. You will research and conclude on complex and non-standard revenue arrangements, shape revenue policy, and make sure new pricing, packaging, and go-to-market initiatives are accounted for correctly and on time. The company's pricing and consumption models are evolving quickly as the business moves deeper into AI, and revenue accounting has to move with it. This role needs someone who adapts quickly, is comfortable with ambiguity, and can reach sound accounting conclusions while the business model is evolving.

In this role you'll get to:

• Own technical accounting conclusions for complex and non-standard contracts, including multi-element arrangements, variable consideration, customer incentives, contract modifications, and usage-based and consumption pricing

• Author and maintain global ASC 606 policy, technical memos, and position papers that evolve with the business and stand up to auditor and SEC scrutiny

• Review contract waterfalls and calculations for complex arrangements, including material rights and termination provisions

• Own the stand-alone selling price (SSP) determination and refresh process, including supporting documentation

• Engage early in go-to-market initiatives, such as pricing changes, launches, bundling, and evolving consumption models, to separate accounting requirements from business choices, flag risks before terms are final, and recommend practical alternatives

• Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Product, Pricing, Legal, and FP&A on non-standard contract structures and approval frameworks, explaining accounting implications in plain language

• Design and maintain SOX controls over contract review, SSP, and other judgment-based processes, and support walkthroughs and testing

• Define accounting requirements for new revenue scenarios in the revenue system ( AREV) and work with Revenue Operations, Finance Systems, and the Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting to test and validate configuration changes and system assumptions

• Coach revenue accountants and partner teams on technical topics and the principles behind policies and controls

• Lead special projects and company-wide initiatives that need deep technical revenue expertise

• Use AI tools to speed up research, contract review, and memo drafting, with appropriate review and controls

We are looking for people who have:

• Extensive accounting experience with a focus on technical revenue accounting, including public accounting (Big 4 or national firm) and a public company SaaS or technology environment; CPA required

• Expert knowledge of ASC 606 and US GAAP, especially for SaaS, usage-based, and multi-product bundled revenue models

• A track record of writing technical accounting memos and defending conclusions with external auditors and the SEC

• Experience designing internal controls based on a thorough grasp of the fact pattern and the risks, with strong knowledge of SOX compliance and SEC reporting requirements

• Working knowledge of revenue systems (e.g., AREV, NetSuite, Oracle RMCS, Zuora Revenue, or similar) and the ability to translate technical accounting into system requirements

• Ability to explain complex accounting impacts to executives and non-accountants at the right level of detail

• Sound judgment: able to cut through the noise to the core of a problem, take a position, document the reasoning, and hold it under challenge

• Ability to build and influence working relationships at all levels across Sales, Product, Legal, and Finance without direct authority

• A record of adapting quickly in a changing business: comfortable with ambiguity, able to reset priorities on short notice, and able to reach defensible conclusions on evolving pricing and consumption models before precedent exists
