jobs.description:
POS-34054

Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting (Operations)

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting to run the execution side of our revenue accounting function. You will own the monthly and quarterly revenue close, the revenue sub-ledger and reconciliations, and the control environment around them, and you will drive automation so the close scales with the business. You will partner closely with the Senior Manager, Technical Revenue Accounting, who sets the technical conclusions, while you make sure they are applied accurately and on time in the system and the close. The company's pricing and consumption models are evolving and you will need to keep the close process, system configuration, and controls aligned as those changes occur.

In this role you'll get to:

• Own the revenue close, including the close calendar, sub-ledger reconciliations, contract asset and receivable roll-forwards, and revenue journal entries and flux analyses

• Lead and develop a team of revenue accountants, setting priorities, reviewing work, and building a culture of accuracy and ownership

• Own day-to-day operation of the revenue system and its integrations (e.g., AREV, NetSuite, Looker), including rule configuration, and data integrity

• Apply policies and conclusions from Technical Revenue Accounting in routine contract reviews

• Own the revenue SOX control environment, including control design and operation, evidence, remediation, and audit walkthroughs and testing

• Prepare and review revenue disclosures for quarterly SEC reporting, including RPO, revenue by location, and deferred revenue roll-forwards

• Provide timely revenue reporting to FP&A and support forecasting and bookings-to-revenue bridges

• Drive process improvement and automation, using AI tools and workflow technology to reduce manual effort in reconciliations, variance analysis, and close, with controls in place

• Operationalize new pricing, packaging, launches, and evolving consumption models by translating accounting guidance into system configuration, data requirements, and close procedures

We are looking for people who have:

• Extensive professional accounting experience, including leading teams, in a public company SaaS or technology environment and/or a Big 4 or national firm; CPA preferred

• Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 and the ability to apply established policy to a high volume of contracts

• Hands-on experience owning a month-end and quarter-end revenue close in a public company, with a record of improving cycle time and accuracy

• Experience with revenue reporting infrastructure (e.g., AREV, NetSuite, or similar), including sub-ledger reconciliation and system implementation or enhancement projects

• Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, internal controls, and audit support, and SEC reporting requirements

• A process-minded, data-driven approach, with advanced Excel and SQL or BI skills a plus

• Strong leadership, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills across Accounting, Finance Systems, Billing, Sales Ops, and FP&A

jobs.title: Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Pricing Analyst with International SOS Government Medical Services, you'll turn labor, staffing, and financial data into cost models that support pricing decisions for federal proposals.

Working with the Senior Pricing Analyst and FP&A Director, you'll evaluate proposal costs, contract profitability, and pricing assumptions while collaborating with proposal, operations, and finance teams.

Must have a minimum of 3 years of experience with a U.S. Government contracting company, plus 5 years of work experience in the USA.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain pricing models and templates for federal proposals, validating labor, materials, overhead, and other costs while documenting assumptions and supporting data.
• Analyze staffing requirements, compensation by locality, prevailing wage rates, and contract-specific requirements to develop accurate labor pricing inputs.
• Evaluate proposal and contract profitability, summarizing cost trade-offs, financial performance, and expected margins for management review.
• Support pricing approaches for FFP, CPFF, T&M, and IDIQ proposals, following established procedures and FAR, DFARS, and company compliance guidance. Identify and escalate pricing or compliance issues for review.
• Research labor rates, material costs, and available competitor information to update pricing assumptions and support proposal decisions.
• Review pricing models for accuracy, formula integrity, and consistency with proposal requirements; assist with peer reviews and additional financial analyses.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in pricing, cost analysis, or program finance within U.S. Government contracting.
• Experience supporting federal pricing proposals.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or similar analytical tools, including building cost models, analyzing financial data, and validating calculations.
• Understanding of government contract cost elements, profitability drivers, and the financial impact of pricing assumptions.
• Ability to follow pricing compliance requirements, maintain supporting documentation, and identify issues requiring additional review.
• Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills, with excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple pricing assignments, explain financial assumptions, and meet proposal deadlines.

About Us

Sharebite is the leading meal benefits platform built exclusively for companies to feed their employees. Our platform allows employees to order meals from any restaurant while streamlining all of the ordering & billing requirements for the company. Every meal ordered through the Sharebite platform results in a meal donation to local partners like City Harvest and Feeding America.

As a Senior Marketing Associate, you will support the execution of Sharebite’s content and communications programs across social, email, industry media, and public relations. You will help build brand awareness, support the sales pipeline, and deepen engagement with our clients and mission-driven partners. The ideal candidate is a creative, data-driven marketer who can turn ideas into high-quality content, test new channels and formats, and collaborate effectively with Sales, Product, and Customer Account Management. This role is ideal for someone who is ready to take ownership of meaningful marketing programs while continuing to grow their strategic and cross-functional skills.

This is a remote role, but ideally candidates are based in or around one of the following locations: New York City, San Francisco (Bay Area), Los Angeles, Chicago, Washington DC, Austin, Boston, Seattle, Minneapolis, Denver or Nashville.

What You’ll Do

• Lead the planning and execution of What’s Working, Sharebite’s owned content series, including a weekly newsletter and monthly podcast.

• Manage Sharebite’s social content calendar and execution, with a focus on video content for LinkedIn and opportunities to build our presence on Instagram and TikTok.

• Create and edit short-form video content and design branded assets for LinkedIn and other social channels using tools such as CapCut, Canva, or similar platforms.

• Manage industry award submissions and support media relations, including press releases and other communications.

• Build and optimize email nurture flows in HubSpot to engage with prospects and drive sales meetings.

• Partner with the Client Account Management team on customer communications, including a quarterly newsletter designed to increase engagement and retention.

• Liaise with Feeding America and City Harvest to develop content, programs, and events that enable our prospects and clients to connect with our mission.

Required Skills and Experience

• 4+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally at a SaaS company—marketplace experience is a bonus

• Strong cross-functional partner with excellent communication skills

• Highly organized with the ability to effectively manage competing priorities

• Strong strategic problem-solving and business acumen skills

• Proven track record of meeting or exceeding goals

• Familiarity with HubSpot preferred

• Experience creating branded assets in Canva or a similar design tool; experience with video editing tools such as CapCut is a plus

At Sharebite, we are committed to providing competitive pay and benefits that are in line with industry and market standards. The base compensation range for this role is $90k - $105k per year, however actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, and location. Salary is just one component of Sharebite's total compensation package, which includes equity, generous health insurance options, and a wide range of benefits and perks including a daily meal stipend.

At Sharebite, we're passionate about our mission to alleviate hunger and inspire employees to connect their work to a larger purpose. We know being well fed is an essential ingredient for employee wellbeing, team performance, and company culture - we've seen the results! Sharebite is proud to have been recognized as Inc. Magazine's Best in Business, Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators, and Inc 5000's Fastest Growing Companies.

Join our team and help bring do-good, feel-good eating to the world.

Sharebite is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@sharebite.com.

jobs.title: Associate Policy & Governance Officer (Gaming Compliance)
jobs.description:
Company Description

We are SkillOnNet, leading the igaming entertainment by providing our customers with the most entertaining and trustworthy experience possible, while also reinventing the gambling industry. We are home to more than 30 well-known brands, including PlayOJO, DruckGluck, BacanaPlay, Genting, and many more. We are committed to long-term development and sustainability, and we are trying to revolutionise our industry for the benefit of our players, ourselves, and the entertainment industry as a whole.

Job Description

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented professional to join our Compliance team as an Associate Policy & Governance Officer. As part of the Policy & Governance subdivision within the Compliance Department, you will independently manage a portfolio of gaming licences across our regulated markets, which include Malta, the UK, Ontario, Denmark, Sweden, Portugal and Spain.

For each assigned licence you will be responsible for interpreting regulatory requirements, drafting policies and operational procedures and developing training materials to ensure that staff understand and effectively apply these requirements in their day-to-day operations.

Responsibilities include:

• Monitor the laws, regulations, licence conditions and guidance applicable to your markets. Brief colleagues on what has changed, which activities are affected, and when action is required.
• Draft and update Marketing Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Safer Gambling policies. Where local requirements differ, propose license-specific wording for approval.

• Create onboarding and refresher materials for each license, using practical scenarios and knowledge checks. Update the materials when regulations, policies or procedures change.
• Coordinate implementation with AML, Safer Gambling and Marketing Compliance. Agree on owners and deadlines, follow up on open actions and flag delays or unresolved issues at an early stage.
• Keep approved policies, procedures and training materials current in the policy management system, with a record of versions and approvals.
• Support departmental administration and reporting. Keep stakeholders informed of decisions and open actions for your licenses.

What we are looking for:

• Ideally 1–3 years of experience in compliance, policy, legal, or risk management. Gaming industry experience and familiarity with B2B or B2C gaming operations will be considered as an advantage.
• Ideally a bachelor's degree in a business-related field such as law, finance, risk management, or a similar discipline (e.g., ICA, ACAMS, legal studies).
• Foundational understanding of regulatory compliance, governance, or licensing obligations.
• Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Confluence-Jira (optional), task management tools (Click-Up or Similar).
• Strong research and analytical abilities with keen attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills - strong presenting and report writing skills. Ability to exercise initiative, discretion, and judgement.
• Highly organised, proactive, and capable of managing multiple tasks effectively.
• Integrity, accountability, and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

• Eligibility to enrol in Company's medical insurance plan
• Eligibility to enrol in Company's pension plan
• Exciting company activities including monthly lunches, corporate gatherings, an intercompany football team, competitions, and many other activities
• Casual dress code
• A chance to advance professionally inside one of the world's largest iGaming organisations

SkillOnNet is a firm believer in putting people first and our “family oriented” multinational culture is what drives us. We care and focus on our staff and ensure that you are provided with the most relevant and valuable tools, privileges and amenities.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer I
jobs.description:
Tines is the complete environment for enterprise AI, trusted by organizations like Reddit, SAP, Mars, Fin, and Headspace. Tines gives all teams a safe, scalable way to turn their expertise into software, whatever their technical background.

Since its founding in 2018, Tines has enabled over 600 enterprise customers to run their most important work, where reliability and security aren't optional. From IT and business operations to security and beyond, Tines empowers teams to build apps, agents and automations to solve complex problems and bring their ideas to life.

Founded by Eoin Hinchy and Thomas Kinsella and co-headquartered in Dublin and Boston, Tines is truly agnostic and helps organizations bring their entire technology stack – any model, any tool, any system, any infrastructure – together.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

A Technical Support Engineer provides technical support and consultation to customers and colleagues. They are essential in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, providing timely resolutions, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

This position focuses on responding to, owning, and resolving users' technical queries.

What you will be doing

• Handling technical inquiries received across multiple channels (Slack, in-app chat, and email), maintaining high standards for responsiveness and ticket hygiene

• Troubleshoot customer inquiries, including but not limited to API integrations, systems issues, network and security-related impediments, 3rd party integrations, and multi-product workflows

• Resolve product or service problems by exploring the client's request, determining the cause of the problem, and selecting and explaining the best solution to solve the problem

• Interpreting API documents and creating Tines workflows

• Configuring and implementing authentication types like OAuth and JWT

• Documenting the steps needed to connect to new tools or document any new workflows

• Building, troubleshooting, documenting, and modifying workflows on remote sessions with customers

• Building strong relationships with other team members within Support and the wider company, acting as the voice of the customer, and maintaining continuity with the team's priorities and open issues despite working outside standard team hours for part of the week

• Contribute to Customer Support resources and deliver meaningful product feedback as the voice of the customer to leadership and relevant internal teams

• Proactively identifying improvements to the product, bugs, and otherwise determining high-impact opportunities to enhance the customer experience

• Writing clear, structured handover notes at the start and end of each shift so incoming and outgoing regional teams have full context with no gaps

• Making independent judgment calls on prioritization, troubleshooting approach, and escalation while working solo during unsupervised weekend hours, including recognizing when an issue requires paging an on-call engineer or escalating outside normal hours

What you will bring to the role

• 2+ years of technical support experience within a SaaS environment, ideally in automation or a related field

• Practical experience constructing, testing, and debugging REST and GraphQL API requests, using developer documentation and SDK examples to understand and troubleshoot integrations

• Exposure to implementing or troubleshooting AI actions and agentic workflows, including LLM APIs, prompt structures, and protocols such as MCP

• Experience troubleshooting in a web-based environment, including HTTP, SSL, and basic networking

• Excellent communication, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, including clear written communication for handover documentation given the reliance on asynchronous handoffs with other regional shifts

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical and technical stakeholders alike

• Experience handling inbound technical customer requests in various form channels (chat, email)

• A proven track record of customer empathy, urgency, and technical competency

• Self-motivated and goal-oriented with excellent organizational and time management skills and a consistent quality bar whether working alongside the team or solo

• Familiarity with at least one modern programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, or Ruby

• Familiarity with query languages such as SQL, and GraphQL

• Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, make sound decisions without direct supervision, and exercise good judgment on when to escalate versus solve independently

• Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed problem-solving, including researching solutions independently using documentation, runbooks, and prior tickets

• Resilience and composure when handling difficult technical or customer issues without immediate backup or a second opinion

• Ability to context-switch effectively between collaborative, team-based work (weekdays) and independent, self-directed work (weekends) without losing continuity

Desirable Experience

• An understanding of computer networking principles (Firewalls, Network Protocols, Subnetting)

• Experience supporting customers using AI and experience with leveraging AI to increase professional effectiveness

• Tines certification

• Familiarity with Docker containers, Postgres, Redis/Valkey, load balancers, and cloud orchestration platforms (AWS, Azure, GKE, OpenShift), sufficient to triage and troubleshoot

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $85,000 – $95,000 per year. This range reflects our good-faith estimate of the base salary we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Art Director, Social
jobs.description:
Equinox is seeking a highly creative, culturally connected, and social-first Art Director to lead and shape the next evolution of how the brand shows up across social.

Managing the team, the Social Art Director will serve as the primary creative lead—driving concept development, visual storytelling, content innovation, and execution across organic social. This person will be responsible for translating the Equinox brand into compelling social experiences that inspire, engage, and move culture while maintaining the premium, aspirational aesthetic synonymous with the brand.

The ideal candidate is equal parts creative visionary and hands-on maker: someone who can develop content franchises, lead ideation sessions, art direct shoots, edit content, and bring ideas to life through design, motion, and storytelling. They possess a deep understanding of social platforms, emerging trends, creator culture, and evolving consumer behaviors, with the ability to balance brand excellence with platform relevance.

Creative Leadership & Strategy

• Partner closely with the VP of Creative as the lead creative voice for Equinox social channels, defining and evolving the social aesthetic, creative direction, and visual tone across platforms.
• Develop innovative, social-first creative concepts that support key business priorities, brand campaigns, memberships, clubs, instructors, fitness programming, and cultural moments.
• Translate broader brand strategies into engaging platform-specific content experiences.
• Partner closely with social, brand marketing, creative, partnerships, and content teams to ensure a cohesive brand expression across channels.
• Manage a team of in-house content creators.
• Champion creative excellence while continually identifying ways to make the brand more relevant and engaging within social culture.

Content Development & Storytelling

• Create narrative-driven content concepts that align with brand priorities and social objectives, bringing a strong editorial mindset to storytelling, sequencing, and audience engagement strategies.
• Develop scalable content franchises and repeatable formats that drive audience engagement and brand affinity.
• Lead rapid ideation sessions, generating timely concepts inspired by social trends, cultural moments, and audience insights.

Art Direction & Production

• Lead art direction for photo and video shoots from concept through execution.
• Partner with producers and external creative partners to develop shoot plans, mood boards, shot lists, and creative briefs.
• Identify and source photographers, videographers, editors, motion designers, and other creative collaborators as needed.
• Oversee post-production to ensure all content meets brand standards and platform best practices.

Design, Motion & Execution

• Create best-in-class social creative across static, motion, and video formats, directing editorial of video content and motion graphics (or hands-on editing as needed) optimized for social platforms.
• Transform existing brand assets into engaging social-first content.
• Ensure all creative work reflects Equinox's premium visual identity while adapting to platform behaviors and audience expectations.

• 4-6 years of experience in social-first creative, art direction, content design, or creative leadership roles.

• Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging social platforms.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (Asphalt 9)
jobs.description:

• Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager (08964) - 6401 Stirling Rd
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager

Born to Lead

Being a Domino's Assistant Manager is more than just a job - it's a career. We're all about fun, but we take your career ambitions very seriously. As someone that likes a challenge, you'll love sinking your teeth into life as a Domino's manager. We want our people to enjoy coming to work, and Domino's managers are no different. Yes, you're responsible for the success of the store and its staff, but we still want you to enjoy achieving it. Chances are if you're having fun, everyone is.

Domino's Pizza loves Domino's people

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential. In other words, we want you to be yourself, and as a Domino's Asst Manager that's exactly what you can be. You'll get to flex your creative muscles, thinking up new ways to drive Domino's fun culture. Sell more pizza, have more fun! It's as simple as that. You'll have the chance to progress far quicker here. If you like the thought of managing your own million-dollar business, then Domino's Pizza is the place for you.

Drive your own career

Being a Domino's Assistant Manager isn't your average management gig. Domino's managers aren't just concerned with their own training; they're constantly supporting and pushing the team to go that one better. It's what makes it such a rewarding place to work. And the way Domino's works, it could be just the beginning. Many of our team members began their careers as Assistant Managers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From assistant manager to general manager to franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

Job Requirements and Duties

As an Assistant Manager, you are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition, you’ll be responsible for Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash Control, Food Management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and Adherence to Standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & Punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store Cleanliness, Marketing, and Profitability

Standing

Walking

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push

· Trays may also be pulled

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients

Crouching/Squatting

· Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential; use of hands is continuous during the day

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands

· Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists

jobs.title: Heavy Equipment Field Technician (Mechanic)
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Heavy Equipment Field Technician (Mechanic)

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Heavy Equipment Field Technician (Mechanic) at our rental facility in Athens, GA, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, provide maintenance and repair for a variety of customer and company owned heavy equipment machinery and aerial lifts and help us build the future of construction. Mechanics will have the opportunity to work on the newest fleet in the industry.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (This role is subject to on-call scheduling with additional compensation provided)

Primary Responsibilities

As a Field Technician, you’ll use our tech to create, assign, and monitor work orders, track machine service intervals, order parts, and diagnose issues faster by pulling data from hundreds of makes and models. With real-time information at your fingertips, you can determine the root cause and corrective action for each issue quickly, enabling you to work smarter, not harder.

• Practice safe job practices for repairing equipment

• Use technology (laptops and tablets) comfortably

• Maintenance and repair of complex mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and diesel systems on a variety of rental and customer equipment and tools while using a high degree of independent judgment

• Assist in the training of lower level technicians as needed

• Maintain paperwork/electronic documentation of work performed (work orders) in a complete and timely manner on a daily basis

• Assist with pick-up and delivery of equipment & parts

• Be knowledgeable of OSHA requirements (preferred)

• Field Mechanic: When required, travel to customer job sites for repair/maintenance of rental or customer owned equipment; must maintain service vehicle in a clean and professional manner

• Year-round company provided OEM training

• Other duties, assigned as needed

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

• Access to industry leading diagnostic tools

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

• Must own tools applicable to position

• Advanced mechanical aptitude and working knowledge of tools

• Extensive knowledge of construction equipment with an advanced understanding of schematics and diagrams

• Superior customer service, teamwork and verbal/written communication skills

Education and Experience:

• High School diploma, Trade school certificate preferred

• Experience in field service, maintenance and repair preferred

• Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record. Must be at least 21 years old to operate company vehicle.

• Must have a clean driving record

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to move, stand, stoop and bend freely

• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times

• Field Technicians may be required to be clean shaven in order to enter worksites for EquipmentShare customers who have this requirement

• This is a safety sensitive position and any offer of employment will be contingent on passing a 10 panel drug screen

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Company overview:

TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.

Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.

Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.

Director, Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation

Location: Wilmington, MA, United States (Full-time on-site)

Position Summary

TraceLink is seeking an exceptional Director, Integrated Campaigns & Demand Generation to lead the strategy, execution, and performance of our global demand generation programs. This leader will play a critical role in scaling TraceLink's commercial growth by translating our technology innovations, thought leadership, and product offerings into integrated campaigns that generate qualified sales meetings, create pipeline, and accelerate revenue opportunities.

The Director will lead a team of campaign marketers and partner closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Sales Enablement, Sales, Marketing Operations, Sales Ops, GTM Engineering, GTM Intelligence, and our Brand, Content, and Digital teams to deliver compelling, coordinated go-to-market programs. A key priority will be building a scalable demand generation engine that supports TraceLink's Agentic Business Process commercialization strategy, from category awareness through solution-specific engagement and qualified commercial opportunities.

We are looking for a leader, a builder, a doer.. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who can develop sophisticated campaign strategies, lead a high-performing team, and personally drive initiatives through execution. The right candidate combines strategic thinking with operational discipline, strong marketing technology expertise, creative judgment, and a commitment to measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Integrated Campaign Strategy & Demand Generation

• Own the global integrated campaign strategy, translating corporate, product, and commercial priorities into executable demand generation programs.

• Design and deliver full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns that build awareness, engage target accounts, generate qualified sales meetings, and contribute to pipeline growth.

• Develop account-based, persona-driven, industry-specific, functional, and solution-oriented campaigns targeting executive, business, and technology decision-makers.

• Define campaign audiences, segmentation, messaging, offers, channel mix, buyer journeys, and conversion strategies.

• Establish scalable campaign frameworks that support product commercialization, emerging market opportunities, and expansion into complex industries and business functions.

• Manage campaign priorities, budgets, resources, and investment decisions based on commercial impact and performance.

Lead Campaign Performance, Operations & Team Development

• Lead, coach, and develop a geographically distributed team of campaign marketers, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and high execution standards.

• Establish effective campaign planning, intake, prioritization, production, and reporting processes that improve speed, quality, and scalability.

• Provide senior leadership with clear performance insights, recommendations, and accountability for results.

• Own campaign performance measurement, including engagement, conversion, qualified meetings, pipeline contribution, and marketing return on investment.

• Partner with Marketing Operations to leverage marketing automation, CRM, intent data, analytics, and attribution capabilities to improve performance.

• Use data and commercial feedback to optimize active campaigns, refine investment priorities, and continuously improve the demand generation engine.

• Leverage emerging AI-powered marketing capabilities to accelerate campaign development, personalization, analysis, and team productivity.

Drive Hands-On Campaign Development & Execution

• Take end-to-end ownership of campaign delivery, from strategy and planning through launch, measurement, and optimization.

• Personally contribute to campaign development, including briefs, messaging, email copy, offers, creative direction, landing pages, and conversion strategies.

• Direct integrated execution spanning email, paid social, search, display, content syndication, webinars, events, organic channels, and sales outreach.

• Work closely with Marketing Operations and GTM Intelligence to ensure accurate audience targeting, marketing automation, lead management, campaign tracking, and launch readiness.

• Proactively identify and resolve execution bottlenecks, maintain momentum, and ensure campaigns launch on time and to a high standard.

• Continuously test and optimize campaign messaging, creative, channels, and conversion paths to improve results.

Lead Cross-Functional Go-to-Market Collaboration

• Partner with Product Marketing and Commercial Operatings/Product Launch to translate product positioning, launches, and solution value propositions into compelling demand generation campaigns.

• Collaborate with Partner Marketing and Channels & Alliances to develop joint campaigns, partner co-marketing programs, and partner-enabled demand generation.

• Work with Sales Enablement and Sales leadership to ensure campaigns are supported by actionable outreach strategies, sales messaging, content, and follow-up programs.

• Partner with Marketing Operations and sales development teams to improve lead qualification, routing, handoffs, and progression to qualified meetings and opportunities.

• Coordinate with Content, Corporate Communications, Web, and Creative teams to bring high-impact integrated campaigns to market.

• Drive cross-functional accountability, ensuring campaign deliverables progress efficiently from planning through execution.

Success Measures

The Director is measured on:

• Campaign-generated qualified sales meetings

• Marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced opportunities

• Lead-to-meeting conversion rates

• Campaign effectiveness, cost efficiency, and return on investment

• Successful execution of integrated go-to-market and product launch programs

• Campaign delivery speed, quality, and adherence to priorities

• Marketing-to-sales handoff effectiveness

• Campaign team performance, productivity, and development

• Scalability and continuous improvement of demand generation programs

Qualifications

Required Experience

• 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including 5+ years in integrated campaigns, demand generation, or growth marketing leadership.

• 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing high-performing marketing teams.

• Demonstrated success personally building, launching, and optimizing multi-channel B2B campaigns that deliver measurable pipeline results.

• Deep expertise in account-based marketing, audience segmentation, buyer journeys, lead nurturing, conversion optimization, and full-funnel demand generation.

• Significant experience marketing complex enterprise SaaS, AI, or technology solutions to executive, business, and technical audiences.

• Proven ability to drive cross-functional go-to-market initiatives involving Product Marketing, Product Management, Marketing Ops, GTM Intelligence, Sales Ops, Partner Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Sales.

• Strong working knowledge of modern marketing technology, including Marketo or comparable marketing automation platforms, Salesforce, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, and ABM/intent platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, or ZoomInfo.

• Practical understanding of campaign automation, audience segmentation, lead scoring, CRM integration, attribution, funnel analytics, and marketing-to-sales processes.

• Exceptional writing, messaging, creative judgment, and campaign development skills, with the ability to contribute directly to campaign deliverables.

• Strong analytical capabilities and a demonstrated ability to translate campaign performance data into actionable optimization and investment decisions.

• Outstanding organizational, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution, independently driving initiatives from concept through measurable results.

Advantageous Experience

• Experience marketing enterprise software or AI solutions to organizations operating in complex, highly regulated, or multi-enterprise industries.

• Experience introducing emerging technologies or creating demand for new enterprise software categories.

• Experience developing global, multi-persona campaigns and partner-led demand generation programs.

• Experience leveraging generative AI and emerging marketing technologies to improve marketing effectiveness and productivity.

Core Competencies

• Team Leadership & Development

• Integrated Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Demand Generation & Pipeline Development

• Hands-On Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Account-Based Marketing & Audience Targeting

• Cross-Functional Go-to-Market Leadership

• Marketing Technology & Analytics

• Creative & Commercial Judgment

• Prioritization, Accountability & Bias for Action

• Performance Optimization & Continuous Improvement

What Success Looks Like

Successful Directors build a high-performing, scalable demand generation engine that consistently converts TraceLink's strategic priorities, thought leadership, and product innovations into qualified commercial opportunities.

They establish strong partnerships with Product Marketing, Sales, Partner Marketing, and the broader marketing organization, ensuring go-to-market initiatives are coordinated, effectively executed, and measured against business outcomes.

Above all, they are leaders who deliver. They set direction, develop their teams, personally contribute to execution, remove obstacles, and take full ownership of results. Their impact is evident in faster campaign launches, stronger campaign performance, improved sales pipeline, and a marketing organization capable of executing at greater scale.

TraceLink is committed to providing competitive compensation and benefits to all employees. This is the estimated base salary range for this role and should serve only as a guide. Final compensation offered may vary based on a variety of factors including but not limited to experience level, fit for the role, skills, domain knowledge, internal equity, budget, and location.

US Pay Range

$183,400—$223,000 USD

Axle is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Axle is seeking a Bioinformatician to join our vibrant team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) supporting the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) located in Phoenix, AZ.

Benefits We Offer:

• 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees

• Educational Benefits for Career Growth

• Employee Referral Bonus

• Flexible Spending Accounts: Healthcare (FSA) Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK) Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP) Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Position Information:

The purpose of this position is to provide bioinformatics programming, computational and statistical analysis, and training support for research on the pathophysiology of obesity and type 2 diabetes in the NIDDK Phoenix Epidemiology and Clinical Research Branch, including developing analysis pipelines, interpreting large genomic data sets, and collaborating with internal staff and outside researchers.

Schedule: This position is Part - Time 12 hours/week.

Certifications & Licenses

• Machine Learning Certification

Field of Study

• Biology

Software

• MATLAB

• R

• Powerpoint

• Outlook

Skills

• Clinical and/or translational research

• Genome-wide association studies

• Work with large data sets

• Microarray data analysis

• Whole Genome Sequencing

Deliverables:

• Meet with lab members to present updates - Ad-Hoc

Statement of Work Details:

• Interact with all levels of staff and communicate with outside collaborators in the US and abroad. - 1

• Collaborate with group members in experiments associated with data collection. - 2

• Work with an interdisciplinary team to apply computational data analysis approaches to make biological discoveries. - 3

• Instruct staff in computational analysis of data. - 4

• Collaborate with staff to review current and historical procedures for the acquisition, quality control and management of data. - 5

• Provides programming and troubleshooting support to the Federal Government in the dissemination of research data.

• Generate and optimize programs and scripts for the analysis of data; create programs and algorithms and develop computational infrastructure resources for organizing and parsing data from large and complex data.

• Serve as bioinformatics expert and coordinate with teams of biologists to conduct experimental queries and/or perform portions of studies using complex procedures and techniques common to modern bioinformatics.

• Coordinate building bioinformatics infrastructure to ensure easy and meaningful scientific analysis and interpretation of data.

• Provide broad-based programming and analytic support for a wide variety of bioinformatic and research projects.

• Install, troubleshoot and run open-source and commercial scientific software on platforms

• Performs computations on research data analysis.

• Perform computational analysis of, and interpret results.

• Provide reports based on analysis of scientific data.

• Perform sequencing and alignment of raw data, and interpret new data using larger public access datasets.

• Provide interpretive analyses of data derived from different experimental platforms to generate biological meaning.

• Write custom programs and algorithms to support data analyses and discovery.

• Works with staff on scientific programming and experimental design.

• Collaborate with scientists to design, analyze, manage and interpret all types of data.

• Design and execute computational experiments.

• Work with staff on planning of experiments, and data analysis for internal and collaborative projects; use bioinformatics expertise to advise and help bench scientists on experimental design and trouble-shooting.

• Work with staff to develop specifications for new analysis; design, test and implement solutions.

• Make recommendations to investigators about the correct computational tools for testing scientific hypotheses and reaching valid conclusions.

• Records observations and report results at weekly laboratory meetings.

• Maintain proper and detailed documentation of the analysis performed and report results at lab meetings.

• Attend scientific and programming meetings; take and compile comprehensive notes; organize and edit content of meeting reports.

• Prepare scientific reports and progress reports; assemble data to prepare tables, graphs and slides; conduct scientific and program related information searches and report results.

• Organize daily laboratory notebook on experiments; prepare weekly updates on on-going experiments and tasks; provide monthly progress notes on assigned projects; submit final progress reports and future directions on projects.

• Organize laboratory notebook or computer database to record results of calculations. Share results at lab meetings.

• Provides statistical support / analysis on research data.

• Devise novel methods of statistical analysis for collected data.

• Utilize and adapt existing bioinformatics techniques to check for trends and patterns in the data.

• Write complex queries to multiple databases.

• Perform data processing and data analysis with existing computational and statistical methods.

• Assist in evaluating and interpreting results for validity and scientific meaning.

• Provides research / service goals in the context of the laboratory's overall mission.

• Create novel programs and algorithms that facilitate discovery of knowledge in investigating large and complex data.

• Develop and optimize programs and scripts that facilitate organization, integration and data-mining of large data sets; integrate these models into a framework of best practices.

• Participate in the design of new protocols involving computational methods.

• Work with staff on the development and maintenance of bioinformatics tools, scripts and pipe-lines for data.

• Participate in research design with investigators for determining best practices pertaining to the bioinformatics analysis in new and ongoing projects.

• Evaluates new types of experimental approaches to protocols based on knowledge of scientific literature, available facilities and research needs.

• Research and review literature to retrieve targeted clinical or scientific information, including novel statistical methods, from publicly available resources.

• Analyze and evaluate data cleaning and harmonization needs in the using a variety of descriptive statistics and analytic methods.

• Identify new tools and resources for reaching biologically meaningful conclusions.

• Collaborate with experimentalists and computational biologists to develop new computational tools to answer research questions of interest.

• Independently coordinates the training of personnel in the use of scientific software applications, statistical software applications and programmatic software applications.

• Provide training in and technical support (including product updates and version control) for programs, algorithms, archives, and pipelines generated during the course of this work.

• Provide ad hoc trainings and hands-on workshops on the use of bioinformatics tools.

• Provide training of students, new investigators, and other laboratory personnel in the use of techniques, procedures and equipment to complete the objectives of the laboratory.

• Onboard and train staff involved in new clinical trials, including the import of a wide variety of legacy data set; provide rigorous quality control of these data.

• Initiates interdisciplinary collaborations with other research centers.

• Work with staff, collaborate with outside researchers, and contribute to positive overall teamwork; teach Bioinformatics principles and methodologies.

• Collaborate with biologists, statisticians and/or other bioinformaticians in the design of models summarizing/explaining experimental data.

• Deliver at least one presentation per year to audiences outside the Government.

• Attend group meetings; present findings; author publications resulting from projects.

• Present analysis results at research conferences and meetings.

• Present new research data in group settings, at meetings or seminars.

• Present scientific and technical data at scientific conferences.

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is expanding its Cyber Fusion Center designed to bring together detection, response, threat intelligence, vulnerability validation and offensive security into a tightly integrated security capability.

We are looking for an exceptional Lead, Offensive Assurance (OA) to build and lead the offensive security capability within the Cyber Fusion Center.

FanDuel Offensive Security Mindset: Real-world Continuous Adversarial Testing

You will establish a highly technical team capable of conducting sophisticated and covert adversary operations across FanDuel's environment. The team will run multiple sustained campaigns throughout the year, emulating realistic threat actors and testing our ability to prevent, detect, investigate and respond to compromises.

The remit also extends to the rapidly evolving AI attack surface. OA will use AI to enhance offensive operations while developing the capability to adversarially test AI systems, agents and the infrastructure and controls surrounding them.

Alongside dedicated red team operations, OA will work closely with Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Validation, Security Engineering, AI and technology teams to conduct purple team exercises, adversary emulation and continuous control validation. OA will also collaborate and coordinate all offensive operations with our legal and GRC partner teams.

This is an opportunity to build the capability from the ground up: its operating model, tooling, infrastructure, tradecraft, campaign methodology, AI capabilities, metrics and culture. Role Mission and Context

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Offensive Assurance & Continuous Adversary Emulation

Lead and mature FanDuel’s offensive assurance capability from first principles, moving the organization from periodic testing toward continuous, intelligence-driven validation.

• Program & Team Leadership: Define the operating model, rules of engagement, technical infrastructure, and multi-year maturity roadmap; mentor and lead a high-caliber offensive security team. Collaborate with relevant functions to develop the existing deconfliction process and the White Cell.

• Continuous Covert OffSec Operations: Design and execute discreet, multi-vector adversary campaigns across cloud, identity, endpoint, application, API, and third-party attack surfaces. Build campaign objectives around intelligence, realistic adversary behavior and FanDuel's evolving technology environment.

• AI-Enabled Offensive Tradecraft & AI Red Teaming: Pioneer the use of AI/autonomous agents to scale offensive speed and attack-path discovery, while systematically stress-testing FanDuel’s own AI systems, models, and agentic workflows against compromise and abuse.

• Purple Teaming & CFC Integration: Partner directly with Detection & Response (DART) and the broader Cyber Fusion Center to run iterative purple team exercises, converting offensive findings into actionable detections, telemetry uplifts, and regression-testable control validations.

• Adversary Research: Continuously research emerging threat actor tradecraft, zero-days, and novel attack surfaces to ensure our defenses are tested against tomorrow’s attacks, not yesterday’s.

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

• Previous experience establishing an internal red team, purple team, or adversarial simulation capability from the ground up, including writing ROEs and deconfliction protocols.

• Demonstrated experience designing and running realistic, multi-stage adversary campaigns rather than isolated security exercises.

• Strong understanding of modern defensive security, including security telemetry, detection engineering and how defenders monitor and track adversary activity.

• Track record operating in high-volume, 24/7, highly regulated environments (gaming, sports tech, fintech, big tech, or large-scale consumer e-commerce).

• Demonstrated experience attacking and pivoting through modern cloud-native infrastructures (AWS/GCP), container/orchestration environments (Kubernetes), and complex identity fabrics (Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID).

• Proficiency in developing custom tradecraft, C2 frameworks, evasion techniques, and automation tooling in Python, Go, Rust, or C/C++.

• Hands-on exposure to frontier model security and modern AI red teaming initiatives, benchmarks, or frameworks.

• Ability to lead highly technical practitioners while remaining deeply hands-on.

• Strong judgement and experience defining the scope, operating safely within the RoE and authorization boundaries and risk tolerances.

• Experience in leading and conducting Purple Team exercises in collaboration with defensive teams.

AI-Enabled Offensive Tradecraft and AI Red Teaming

• Use AI and automation where appropriate to accelerate attack-path discovery, scenario development, infrastructure management, tradecraft development, testing, analysis, and reporting.

• Adversarially test internal AI systems, model integrations, agent workflows, tool-use patterns, data flows, and supporting infrastructure.

• Assess AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, tool abuse, data exposure, model manipulation, unsafe agent actions, control bypass, excessive agency, and unintended access to sensitive systems or data.

Why This Role Matters

Modern security programs need evidence that their defenses work against real attacker behavior.

At the same time, AI is changing both sides of the security equation. Attackers are gaining new capabilities while organizations are introducing AI systems capable of accessing data, invoking tools, making decisions and taking actions. Offensive Assurance provides the mechanism to continuously test both. The capability you build will challenge FanDuel's security program, expose assumptions before adversaries can exploit them and create a continuous feedback loop between offense, intelligence, engineering and defense. You won't inherit the finished capability.

You'll build it. Then you'll continuously try to break everything we believe is protecting us.

Don’t check all the boxes? That’s okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position.

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.
In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

Weekend Supervisor, Operations

Position Summary

The Weekend Supervisor, Operations serves as the first-line operational contact for urgent weekend staffing, house-call scheduling, and facilities needs across Northern California, Southern California, South Florida, and NYC/Hamptons. This permanent remote position coordinates timely solutions, documents decisions, and escalates major incidents within established authority and protocols.

The position reports to the VP, Operations, with a dotted-line relationship to Regional Operations Leaders (ROLs).

Location and Schedule

• Must reside in New York or Florida.

• Friday afternoon to Monday morning, 40 hours per week

Key Responsibilities

Act as the primary point of contact for operational staff concerns, escalating to the extended Operations leadership team as needed.

• Assist in maintaining inventory of supplies for the site partnering with Operations and Nursing leadership to ensure all items are stocked.

• Serve as an operational escalation point for staff by answering questions about operational workflows and clarifying standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Monitor phone SLAs and task completion

Staffing and Callouts

Ensure all sick calls are backfilled, and centers are staffed according to Sollis' staffing model.

• Receive and log staffing callouts across all four markets, updating all timesheets accordingly.

• Secure replacements through the on-call roster, float pool, or incentive pay offers.

• Approve overtime, incentive pay, shift swaps, and move staff to ensure coverage within pre-approved and discussed parameters.

• Escalate unfilled critical shifts according to the defined protocol and document coverage decisions and outcomes.

House-Call Scheduling

• Secure house-call providers when no provider is on shift for that position.

• Coordinate with house-call per diem providers on availability, routing, and priority.

• Confirm completion and communicate scheduling changes to affected parties.

Facilities Emergencies and Escalation

• Coordinate the initial operational response to after-hours water, power, HVAC, security, lockout, and safety issues.

• Dispatch local vendors and contractors and approve emergency spending within the approved limit.

• Notify the Regional Operations Leader of safety, legal, or major outage events and escalate major incidents to leadership.

• Document incidents, actions taken, associated costs, and unresolved needs.

Communication, Reporting, and Handoffs

• Send a Monday-morning handoff report covering incidents, open items, and costs, and keep market leads informed of issues affecting Monday operations.

• Maintain current contact rosters, vendor lists, and facilities runbooks for each market.

• Brief designated backup managers before planned absences, review their reports on return, and update runbooks with lessons learned.

• Track active hours, incidents, after-hours spending, and coverage outcomes by market.

• Recommend improvements based on recurring issues and perform other duties within the urgent operational scope.

Qualifications

Required

• 3+ years of experience in operations, scheduling, dispatch, or facilities coordination.

• 1+ year of experience in a supervisory or lead role.

• Strong decision-making under pressure and with limited information.

• Comfort working irregular and overnight hours across two time zones and multiple markets.

• Residence in New York or Florida

• A dedicated remote workspace with reliable internet, backup connectivity, and phone access, and the ability to meet the approved urgent-response expectations.

Preferred

• Experience in multi-site or multi-market operations.

• Familiarity with workforce management or scheduling software.

• Vendor management experience and working knowledge of basic facilities and safety protocols.

• Familiarity with regional operating needs, including South Florida hurricane season and seasonal peaks in the Hamptons.

Proposed Compensation

Proposed fixed annual salary: $60,000–$70,000, based on experience and location, paid for all 52 weekends, including PTO. Final compensation and employment classification are subject to HR/Legal review and approval.

jobs.title: Lead, Production Planning
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

The Launch team operates at the intersection of every major aspect of Terran R, from stages and payloads to ground systems, launch, landing, and refurbishment. The Cape is the only place where you see it all come together, offering a level of exposure and responsibility unmatched elsewhere in the program. This is where first flights happen, where history is built on top of history, and where the scale of what's underway is unlike anything in modern aerospace. The mission stays the same, but the work evolves with every milestone: from first launch to reuse, high-cadence operations, and beyond. If you're looking to define what's next in space launch and write a new playbook, not just repeat what’s already been done, this is where it happens.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Money Movements Squad
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Today, roughly 40% of all transactions on the Egyptian Exchange flow through Thndr. Every one of those trades has to be funded, and every pound, dirham, or soon riyal, a user makes has to be money they can actually take back out. Money has to move, into accounts, out to banks, between our own books and the market, accurately and on time, every single time. That is the Money Movements team.

 

We move more than 1 billion EGP every day across hundreds of thousands of individual movements, and the figure we care about most is how many of them go wrong, which we work relentlessly to keep as close to zero as possible. We connect directly to banks, payment gateways, and payment providers, settle with the exchanges and asset managers, and write and maintain our own backoffice across Egypt and the UAE. Underpinning all of it is our own in-house ledger, built on TigerBeetle, a bleeding-edge financial database that gives us the correctness and throughput this domain demands. We do this across two markets today, with Saudi Arabia coming next.

 

This is a sensitive system. When money is in motion, uptime and correctness are not nice-to-haves, they are the entire job. A delayed settlement, a double credit, or a balance that does not reconcile is never just a bug, it is real money belonging to real people. You would be working alongside some of our strongest engineers on problems that are unusually hard and unusually consequential, owning systems that the rest of the platform quietly depends on.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design, build, and operate the services that move money in and out of Thndr, including deposits, withdrawals, settlement, and reconciliation, across Egypt and the UAE.

• Own the correctness and reliability of these systems end to end. Money that flows through your code has to land in the right place, in the right amount, every time.

• Build and maintain integrations with banks, payment gateways, payment providers, and asset managers, and handle the messy realities that come with them: timeouts, partial failures, retries, and the occasional provider that goes down at the worst possible moment.

• Raise the bar on quality and operational discipline, with strong observability, sensible on-call, thorough testing, and systems that fail safely when something goes wrong.

• Partner closely with our finance and operations teams, and help bring the same connectivity and rigor to Saudi Arabia as we expand.

 


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• A strong track record of designing, shipping, and operating reliable backend systems in production, used by large numbers of people.

• Real depth in distributed systems, and a clear understanding of what it takes to keep them correct under load and under failure.

• Comfort owning systems end to end, from design through production and on-call. You care not just about writing the code, but about how it behaves at 3am.

• Familiarity with our stack, or the confidence to get there quickly: Python, C#, .NET Core, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, and Redis.

• A high bar for correctness and operational discipline. You understand what it means to run a system where a mistake has real consequences for real people.

• A clear, candid communicator who can hold their own with other engineers and work closely with the finance and operations teams who rely on what you build.

• Strong debugging skills. When a balance is off by 50 cents across a million transactions, you can find the real cause, not just a quick fix.

 


WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

 

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

 - High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.

 - Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

 - Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

 

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

 - 5.5 million app downloads

 - EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025

 - #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year

 - 76% of users are first-time investors

 - 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

 

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

 

Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

 

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Feed Squad
jobs.description:
ABOUT THNDR

Thndr is on a mission to make investing simple and accessible for everyone across the Middle East and North Africa. Since launching in 2019 and going through Y Combinator shortly after, we have grown into Egypt's number one investing app, with millions of people putting their money to work in stocks, gold, mutual funds, and more, many of them investing for the very first time.

We are licensed by Egypt's Financial Regulatory Authority and are a member of the Egyptian Exchange. In 2024 we expanded into the UAE under an ADGM license, and in 2025 we became the first remote retail trading member of the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. That same year, the World Economic Forum named us a Technology Pioneer, the only Egyptian company alongside Apple, Google, Dropbox, and others. In 2026, The Financial Times named us the fastest growing company in Africa. We are backed by investors including Tiger Global, Prosus Ventures, BECO Capital, and Y Combinator, and we are only getting started.

 


THE TEAM YOU WOULD JOIN

Today, roughly 40% of all transactions on the Egyptian Exchange flow through Thndr. Behind almost everything a user sees or relies on is market data, and the Feed team owns it. Live and delayed prices, statistics, charts, and asset data across every market we operate in all flow through systems we build and run.

We ingest data from different providers, sometimes multiple per market, and expose it to the rest of Thndr through a single, unified feed. Nearly everything downstream depends on it: the live prices users watch, the alerts we fire when something moves, and the limit orders that execute off the numbers we serve. Our users range from first-time investors making a decision about where to put their money, to technical traders who need immediate, actionable insights. Every millisecond matters. When a price arrives late or wrong, it is not a cosmetic bug, it is real money for real people acting on information that has to arrive on time, every time.

On top of that, we are building for scale, and one that is genuinely hard: a feed engineered to handle 100,000+ assets and hundreds of thousands of price updates a second, without dropping a beat.

This is a sensitive system, and a foundational one. Providers fail, connections drop, and infrastructure gives out mid-session, and none of that is an excuse to stop serving users. Much of the hard part is staying correct and available when something upstream breaks: failing over in the middle of an open market, absorbing a provider outage, and keeping the feed flowing when the pieces underneath it do not. You would be working alongside some of our strongest engineers on problems that are unusually hard and unusually consequential, owning systems the rest of the platform quietly depends on.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and operate the feed services that serve market data across Egypt, UAE, US, and soon KSA, processing large volumes of data and events with very low latency and high reliability.

 - Keep the feed available and correct when things break, owning the SLOs and overall health of your services, with strong observability, sensible on-call, and graceful failover when a provider drops or infrastructure gives out mid-market.

 - Understand the different databases and data models we use, Redis, ClickHouse, and Postgres, how each behaves, and when to reach for which.

 - Own the infrastructure the feed runs on. Understand how data reaches us from each provider, and build in redundancy where it matters so a single upstream failure never takes us down.

 - Identify technical debt and reliability risks in your area and steadily improve the systems you own.

 - Raise the bar on quality and operational discipline, and support the engineers around you through code and design reviews and pairing.

 


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A strong track record of designing, shipping, and operating reliable backend systems in production, used by large numbers of people.

 - Real depth in distributed systems, and a clear understanding of what it takes to keep them fast and correct under load and under failure.

 - Comfort owning systems end to end, from design through production and on-call. You care not just about writing the code, but about how it behaves when a provider drops or a node fails.

 - A feel for performance, and the instinct to treat latency and throughput as first-class concerns rather than afterthoughts.

 - Familiarity with our stack, or the confidence to get there quickly: Python, C#, .NET Core, Golang, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, and ClickHouse.

 - A high bar for correctness and operational discipline. You understand what it means to run a system where a mistake has real consequences for real people.

 - A clear, candid communicator who can hold their own with other engineers and work closely with the teams that build on what you provide.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building systems optimized for real-time performance, where latency and throughput are on the line.

 - Experience with ClickHouse or similar OLAP databases, and the query and schema patterns that get the most out of them.

 - Experience in fintech, brokerage, trading, or another regulated, high-stakes domain where correctness and timing matter.

 


WHY THIS ROLE

The feed sits underneath almost everything Thndr does. Every price a user watches, every alert we send, and every order that fires does so because the feed delivered the right number at the right moment. It is some of the most performance-critical engineering in the company, the kind of work where being fast and being correct are the same problem, and it matters to millions of people.

If building systems that have to be fast, correct, and trusted without exception sounds like your kind of challenge, and if doing it at real scale across multiple markets excites you, we would love to hear from you.

 


WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design.
