jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Experience squad
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Every Thndr user passes through our systems before their first trade: signing up, verifying their identity, getting approved, logging in securely. Our ownership extends well beyond the initial user journey, covering Savings and Thndr Gold, the forthcoming Thndr Card and real estate products, the client domain, user profiles and the entire engagement pipeline.

We run around twenty services across Egypt and the UAE, several of them Tier 1. That makes operational excellence non-negotiable. We treat reliability, monitoring and incident response as part of the job.

The most interesting part is the product side. Savings and Gold are ours end to end, and real estate is next. A gram of gold is an instrument, an order, a custody record and a ledger entry, all handled through our back office. We build the layer on top: a domain model clean enough to turn a trading instrument into a product where someone buys gold, or a slice of a building, without seeing any of that.

The work is broad. One minute you’re building an OAuth flow for a third party integration; the next you’re integrating an AML service provider for a new product with its own hosting and security requirements; a third time you’re arguing with policy on how to keep the experience smooth under new compliance demands.

We sit between product teams shipping new features, operations and finance teams who live with what we build, and back office squads whose capabilities we build on top of. We’re looking for a senior engineer to own a subset of these domains: to know them better than anyone, decide where they go next, and be accountable for their health.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own part of our domains end to end. You lead the projects in them, you set the technical direction, and you are accountable for their service health; latency, error rates, on-call, and the slow accumulation of debt that nobody else is watching.

 - Lead cross squad projects. Break down ambiguous product asks into a plan, sequence the work, pull in the people you need, unblock them, and ship it. Senior here means the project moves forward, not that the hardest function gets written.

 - Design systems that scale and degrade gracefully. Our services sit in front of every user on the platform and depend on third parties that time out, rate limit, and occasionally disappear. You build for that reality: idempotency, retries, sensible fallbacks, and failure that is contained instead of cascading.

 - Raise the bar on quality and operational discipline. Promote our observability culture, favor small and independently shippable PRs and define measurable and achievable SLOs to our critical flows.

 - Work close to the product. You will sit with product, design, and data teams to argue about what should be built and why, not just how. Pushing back on a bad requirement is part of the job.

 - Partner with operations, CX, and compliance, who rely on what you build to open accounts, resolve user issues, and keep us on the right side of regulators in every market we operate in.

 - Help bring our domains to new markets as we expand beyond Egypt, UAE and the US.

 - Impact-driven and product-minded. At the end of the day we are building a product for a large user base, so we need someone who thinks about the product first, not just the technical side. The best technical decision for a user funnel is not always the most interesting one.

 - Project management and leadership skills. Scoping, sequencing, communicating status, and bringing other engineers along with you are core skills of a senior here, not a bonus.

 - Confidence owning systems end to end, from design through production and on-call. You care not just about writing the code, but about how it behaves once real users are on it, and when incidents happen, you find the root cause quickly, contain the impact, unblock affected users and put lasting fixes in place.

 - Experience in fintech is appreciated — enough awareness of domain-critical flows involving money, identity, and regulation to know which mistakes are expensive and which are merely annoying.

 - Strong communication across teams. We need someone who can hold their own with other engineers and work closely with the product, operations, and compliance teams who rely on what you build.

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. jobs.title: MI Analyst
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The role

As our MI Analyst, you will tell our Contact Centre leaders what the data means and what to do about it, then build the tools that deliver it at scale. You will sit in the Workforce Planning team, working across all teams who deal with customer contacts and report to the Head of Workforce Planning. Each day, week and month we publish reporting on agent productivity, operational performance and business review data across multiple teams and two sites. The job is to go beyond filling in the numbers and answer the "so what":

 - What are our most immediate opportunities?

 - What do we do about them with operational leaders?

 - Where are we losing efficiency?

 - Where could the same hours deliver more?

You will also use AI to do this faster than any manual process could. We run Claude connected to our BI data lake, so the right person can pull data, build reports and automate repeatable work themselves, without waiting in a queue. We want someone who sees that and immediately starts asking what they can automate.

What you will do

Find the insight

 - Turn Contact Centre data into clear findings and recommendations, and tell leaders what to do, not just what happened.

 - Spot where we are losing efficiency or capacity, size each opportunity, and prioritise the ones worth acting on.

 - Add commentary to the reports you publish, so readers see the story behind the numbers.

 - Own our understanding of contact drivers: explain why customers contact us, how that is changing, and what we could do to reduce it or handle it better.

Build with AI, at scale

 - Use Claude and our BI data lake to pull data, build reports and automate manual collation.

 - Replace repeatable, manual reporting with automated, reliable processes, so your time goes on analysis.

 - Bring us ideas for what to automate next, and show the time and capacity you save.

 - Document what you build so others in the team can run and maintain it when required.

Run the reporting cadence

 - Deliver daily, weekly and monthly reporting on agent productivity, utilisation and key service metrics across phone, email, chat and messaging.

 - Prepare the data for our daily, weekly and monthly business reviews (WBR and MBR).

 - Keep stakeholders updated on what you are working on and when it will land, without being asked.

Own accuracy

 - Validate every output before you share it. You are the last line of quality control on your own work.

 - Check sources and definitions rather than trusting historical reports, and flag anything that looks wrong before others find it.

 - Cross check your reports against the WBR and other sources, so mismatches show up before stakeholders spot them.

Be our Contact Centre data partner to BI

 - Act as the Contact Centre data partner to our BI teams, and the link between them and our operational leaders.

 - Help validate data models, dashboards and metrics against what is really happening on the floor.

 - Spot data issues early, raise them with BI with clear examples, and see them through to a fix.

 - Turn operational questions into clear requirements for BI, and help test what they build before it goes live.

 - Keep metric definitions consistent across Zendesk, Talkdesk, Calabrio and Looker.

Work with the business

 - Understand what team leaders and managers need from the data, and challenge whether our metrics are the right ones.

 - Help define and evolve Contact Centre KPIs as the business grows.

 - Support ad hoc analysis and reporting on test and learn initiatives, and on BPO partner performance.

What we are looking for

We want someone who has already worked with data in a busy operation and wants to do much more with it. If you are curious, thorough and keen to build, we want to hear from you.

You will need

 - Real curiosity about data. You ask why a number moved, not just what it is.

 - The ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation that a non-technical leader can act on.

 - Strong attention to detail, and the habit of sense checking your own work before anyone else sees it.

 - Experience as an analyst, with a real understanding of the data you work with: where it comes from, how it is built, and what it can and cannot tell you.

 - Hands on experience using AI tools such as Claude to analyse data or build things, or a strong track record of picking up new tools fast.

 - Strong written and spoken communication, including working with BI teams to validate data and proactively updating stakeholders on progress and delays.

 - A drive to take ownership, without being prompted, of the reports and processes you run.

 - The ability to manage daily and weekly deadlines in a fast moving operation.

It would be great if you have

 - Experience in a Contact Centre or operations environment, and working knowledge of how AHT, occupancy, SLA and productivity are measured and what moves them.

 - Experience with BigQuery, dbt, Looker Studio or similar BI tools.

 - Experience with Zendesk, Talkdesk or Calabrio data.

 - Examples of something you automated or built that saved real time.


WHY JOIN US

 - Claude connected to our BI data lake, so you can build with real, live data from day one.

 - Your work is used every morning by operational leaders to run the day and directly impacts business performance.

 - Room to move from running reports to owning our Ops reporting automation.

 - A small team where good ideas get picked up and shipped.

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

 - £34,000 per annum

 - Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway’s success

 - 33 days holiday (inclusive of bank holidays)

 - Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

 - Private medical insurance via BUPA

 - Life assurance

 - Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

 - Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

 - 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

 - EV leasing scheme

 - Cycle to work scheme

 - Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

 - 1 paid volunteering day a year

Equal Opportunities Statement

Motorway is committed to equality of opportunity for all employees. We work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximise their full potential. We believe our workforce should reflect a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives and experiences. Our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion is evident through our constant focus on recruiting, developing and advancing individuals based on their skills and talents.

We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

jobs.title: Adjunct Faculty- Doctor of Education
jobs.description:
Walden’s Values and Mission

At Walden, a commitment to social change is more than a discussion point, it's integral to our identity. From our founders onward, this principle has drawn students and faculty who share this value, guiding our actions in every endeavor. As a specialized online teaching institution, we are dedicated to inclusive teaching and learning across all academic programs. We intentionally foster an environment of shared accountability to enhance and advance the equitable health and well-being of communities, systems, and organizations. We recognize the inherent worth, humanity, and dignity of each individual within the learning process. Our institutional philosophy is one of support and guidance; we meet students where they are and accompany them on their academic journeys.

Our Students

Walden University serves a diverse student body, providing broad access to higher education. We are dedicated to nurturing the curiosity of our students and supporting their academic growth as they pursue their educational goals. By creating opportunities for diverse, working adult learners to advance their education, Walden has empowered generations of alumni to become agents of positive change within their professions and communities. This commitment to student success is at the heart of our mission and the driving force behind the dedication of our faculty and staff.

Responsibilities

Instruction

At Walden, inclusive teaching is a deliberate practice that recognizes and values the diverse social, cultural, community identities, and lived experiences of all learners. It employs a variety of strategies to fully engage students' strengths within learning environments that connect meaningfully to their lives and professional development. Our aim is to ensure that every learner understands that Walden values their inherent worth, humanity, and dignity. This commitment to inclusive teaching is demonstrated through several key faculty practices:

• Regular and varied communication with students to foster a welcoming and inclusive classroom environment.
• The creation of engaging and dynamic learning experiences that promote student learning, discussion, and growth.
• Consistent feedback and feedforward to support students' academic and professional development, providing insights into current performance and guidance for future growth.
• Individualized instructional support and guidance that demonstrates genuine care and concern for student well-being, personal and professional growth, and the achievement of their goals.
• Dedication to the mission and vision of Walden University.
• Accessibility to students through various channels, including email, phone, text, office hours, and individual appointments.

Scholarship

Walden University recognizes scholarship as essential to effective teaching and the development of scholar-practitioner students. Faculty are encouraged to engage in scholarship aligned with Walden's mission. These activities are coordinated with academic leadership, and specific requirements are determined by the program and/or college.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager | Platform
jobs.description:
This role is not open to visa sponsorship or transfer of visa sponsorship including those on H1-B, F-1, OPT, STEM-OPT, or TN visa, nor is it available to work corp-to-corp.

This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our South Charlotte, NC or New York, NY office (Tuesday through Thursday) and optional remote days on Mondays and Fridays each week.

Red Ventures' Growth and Transformation team (RVGT) drives growth for Fortune 500 clients in home services and financial services, including telecom, deregulated energy, credit cards, and deposits. RVGT is building a Growth Operating System: reusable workflows, agents, context layers, and governance that make growth more efficient and scalable for every partner we work with.

We're hiring a Senior AI Product Manager for the Agentic Platform team, which builds the shared foundation that the Growth Operating System runs on. That foundation includes data collection across our sites, governed access to data and tools, the infrastructure that runs agents reliably and securely, and the evaluation and measurement that show what's working. We're looking for someone who is deeply technical and analytically rigorous, with strong product sense, user empathy, and the judgment to tell what belongs in a shared platform versus a single team's implementation.

This role is highly visible and shapes how our largest client relationships run on AI. You'll have autonomy to propose platform capabilities, set KPIs, and be accountable for driving adoption and impact against them.

What You'll Do:

• Shape the Platform: Help build the shared foundation our delivery teams run on, from site interaction data to reusable agentic workflows. Partner closely with engineering, data science, and client teams to identify the capabilities that would make the biggest impact on their work. Decide what to standardize, what to make configurable, and what to leave to individual teams. Shape the roadmap so data- and AI-powered operations scale across clients.

• Govern Access to Data and Tools: Define how agents and the people using them connect to company and client data: who and what can access which systems, with which permissions, and with a clear record of what was done. Make governed access the easy path rather than an obstacle.

• Build in Quality from the Start: Set the standards and tools for evaluating agents for reliability and quality before they reach client work, and for monitoring them once they're running.

• Own End-to-End: Take each capability from initial business case and feasibility assessment to hands-on execution and optimization. Track adoption, time saved, and growth outcomes, report ROI, risks, and opportunities to leadership, and own the results of what ships.

• Mentor & Influence: Mentor other product managers on building with the platform, while serving as a high-visibility point person for senior stakeholders across the organization.

What We’re Looking For:

• Builder Mindset: You can write prompts, read code, and debug agentic systems, with a proven track record of building with tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar. You're a "doer" who can build proofs of concept or prototypes to demonstrate the value of potential AI investments.

• Systems Thinker: Experience building AI tools or platforms that other teams rely on. You can translate ambiguous one-off requests into a clear product vision and reusable capabilities with broad impact. You think in compounding systems, not one-off automations.

• Deeply Curious: You track how AI capability is changing, including where frontier AI labs are headed, and translate it into what the platform should build, adopt, or retire.

• Grounded in Outcomes: You prioritize based on impact and business value, and determine not just what to build, but why it matters. You can tell a capability that isn't working from one that's still early, and you make investment and deprecation calls accordingly.

• Influential Communicator: You build trust with cross-functional and client stakeholders, align teams through ambiguity, navigate trade-offs in fast-paced environments, and explain the technical "why" to non-technical audiences.

Experiences You've Had:

• Product Ownership: You've built and scaled a technical platform, workflow, or shared capability that multiple teams, partners, or customers depended on in production.

• Working Across Complex, Cross-Functional Environments: You've influenced cross-functional leaders, balanced competing priorities, and made high-impact product decisions in fast-paced, ambiguous settings.

• Delivering Measurable Business Outcomes through AI/ML: You have a record of improving key metrics and showing clear ROI from AI-powered products or systems.

• Data and Analytics Fluency: Hands-on experience with data-related programming (SQL, Python), data modeling, and experimentation, with the rigor to judge whether a system is creating real value or just running tasks.

Compensation:

Total Cash Compensation Range: $155,000-$220,000

New York City Total Cash Compensation Range: $193,750-$230,000

Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses, a joint venture in the health services industry, and strategic investments in Europe. Their businesses include The Points Guy, Lonely Planet, Bankrate, the Allconnect Platform, RV Home Client Growth, RV Growth & Transformation, Sage Home Loans Corporation, and more. jobs.title: Assoc Director/Director, Enterprise Technology & AI Strategy
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a team committed to making a meaningful impact on cancer treatment through the discovery and development of precision medicines? At Kura Oncology, you have an opportunity to be a part of something bigger, with a lasting impact that you can be proud of.

At Kura Oncology, we are working to change the paradigm and improve the science of cancer treatment. As an organization, we strive to cultivate a diverse and talented professional culture driven to develop precision medicine therapeutics.

As we continue to build a leading biotech organization with a strong culture, a patient-focused mindset and a team focused on relentless execution, we are looking for innovative, passionate professionals to join us and make our vision a reality.

To succeed at Kura, you will need to have a demonstrated ability for excellence in drug discovery and development and a roll-up your sleeves attitude. The ideal candidate will possess a values-driven work style where integrity and grit drive all behaviors, decisions, and actions.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

The Associate Director/Director, Enterprise Technology & AI Strategy leads the development and execution of the organization’s enterprise technology and artificial intelligence strategy in a growing precision medicine environment. This role shapes an integrated portfolio of AI, automation, enterprise applications, and digital capabilities aligned with business priorities, scientific objectives, and operational needs. Partnering with business leaders, IT, Quality Assurance, Information Security, Legal, Privacy, and Data stakeholders, the Director guides investment priorities, platform modernization, responsible AI adoption, and measurable value realization. The position balances innovation with architectural alignment, data readiness, user experience, scalability, quality expectations, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate brings strategic leadership and delivery experience across enterprise technology and AI in regulated life sciences environments. This individual translates executive priorities and scientific and operational needs into actionable roadmaps, compelling business cases, and sustainable technology capabilities. The Director leads cross-functional discovery and portfolio governance, guides initiatives from assessment through deployment and optimization, and establishes clear accountability for adoption and business outcomes. The role requires sound judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder leadership, and the ability to communicate investment recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and realized value to executive audiences.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Enterprise Technology & AI Strategy, Portfolio, and Value Realization

• Develop and maintain an integrated enterprise technology and AI strategy and roadmap aligned with business priorities, scientific objectives, operational needs, data capabilities, enterprise architecture, and responsible AI expectations.

• Lead cross-functional opportunity discovery to identify high-value applications of AI, automation, analytics, and enterprise technologies, defining intended users, workflow improvements, data requirements, measurable outcomes, and expected business value.

• Develop business cases, prioritization frameworks, investment recommendations, and executive decision materials across Research, Development, Clinical, Technical Operations, Corporate, and enabling functions.

• Establish and manage an integrated portfolio that provides visibility into strategic alignment, initiative maturity, expected value, cost, risk, data readiness, dependencies, accountable ownership, and adoption.

• Lead portfolio planning and facilitate executive governance discussions to recommend investment priorities, sequencing, resource allocation, and decisions to scale, redirect, or discontinue initiatives.

• Establish value realization practices with business sponsors, including baseline measures, benefit ownership, adoption targets, and ongoing assessment of realized outcomes.

• Anticipate organizational, technical, data, security, quality, regulatory, and change management barriers; drive mitigation planning and escalate decisions to accountable leaders.

AI Solution Discovery, Responsible Governance, and Adoption

• Lead the enterprise AI initiative lifecycle from opportunity assessment and feasibility through proofs of concept, pilots, scaled deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.

• Partner with business, system, data, and technical owners to define intended use, target experiences, data inputs, model and agent behavior, human oversight, acceptance criteria, and success measures.

• Establish and operationalize a practical, risk-based AI governance framework in partnership with Architecture, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Quality Assurance, Data, and other accountable functions.

• Oversee assessments of AI platforms, models, agents, integrations, automations, and vendor capabilities for business fit, technical feasibility, responsible use, operational readiness, and lifecycle support.

• Establish proportionate governance and documentation standards covering use case assessments, evaluation results, risk and control decisions, data considerations, approvals, accountable ownership, and human oversight.

• Direct proofs of concept and pilots that evaluate user value, output quality, workflow fit, data suitability, operational constraints, and known limitations; recommend whether to scale, modify, or discontinue solutions.

• Lead adoption planning with business sponsors, including communications, role-based learning, workflow changes, user feedback, and transition to operational ownership.

• Monitor utilization, adoption, user experience, realized benefits, quality indicators, and residual risks; use findings to guide portfolio decisions and solution improvements.

Regulated Technology, Quality, and Risk Alignment

• Embed quality, compliance, data integrity, and risk considerations into enterprise technology and AI planning, delivery, and lifecycle management.

• Partner with Quality Assurance and accountable system owners to determine whether proposed capabilities affect GxP computerized systems, regulated processes, or electronic records, and identify applicable validation and lifecycle requirements.

• Ensure initiative plans incorporate applicable intended use definitions, requirements, risk assessments, testing, traceability, approval evidence, records retention, and change controls in accordance with established quality procedures.

• Align solution plans with applicable regulatory requirements, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11, relevant guidance such as GAMP 5, and internal policies, in partnership with Quality Assurance and designated subject matter experts.

• Facilitate agreement on regulated use, validation strategy, acceptance criteria, solution limitations, human oversight, approval gates, and post-deployment monitoring, with approval authority retained by accountable functions.

• Ensure implementations, integrations, model or agent changes, and material configuration updates undergo appropriate AI risk and validation impact assessments, with documented disposition and ownership.

• Support audit and inspection readiness through organized governance and quality evidence, and coordinate contributions to periodic reviews, data integrity assessments, and system retirement activities where relevant.

Enterprise Platforms, Technology Enablement, and Continuous Improvement

• Define the strategic direction and evolution of enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, knowledge management capabilities, and automation technologies that enable business outcomes and AI adoption.

• Guide platform modernization, upgrades, integrations, configuration changes, and workflow improvements, balancing business value, architectural fit, security, compliance, scalability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.

• Evaluate technology and vendor options, inform sourcing and investment decisions, and oversee partner commitments, delivery outcomes, and alignment with enterprise priorities.

• Maintain visibility into delivery milestones, cross-platform dependencies, capability gaps, resource constraints, vendor performance, risks, and decisions requiring leadership action.

• Establish clear operational ownership, support expectations, communications, and readiness criteria for the transition of new capabilities into ongoing service.

• Translate lessons from AI initiatives and platform enhancements into reusable solution patterns, stronger governance, improved user experiences, and measurable operational improvements.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field

• 5+ years of progressive experience in AI strategy, digital transformation, emerging technology, enterprise systems, data or analytics, technology consulting, or related Information Technology roles

• Demonstrated experience shaping AI, automation, analytics, or emerging technology strategies from opportunity discovery through pilots, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement

• Experience supporting regulated technology in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, or life sciences industry, including familiarity with GxP computerized systems and risk-based validation expectations

• Working knowledge of responsible AI practices, data governance, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, data integrity principles, and Good Documentation Practices

• Experience building business cases, roadmaps, governance approaches, and executive recommendations for AI, automation, analytics, or emerging technology initiatives

• Experience with AI platforms, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, integrations, workflow automation, and data-enabled system enhancement initiatives

• Experience using AI, portfolio, analytics, ticketing, quality management, document management, collaboration, or workflow platforms

• Strong strategic thinking, analytical, problem solving, facilitation, business case development, and documentation skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate AI, technical, business, quality, and regulatory considerations for executive, operational, and technical audiences

• High level of discretion, sound judgment, curiosity, attention to detail, and ability to influence across multiple priorities in a fast paced environment

• Professional certifications or continuing education in AI, data governance, product management, quality, validation, PMP, PMI ACP, Scrum, or CISA are preferred

• Makes decisions for assigned programs or functional areas, balancing priorities and resolving routine challenges; escalates high-impact or cross-functional decisions as needed.

• Facilitates cross-functional coordination for assigned programs or initiatives, ensuring alignment and timely execution of deliverables.

The base range for this role at the Associate Director level is $170,000 - $209,000 and Director level is $200,000 - $241,000. Individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including, and without limitation, job-related skills, experience, work location, and relevant education or training. Kura's compensation package also includes generous benefits, equity, and participation in an annual target bonus.

Kura’s Values that are used for candidate selection and performance assessments:

• We work as one for patients

• We are goal-focused and deliver with excellence

• We are science-driven courageous innovators

• We strive to bring out the best in each other and ourselves

The Kura Package

• Competitive comp package

• Bonus

• 401K + Employer contributions

• Generous stock options

• ESPP Plan

• Regular employee social activities, including happy hours, monthly birthday celebrations, Kura Koffee Talks, and much more!

Kura Oncology is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to discovering and developing innovative precision medicines to help patients with cancer lead better, longer lives.

Through our deep understanding of cancer biology and decades of experience in precision oncology, we are studying the underlying causes of treatment resistance. This enables us to design smart combination regimens with other cancer therapies to target tumors from multiple directions, with the goal of improving long-term clinical benefit.

Kura developed and is commercializing KOMZIFTI® (ziftomenib), the FDA-approved once-daily, oral menin inhibitor for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia, and continues to pioneer advancements in menin inhibition and farnesyl transferase inhibition. For additional information, please visit Kura’s website at www.kuraoncology.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

Kura Oncology is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Sustainability Engineer - Radiopharmaceutical Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

This role provides technical support and training for radiopharmaceutical preparation as well as participating in validation activities, CDMO (Contract Development/Manufacturing Organization) qualification initiatives, technical transfers, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement endeavors.  Role will provide leadership and technical expertise - both internally and externally - to cross-functional teams as well as support field execution with focus on compliance with industry regulations, quality standards, and regulatory frameworks.  This role also provides first line technical support for ongoing batch manufacturing.

Key Accountabilities:

• Technical lead of tech transfer and manufacturing activities related to drug substance and drug product formulation, radiolabeling, and fill/finish of small molecule and biologic based radiopharmaceuticals

• Analyze production processes and report results. Identify and communicate gaps, risks, and inefficiencies. Drive implementation of process improvements and risk mitigations. Lead manufacturing investigations and root cause analyses

• Support implementation of cold and hot analytical methods under the guidance of internal QC SMEs, ensuring alignment with approved methods, validation requirements, and quality standard.

• Provide support to Regulatory Affairs for product IND and new NDA submissions, support inspection readiness, participate in regulatory agency inspections, and provide audit support, as required

• Manage technical collaborations with multiple CDMOs to provide technical support and achieve key project milestones

• Author and review documents such as SOPs, batch records, protocols, and reports to produce clinical and/or commercial products

• Ensure appropriate compliance through document creation/review/approval, quality investigations, corrective actions, and change control within a Quality system

• Follows procedures to support intellectual property protection

• Provide first line technical support for ongoing batch manufacturing as the first point of contact for technical questions, concerns, and/or escalations

• Work closely and collaboratively with Quality Assurance to provide ongoing support to manufacturing partners

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in science or engineering with > 7 years of experience in the radiopharmaceutical industry, including GMP; or PhD in science or engineering with >5 years of experience in radio-pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry, including GMP. PET manufacturing, handling of automated synthesis modules, and analytical experience is desirable

• Hands‑on experience with multiple isotopes like F-18, Lu-177 and I-131 etc. are a plus for this position

• Demonstrated leadership and managerial skills

• Experience working cross-functionally with a team of internal scientists and engineers, managing external CDMOs to ensure compliance with project timelines/cGMPs, and on-going manufacturing operations

• Experience working in radiopharmaceutical manufacturing environments, including knowledge of radiation safety principles, ALARA, and applicable regulatory requirement

• Experience in MS Office suite applications (e.g., Excel, Word, Project)

• Experience in authoring challenging technical documents, including but not limited to, protocols, reports, SOPs, and quality investigations

• Experience in radiopharmaceutical and process development

Key Capabilities:

• Autonomy: Comfortable working independently with senior-level support

• Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with internal and external colleagues and stakeholders, using clear and concise language.

• Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges

• Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected

• Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do

• Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results

• Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges

• Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals

• Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges

• Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

Travel expectation: ~10-25% (including international, overnight, and weekend) may be required for key in-person meetings, partner site visits, and SME/technical assignments

At Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives. Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world.  We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

jobs.title: Manager, Social Media & Digital Enagement
jobs.description:
Salary: $70,000-75,000. This position is also eligible for a bonus incentive.
Washington, DC or Remote

BBYO is the largest pluralistic Jewish teen movement in the world, with tens of thousands of members across 60+ countries. We're looking for a passionate social media professional to join our marketing and communications team and make a difference.

Do you spot a trend before it peaks and know how it should look on Instagram versus LinkedIn? Do you get as excited about a perfectly timed caption as you do about a cost-per-click report? Does the idea of leading the social presence of a global movement of teens thrill you? Then this job is for you!

As our Social Media and Digital Engagement lead, you'll own BBYO's organic and paid social strategy from end to end. You'll build an engaged community across our platforms, grow our brand, and collaborate with our teen communications leaders. Your work will include:

• Social media strategy, planning, and goal setting across every platform we're on

• Platform-native content creation, with a distinct voice for each channel and audience

• Paid social and Google Ads campaign management

• Trend spotting and real-time, reactive content

• Leading the teen Press Corps social media team

• Coaching BBYO’s international teen communications leaders (Mazkir and Mazkirah)

• Analytics, reporting, and brand reputation monitoring

YOU

You live on the internet and know what's trending with Gen Z and Alpha. You understand that a great Instagram carousel, a TikTok, a LinkedIn post, and a Snapchat story are four different things, and you can write for a 15-year-old, a parent, an alum, and a donor without missing a beat.

You're tech savvy and an early adopter. You use AI tools to brainstorm, draft, edit, and analyze, and you know where human judgment has to take over. You're as comfortable in Meta Ads Manager as you are in a content calendar, and you're an "always learner" who's excited to test new platforms and tools. You care about the teens behind every post, and you’d rather hand them the mic and coach them instead of speaking for them. Oh, and you're super creative.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Social media strategy and management

• Own BBYO's social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube, Facebook, X, and LinkedIn, with clear goals and KPIs for each channel.

• Define and maintain a platform-specific voice and content approach for each channel and audience within BBYO's brand guidelines.

• Manage the day-to-day social presence, including community management, comment moderation, and real-time engagement during major moments like BBYO International Convention (IC) and summer programs.

• Monitor the social media space for brand mentions, conversations, and potential issues, and escalate as needed.

• Manage BBYO’s photo library in Google Photos, collecting images from events, staff, teens, and photographers and organizing them into albums so the team can quickly find what it needs.

• Report monthly on performance, including reach, engagement, conversions, and return on spend, and turn insights into recommendations.

Content and trends

• Lead ideation and creation of stories, carousels, reels, and copy, partnering with teens, staff, and creators to keep content authentic and teen-centered.

• Track platform features, audio, memes, and cultural moments, and move quickly to turn relevant trends into on-brand content.

• Build and manage a monthly content calendar that balances planned campaigns, evergreen content, and reactive posts.

• Use AI tools to speed up ideation, copywriting, editing, repurposing, and analysis, with human review to protect brand voice, accuracy, and teen safety.

Paid media

• Plan, build, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, and other platforms as needed.

• Manage Google Ads campaigns to drive registration, membership, and fundraising.

• Own audience targeting, A/B testing and budgets, and set up conversion tracking with pixels, UTMs, and Google Analytics.

Teen leadership and coachinh

• Mentor the International Mazkir and Mazkirah (teen communications leads), supporting their goals, initiatives, and growth as leaders.

• Lead the Press Corps social media team, an initiative where teens capture and share BBYO’s story year-round via social media channels.

• Support execution across three Press Corps cycles each year: a school-year cohort (fall–spring), an IC cohort (winter through International Convention), and a summer cohort (May–August).

jobs.title: Associate Solutions Manager
jobs.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a technology and science community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We're looking for an Associate Solutions Manager to help us accomplish our mission to improve lives by learning from the experience of every cancer patient. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

What You'll Do

Flatiron’s real world evidence (RWE) solutions are helping life science companies accelerate oncology R&D, design clinical trials, attain regulatory approvals and much more. The Client Solutions team plays an instrumental role in designing and delivering fit for use data and services that serve our customers needs, configuring and executing on the solution, and ensuring customers derive maximum value from it. You will support a cross-functional client-facing team aimed at identifying and delivering high-impact RWE solutions across the drug development lifecycle. You will engage with clients and internal teams throughout to ensure successful scope identification, solutions design, execution, delivery and client satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, customer obsessed, comfortable with ambiguity and brings a track record of removing both technical and logistical roadblocks to meet customer needs. In addition, you'll also:

• Partner with Flatiron Life Science Partnerships team and Flatiron customers to ensure a clear understanding of the customer need and any additional considerations (e.g., budget, timeline, expertise, etc) that might affect the solutions you come up with.

• Design fit-for-purpose RWE solutions for our customers, which includes understanding and breaking down use cases, defining patient cohort selection criteria, designing specific data models, aligning on analytic approaches and setting the right quality bar for the cross-functional team to execute against.

• Manage a portfolio of 3-5 solutions (e.g., real-world data deliverables and/or analytic services) in parallel and prioritize tasks across projects and teams based on comprehensive judgment of trade-offs

• Interface with and lead problem-solving discussions with internal stakeholders (e.g., Life Sciences Partnerships, Research Oncology, Clinical Data, Product, Engineering, and Research Sciences) to ensure that all necessary inputs are considered and the team makes sound decisions

• Take ownership of our existing operations process and work with our technology teams to streamline so that we can respond to our customers needs as soon as possible

• Lead or support meetings and engagements with customers (e.g., Life Sciences companies) and communicate progress and decisions clearly and regularly to internal and external stakeholders

• Create and standardize processes so that each project is easier, faster and/or of higher quality than the last one

You’ll be our key liaison between our Life Sciences Partnerships, Research Oncology, Clinical Data, Product, Engineering, and Research Sciences teams to drive projects while scaling Flatiron’s long-term research offerings.

Who You Are

You are skilled in project management, analytical/quantitative thinking, structured communication (both oral and written) and excited about learning and becoming an expert of the Flatiron ecosystem. You're excited by the prospect of rolling up your sleeves to tackle meaningful problems each and every day. You’re a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who recommends improvements and alternative solutions to resolve problems. You effectively lead cross-functional teams and value the chance to make an important impact.

• At least 2 years work experience in one of the following types of highly structured or scientific environments: healthcare consulting, RWD/RWE, CRO/ARO, or pharmaceutical industry

• Superb project management and communication skills

• Highly organized and results oriented with a high degree of ownership

• Comfort executing in ambiguous, rapidly evolving businesses with multiple stakeholders and dependencies

• Demonstrated bias for action

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• Experience working on cross-functional teams

• Passion to fight cancer

Extra Credit

• Experience or coursework in a quantitative discipline such as biostatistics, epidemiology, applied statistics, health economics, or a related discipline

Where You’ll Work

In this hybrid role, you’ll have a defined work location that includes work from home and 3 office days set by you and your team. For more information on our approach to hybrid work, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

• Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive compensation package

• 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals

• Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice

• Mental well-being tools and services

• Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave

• Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy

• Travel support for safe healthcare services

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Titan Security is built on serving our clients and building careers – just like yours. We are trusted by some of the most well-known companies and properties in the country while remaining dedicated to building personalized security solutions that solve the needs of every customer we support. Role Summary The Security Shift Supervisor leads shift operations, managing assigned security officers, access control, crowd management, and real-time incident response across the public concourses, retail levels, and transit-connected zones. Situated beneath a 38-story residential tower and a 22-story office high-rise, the complex features major retail anchors, a multi-screen cinema, a dining hall, and direct underground pedestrian access to both the CTA Blue Line and Red Line subway stations. • Observe departing personnel to guard against theft of tenant or building property.

• Monitor security cameras that are within the facility.

• Respond to incidents including property emergencies.

• Ability to stand/sit/walk for extended periods of time.

• Assist tenants and visitors with directions and general business information.

• Clearly and accurately record data such as property damage, unusual occurrences, and malfunctioning of equipment, to building and Titan management.

• Maintain clear, accurate logs pertaining to people or property including packages.

• Provide excellent Customer Service to all parties encountered while on duty.

• Other duties as assigned.

***These positions require at least 2 years of continuous supervisory experience.***

Education and/or Experience:  High School diploma or general education degree (GED) and 3 years prior satisfactory employment as a security officer or directly related experience.  Must be at least 18 years of age.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Valid Security License if required by state, driver’s license as applicable.

Language Skills:  Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Bi-lingual considered a plus.

Other Qualifications:  Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check.  Must maintain a working telephone number though which we can contact you.

Physical Demands: The physical demands are based on the contract and must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  A list of these job duties is inclusive of, but not limited to: candidates must be able to stand for extended periods of time; be able to lift, push, and/or pull at least 50 lbs.; be able to accommodate foot patrols on the interior & exterior of the assigned facility; be able to perform assigned duties regardless of inclement weather.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We’ve done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they can feel empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

We’re rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That’s where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

VEG is a 2025 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we find a way to say YES—and this role brings that mindset to hiring top talent across the Central Region. As a Talent Manager, you’ll be key to building strong, high-performing hospital teams by driving a proactive, relationship-focused recruiting strategy. You’ll partner with hospital leadership to attract exceptional Veterinarians, Technicians, Assistants, and more—people who live VEG’s mission and values.

Reporting to the Regional Director of Talent Acquisition, you’ll lead hiring efforts across multiple hospitals, develop tailored recruitment plans, and train leaders to help scale our high-touch approach to hiring.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Act as a strategic thought partner with the Talent Team/hospital leadership in order to understand and execute against the constantly evolving needs of the organization

• Understand and own your hospitals’ hiring needs by partnering with the leadership team to identify strategic talent pools, source top-tier candidates, manage candidates through a mutual assessment process, and work with candidates through all parts of their offer process

• Create and drive scalable talent strategies through a deep expertise of industry best practices, diverse relationships and networks, and strong cross-function execution

• Build and sustain a creative relationship-based approach for talent while utilizing multiple channels and talent pools

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization as well as external vendors

• Attend conferences to meet and attract the best talent in various industries such as veterinary, retail, hospitality, etc.

• Consistently drive improvements across our process and technology landscape in line to drive efficiencies

• Develop and sustain key performance indicators and metrics to measure success across your region

• Mentor and guide team members in your region to promote personal growth and development

WHAT YOU NEED

• 4-year degree from an accredited undergraduate institute (any field of study) preferred

• 4+ years of recruiting experience

• Based in Central region, preferably in the Houston/Austin or San Antonio market.

• Experience with candidate management in either a CRM or ATS platforms, we use Greenhouse and GEM

• Passion for Talent and creative ways of finding, attracting, and assessing candidates

• Strong communication and organizational skills, as well as the ability to multi-task and maintain confidentiality, are a must

• Energetic, motivated, self-starter

• Ability to travel, 25-30% of the time (domestic and international travel possible)

• Experience with (phone, video and in-person) interviews, candidate screening, and assessment

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive Compensation Including ($110,000 - $130,000) + bonus + benefits.

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Paid parental leave, up to 10 weeks at 100% of regular salary, and offering inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Unlimited PTO to use for vacation or sick days - however you need it!

• Generous referral rewards, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people.

DEI
At VEG, diversity is a strength that fuels innovation and compassion. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most”—and we do that best when VEGgies feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We’re committed to building a culture that reflects the communities we serve, where different perspectives are celebrated, voices are heard, and everyone has equitable opportunities to grow. Saying yes to VEG means helping us become the world’s veterinary emergency company, together.

• Ability to attain basic competencies in operation of computer software including scheduling programs, electronic health records, and computerized telephone system

jobs.description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Recruiting Operations Manager Role: We are seeking a Recruiting Operations Manager to build and own the systems, processes, and reporting that enable our global recruiting team to deliver on an ambitious hiring plan. You’ll help translate hiring priorities into clear workflows, reliable data, and actionable insights—giving recruiters more time to recruit and leaders greater visibility into hiring progress and risks. This is a highly hands-on role with broad ownership across recruiting technology, data integrity, reporting, capacity planning, and process improvement. You’ll partner closely with Recruiting leadership, People Operations, People Business Partners, FP&A, Legal, and hiring managers to strengthen how we operate across regions. You’ll be equally comfortable configuring a Greenhouse workflow, reconciling hiring data, building a forecast, and helping teams adopt a better process. Success means our recruiting operations become more accurate, efficient, and predictable as the company grows. This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC, one of our office hubs, or elsewhere in the US. We expect East Coast work hours, with flexibility to collaborate with global teammates. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. As Our Recruiting Operations Manager You Will: • Own recruiting systems and workflows. Manage Greenhouse and related tools, including configurations, permissions, templates, approvals, integrations, and improvements in partnership with People Operations. • Ensure reliable recruiting data. Establish data standards, ownership, and audits; resolve discrepancies across Greenhouse and ChartHop to keep approved roles, recruiting activity, offers, and hires aligned. • Turn reporting into action. Own dashboards and operating reviews tracking hiring progress, funnel conversion, stage timing, offer acceptance, sourcing effectiveness, and hiring targets. Drive recommendations and follow-through. • Improve hiring forecasts and capacity planning. Assess hiring delivery using pipeline trends, role complexity, recruiter capacity, and expected start dates. Flag risks and inform prioritization and resourcing. • Maintain hiring plan integrity. Partner with FP&A and PBPs to align approved roles, recruiting status, recruiter assignments, and target start dates, providing insights for headcount budgets and financial forecasts. • Strengthen recruiting processes. Improve workflows from headcount approval through onboarding handoff, defining responsibilities, service expectations, and escalation paths. • Enable consistent execution. Build documentation, training, and tools for recruiting teams and hiring managers. Drive adoption and assess impact on hiring outcomes and candidate experience. • Scale through automation and tools. Reduce manual work through integrations, automation, and AI. Evaluate vendors and tool adoption, partnering with People Operations, Legal, and IT on access, privacy, and operational controls. You Are Likely To Succeed as our Recruiting Operations Manager If: • You have 5+ years of experience in recruiting operations, talent operations, or a closely related field, including meaningful ownership of recruiting systems, reporting, and process improvement in a growing organization, at least 2 years as a Recruiter. • You have hands-on Greenhouse administration experience and can independently configure workflows, troubleshoot issues, and improve how recruiters and hiring managers use the system. • You are highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, with experience reconciling data across systems, building reporting, and turning analysis into practical recommendations. Experience with ChartHop, business intelligence tools, or SQL is a plus. • You understand recruiting funnels, hiring forecasts, and capacity planning, and can explain both what the data shows and where assumptions or data quality limit the conclusion. • You have a track record of taking an unclear or inconsistent process, establishing ownership, and implementing improvements that teams actually adopt. • You build strong partnerships across Recruiting, People, Finance, and business leaders. You can clarify responsibilities, navigate competing priorities, and influence decisions without direct authority. • You combine strong attention to detail with sound judgment about what matters most. You are comfortable owning recurring operational work while making the underlying processes better. • You enjoy being a hands-on individual contributor with broad functional ownership. Experience supporting recruiting across multiple countries or regions is a plus. • Prior people management experience preferred What We Offer: Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more! • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above! • The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $114,000 - $145,000, with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 10%. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks. The compensation package also includes equity. This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers.

ON.energy is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers.

Project Engineer

ON.energy is seeking a Project Engineer to support the planning, coordination, and execution of battery energy storage (BESS) and mission-critical data center power infrastructure projects. The Project Engineer plays a key role in bridging engineering, procurement, and construction activities, ensuring that designs are implemented correctly, technical issues are resolved promptly, and project milestones are achieved.

This role is well suited to someone with strong technical fundamentals, clear communication skills, and a desire to grow within a fast-paced, high-impact environment supporting the AI data center infrastructure build-out.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Technical Coordination

• Support the execution of battery energy storage and power infrastructure projects from engineering through commissioning.

• Interface daily with contractors, vendors, engineers, and permitting authorities to keep project activities on schedule.

• Track material submittals, procurement status, and construction progress against the project plan.

Engineering Design Review & Technical Submittals

• Review and coordinate construction and electrical design drawings, including single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and site layouts.

• Assist in preparing technical submittals, RFIs, and design packages for review and approval.

• Help identify, troubleshoot, and resolve design or installation issues in coordination with engineering.

Procurement, Construction & Field Support

• Support construction teams during field execution to ensure technical accuracy and compliance with approved plans.

• Participate in site inspections, quality control reviews, and punch-list development.

• Travel to project sites as needed to support field execution and resolve on-site technical issues.

Documentation & Project Close-Out

• Assist in documentation and close-out processes, including as-built drawings and O&M manuals.

• Maintain accurate, version-controlled project records in coordination with the Document Control function.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or Energy Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.

• 3–6 years of experience in engineering or project support roles within construction, energy, or infrastructure projects.

• Working knowledge of battery energy storage systems (BESS), switchgear, transformers, UPS, or other critical power infrastructure.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and site layouts.

• Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to coordinate across engineering, procurement, and construction teams.

• Willingness to travel to project sites (approximately 20–30%).

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience on data center, utility-scale, or EPC energy infrastructure projects.

• Exposure to permitting, inspection, or utility interconnection processes.

• Familiarity with ESS technologies, MV/LV power systems, or UPS architecture.

• Experience supporting FAT, commissioning, or site acceptance testing.

• PE license (or active pursuit of licensure) is a plus.

• Bilingual English/Spanish, useful for coordination with the Mexico City engineering team.

• Interest in long-term career growth within the clean energy and mission-critical infrastructure industry.

jobs.title: Global Head of Programmatic Product
jobs.description:
At Jellyfish we believe that our individual differences are our greatest assets. We are passionate about empowering every employee to reach their full potential and contribute their unique perspectives to our collaborative environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and firmly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce drives innovation and leads to better solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other personal characteristics that make them who they are.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

The salary range for this position is ($220,000 – $260,000 per year)

The Global Programmatic Lead (Programmatic Architect) is the senior technical practice leader for Programmatic Media across Jellyfish, sitting within the Domain Specialists hub and reporting to the Chief Solutions Officer - Media, Strategy & AI (CSO). You are the global custodian of how Jellyfish architects, engineers, automates, and commercialises programmatic activation across DSPs, SSPs, curation layers, bidding algorithms, and data clean rooms.

This is a senior role, there is no direct line management or people management but you are expected to collaborate with activation team leads & regional media leadership to affect positive change for Jellyfish clients. You are not running campaign ops or managing direct reports; you are the agency’s most senior programmatic technologist and systems architect. You define the global practice, codify frameworks for scaled delivery, contribute to our proprietary product roadmap, lead high-stakes pitches to win new business, drive technical advancement through strategic ad-tech partnerships, and serve as principal technical counsel to our highest-value global enterprise clients.

You partner closely with regional media and delivery leads across NA, EMEA, and APAC. While regional delivery teams execute programmatic campaigns in their local markets, you set the technical architecture, bidding methodologies, automation workflows, and delivery standards they operate from.

 

50% Product, Commercial & Technical Partnerships · 50% Client Strategic & Technical Leadership

The role is an intentional 50/50 split:

 - 50% Practice & Product Architecture: Designing buying & audience strategies, automation hooks/MCP integration, steering ad-tech integration roadmaps, managing top-tier tech partnerships (Google, The Trade Desk, Amazon, etc.), and spearheading major pitches.

 - 50% Client Strategic Leadership: Serving as principal programmatic strategist and trusted technical advisor for Tier-1 accounts, driving technical maturity (signal resilience, clean rooms, custom algorithms) and unlocking incremental retained revenue.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

1. Product Strategy, Automation & Technical Partnerships (50%)

 - Define the Global Programmatic Methodology: Own and update the global programmatic playbook, codifying standards across audience intelligence, bidding, algorithmic optimisation, curated marketplaces (PMPs/PG), dynamic creative optimisation (DCO), and identity/signal resilience.

 - Codify Delivery & Drive Automation: triage execution into fully automated, hybrid, or human-assisted workflows, handing off artefacts to delivery and MSP teams to streamline campaign build times and eliminate operational friction.

 - Contribute to Proprietary Product Evolution: Partner directly with Jellyfish Product teams to feed technical requirements, data schemas, and API automation hooks into internal tooling.

 - Ad-Tech Partnerships & Frontier Innovation: Own strategic technical relationships with core platforms (DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon, Google, premium SSPs, retail ad networks, clean rooms). Secure first-mover advantage on platform alphas and betas, testing them technically and translating them into deployable client solutions.

 - Product-Centric New Business: Architect winning product narratives, bespoke tech architectures, and commercial frameworks for major pitches and RFPs. Lead the programmatic discipline in tier-1 global pitches, driving high pitch-win rates and expanding retained scope.

 - Cross-Discipline Integration: Architect the connective programmatic layer across Search, Social, Retail Media, GEO, and Creative, building unified full-funnel activation frameworks (e.g., audience syncing, cross-channel frequency management, closed-loop attribution).

2. Client Strategic & Technical Leadership (50%)

 - Principal Technical Counsel for Tier-1 Clients: Act as the lead advisor for CMOs, Heads of Media, and MarTech executives at enterprise accounts - translating complex programmatic engineering into board-level growth strategies.

 - Drive Client Programmatic & AI Maturity: Actively advance Tier-1 clients along the programmatic maturity curve.

 - Brief Validation & Technical Governance: Serve as the technical filter on complex client briefs, ensuring brief feasibility and alignment with modern media architectures before execution.

 - Thought Leadership & External Voice: Represent Jellyfish as a category authority through POVs, white papers, analyst briefings, industry summits, and keynotes on topics like cookieless addressability, agentic media buying, and AI-driven curation.

Qualifications:

 - 8+ years of advanced programmatic and ad-tech experience within an agency, DSP/SSP, ad-tech vendor, or sophisticated brand-side media team.

 - Expert Technical Proficiency across Enterprise DSPs: Deep technical fluency with platforms such as Display & Video 360 (DV360), The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, Campaign Manager 360, and major SSP curation tools.

 - Supply Path & Media Economics: Strong track record designing SPO frameworks, private marketplace (PMP) deal structures, and custom algorithm setups.

 - Track Record in Commercial Growth: Proven background contributing to high-value new business pitches, RFPs, and expanding programmatic scope in enterprise brand accounts.

 - No line-management required, but proven leadership through influence, upskilling, and technical mentorship across cross-functional teams.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.


Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritize your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs

💰Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme and 401k retirement plan.

🏥 Healthcare plans: Have peace of mind with our healthcare, vision and dental insurance, plus short and long-term disability and life cover.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to talentacquisition@jellyfish.com.
