jobs.title: Deadline: TV Writer
jobs.description:
Deadline: TV Writer

Deadline is the authoritative source for breaking news in the entertainment industry, regularly included on lists of top entertainment websites. Influential industry thought leaders and key decision-makers in the entertainment, financial and other business fields regularly track Deadline.com for news breaks. Due to its avid audience, Deadline.com’s postings regularly receive more reader comments than all entertainment industry news sites combined.

This position will cover the business of television. This position will find and break the stories that matter to the industry, from fast-moving news to the bigger-picture trends behind it. Drawing on sources among executives, agents and publicists to report exclusives, secure high-profile interviews and stay ahead of the competition.

Day-to-day, this position will develop, write and edit stories, respond quickly when news breaks, and cover major industry events while bringing story ideas to the team and work with Deadline's reporters and editors. This role will work independently and take initiative.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Los Angeles.

Key Responsibilities:

• Break impactful TV business news on a regular basis, and be fast and first on breaking stories

• Identify, analyze and report on breaking news and bigger-picture TV stories

• Build and maintain a pipeline of sources to report exclusives

• Develop, write and edit stories daily

• Spot stories that will generate buzz and traffic

• Attend, cover and write about major industry events

• Stay across industry trends and issues

• Come to the team with ideas for new and impactful projects

Required Qualifications:

• Minimum of 3-5 years of reporting experience across TV and media, with at least 2 years in a professional setting

• Strong writing skills and well-connected sources within the TV industry, from executives to agents to publicists

• Ability to analyze, interpret and break hard news

• Proven track record of exclusive news stories

• Ability to identify time-sensitive news and meet tight deadlines

• A self-starter who is enterprising and works well independently

• Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills

• Flexibility with work hours, including time outside the 9-to-5 weekday in urgent news situations

Preferred Qualifications:

• Understanding of how to optimize news for search and social media

• Strong networking skills

• Strong research skills and attention to detail

A good faith estimate of the salary is $75k - $100k upon hire. Factors that could be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, years of experience and comparison to current employees already in this role. If you have more or less experience than specified on this job posting, please apply and list your salary expectations.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors).

It’s all About You…

PMC's comprehensive benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support every aspect of your life, empowering you to thrive both personally and professionally. We offer PMC-Paid Healthcare with no employee paycheck contributions on medical, dental, and vision for you and your family. PMC also offers Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care & Commuter), an Employee Assistance Program, Life Insurance, Short & Long Term Disability, Paid Parental Leave, and a 401(k) Retirement Plan with an Employer match. Employees are also eligible to take advantage of company discounts and perks including Pet Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Mortgage discounts, and a variety of other savings on wellness, lifestyle, and financial essentials. As part of PMC's dedication to consistently meet employee’s needs, we have launched a new Flexible Vacation Policy.

At PMC, we believe working in a highly collaborative, office-first environment fosters real-time communication, spontaneous idea sharing, and stronger interpersonal relationships that drive innovation and team cohesion. PMC prioritizes in-person collaboration and does not offer remote-only roles.

About Deadline:

Deadline Hollywood is an authoritative source for breaking news in the entertainment industry, regularly included on lists of top entertainment websites. Influential industry thought leaders and key decision-makers in the entertainment, financial and other business fields track Deadline.com for the latest news multiple times a day. Due to its avid audience, Deadline.com’s postings regularly receive more reader comments than all entertainment industry news sites combined. Deadline’s parent company, Penske Media Corporation (PMC), is a leading digital media company, publishing, and information Services Company founded in 2003.

About Penske Media Corporation (PMC)

Penske Media Corporation (PMC) is a leading global media and information services company whose award-winning content attracts a passionate monthly audience of more than 500 million people.  Since 2004, PMC has been a pioneer in digital media and owns over 300 live events, while reaching audiences across all screens. Penske Media is recognized, as one of the Top 100 Private Companies in the United States and North America.

Our Companies & Brands

• Iconic Media Brands (PMX): Variety, Rolling Stone, The Verge, Billboard, The Hollywood Reporter, WWD, SHE Media, Robb Report, Deadline, Eater, Sportico, ARTnews, Fairchild Media, VIBE, IndieWire, SB Nation, ARTFORUM, POPSUGAR, Gold Derby, BEAUTY INC, Art in America, Punch, The Dodo, and more.

• Data & Analytics: Luminate, the premier music and entertainment data and analytics company.

Global Footprint

PMC and its subsidiaries are co-headquartered in New York and Los Angeles, with additional offices spanning 14 countries worldwide.

Want to learn more? Visit www.PMC.com to explore our complete portfolio.

jobs.title: Traveling Reactor Services – Vessel & Systems Technicians
jobs.description:
The Nuclear Company is the fastest-growing AI-enabled startup in nuclear energy, bringing together experienced nuclear professionals, technologists, engineers, and builders to deliver the next generation of nuclear power. Through our design-once, build-many approach, we are creating a repeatable model for deploying nuclear fleets—combining the industry’s highest standards for safety, quality, and regulatory rigor with the speed and innovation required to meet the world’s growing energy needs.

We are building the future of nuclear work. Every employee is expected to use AI, technology, and our Nuclear Operating System (NOS) to strengthen engineering and operational decision-making, improve quality, eliminate inefficiencies, and accelerate execution without compromising safety. Our nuclear expertise shapes the continued evolution of NOS, enabling us to capture institutional knowledge, standardize best practices, and deliver complex projects with greater consistency and certainty.

We hire people who believe nuclear energy is essential to human progress. Our team is made up of mission-driven experts who respect the rigor of the industry while challenging outdated ways of working. They bring deep technical judgment, intellectual curiosity, high agency, and the humility to learn from others. Our values—Transparency, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappy, and Tenacity—guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions. Together, they form TRUST, the foundation of our safety culture and our commitment to intellectual honesty, personal accountability, open communication, and operational excellence.

TNC Services, the services division of The Nuclear Company, supports America's existing nuclear fleet by delivering specialized maintenance, outage execution, technical expertise, and workforce solutions. The organization includes the 25-year legacy and expertise of Powerhouse Resources while continuing to expand its capabilities through strategic growth, helping utilities maximize the reliability of today's nuclear fleet while advancing the next generation of nuclear energy.

Please Note [[OUTAGE - TRAVEL - PROJECT WORK]]:

One Application. Multiple Opportunities.

• This posting is used to identify qualified candidates for current and upcoming outage and project work across our field services team.

• Apply once, and we'll consider you for opportunities that match your experience, certifications, travel preferences, and availability.

• If your background aligns with a current or future project, one of our recruiters will reach out to discuss the opportunity in more detail.

• Compensation, travel, and per diem packages may vary depending on the specific project, location, and duration.

Overview:
We are seeking experienced traveling in-vessel, under-vessel, inspection, and reactor systems professionals to support current and upcoming outage and project work at commercial nuclear power plants. These roles support in-vessel and under-vessel inspections, foreign material search and retrieval, reactor system maintenance, and specialized reactor instrumentation work performed during scheduled outages.

Typical backgrounds we are looking for include:

• In-Vessel Inspection (IVVI) Technicians

• In-Vessel Technicians and Reactor Vessel Inspection Technicians

• Foreign Object Search and Retrieval (FOSAR) Technicians

• Under-Vessel Inspection (UVIC) Technicians

• Under-Vessel Services and Reactor Maintenance Technicians

• Control Rod Drive (CRD) Technicians and CRD Maintenance Technicians

• Hydraulic Control Unit (HCU) Technicians

• LPRM, TIP, and Incore Instrument Technicians

• Incore Instrumentation and Flux Thimble Technicians

• Reactor Services Technicians with specialized in-vessel, under-vessel, or reactor systems experience

• Reactor Services Leads, Foremen, and Supervisors with experience in these areas

This role is a fit if you have:

• Hands-on experience in one or more in-vessel, under-vessel, inspection, CRD/HCU, or reactor instrumentation scopes at a commercial nuclear power plant

• Experience with IVVI, FOSAR, UVIC, LPRM, TIP, in core instrumentation, or related reactor systems

• Ability to read and follow work packages, procedures, and technical documentation

• Experience working in highly regulated, safety-critical environments with a strong commitment to quality, radiological controls, foreign material exclusion (FME), and nuclear safety

• Previous nuclear badging or unescorted access (preferred)

• Willingness to travel for outage and project-based assignments throughout the United States

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to build backend services and APIs that support our robotic platforms and associated application workflows. The successful candidate will design and build services and APIs that are scalable, testable, maintainable, and easy to integrate with internal and external systems. This role will also provide technical leadership across service design, architecture, and engineering practices.

Essential Job Duties

• Design, build, test, and operate backend services and APIs that support our robotic platforms and associated application workflows.
• Architect and develop service capabilities such as remote configuration management, software updates, service workflows, and telemetry data ingestion.
• Implement comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end testing within CI pipelines.
• Drive CI/CD, observability, and operational practices that support small, frequent, and high-confidence releases.
• Ensure services and APIs include first-class documentation, health endpoints, and uptime monitoring.

• Strong experience with automated testing, Gitlab CI/CD, and AWS-based deployment practices for backend services.

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
The Payroll Specialist is responsible for the accurate and compliant administration of multi-state payroll operations, payroll tax compliance, reporting, audits, and payroll data integrity. This role serves as the primary payroll resource for employees and management, supports payroll-related activities, manages payroll audits and tax compliance initiatives, and supports payroll data validation and reporting for the Workday implementation. The position also provides support to Human Resources as needed, including benefits administration, employee records management, compliance initiatives, and special projects.

Payroll Administration & Reporting

• Process and administer accurate, timely multi-state payroll in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
• Maintain payroll records, employee compensation data, tax withholdings, deductions, garnishments, W-4s, and W-2 reporting.
• Reconcile payroll data, resolve discrepancies, and support year-end payroll processing and reporting.
• Prepare payroll reports, workforce metrics, and data analysis to support business needs.
• Partner with other sites to support payroll processing and employee data management.

Payroll Audits, Tax Compliance & HR Systems

• Manage corporate payroll audits and ensure compliance with payroll regulations, internal controls, and company policies.
• Conduct payroll data audits, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain payroll accuracy and data integrity.
• Review state payroll tax requirements and coordinate registrations and compliance activities for new state jurisdictions.
• Resolve payroll tax issues by working with payroll vendors and government agencies.
• Support Workday implementation through payroll data audits, testing, validation, reporting, and system integration efforts.
• Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance payroll efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.

Benefits & Financial Reporting Support

• Validate and reconcile union and health insurance invoices before submission to Finance.
• Partner with Finance to prepare payroll, benefits, labor, and workforce-related reports.
• Review and reconcile payroll deductions, benefit premiums, and union dues to ensure accuracy and compliance.
• Support audits, reporting, and financial data requests as needed.

HR Support

• Support HR operations, including benefits administration, onboarding, employee records, compliance initiatives, and special projects.
• Assist with benefit enrollments, employee communications, employee events, audits, and HR record maintenance.
• Provide backup support to the HR team during periods of increased workload.

1-3 years of experience processing multi-state payroll.

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (Agents & Evals)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

MOXFIVE helps enterprises respond to, recover from, and build resilience against cyber attacks. Our responders have led many of the most prominent security investigations in the world, from ransomware that takes a business offline to nation-state intrusions. When an attack hits, we work alongside the executives, outside counsel, and insurers who need answers fast and need answers they can defend.


The MOXFIVE founding team brings over 30 years of combined cybersecurity experience from leading companies such as CrowdStrike, Mandiant, Palo Alto Networks, Crypsis, Illumio, and Expel. Intelligent Insurer named MOXFIVE Cyber Security Consulting Team of the Year in 2024 and 2025, and Inc. has named us one of its Best Workplaces three times.


Today, we are focused on seizing an opportunity with the potential to disrupt the breach response market. We are building an AI investigation platform that puts our frontline experience behind every analyst on a case.


WHO YOU ARE

You are an engineer who treats agent behavior as a real engineering discipline, not prompt guesswork. You have shipped tool-using agents in production, dug through messy runs when they went sideways, and built evaluations that tell you whether a change actually helped.


You want to stay close to the full improvement loop. Rather than handing findings off to another team, you investigate why an agent fell short, test new approaches, and ship the changes directly into prompts, tools, and the runtime.


THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

Our agents investigate real security incidents alongside forensic analysts, where every finding has to hold up under scrutiny. Because we are an active incident response firm, you will work directly with frontline responders rather than guessing on generic benchmarks. 

You will design evaluations rooted in real-world tradecraft, research and test ways to make our agents sharper, and work alongside the team in the runtime to ship what proves out.
Your core responsibilities will include:

 - Investigation Evaluations: Building high-fidelity evaluation suites and realistic intrusion scenarios alongside forensic responders (including clean-host negative cases and tricky edge cases), calibrating automated graders against analyst judgment, and turning recurring failure modes into permanent regression tests.

 - Model Benchmarking & Selection: Evaluating frontier and specialized models, reasoning settings, and routing strategies against our forensic benchmarks to drive decisions on quality, latency, and cost.

 - Applied Agent Research: Investigating where our agents struggle on complex forensic workflows, researching new prompting, context, memory, and agent patterns, and running controlled experiments to separate real gains from noise.

 - Prompts, Tools & Runtime Iteration: Partnering directly in the agent runtime, system prompts, and tool interfaces (schemas, descriptions, context assembly, and error recovery) so evaluation insights land quickly in production.

 - Reliability & Safety Gates: Running evaluation checks before prompt, tool, model, or runtime changes ship, and testing how agents behave when reading adversarial or untrusted evidence.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Production Agent Engineering: You've built and operated tool-using LLM agents in production across multiple model providers, including multi-step control loops, tool calling, context management, and graceful failure handling.

 - Evaluation Systems: You've designed and maintained LLM evaluation harnesses in production (curated datasets, expert rubrics, automated judges calibrated to human reviewers, and CI regression suites), and you can talk candidly about where an eval misled you.

 - Trace-Driven Debugging: You can read a long agent trajectory, diagnose why the agent went off course, and turn messy qualitative failures into repeatable regression cases.

 - Strong Python: Production-grade Python with solid fundamentals in testing, observability, and maintainable system design, able to work directly in agent runtimes and build reliable evaluation tooling.

 - AI-Native Development: You build with coding agents every day and know how to review and verify what they produce.

 - Experimental & Measurement Rigor: You design clean model and prompt comparisons, separate real gains from run-to-run variance, and balance accuracy against latency and token cost.

 - Domain Collaboration: You work directly with subject-matter experts to translate tacit judgment into concrete rubrics and agent capabilities, and you communicate tradeoffs clearly in writing and in person.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Security Domain: Experience building security products, or familiarity with digital forensics, incident response, or security telemetry.

 - Expert Domains: Experience building AI systems for specialists in high-stakes fields such as legal, healthcare, or finance where conclusions must be auditable.

 - Adversarial & Long-Horizon Agents: Experience hardening agents that inspect untrusted inputs (such as prompt-injection defenses) or operating long-running, stateful agent workflows.

jobs.title: Laser Architect - Beam Smoothing
jobs.description:
Summary
We are looking for a Senior Laser Architect to take ownership of beam-smoothing technology within our laser-driven fusion programme. You will work in the Laser Division to connect smoothing performance with science requirements and laser system design, so that beam quality and system reliability support our fusion energy goals.



Key responsibilities

 - Own the beam-smoothing roadmap, from concept through deployment and continuous improvement.

 - Translate science and system requirements into beam-smoothing and laser-system specifications.

 - Guide the design and optimisation of smoothing approaches for uniformity, contrast and focal-spot quality, across coherent and incoherent techniques.

 - Assess how smoothing choices affect the wider laser and facility architecture, balancing performance, complexity, risk and cost.

 - Work with modelling, experimental and engineering teams to turn results into design decisions.

 - Support technology selection and supplier engagement for smoothing-related hardware and diagnostics.

 - Set design standards and provide technical direction and mentoring to the beam-smoothing team.

Required qualifications

 - PhD or equivalent experience in physics, optics, photonics, applied physics, electrical engineering or a related field.

 - Significant hands-on experience with high-power or high-energy laser systems, in research or industry.

 - Solid understanding of beam smoothing and beam quality, including coherence, speckle, propagation and focal-spot formation.

 - Experience designing and analysing experiments on laser performance or beam quality.

 - Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and translating physics needs into engineering requirements.

Preferred qualifications

 - Experience with laser-driven fusion or inertial confinement fusion programmes.

 - Experience with modelling tools for beam propagation and smoothing.

 - Familiarity with systems engineering practices such as requirements flow-down, verification and trade studies.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Engagement Director, Financial Services, you’ll own Legora’s partnerships with a focused portfolio of leading financial institutions and help build our approach to the sector. Working directly with General Counsel and senior legal leaders, you’ll shape how their departments put AI to work—and be accountable for turning that ambition into measurable value and long-term growth.

This is a senior, hands-on role combining direct account ownership with leadership of our financial services vertical within Engagement. You’ll lead the account team, develop approaches that work across institutions, and bring client priorities and insights directly into our product strategy, helping shape what Legora builds next.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the strategic partnerships. Set and lead the account strategy for a focused portfolio of financial institutions, connecting legal department priorities, adoption, and commercial growth in a multi-year plan.

 - Advise senior legal leaders. Earn the trust of General Counsel, legal leadership, and legal operations teams. Understand how each department supports the institution’s business and bring a clear perspective on where AI can create the greatest value.

 - Turn strategy into sustained adoption. Partner with Legal Engineering to embed Legora into legal workflows across teams, business lines, and jurisdictions. Build champions and work with client stakeholders to address the governance, security, and operational requirements that affect adoption.

 - Own the growth of the partnership. Be accountable for retention and expansion across your accounts. Lead renewal and growth strategy alongside commercial leadership, building executive support and a compelling business case for extending Legora into additional teams and use cases.

 - Prove the value. Agree on success measures with each institution and demonstrate improvements in legal workflows, turnaround times, and team capacity. Lead executive reviews that connect those results to renewal and expansion decisions, and intervene early when adoption stalls.

 - Shape Legora’s direction in financial services. Translate insight from your accounts into recommendations for Product, Legal Engineering, and leadership, influencing our roadmap, investment priorities, and approach to the sector.

 - Build the financial services engagement approach. Turn successful use cases and lessons from client delivery into frameworks the wider team can use. Establish repeatable approaches to adoption and value measurement while adapting to each institution’s needs.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 8+ years in strategic account management, consulting, professional services, or enterprise customer success, or equivalent customer-facing role, with a track record of leading complex relationships, advising senior stakeholders, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

 - Commercial ownership. You’ve translated client value into retention and expansion. You can lead complex renewal conversations, build compelling business cases, and develop a clear strategy for growing a major account.

 - A track record of turning strategy into action. You’ve helped complex organizations adopt new technology and change established ways of working. You know how to build champions and sustain momentum through demanding approval processes.

 - Experience leading teams. You’ve coached client-facing colleagues, set priorities, and held a team accountable for results while maintaining direct ownership of senior client relationships and commercial outcomes.

 - Strong analytical judgment and clear communication. You look beyond headline adoption numbers to understand what’s working, where momentum is stalling, and where an account can grow. You turn those insights into clear recommendations and challenge assumptions when the evidence calls for it.

 - A builder’s mindset. You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and build solutions where no playbook exists. You use AI to automate workflows and turn what you learn into tools and approaches that make the whole team more effective.




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Metron

Metron is an employee-owned company dedicated to delivering innovative solutions for the most challenging national security problems. For over 40 years, our principled approach to problem-solving has yielded creative solutions at the intersection of advanced mathematics, computer science, physics, and engineering. Our people are leaders in their technical fields and are passionate about solving challenging problems. Metron is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead day-to-day product direction on a high-performing team within our Mission Planning Line of Business. The Product Manager will connect mission needs, user feedback, customer priorities, and engineering execution to deliver operationally relevant capabilities through Agile development.

As the product leader, you will own the product roadmap and backlog, work closely with the Government Product Owner and mission users, and coordinate with technical and systems integration leaders so that each increment is feasible, testable, and aligned with the broader architecture and mission workflows.

Key Responsibilities

• Establish and maintain the product vision, roadmap, release priorities, and outcome measures in alignment with customer mission needs, operational intent, CONOPs and program objectives.

• Translate stakeholder and user needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable backlog items; prioritize work with the Government Product Owner and mission stakeholders.

• Lead product activities across Agile development teams, including backlog refinement, sprint and release planning, demonstrations, user acceptance activities, and feedback cycles.

• Engage mission users and subject-matter experts to discover needs, validate workflows, refine UI/UX concepts, and ensure delivered capabilities are useful in operational contexts.

• Coordinate with the Technical Lead, Systems Engineering and Integration Lead, and engineering teams to manage interfaces, dependencies, technical feasibility, and integration readiness.

• Guide delivery and integration of mission planning applications, enterprise systems, mission workflows, advanced analytics, data science, or AI/ML capabilities when they support mission outcomes.

• Track product outcomes, user feedback, risks, decisions, and dependencies; brief Government partners and program leadership on product status and recommended priorities.

• Support verification, validation, release readiness, transition to operations, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

• At least 5 years of U.S. Army, U.S. Marine Corps, Joint Force, or comparable military experience in operational planning, mission command, fires, intelligence, maneuver, command and control, or related functions.

• Active TS security clearance with the ability obtain SCI access.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent combination of education, military operational experience, and professional expertise.

• Demonstrated experience translating mission or user needs into product roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and executable software requirements.

• Experience delivering mission-critical software for DoW, Intelligence Community, space, cyber, or similarly operationally demanding environments.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams spanning software engineering, data and analytics, systems integration, test, and mission operations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to brief customer stakeholders and senior leadership.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience serving at the battalion, brigade, division, regiment, Marine Expeditionary Force, or higher operational-staff level.

• Familiarity with the Joint Planning Process, Military Decision-Making Process, Marine Corps Planning Process, or comparable planning methodologies.

• At least 5 years of product management, product ownership, or mission software delivery experience, including leadership of Agile development teams.

• Experience with military mission-planning systems, command-and-control systems, operational planning software, or digital mission applications.

• Experience with Agile methods, iterative release planning, backlog management, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and user feedback loops.

• Product Owner or Agile certification such as CSPO, Product Owner/Product Manager, or an equivalent credential.

• Experience supporting software fielding, deployment, transition to operations, training, or user adoption.

• Experience with software such as Confluence, Jira, ADO.

• Advanced degree in a relevant field.

Location: Reston, VA

*The selected individual must report to the Reston, VA office or other facilities to complete classified work. This is not a remote position.

jobs.title: Industrial Lube Technician (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Harsco Environmental is seeking a safety-focused and reliable Lube Technician to support the maintenance and performance of heavy mobile equipment operating in industrial and steel mill environments. The Lube Technician is responsible for performing preventive maintenance services including lubrication, fluid changes, filter replacements, inspections, and basic mechanical support on equipment such as loaders, excavators, material handlers, haul trucks, skid steers, forklifts, and overhead cranes. This position plays a critical role in maximizing equipment uptime, reducing breakdowns, and supporting safe operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform scheduled preventive maintenance services on heavy equipment according to manufacturer and company standards.
• Change engine oil, hydraulic oil, transmission fluid, gear oil, coolant, and other operating fluids.
• Inspect, lubricate, and service grease points on mobile equipment and designated plant equipment.
• Replace fuel, oil, air, hydraulic, and coolant filters.
• Conduct equipment inspections and identify potential mechanical issues, leaks, excessive wear, or safety concerns.
• Check and maintain proper fluid levels in engines, transmissions, differentials, hydraulic systems, and cooling systems.
• Service and assist with preventive maintenance activities on overhead cranes and other industrial material handling equipment as required.
• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and service records accurately.
• Notify supervisors and mechanics of equipment deficiencies requiring repair.
• Maintain clean and organized work areas, service trucks, tools, and maintenance facilities.
• Follow all Harsco Environmental safety policies, lockout/tagout procedures, and site-specific requirements.
• Support mechanics with general repair work when needed.
• Participate in safety meetings, training programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED preferred.
• Previous experience performing lubrication and preventive maintenance on heavy equipment, mining equipment, construction equipment, or industrial machinery preferred.
• Basic mechanical aptitude and understanding of diesel-powered equipment.
• Ability to identify fluid leaks, worn components, and abnormal equipment conditions.
• Ability to safely operate service trucks and lubrication equipment.
• Valid driver's license required.
• Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and industrial environments.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds regularly and perform physical labor including climbing, kneeling, bending, and standing for extended periods.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in steel mills, manufacturing facilities, mining operations, or heavy industrial environments.
• Knowledge of Caterpillar, Komatsu, Volvo, John Deere, Sennebogen, Terex, or similar heavy equipment.
• Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
• OSHA, MSHA, or industrial safety training experience.

Working Conditions

• Work is performed in active industrial and steel manufacturing environments.
• Exposure to heat, dust, noise, vibration, moving equipment, and outdoor weather conditions.
• Required use of personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, and steel-toed boots.
• May require overtime, weekends, holidays, and rotating shifts based on operational needs.

Additional Information

We offer competitive benefits, including health insurance, life insurance and disability plans, as well as a 401k with company matching.

Harsco is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Head of US, Multimodal Clearing
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

The Team:

This role is to join a "tip of the spear" team that brought Alpaca's ITN to market. We focus on building bleeding edge products that push the envelope for the entire industry. Alpaca's ITN is the world's first and only example of multimodal clearing; we invented the category. You will be joining a winning team that takes products from zero to one in the most authentic sense of the phrase with a track record to prove it. Expectations of excellence and technical competence are extremely high. This is not just any team at Alpaca: this is an elite squad of seasoned serial entrepreneurs with high agency responsible for the very innovations that generate Alpaca's competitive edge.

Your Role:

You are the US lead for Alpaca's multimodal clearing initiative. You hold the design conversations with clearinghouses, venues, blockchains, prime brokers and market makers, and you run the Washington work that a clearing agency needs: the SEC and the industry process around governance for the Longtable Foundation and proposed clearinghouse or partner clearinghouses.

You are the person in the room who can talk market structure with regulated clearinghouses, and then turn that into a build the engineering and product leads can execute. You work with the product, engineering, and legal leads on this team, and with Alpaca leadership.

Things You Get To Do:

• Own the US partner map for the clearinghouse: who we build with, who we clear for, and what we ask of each

• Lead solution design with outside clearing experts and onchain architects, from atomic settlement, netting through

• Represent the project to venues, issuers, and market makers on the roadshow, then drive each follow-up to a signed and scoped partnership

• Hire and direct the US operating core as the license work and the member pipeline grow

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

• Deep US market-structure experience across exchanges, broker-dealers, or clearing agencies

• A track record of getting something through a regulator or a member-owned market utility, not only of advising on one

• Enough technical fluency to argue a clearing design: novation, margin, default waterfall, and where a smart contract can and cannot replace a clearing agency

• Credibility with the people who run US equity market structure today

• Clear writing and a calm way of holding a multi-party negotiation

• Deft ability to use AI to produce prototypes instantly

jobs.title: Department Manager (Niš)
jobs.description:
ŠTA ĆEŠ RADITI

Kao menadžer odeljenja, bićeš lider u pružanju podrške i podsticanju celog svog tima. Negujući inkluzivnu kulturu koja promoviše saradnju i preduzetnički duh, stvaraćeš okruženje u kome svako može da napreduje. Postupajući u skladu sa našim vrednostima, doprinosićeš i svom, kao i kompanijskom uspehu.

Takođe ćeš:

• Voditi svoj tim ka postizanju izvanrednog iskustva kupaca, obezbeđujući odlične operativne i vizuelne standarde, dok aktivno promovišeš prodaju naših artikala.
• Preuzeti odgovornost za prednosti svog odeljenja i prodavnice, analizirati prodajne performanse, prepoznavati komercijalne mogućnosti, postavljati ciljeve i praviti planove za poboljšanje rezultata, profita i nivoa zaliha.
• Upravljati planiranjem tima i rasporeda i obezbeđivati neometane rutine zatvaranja i otvaranja prodavnice.
• Zapošljavati, obezbeđivati obuku i razvoj svog tima, negujući inkluzivnu kulturu punu saradnje koja promoviše razvoj i inovaciju.
• Biti u toku sa modnim trendovima, preferencama kupaca, kao i ponudom konkurentnih brendova, kako bi se održala konkurentska prednost.
• Predstavljati sebe i brend na pozitivan način tokom svake interakcije sa kupcima.
• Obezbeđivati ukupno OMNI iskustvo kupaca, promovišući aktivno naš program lojalnosti.

​

SA KIM ĆEŠ RADITI

Naše prodavnice su srce naše kompanije, gde naši kupci imaju direktan dodir sa našim brendom. Kao deo dinamičnog tima u prodavnici, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savetnika, menadžera odeljenja, menadžera prodavnice i aranžera, do glavnog blagajnika — doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog okruženja punog dobrodošlice.  Takođe ćeš sarađivati sa širim timom područja, kao i između prodavnica, kako biste delili iskustva i podsticali uspeh zajedno. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imaćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju pomoći kupcima da se osećaju samouvereno i ističu svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Gradeći značajne veze sa kupcima u našim prodavnicama, mi modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

KO SI TI

Tražimo osobe sa…

• Iskustvom u prodajnom menadžmentu i operativnosti.
• Ekspertizom u planiranju prodaje, analiziranju i praćenju, koristeći alate orijentisane prema kupcima i izveštavanje.

I osobe koje su…

• Snažni i samouvereni lideri, koji inspirišu, podučavaju i razvijaju svoj tim, dok ilustruju kompanijske vrednosti i kulturu.
• Uživaju u saradljivim i dinamičnim okolnostima, sa načinom razmišljanja koji je orijentisan prema pronalaženju rešenja.
• Motivisani da stvaraju odlično iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišu i prodaju naše artikle.
• Istinski zainteresovani za modne trendove, komercijalnost i uvide u konkurente radi podsticanja prodaje.
• Efikasni u komunikaciji, kreativni i znatiželjni.
• Fleksibilni, analitični i orijentisani ka postignućima, sa umećem da upravljaju statistikom i rade sa brojevima.

​

KO SMO MI

H&M Grupa je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i poduhvata. Naš cilj je da dokažemo da ne postoji kompromis između odličnog dizajna, pristupačnih cena i održivih rešenja. Želimo da oslobodimo modu za sve, a naši kupci su srce svake odluke koju donosimo.

​

Naš tim čine hiljade posvećenih i talentovanih kolega, koje su ujedinjene našom kulturom i vrednostima. Zajedno, želimo da koristimo našu moć, našu veličinu i znanje da usmerimo modnu industriju kao inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

​

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ OBOŽAVATI DA RADIŠ OVDE

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična kompanija puna dobrodošlice. Našim zaposlenima nudimo atraktivne benefite i beskrajne mogućnosti za razvoj širom sveta.

• 10% popusta za zaposlene u svim brendovima H&M grupe, u prodavnicama i onlajn
• H&M Incentive Program (podsticajni proram) – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovde.
• Poklon kartica za bebu
• Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
• Poklon za odlazak u penziju
• Bonus za preporuku prijatelja protivvrednosti
• Naknada za prevoz
• Naknada za dugogodišnji rad u kompaniji nakon 10, 15 i 20 godina
• Božićni/Novogodišnji poklon za decu zaposlenih

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE

Naša jedinstvenost potiče iz kombinacije mnogo stvari – naše kulture pune inkluzije i saradnje, naših snažnih vrednosti i mogućnosti za razvoj; ali najviše iz ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.

Neka tvoj sledeći korak u karijeri bude sa nama. Putovanje počinje ovde.

​*Posvećeni smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, zasnovan na jednakosti i kompetencijama. Zbog toga te molimo da u svojoj prijavi ne šalješ motivaciono pismo.

jobs.title: Collective Training Subject Matter Expert (SME)
jobs.description:
Clearance:TS/SCI Eligibility Required
Location: Fort Belvoir, VA
 
Description

PingWind is seeking a highly qualified Collective Training Subject Matter Expert (SM:E) to support an opportunity with the Department of War. The SME will provide expert collective training support to the Military Intelligence Readiness Command (MIRC) Headquarters in the development, management, coordination, execution, and assessment of collective training programs for Army Reserve Intelligence forces.

This position supports intelligence readiness across multiple disciplines, including Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT), All-Source Intelligence, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), Human Intelligence (HUMINT), and Counterintelligence (CI). The successful candidate will work closely with Geographic and Functional Commands (GFCs), Army Reserve Intelligence units, and other stakeholders to ensure training programs align with Army doctrine, operational requirements, and readiness objectives.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
•    Review and analyze collective training plans developed by GFCs to ensure alignment with Army doctrine, policies, training strategies, and readiness requirements.
•    Identify gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for improvement within proposed training plans, and provide actionable recommendations and guidance to GFCs.
•    Support the planning, coordination, execution, and assessment of collective training exercises across multiple intelligence disciplines.
•    Develop comprehensive exercise plans, scenarios, and training objectives that support operational requirements and mission readiness.
•    Coordinate with subject matter experts, role players, training facilitators, and other stakeholders to ensure realistic and effective training delivery.
•    Facilitate the integration of GEOINT, All-Source Intelligence, SIGINT, HUMINT, Counterintelligence, and other intelligence functions into collective training events.
•    Identify, coordinate, and secure training resources, including facilities, equipment, materials, and support services.
•    Coordinate with relevant organizations to ensure the availability and allocation of necessary resources for collective training events.
•    Manage logistical requirements for training events, including transportation, lodging, scheduling, and participant support.
•    Develop evaluation criteria, performance measures, and assessment methodologies to determine training effectiveness.
•    Conduct after-action reviews (AARs), analyze training outcomes, and identify strengths, weaknesses, and areas for improvement.
•    Prepare detailed reports, findings, and recommendations to enhance future training programs and intelligence readiness.
•    Liaise with GFCs, Army Reserve Intelligence units, and other organizations to ensure effective coordination and collaboration during training events.
•    Foster collaborative relationships with subject matter experts, training facilitators, and external partners to leverage their expertise, resources, and best practices.
•    Participate in meetings, working groups, planning sessions, and forums related to collective training and intelligence readiness.

Basic Qualifications

•    Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
•    Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of military experience, training, and education.
•    Minimum 5 years of experience supporting military intelligence training, readiness, or operations.
•    Demonstrated experience planning, coordinating, and executing collective training exercises within military organizations.
•    Working knowledge of Army training doctrine, training management processes, and readiness reporting requirements.
•    Experience supporting one or more intelligence disciplines, including GEOINT, SIGINT, HUMINT, All-Source Intelligence, or Counterintelligence.
•    Experience developing exercise scenarios, training objectives, evaluation criteria, and after-action reviews.
•    Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
•    Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic operational environment.

Preferred Qualifications

•    Graduate of Military Intelligence professional military education courses.
•    Experience supporting Army Reserve or National Guard intelligence organizations.
•    Experience with the Army Training Management System (ATMS), Digital Training Management System (DTMS), or similar training management platforms.
•    Certified military instructor, facilitator, or trainer credentials.
•    Experience supporting intelligence readiness, mobilization, or collective training programs at the brigade, division, command, or higher headquarters level.
 
Travel

•    Up to 30% travel may be required to support subordinate unit training missions at various locations throughout the United States and OCONUS.
 
About PingWind
PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. We have extensive experience in the fields of cybersecurity, development, IT infrastructure, supply chain management and other professional services such as system design and continuous improvement. PingWind is an SBA certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with offices in Northern Virginia and Huntsville AL.

jobs.title: Lead AI Learning Designer (Math)
jobs.description:
Our mission at Ello is simple and urgent: maximize the potential of every child, everywhere. We're building the world's first AI teacher to close that gap: one that listens, speaks, adapts, and inspires, just like the best human educators.



Our first product, Read with Ello, is already helping tens of thousands of kids each week learn to read. It listens as they read aloud, offers support when they stumble, and generates magical, personalized stories. It works, and kids love it.



Now, we're scaling that success into something even bigger: a complete AI teacher that can help children learn far beyond reading. Our new app combines language, speech, and memory to deliver interactive learning for kids worldwide; check it out here https://www.ello.com/. We're moving fast: we ship weekly, test directly with kids, and push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in education.



With the resources of the world's top investors and the heart of a public benefit corporation, we're here to revolutionize how children learn globally. Featured on TIME's Best Inventions and Fortune's Change the World, Ello is a small, mission-driven team taking on one of the most important challenges of our time: to democratize education.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Ello teaches reading, math, and English to kids ages 4 to 9. You'll own how Ello teaches math, from a 4-year-old's first counting to a 9-year-old adding and subtracting multi-digit numbers.



Our AI Learning Designers build math activities every week on our in-house authoring platform. Your job is to make every one of those activities better. You'll decide what a great math activity looks like for a 5-year-old: which representation to use, when to move from counters to symbols, and how much a child should struggle before the tutor steps in. You'll turn that into templates the team builds from, and review what ships against that bar. You'll also own the scope and sequence: which skills come in which order, and how Ello places each child at the right level. Placement is a live problem today. When a child starts too low, or gets stuck in an interactive tool that doesn't work the way they expect, they stop. Fixing that is yours.



You'll work most closely with Brent Johnson (our Head of Learning Design and Creative Technology), the math learning designers you direct, and the engineers and product managers who build the AI tutor. A lot of the job is translation. You'll take what you know about how young children build number sense and turn it into specs, prompts, and evaluation criteria that shape how the AI behaves in a live session, and into the interactive math tools (number lines, ten frames, base-ten blocks) that kids use inside it. Then you'll listen to real sessions with kids and fix what isn't working.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Ello's math curriculum for ages 4 to 9: scope and sequence, learning progressions, placement, and where each activity fits in a child's daily plan

 - Define the shapes of math activities: which templates, interactive tools, and representations work for each skill, when to move from concrete to abstract, and what "great" looks like for each one

 - Build the production system that lets AI Learning Designers ship high-quality activities at volume: templates, examples, and improvements to our activity-creation agent

 - Set the quality bar and act as the reviewer for math activities before they reach kids

 - Direct and coach the math learning designers and interns on the team: give feedback on their activities, unblock their work, and raise their craft

 - Turn instructional goals into prompts, specs, and evaluation criteria that engineers can build against and test

 - Listen to and annotate real sessions with kids; use data to find where children get stuck, struggle, or lose interest; and change the activities and system to improve it

 - Spec the interactive math tools kids use in activities, and work with design and engineering until a 5-year-old can use them without help

 - Partner with product and engineering on how math works across the app




KEY REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years designing elementary math curriculum or activities, including at least one full scope and sequence

 - Direct experience designing for young children (roughly ages 4 to 9): you know what holds a 5-year-old's attention, what frustrates them, and how that changes how you teach

 - Deep knowledge of how young children develop number sense and early math, and of evidence-based instruction: learning trajectories, concrete-representational-abstract sequencing, visual models, and productive struggle

 - Experience setting the quality bar for other people's work: you have reviewed, coached, or directed other designers or curriculum writers

 - Experience designing for digital or interactive products (an app, an online course, a game)

 - You use AI tools every day, and they have changed how you work in specific ways you can describe. You're excited to build with LLMs, not only to use them

 - You can hold a real working conversation with engineers and stay in it until a spec is buildable

 - You turn learning science into concrete design decisions and can explain why an activity works




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience writing or refining prompts that shape the behavior of an AI tutor, agent, or conversational product

 - Experience at an AI-driven or children's math edtech company

 - Experience building systems that let a team produce content at scale (templates, style guides, rubrics, content pipelines)

 - A technical background (computer science, data science, or similar) that helps you reason about how AI systems and software work together

 - Experience teaching early elementary math in a classroom, 1:1, or in small groups

 - Experience designing digital math manipulatives or interactive math tools

 - Familiarity with Common Core math standards and research-based early math progressions

 - An advanced degree in math education, learning sciences, or learning design




WE LOOK FOR CANDIDATES WHO

 - Have something to teach us. We will look to you as the expert in the room on how young children learn math, with a strong, opinionated sense of what good early math looks and feels like

 - Hold a high bar for craft and give direct, kind feedback that makes other people's work better

 - Default to ownership and move with urgency

 - Care about both the learning and the delight, and see them as reinforcing each other rather than trading off

 - Learn from real kids, not only from theory, and change their minds when the data says to

 - Want to be part of a tight-knit team and build meaningful relationships at work




REASONS TO JOIN US

 - Own a full subject at an AI-first company and shape how millions of children could learn math

 - Lead a team of learning designers and build the system they work in

 - Work hands-on with AI: write the specs and prompts that shape a live AI tutor, and see the result in real sessions with kids

 - We ship weekly, so you'll see your design choices in front of real kids fast

 - Build the early math foundations children carry into every grade after

 - Be part of a growing but tight-knit team




ABOUT ELLO

Ello is a public benefit corporation on a mission to maximize the potential of all children. We're currently around ~50 people, headquartered in San Francisco with a second office in Nairobi, Kenya.



Our team has deep expertise in artificial intelligence, K-12 education, and child development across institutions such as Stanford, Berkeley, Google, Apple, and more. We were part of Y Combinator's W20 batch and are funded by world-class investors including Goodwater Capital, Homebrew, Reed Hastings, Common Sense Growth, Ravensburger, Project A Ventures, Reach Capital, Khosla Ventures, WndrCo, Visible Ventures, and K9 Ventures.



We're a small, collaborative team that takes each other's voices very seriously. Because our mission is to support all children, it is critical that our team is representative of the communities we work in; we place significant emphasis on ensuring diversity in our team and inclusion in our culture. If you have questions about immigration, reach out to us at recruiting@ello.com.



We feel enormously privileged to be building at this moment. Advances in AI have made it possible, for the first time, to imagine giving every child a truly personalized teacher. We don't take that opportunity for granted.



We work with urgency because millions of children can't wait. We care deeply about craftsmanship because learning experiences should feel magical. And we believe it's possible to build ambitious technology while building a company where people do the best work of their careers.



If that excites you, we'd love to meet you.



At Ello, diversity is a moral imperative and a competitive advantage. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, skin color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We plan and structure our interviews to assess skills and experience directly. If you need accommodations throughout the interview process, please contact recruiting@ello.com.

As a Senior Process Integration Engineer, you will play a key role in translating new technologies and products from development into robust, scalable, and manufacturable processes. You will work closely with Engineering, R&D, Product, Operations, and Quality teams to develop, integrate, optimise, and release processes and products into manufacturing.

Your work will be essential in ensuring that new products and technologies can be reliably manufactured with the required performance, quality, and yield.

 - 4+ years of experience in Process Integration, Process Engineering, NPI, Yield Engineering, or a related engineering role.

 - A Master's or PhD degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

 - Experience working in a semiconductor startup, microfabrication foundry, advanced manufacturing or other high-tech hardware environment.

 - Strong understanding of process development, process integration, qualification, and manufacturing transfer.

 - Experience with structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, SPC, DOE or similar tools.

 - Experience in analysing process and manufacturing data to identify root causes and improve process performance and yield.

 - Familiarity with quality and manufacturing systems, including Control Plans, non-conformance management, change control and corrective/preventive actions.

 - Experience working in cross-functional environments involving R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality.

 - Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

 - Experience with semiconductor fabrication of superconducting devices or quantum technologies would be a nice to have.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
About us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Make it Right. Play to Win. Win as One

About the role

We are looking for an Associate HR Generalist to support our day-to-day HR operations in Poland. In this role, you will be responsible for a broad range of HR administration activities, with a particular focus on payroll coordination, employee lifecycle administration, benefits, and health and safety. You will work closely with employees, managers, our payroll provider, and external partners, helping ensure that HR processes run smoothly, accurately, and in compliance with applicable regulations. Beyond the administrative responsibilities, you will play an important role in creating a positive employee experience and building trust in HR.
This role is based in Zielona Gora. This is a hybrid opportunity with three days a week in-office attendance.

What will you be doing?

Payroll & Benefits Administration

• Prepare and submit monthly payroll data to the external payroll provider, including updating payroll systems and providing required documentation.

• Calculate overtime and on-call payments.

• Monitor employee sick leave and working time records.

• Manage employee benefits and related administration.

• Prepare additional payroll reports and spreadsheets for the Finance team, including data required for audits and R&D tax relief.

• Maintain contact with relevant authorities and institutions, including the Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) and the National Labour Inspectorate (PIP).

Employee Lifecycle Administration

• Prepare employment-related documents, including contracts, amendments, employment and salary certificates

• Update employee records in HRIS and payroll systems.

• Maintain and complete employee personnel files.

• Prepare welcome packages.

• Conduct onboarding meetings focused on employee benefits.

• Support employees in understanding HR, employment, and payroll processes and applicable regulations

• Monitor the validity of mandatory occupational medical examinations.

• Coordinate initial and periodic H&S training with an external provider

• Maintain and update internal HR policies, procedures, and regulations, including payroll and working conditions policies

• Coordinate offboarding administration, including submitting IT tickets and notifying relevant stakeholders about employees’ last working days.

What are we looking for?

• 1–2 years of experience in HR administration, payroll, personnel administration, or working in an accounting/payroll office.

• Very good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including working with formulas, data analysis, and spreadsheets.

• Good command of English, both written and spoken, enabling effective communication with international colleagues and external partners.

• Good understanding of basic HR and payroll processes and employment documentation.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy, especially when working with employee and payroll data.

• Good organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• A proactive, hands-on approach and willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

• High level of confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive employee information.

• A service-oriented mindset and good communication skills, with a genuine interest in supporting employees.

The tech stack

Outlook, HRIS, Excel

What do we offer?

🏢💻Hybrid Framework - The best of both worlds! Work from home when you need focus and flexibility, and spend 3 days a week in the office for face-to-face collaboration, sharing ideas and catching up with the team. Because some things are simply better together!

📙 Personal Training Budget. Up to 7000 PLN/ year training budget (certifications, conferences attendance, etc.) to invest in your professional development. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the product community, and develop your soft skills to lead teams and manage other stakeholders.

📺 Internal and external training, free access to online training platforms such as Linkedin Learning

🗺️ Languages classes every week. Thirsty for knowledge? Learn a new language by joining our free English/Spanish/German classes. You can connect and enjoy taking up a new language or improving your current skills with one of our great instructors.

💜 Lunch card. Enjoy a subsidized lunch card and grab a meal with your teammates — because the best conversations often happen over lunch!

🏥 Free private medical insurance. Take care of your health with private medical care fully covered by us

📄 Attractive life insurance. Extra peace of mind for you and your loved ones.

🏐 Co-financed Multisport card - We support an active lifestyle because staying healthy and feeling good matters.

😊 Volunteer day. You can take 16 hours per year in order to participate in volunteering activities!

🌅 Up to 30 days of vacation per year (additional days are granted along with seniority at AUCTANE).

💙 Up to 1000 PLN/year PLN/year to match your NGO donations! We are happy to support your initiatives by duplicating the amount donated.

👩‍⚕️We have an Employee Assistance Program with psychological assistance free of charge for you and your loved ones.

🗓️ Annual Salary Review: We are reviewing the salaries of all our teams annually in order to evaluate an increase according to individual performance and the business results.

Referral Fee 🔗 We need your support in hiring top-class talent! We offer a referral bonus of 4k-20k PLN, depending on the complexity of the role and the hiring process.

💜 An inclusive and upbeat work environment Leave your suit behind... we’re a t-shirt and converse kind of place! More importantly, our company culture promotes diversity and inclusion. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.

🌍 A cross-cultural atmosphere We are a truly international team of 20 nationalities that speak 10 languages. Our company language is English and all internal communication and company-wide meetings are in English.

🏟️ Company events We do our best every day, even at our regular team-building events.

🏢 Nice Office in Zielona Gora and Wroclaw (free drinks, snacks…)

Do you want to know a little bit more about the team? Please, don’t hesitate to reach out to Amazing Auctane-PL and our Instagram

jobs.title: Google Workspace Deployment Engineer, Contract
jobs.description:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

Overview of Role

As a Workspace Engineer you’ll provide technical execution and support for migrations to Google Workspace. This is a hands-on engineering position requiring technical proficiency in both (Google) and (Microsoft 365, Exchange, SharePoint) environments to ensure successful data transitions.

• For Small to Mid-Sized Engagements: You will perform the technical tasks across the project lifecycle, carrying out the migration from initial discovery through to final cutover.

• For Large-Scale Enterprise Projects: You will support the project team by executing phased migration strategies and serving as a technical subject matter expert during the implementation phase.

Responsibilities

• Implement, and support Google Workspace small to mid deployments and migrations.

• Assist in the design, implementation, and support Google Workspace Enterprise deployments and migrations.

• Participate in technical discussions with customer executives that drive decisions and implementation

• Manage cloud networking services and connect to client networks

• Execute tasks related to SaaS configuration, development and integrations

• Configure and manage Cloud Platform services and APIs

• Develop custom scripts as necessary using Powershell, Python or Appscript

• Train our clients’ end users and their technical personnel as required per project scope

• Write technical documentation for deployed solutions that includes end-user guides and process manuals

• Write, Contribute, Publish content to our LMS for Google Workspace content

• Ability to travel to client sites as needed and requested

• Anything else that needs to be done that adds value to the business, our clients and your co-workers

Qualifications

• Proficient knowledge of DNS, Networking and Email Administration

• 3+ years of experience administering MS Active Directory and/or Azure Active Directory

• 3+ years of experience administering Google Workspace (Formly G Suite)

• 3+ years of experience with and/or understanding of Office 365, Exchange or SharePoint Online

• 3 + years of experience with migration tools (Google Workspace Migrate, CloudM Migrate, Movebot, Bit Titan, etc.)

• 3+ years of working with integration tools Okta, ADFS, GAM, Bettercloud, CloudM Manage, GCDS, etc.

• Familiarity with IT security practices such as identity and access management, device management and data protection

• Ability to travel to client sites as needed and requested

• This position is highly client facing, candidates will be required to demonstrate strong communication and management skills

• Prior Google Workspace deployment and/or administration experience

• Certification (preference): Google Cloud Collaboration Engineer, Google Cloud Associate Engineer, Associate - Google Workspace Administrator

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.

AI Transparency & Disclosure

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

jobs.title: Content Coordinator (NL/FR)
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

You coordinate content production, localisation and distribution, ensuring campaigns are executed efficiently and consistently across markets

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

And people who are…

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

• Development and learning opportunities in an international organisation.
• A collaborative and inclusive working environment.
• Flexible ways of working where business needs allow.

JOIN US

This is a fulltime position based in either Amsterdam or Brussels

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it's our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Senior AI Researcher
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Our data science team is seeking a highly skilled AI researcher with expertise in modern AI methods (e.g., multi-agent architectures, reinforcement learning on LLMs) and a passion for transforming theoretical challenges into real-world products.
In this role, you will leverage our unique clinical datasets to design and build groundbreaking solutions that provide medical benefits to millions of people. You will take full end-to-end ownership of your models - from ideation and research to production deployment and ongoing monitoring.
Working across both research and production environments, you should have proven experience in developing and deploying machine learning algorithms, along with strong interpersonal and collaboration skills. We value independent thinkers who are also proactive doers.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Develop clinical AI models to support K’s clinic workflows, with a focus on patient-facing applications

• Design and implement scalable, efficient pipelines for data preprocessing, information extraction, and model training

• Stay up to date with the latest AI research and best practices, and translate them into production-ready solutions

• Communicate complex technical concepts and solutions to non-technical stakeholders

• Collaborate with MLE and AI engineering teams to deploy scalable, robust solutions

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in AI research, with a strong background in LLM research

• Advanced proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with leading frameworks and libraries, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, torchtune, and vLLM

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. Preferably with applied focus on machine learning, computer vision, NLP, or deep learning

• Fast learner with excellent problem-solving skills

• Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and eagerness to learn and share knowledge

• Passion for medicine, health, and wellbeing, with a drive to make a meaningful impact

• Proven experience translating deep learning research into reliable, high-impact production systems

• Collaborative team member who contributes to shared technical decisions and knowledge sharing

• (Preferred) Experience with medical data or medical AI

Who We Are:

Behind every leading health system is K Health’s AI-powered virtual care engine.

Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top-grade Virtualists in AI-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability.

We’re founded in 2016, headquartered in New York City, and backed by over $443.5M from leading investors including Valor Equity Partners, Claure Group, Mangrove Capital Partners, 14W, Notable Capital, Lerer Hippeau, Primary Venture Partners, Comcast Ventures, PICO Venture Partners, Max Ventures, and other strategic healthcare partners.

We offer competitive compensation packages based on industry benchmarks for function, level, and geographic location. Offer amounts are determined by multiple factors such as a candidate's experience and expertise.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, citizenship, military or veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. We’re deeply committed to building teams as diverse as the patients we serve and strive to cultivate an environment where everyone can bring their most authentic self to work. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our users.

We are committed to maintaining the integrity of our hiring process and ensuring a safe environment for all candidates. All communication for job offers from K Health will come from email addresses ending in @khealth.com. K Health will never ask you to provide financial information about yourself during the recruitment process. We will never use personal email accounts or other domains for official correspondence. Our official job postings are only listed on our official website and reputable job boards. Be cautious of job offers from sources other than these platforms.
