jobs.title: Licensed School-Based Social Worker (Remote) Talent Pool, Upcoming Opportunities
jobs.description:
This is an evergreen posting for School Social Workers, which means we accept applications year-round and review candidates on a rolling basis. Because our services are delivered virtually, openings depend on the states where you hold licensure or certification and the needs of the districts we partner with, not on where you live. Even if we don’t have a caseload that matches your credentials right now, we encourage you to apply so we can reach out as new district partnerships and school-year openings come up.

We know the right fit matters on both sides. Applying here adds you to our provider talent community, and our recruiting team will contact you when a caseload aligns with your credentials, availability, and experience.

Are you an experienced School Social Worker dedicated to making a profound impact on students with learning differences? Join Parallel's mission-driven team of expert clinicians to deliver essential, tailored social work services and equip students and families with the tools for lifelong success in a remote setting.

What You’ll Do

• Provide critical direct and indirect social work services to children and their families, addressing their unique psychosocial and emotional needs.

• Collaborate across school or IEP teams to develop comprehensive, tailored treatment plans and Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) that incorporate measurable social work goals.

• Serve as a systemic expert by offering staff critical insights into the cultural, familial, and societal factors that influence student behavior, academic performance, and overall well-being.

• Lead mental health and behavioral interventions by designing and implementing positive behavioral intervention strategies and performing comprehensive mental health evaluations.

• Support families and school staff by providing parental support and guidance to facilitate successful school adjustment, and training educational staff on behavior management techniques and direct support as required.

What You’ll Need

Clinical & Educational Expertise

• Active Clinical Social Worker license (LCSW or state equivalent).

• Valid state license or certificate for K-12 school practice (requirements vary by state).

• Minimum of one year of full-time school social work experience (internships excluded).

• Demonstrated proficiency in all National SSW Practice Model domains.

• Expertise in Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) frameworks, counseling, and psycho-educational evaluations.

Technical & Communication Skills

• Strong communication skills, specifically tailored for engaging with diverse student populations, families, and school staff.

• Tech-savvy approach with preferred experience conducting telehealth services via virtual meeting platforms.

• Previous experience with remote social work is highly desirable.

• Fluency in additional languages is a significant asset.

Remote Setup & Availability

• Access to a private, secure workspace with a reliable computer, webcam, and high-speed internet connection.

• Availability required during traditional school hours (8:00 am–3:00 pm, Monday–Friday); a minimum of 15 hours per week is preferred.

Why Join Parallel?

At Parallel, we simplify your work so you can focus on what matters most—delivering quality care. We provide comprehensive support, including:

• Thoughtful Student & District Matching: Alignment with your experience, licensure, and expertise to match you with appropriate districts, schools, and student needs.

• Efficient Tools and Support: Access to templates, tools, and streamlined systems designed to reduce administrative paperwork and maintain organization.

• Billing & Operational Support: Systems that manage billing and documentation workflows, allowing you to prioritize student support and collaboration.

• Clinical Resources: Utilization of standardized assessments, progress monitoring tools, and therapy resources to ensure high-quality service delivery.

• Innovation & Feedback: Opportunities for your input to directly shape the future of our programs.

• Clinical Community: Connection with peers through dedicated office hours, provider meetings, and free continuing education opportunities offered throughout the school year.

• A Powerful Mission: The chance to significantly improve the lives of students nationwide.

Compensation

The rates below apply to 1099 opportunities and are based on the provider’s primary service delivery state.

• MI: Starts at $54/hour

• CA, NY, WA: Starts at $52/hour

• CO, IL, IN, MA, ME, OR: Starts at $48/hour

• AL, AR, AZ, GA, KS, KY, MO, MS, NC, OH, OK, PA, SD, TN, TX, VA, WV: Starts at $46/hour

Join us in making a lasting impact—apply today to become part of the Parallel Provider Network!

👋 About Parallel

Parallel is the first tech-forward provider of care for learning and thinking differences across the United States. We believe learning differences are parallel ways of thinking that should be celebrated. Our mission is to provide students with the resources and encouragement to succeed in the classroom and beyond by helping them build confidence in their unique strengths and create strategies to work around their challenges.

Parallel simplifies the process of getting support for learning differences by consolidating providers and resources on a single platform. We connect students with qualified professionals while significantly reducing waiting times, costs, and confusion.

Our core services include:

• Psychological Assessment

• Counseling

• Speech-Language Services

• Special Education

• And more

Learn more at parallellearning.com.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Parallel, we believe in celebrating differences. This belief extends from schools into our workplace and through the ways we work together toward our mission. We are committed to fostering a diverse, accessible environment that represents many different cultures, backgrounds, viewpoints, and abilities by championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We are committed to building and fostering a diverse workforce, including individuals from historically marginalized groups, and creating a workplace where employees’ strengths are championed, differences are celebrated, and no one is discriminated against based on age, race, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization where different learners and thinkers can thrive.

jobs.title: Licensed School-Based Special Education Teacher (Remote) Talent Pool, Upcoming Opportunities
jobs.description:
This is an evergreen posting for Special Education Teachers providing specially designed instruction (SDI), which means we accept applications year-round and review candidates on a rolling basis. Because our services are delivered virtually, openings depend on the states where you hold teaching certification and the needs of the districts we partner with, not on where you live. Even if we don’t have a caseload that matches your certification right now, we encourage you to apply so we can reach out as new district partnerships and school-year openings come up.

We know the right fit matters on both sides. Applying here adds you to our provider talent community, and our recruiting team will contact you when a caseload aligns with your certification, availability, and experience.

Are you passionate about supporting children with learning differences? Parallel is seeking experienced Special Education Teachers to provide virtual instruction to K-12 students nationwide. We are hiring educators with experience in resource/inclusion settings (mild to moderate disabilities) as well as self-contained classrooms (profound/severe disabilities).

What You'll Do

• Deliver Expertise: Provide legally compliant, specially designed instruction (SDI) and deliver compensatory education services (when indicated) to students with active Individualized Education Programs (IEPs).

• Instructional Design & Implementation: Develop and execute data-driven, individualized lesson plans to target critical skill areas:

• Reading and literacy development

• Foundational math skills and intervention

• Executive functioning and organizational strategies

• Functional and adaptive life skills

• IEP Management & Compliance: Own the creation, management, and ongoing progress monitoring of student IEPs, including case management responsibilities.

• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Collaborate with the student's IEP team to coordinate service schedules and tailor instructional approaches to unique student needs.

• Assessment & Evaluation: Administer screenings, conduct progress monitoring, and complete formal outcomes assessments to drive instructional decision-making.

What You'll Need

Core Qualifications (Required Qualifications)

• Active Special Education teaching license/certification.

• School-based experience providing specially designed instruction and working effectively with diverse student populations.

• Exceptional collaborative communication skills for engaging with IEP teams, including teachers, parents, and students.

• Proficiency in conducting virtual services using meeting platforms and a strong command of instructional technology.

Remote Setup & Availability

• Dedicated, private workspace with a secure, high-speed internet connection, reliable computer, and webcam.

jobs.title: Electrician
jobs.description:
Electrician

The Electrician role entails executing electrical wiring plans for lighting, intercom, and systems, installing apparatus, fixtures, and safety components, and ensuring compatibility in circuits. Conduct preventive maintenance, troubleshoot, and respond to emergency calls post-midnight. Assist in emergencies, maintain logbooks, and report issues to supervisors. Additionally, upholds cleanliness, aid in manpower needs, and fulfill general duties promptly. This role demands meticulousness in installations, adeptness in troubleshooting, and a readiness to support team members during emergencies and routine operations.

What is in it for you:

• Engage in conservation efforts and help preserve wildlife.
• Enjoy sustainable adventures with exclusive rewards.
• Celebrate locality and heritage in a vibrant community.
• Advance your career with global development opportunities.
• Drive change through impactful social initiatives.
• Collaborate with a passionate, innovative team.

Key Responsibilities:

• Installation and Maintenance: Responsible for executing plans of electrical wiring, installing apparatus and fixtures, connecting wiring in circuits, and ensuring compatibility of components. Prepares conduits, prevent breakdowns through routine inspections, troubleshoot, attend maintenance requests, and maintain various lights for operational efficiency.
• Emergency Response and Assistance: Stands by on call for emergency electrical work post-midnight as per duty roster or Engineering Supervisor's directives. Assist in emergencies, perform emergency repairs, maintain tools, and order supplies. Additionally, addresses fire alarm faults, attend breakdowns of major equipment like generators, STPs, and desalination plants.
• Record-Keeping and Reporting: Maintains records of electrical parts used during repairs and notifies the Engineering Supervisor to order necessary parts. They ensure all maintenance requests and materials used are properly logged in the logbooks. Additionally, reports any major operational issues to the Engineering Supervisor or Duty Engineer.
• General Duties and Responsibilities: Maintains cleanliness around the electrical workshop and job sites, assists engineering crews with urgent manpower needs, and attends duties punctually as per the duty roster. Provides assistance during emergencies or in the event of fire or natural disasters.

• Experience and Qualifications: A minimum of three (3) years' experience in a similar role within a five-star hotel or similar organization, along with a trade license, certification, or diploma.
• Skills and Communication: Strong interpersonal written and verbal communication skills are necessary.
• Additional Considerations: Locally available candidates are advantageous.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

About Mantis Collection: Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco-tourism in a poverty-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.



Fully remote 

Must work 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET)

FULL TIME OPPORTUNITIES

We're hiring full time Campaign Managers across sports & entertainment, each campaign manager works predominantly with one client.

Our clients want to be great at creator marketing, and they move quickly. Briefs evolve once a campaign is live, and our best campaign managers enjoy shaping them with the client.

Commercial

- Your creator briefs and scripts get the content right first time

- You hold every piece of content to a high standard before it reaches the client

 

Platform, AI and data

- You're running full campaigns in our platform from day one: discovery, casting, outreach, contracts, payments and reporting. Experience with other influencer marketing tech platforms is a huge plus

- Your outreach works at volume and still feels personal

- AI is part of your daily workflow for research, outreach and briefs, and you check its

output

- You know TikTok, Instagram and YouTube analytics inside out

 

Complexity

- Complex, bespoke accounts are your comfort zone, and that experience carries over to high-volume work

- You've worked in agile, fast-moving teams, like an agency or a

tech start-up. You get up to speed quickly and adapt when priorities shift

 

Communication and leadership

- Your writing is clear and confident, and everyone knows what's happening

- Clients hear from you before they need to ask, and your performance updates are easy to follow

- You stay composed on tough client calls and keep the relationship strong

- You flag risks early, with a fix in mind

- Leadership gets honest numbers from you, including when results are behind

- You give your Campaign Manager clear direction and useful feedback

- You build strong relationships with our Client Solutions and Strategy teams, and with your creators

We're growing our beauty team fast. If you've worked with beauty or fragrance brands, we'd especially love to hear from you.



 


WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years in influencer marketing, talent management or campaign management

- A solid grasp of how influencer campaigns run end to end

- Hands-on experience with influencer marketing platforms for discovery, outreach and reporting

- Creator negotiation and contracting experience, including usage rights

- Some client-facing experience, ideally with enterprise brands

- Campaign experience and strong US cultural knowledge in Sports betting and fantasy experience. 

- Availability 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET), Monday to Friday. This is mandatory,

wherever you're based

HOW THE PROCESS WILL RUN

 - If suitable, you'll have a short conversation with a member of our talent team and the campaign lead.

Benefits

🌴 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 3 wellness days and paid sick leave
📚 Annual Learning and Development budget
💰 Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work
🩺 Healthcare coverage for US-based team members

 

AI in your application

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. Everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Brokerage Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

Savvy is looking for a Head of Brokerage Operations to design, lead, and scale the operating backbone of a fast-growing, technology-enabled wealth management business. This leader will own all core operations across our introducing broker-dealer, ensuring that our supervision, service, and back-office workflows are compliant, efficient, and power delightful advisor and client experiences.

The right candidate is a proven leader who thrives in complex, cross-functional operating environments and has a track record of scaling systems, teams, and processes in high-growth settings. This individual will be expected to work closely with Savvy’s Engineering, Product, and Design teams to streamline  B-D operations through the use of automation and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong operating judgment across financial services and regulated environments with a builder’s mindset and an instinct for automation, measurement, and continuous improvement.




RESPONSIBILITIES:


OPERATIONAL LEADERSHIP & SCALE

 - Own and evolve the operating model for our broker-dealer, including service, supervision support, onboarding, maintenance, trading, and money movement.

 - Foster a culture of innovation, white-glove support, and continuous improvement.

 - Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and Brokerage Operations teams to drive innovation through all parts of how Savvy’s Custodial platform operates

 - Act as a cross-functional operator across Savvy, identifying inefficiencies, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution across Brokerage Operations, Product, Finance, and Compliance


END-TO-END PROCESS DESIGN

 - Map, redesign, and standardize core workflows including:
   
   - client onboarding / ACATs / account opening
   
   - KYC/AML, suitability, and Reg BI documentation
   
   - trading, cash management and money movement
   
   - client service requests and lifecycle maintenance
   
   - advisor transitions and rep onboarding

 - Partner with RIA Operations so advisors and clients moving onto the broker-dealer experience “one firm,” not two regulatory models.


BROKER-DEALER OPERATIONS

 - Establish and manage the day-to-day operations of Savvy’s Broker-Dealer, including account opening, transaction processing, supervision, and trade surveillance.

 - Own the day-to-day relationship with our clearing firm partner, act as the primary operational point of contact, run a regular operating cadence, track and escalate issues, and hold the partnership to clear service levels.

 - Partner closely with Savvy’s Engineering, Product, and Design teams to identify and implement appropriate platform improvements to support the growth of Savvy’s BD entity.

 - Work closely with the B-D CEO, CCO and FINOP to ensure adherence to FINRA rules and broker-dealer regulatory obligations.

 - Maintain and update required supervisory procedures (WSPs) and coordinate with Compliance and Legal on regulatory filings and exams.

 - Ensure seamless integration and reconciliation between clearing firm systems, CRM, portfolio management tools, and compliance systems.

 - Implement supervisory tools and technology for broker-dealer oversight, including email and trade surveillance systems.


TECHNOLOGY + AUTOMATION OWNERSHIP

 - Lead adoption and optimization of our tech stack.

 - Identify automation opportunities and reduce manual work through tooling, integrations, and AI-assisted workflows.


METRICS, CONTROLS, AND PERFORMANCE

 - Define and monitor operational KPIs and SLAs (cycle times, error rates, NIGO rates, service quality, advisor satisfaction, and cost-to-serve).

 - Implement strong operational controls and vendor oversight across custodians, clearing firms, and third-party providers.




MUST HAVE:

 - 8–12+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, ideally within fintech, financial services, or other regulated environments. Direct experience operating a broker-dealer is preferred.

 - Active Series 7, 24

 - Strong understanding of FINRA broker-dealer operations and supervision requirements, and the ability to build deeper domain expertise quickly.

 - Proven record of scaling teams and processes in a high-growth setting (preferably in a high growth startup environment).

 - Strong operator instincts: you’ve personally rebuilt workflows, reduced cycle time and error rates, and driven measurable operational improvements.

 - Operator with hands-on experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams in a startup or high-growth fintech environment; comfortable translating business problems into scalable systems and automation initiatives.

 - Excellent people leadership and cross-functional communication.

 - Extensive experience using third party tools to power operations, including leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT/Claude, analytics copilots, automation) to speed up research, synthesis, and operational workflows.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure, and often ambiguous environment


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Familiarity with common brokerage operations tech stack.

 - Experience managing the relationship with a clearing firm (e.g., Fidelity, Pershing or Apex) as an introducing broker-dealer.

 - Prior responsibility for FINRA exam and audit readiness.

 - Hands-on experience with compliance reporting and regulatory audits.


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Savvy Wealth is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment that values diversity and individual contributions.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans 

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

 - Benefits are available to full-time employees

Even if we don’t have a caseload that matches your licensure right now, we encourage you to apply so we can reach out as new district partnerships and school-year openings come up.

We know the right fit matters on both sides. Applying here adds you to our provider talent community, and our recruiting team will contact you when a caseload aligns with your licensure, availability, and experience.

Are you a dedicated clinician driven to make a meaningful difference in the lives of children with learning differences? Parallel is seeking expert Speech-Language Pathologists to deliver high-impact, personalized teletherapy. Join our mission-focused team and help empower students and their families with the critical tools they need to thrive and succeed.

What You’ll Do

• Provide student-centered, IEP-aligned virtual speech therapy sessions.

• Conduct comprehensive speech-language evaluations leveraging Parallel’s proprietary Clinical Test Library and automated Report Writer.

• Partner with multidisciplinary teams to design, monitor, and refine Individualized Education Programs.

• Participate in IEP meetings and provide dedicated case management for “Speech Only” students as required.

• Systematically track session data and student progress to offer insightful IEP consultations.

• Develop detailed, goal-oriented progress reports for each reporting cycle.

• Deliver specialized state-specific services, including AAC support, Pre-K interventions, speech screenings, and SLPA supervision.

What You’ll Need

• Current ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP).

• Minimum of 1 year of recent, full-time school-based experience conducting IEP-directed therapy and evaluations (post-CFY). 2+ years of experience is preferred for case management assignments.

• Demonstrated expertise in the IEP process, educational eligibility determinations, and writing comprehensive evaluation reports.

• Prior experience with Medicaid billing systems is highly advantageous.

• Exceptional communication skills and the ability to build rapport with students from diverse cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds.

• Tech-savvy with proficiency in virtual telehealth platforms and digital documentation.

• Availability during standard school hours (Monday – Friday, 8:00 am – 4:00 pm).

• Multilingual fluency is considered a significant asset.

Why Join Parallel?

At Parallel, we simplify your work so you can focus on what matters most—delivering quality care. We provide comprehensive support, including:

• Compensation for Direct & Indirect Time: We recognize the full scope of your work and compensate both direct service time and indirect activities such as documentation, planning, and collaboration.

• Thoughtful Student & District Matching: Alignment with your experience, licensure, and expertise to match you with appropriate districts, schools, and student needs.

• Efficient Tools and Support: Access to templates, tools, and streamlined systems designed to reduce administrative paperwork and maintain organization.

• Billing & Operational Support: Systems that manage billing and documentation workflows, allowing you to prioritize student support and collaboration.

• Clinical Resources: Utilization of standardized assessments, progress monitoring tools, and therapy resources to ensure high-quality service delivery.

• Innovation & Feedback: Opportunities for your input to directly shape the future of our programs.

• Clinical Community: Connection with peers through dedicated office hours, provider meetings, and free continuing education opportunities offered throughout the school year.

• A Powerful Mission: The chance to significantly improve the lives of students nationwide.

Compensation

The rates below apply to 1099 opportunities and are based on the provider’s primary service delivery state. W-2 positions may also be available depending on active state licenses, weekly availability, and district needs.

• CA: Starts at $66/hour

• NY, WA: Starts at $62/hour

• IL, IN, MA, MO, OR: Starts at $56/hour

• CO, ME, MI: Starts at $54/hour

• AL, AR, AZ, GA, KS, KY, MS, NC, OH, OK, PA, SD, TN, TX, VA, WV: Starts at $52/hour

Join us in making a lasting impact—apply today to become part of the Parallel Provider Network!

👋 About Parallel

Parallel is the first tech-forward provider of care for learning and thinking differences across the United States. We believe learning differences are parallel ways of thinking that should be celebrated. Our mission is to provide students with the resources and encouragement to succeed in the classroom and beyond by helping them build confidence in their unique strengths and create strategies to work around their challenges.

Parallel simplifies the process of getting support for learning differences by consolidating providers and resources on a single platform. We connect students with qualified professionals while significantly reducing waiting times, costs, and confusion.

Our core services include:

• Psychological Assessment

• Counseling

• Speech-Language Services

• Special Education

• And more

Learn more at parallellearning.com.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Parallel, we believe in celebrating differences. This belief extends from schools into our workplace and through the ways we work together toward our mission. We are committed to fostering a diverse, accessible environment that represents many different cultures, backgrounds, viewpoints, and abilities by championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We are committed to building and fostering a diverse workforce, including individuals from historically marginalized groups, and creating a workplace where employees’ strengths are championed, differences are celebrated, and no one is discriminated against based on age, race, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization where different learners and thinkers can thrive.

jobs.title: QA Lead
jobs.description:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, Trust Wallet makes it easier, safer, and more convenient to explore Web3, securely access dApps, manage your crypto, and buy and sell digital assets, all in one place.




JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on QA Lead to drive the quality strategy and execution for Trust Wallet’s products across mobile, web, backend services, and APIs.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in software testing and automation with proven leadership capabilities. You will lead and develop a team of QA engineers, establish scalable quality practices, and work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of secure, reliable, and user-friendly products.

As QA Lead, you will take ownership of quality throughout the software development lifecycle, identify and mitigate release risks, and foster a culture in which quality is a shared responsibility across the organization.




ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and drive the overall QA strategy, quality standards, testing methodologies, and automation roadmap across mobile, web, backend, and API products

 - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of QA engineers, providing technical guidance, regular feedback, and support for career growth

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, and other stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, assess risks, and establish appropriate testing strategies

 - Own end-to-end quality planning and execution for product releases, including functional, regression, integration, performance, compatibility, and exploratory testing

 - Establish scalable test automation frameworks and increase automated test coverage across critical user journeys and platform components

 - Introduce effective quality gates into CI/CD pipelines and continuously improve release confidence and engineering efficiency

 - Review test plans, test cases, automation code, and defect reports to ensure quality, consistency, and maintainability

 - Identify, prioritize, and communicate product and release risks, providing clear quality assessments and release recommendations to stakeholders

 - Define and monitor quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, test effectiveness, release stability, and production incident trends

 - Lead defect triage and root cause analysis, working with relevant teams to resolve issues and prevent recurrence

 - Improve QA processes, tools, environments, and documentation to support rapid and reliable product delivery

 - Champion shift-left testing and promote shared ownership of quality across engineering and product teams

 - Stay current with developments in QA engineering, test automation, mobile technologies, blockchain systems, and cryptocurrency security


QUALIFICATION & REQUIREMENTS

 - Over 10 years of experience in software quality assurance, including significant experience in senior or technical leadership positions

 - Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing QA engineers in a fast-paced Agile environment

 - Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing test strategies for mobile applications, web applications, backend services, and APIs

 - Strong expertise in test automation tools and frameworks such as Appium, Selenium, or equivalent technologies

 - Experience with API testing tools such as Postman and network debugging tools such as Charles or Proxyman

 - Proficiency in Java or another relevant programming language, with the ability to design, review, and maintain automation frameworks

 - Experience integrating automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines

 - Solid knowledge of functional, regression, integration, exploratory, performance, compatibility, and security testing

 - Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, release management, defect management, and software testing best practices

 - Demonstrated ability to define quality metrics, analyze trends, and use data to drive improvements

 - Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and risk-management skills

 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical partners

 - High level of ownership, attention to detail, and ability to operate effectively in a rapidly evolving environment

 - Solid understanding of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, decentralized applications, or wallet security is highly advantageous


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience testing consumer-facing fintech, cryptocurrency, blockchain, security, or high-availability products

 - Experience with mobile testing across iOS and Android devices, operating systems, and device configurations

 - Familiarity with blockchain transactions, wallet operations, smart contracts, dApps, staking, swaps, and cross-chain functionality

 - Experience with performance, security, or reliability testing tools and practices

 - Experience building or scaling a QA function within a globally distributed organization

 - Relevant software testing or Agile certifications are a plus


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.




WHY WORK AT TRUST WALLET?

 - Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

 - Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

 - Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

 - Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

 - Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

 - Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

 - Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.



*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

jobs.title: Claims Handler – Auto
jobs.description:

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

ClaimSorted is a Third-Party Administrator (TPA) that manages insurance claims end to end on behalf of insurers. We combine a high-performing claims team with an AI-enabled platform to deliver claims up to 3x faster, with better service and better economics for insurers.

We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done."

We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join.



About the Role

Ready to grow your claims career faster than the traditional industry allows?

We're looking for an early career Auto Claims Handler to join ClaimSorted in downtown Dallas!

This role is ideal for:

 - An adjuster with 1–2 years of experience who wants to build their career at a company that rewards performance, not tenure

 - Someone licensed and early in their career who is hungry to learn the business and grow fast

We are not looking for tenure for the sake of it. We are looking for people with talent, ambition, work ethic, and the drive to build a real career.

If you join us, we will give you the training and support to become the best adjuster possible - customer service, coverage, investigation, data, and quality. Our goal is to help you become one of the best claims leaders of the future.



What You'll Do

 - Own a desk of auto physical damage claims end to end: from first notification of loss through to payment

 - Confirm coverage and determine liability, reviewing the policy, photos, police reports and statements from the insured, claimants and witnesses

 - Review repair estimates and appraisals, and manage total losses, salvage and rental

 - Calculate payments accurately using the deductible and policy limits, and follow up with repair shops, appraisers or the insured for missing information

 - Communicate with policyholders and claimants throughout the claims journey, ensuring a clear and positive experience, especially when they've just been in an accident and are without a vehicle

 - Make sound, well-documented decisions and manage claims within your authority

 - Identify potential fraud indicators and escalate appropriately

 - Maintain accurate and thorough claims records for audit and compliance

 - Contribute to continuous improvement by working with operations and engineering



Who You Are

 - Willing to work 5 days in office in Dallas (in our amazing new office Downtown)

 - Texas All-Lines Adjuster license, with Texas designated as your home state

 - 1–2 years of claims adjusting experience (auto physical damage a plus)

 - Sharp, organized, and able to prioritize independently

 - A clear communicator, in writing and on the phone

 - Genuinely curious about how claims and coverage work

 - Comfortable using data to make decisions

 - Team-oriented, hardworking, and ambitious

 - Startup or high-growth experience is a plus



Why Join Us

This is a chance to grow faster than you would at a traditional insurer or claims business.

You'll be trained on our process and tools, but you'll be expected to ramp up fast and take ownership early. You'll get real responsibility, real training, and the opportunity to build your career in a high-performance environment that rewards talent and hard work.

If you're licensed, hungry to learn the auto claims business, and want in on a company early, we'd love to hear from you.



Our Values

Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.
Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.
Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.
Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'
Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.



Compensation & Benefits

 - Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

 - Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

 - Generous, transparent equity participation

 - Medical, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) with 4% company match

 - 20 days annual PTO

 - Company offsites

 - Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

Cloudflare is looking for an enthusiastic B2B Enterprise marketing manager, who is dynamic, creative, and analytical. The individual has a track record of delivering creative and smashing programs that generate new prospects and grow the marketing revenue pipeline. This person will be dedicated to growing our businesses in ANZ across enterprise and public sector accounts.

You will support the creation, launch, and execution of campaigns that span a variety of channels - email, social, and webinars as well as supporting end-to-end execution of our in-person and virtual events, either direct or with our partners. You have a natural inclination to measure the effectiveness of marketing activities, strong project management skills, and the ability to think strategically and orchestrate many moving parts. You must have strong working knowledge and expertise in demand generation marketing funnel and lead flows. The right candidate will have the ability to work cross-functionally with all teams in-region, across APAC and in headquarters in San Francisco. This is a regional role based in Sydney or Melbourne, Australia. Market experience and expertise is required for this role.

What you'll do

• Report into the Head of Marketing APAC, based in Singapore

• As the ANZ Enterprise marketing manager, you will plan, promote, and execute field marketing initiatives across the region that capture mindshare, drive prospects into customers and support Cloudflare customers on their journey to build and secure on Cloudflare.

• You will be accountable for online, trade shows, conferences, executive dinners, workshops, developing communities, and the full range of regional marketing tactics and execution for Australia across enterprise & public sector.

• Manage campaigns from strategic planning and execution to evaluation, ensuring smooth project management throughout. Oversee timelines, track ROI, and implement data-driven optimisations to continuously improve performance and communicate campaign results to key stakeholders.

• Work in cross-functional teams and collaborate closely with global & regional demand centre teams, the partner team, BDR, product marketing, sales, marketing operations, sales ops and others in the development, execution and measurement of high-impact integrated marketing campaigns (global or regional) that are optimised and relevant across the marketing mix - online, offline, ABM, communities and more.

• Align marketing initiatives to directly support sales objectives, focusing on full lead lifecycle and funnel management, from lead generation to opportunity progression and customer loyalty and expansion.

• Assess campaign performance using SFDC and Tableau reporting, evaluate ROI, and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• 5 to 8 years proven experience in B2B marketing (enterprise software, cybersecurity, SaaS, regional marketing and/or info security experience a plus)

• BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, or other quantitative field

• On the digital side, you will be supporting our digital teams to help with execution and optimisation of online marketing campaigns across multiple channels (e.g. email, webinars, social media, etc.).

• Excellent channel experience working with partner marketing, distribution, resellers and systems integrators.

• In addition, you must have experience in planning, budgeting and managing trade shows, events, and conferences from start to finish

• Have proven track record of launching successful online and offline marketing campaigns and driving qualified leads in the funnel

• Strong project management/organisational skills and the ability to successfully manage multiple initiatives at once

• Strong interpersonal skills, collaborative, and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments in different time zones

• Results oriented with experience using qualitative and quantitative metrics with a focus on revenue, conversion, sales and other marketing goals

• Analytically inclined, exceptional organisational skills, with rigorous attention to detail

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment with tight deadlines

• Having a strong sense of curiosity and passion for learning

• Exhibit strong stakeholders’ management and communication skills

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Marketo, and Tableau, will be an advantage.

• Previous experience in a high growth company in the SaaS, security, or network space, combined with knowledge of how the Internet works is a plus

• An established player in the business and marketing community with a strong business network which included media, marketing agencies, events organisers, social media platforms amongst others.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

jobs.title: Sales Team Coordinator | ON-SITE
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a proactive, organized, and customer-focused Sales Team Coordinator to support and coordinate the daily activities of our sales team.

This is a hands-on sales support, customer service, and people-coordination position. The employee will help organize priorities, monitor assignments, follow up with team members, coordinate communication, and make sure sales-related tasks continue moving forward.

The Sales Team Coordinator serves as a central point of communication between sales representatives, customers, management, and other departments.

Work Location

This is a full-time, on-site position located at:

508 S D Road

Giltner, Nebraska 68841

The employee is expected to work from the Bish Enterprises office during normal working hours.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Applicants must be able to reliably commute to the Giltner office.

A company laptop may be provided for business use. Receiving a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Travel Requirement

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include:

• Customer visits
• Trade shows
• Agricultural events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Training
• Sales meetings
• Dealer visits
• Other company-related activities

Travel may occasionally involve early mornings, evenings, weekends, or overnight stays.

The amount and location of travel may vary depending on customer needs, company events, sales activities, and the agricultural season.

The employee must be willing and able to travel when required.

Sales Team Coordination

The Sales Team Coordinator will help organize and coordinate the daily work of the sales team.

Responsibilities include:

• Helping communicate daily and weekly priorities to members of the sales team.
• Tracking sales-related assignments, deadlines, customer commitments, quotes, orders, and follow-up activities.
• Contacting team members for updates, missing information, and task completion.
• Reminding team members of deadlines, meetings, customer commitments, and required follow-ups.
• Making sure assigned tasks have a clear owner, deadline, and next step.
• Following up when work is incomplete, overdue, unclear, or missing.
• Helping organize and facilitate sales meetings.
• Preparing meeting agendas, notes, action items, assignments, and follow-up lists.
• Monitoring progress on action items discussed during meetings.
• Helping keep sales representatives aligned with company priorities and customer expectations.
• Identifying stalled opportunities, communication gaps, workload conflicts, or missing information.
• Escalating repeated delays, unresolved problems, or serious concerns to management.
• Helping maintain consistent use of the company’s CRM, calendars, sales procedures, and reporting systems.
• Assisting with onboarding and training coordination for new sales team members.
• Helping organize training materials, system access, schedules, meetings, and follow-up activities.

This role includes meaningful people coordination and day-to-day oversight of sales activities.

The employee may provide direction, follow-up, and accountability to members of the sales team. However, final authority regarding hiring, termination, compensation, formal discipline, and major personnel decisions remains with company management unless otherwise assigned.

Customer Service and Communication

The Sales Team Coordinator will help support customers throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities include:

• Answering customer phone calls, emails, and other inquiries in a friendly and professional manner.
• Gathering the information needed to understand the customer’s request.
• Directing technical, pricing, warranty, service, or product questions to the appropriate team member when necessary.
• Following up with customers regarding quotes, orders, availability, appointments, delivery information, and next steps.
• Providing customers with accurate information based on approved company materials and pricing.
• Communicating delays, changes, and updates clearly and promptly.
• Documenting customer commitments and making sure promised follow-ups are completed.
• Assisting with customer concerns by gathering information and coordinating with the appropriate department.
• Following customer issues through until they are resolved or transferred to the correct person.
• Representing Bish Enterprises professionally when communicating with customers, vendors, dealers, visitors, and industry contacts.

Quotes, Orders, and Sales Support

Responsibilities include:

• Preparing customer quotes, proposals, product information, and sales documents using company templates and approved pricing.
• Reviewing documents for accuracy and completeness before they are sent.
• Receiving customer orders and accurately entering the required information into company systems.
• Confirming customer contact information, products, pricing, delivery details, payment requirements, and other order information.
• Monitoring open quotes and orders to help prevent missed deadlines or incomplete tasks.
• Coordinating with production, parts, service, shipping, accounting, marketing, and other departments.
• Checking order status and identifying possible delays or missing information.
• Communicating order updates to the appropriate sales representative, customer, or manager.
• Scheduling customer calls, meetings, demonstrations, appointments, and follow-ups.
• Maintaining sales calendars and communicating scheduling changes.
• Assisting with preparation for trade shows, customer visits, sales meetings, and equipment demonstrations.

CRM, Reporting, and Administrative Support

Responsibilities include:

• Entering and maintaining customer, lead, quote, order, and follow-up information in the company’s systems.
• Keeping customer contact information, notes, deadlines, sales stages, and next steps complete and current.
• Preparing regular sales reports using information from the CRM, spreadsheets, and other company systems.
• Organizing information clearly for management and the sales team.
• Highlighting overdue follow-ups, open quotes, customer concerns, order issues, and other items requiring attention.
• Completing data entry, filing, document preparation, and record organization.
• Maintaining commonly used sales materials, templates, documents, and office supplies.
• Helping improve sales coordination procedures, tracking systems, and internal communication.

Independence and Accountability

The successful candidate must be able to work independently after receiving appropriate training.

The employee will be expected to:

• Keep track of assigned tasks and deadlines.
• Follow up without needing repeated reminders.
• Ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
• Identify routine problems and take reasonable action to solve them.
• Find the correct person or resource when assistance is needed.
• Communicate delays, mistakes, or concerns promptly.
• Keep management informed about important customer, sales, or team issues.
• Address incomplete work professionally and respectfully.
• Balance being supportive with maintaining clear expectations.
• Work confidently with different personalities and communication styles.

This position may not be a good fit for someone who requires constant step-by-step direction for routine work or who is uncomfortable following up with coworkers about incomplete assignments.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time position that generally requires approximately 44 to 50 working hours per week.

The normal schedule is Monday through Friday.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required due to:

• Customer deadlines
• Company travel
• Trade shows or events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Agricultural seasonality
• Increased workload during busy periods

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval.

Any schedule adjustment must still allow the employee to meet customer needs, attend required meetings, complete on-site responsibilities, coordinate the sales team, and fulfill travel requirements.

Because Bish Enterprises is a small and growing company, employees may occasionally be asked to assist with reasonable duties outside their normal task list.

People Coordination and Leadership Skills

• Ability to coordinate the daily work of the sales team members.
• Ability to clearly communicate assignments, priorities, deadlines, and expectations.
• Ability to follow up professionally when tasks or customer commitments are incomplete.
• Confidence asking team members for updates and required information.
• Ability to document responsibilities, deadlines, decisions, and next steps.
• Ability to lead or help facilitate sales meetings.
• Ability to identify when work is delayed, unclear, duplicated, or missing.
• Ability to address routine accountability concerns professionally.
• Ability to escalate serious or repeated issues to management.
• Ability to balance supporting team members with maintaining clear expectations.
• Ability to work with different personalities and communication styles.
• Ability to keep people organized and aligned without waiting for management to intervene in every situation.

Computer Skills

The employee must be comfortable using:

• Microsoft Outlook
• Microsoft Word
• Microsoft Excel
• Online calendars
• Customer relationship management systems
• Video meeting platforms
• Web-based business software
• Printers, scanners, telephones, and standard office equipment

The employee should be able to:

• Write clear and professional emails.
• Create, edit, save, and organize documents.
• Schedule meetings and manage calendar invitations.
• Enter data accurately.
• Sort and filter information in Excel.
• Use simple Excel formulas.
• Prepare small spreadsheets and basic reports.
• Create clear lists of assignments, owners, deadlines, and next steps.
• Learn new software with reasonable training.
• Perform basic office-equipment troubleshooting, such as reconnecting equipment or clearing a printer paper jam.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but may not be required:

• Previous experience coordinating employees, sales representatives, projects, schedules, or cross-functional teams.
• Previous experience in sales support.
• Customer-service experience.
• Administrative or office experience.
• Order-entry or order-processing experience.
• Experience preparing quotes or proposals.
• Experience using customer relationship management software.
• Experience leading meetings or tracking team assignments.
• Experience working with agricultural equipment, farming customers, machinery, manufacturing, parts, or service departments.
• Experience supporting trade shows, events, or customer demonstrations.
• Previous sales experience.

Applicants do not need to have held the exact title of Sales Team Coordinator.

Related experience in team coordination, customer service, office support, sales administration, order processing, project coordination, or account support may be considered.

Compensation

Wage is $40,000 base salary plus commission.

Expected yearly earnings are approximately $45,000–$70,000 during the first year. Actual earnings may vary based on performance, eligible sales, and the terms of the company’s commission plan.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time, on-site position located at Bish Enterprises in Giltner, Nebraska.

The normal work schedule is Monday through Friday, generally totaling approximately 44–50 hours per week.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required based on customer needs, company travel, trade shows, events, and agricultural seasonality.

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval, provided that customer coverage, required meetings, on-site responsibilities, team coordination, and travel requirements are met.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Travel

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include customer visits, trade shows, agricultural events, equipment demonstrations, training, dealer visits, sales meetings, and other company-related activities.

Travel may occasionally include overnight stays, early mornings, evenings, or weekends.

The amount of travel may vary based on company needs and the agricultural season.

Benefits

Bish Enterprises offers a variety of benefits to eligible full-time employees. Benefits may include:

• Health insurance assistance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Life insurance
• Paid time off
• Paid holidays
• Retirement plan options
• Employee discounts
• Professional development and training opportunities
• Company-provided equipment required for the position

Health Insurance

Bish Enterprises does not currently offer a traditional company-sponsored group health insurance plan.

Eligible employees may purchase individual health insurance through the federal Health Insurance Marketplace or another provider of their choice.

The company may provide a monthly health insurance contribution or reimbursement toward an eligible individual health insurance plan, subject to company policy and applicable requirements.

Employees are responsible for selecting, enrolling in, and maintaining their own individual health insurance coverage.

The availability and cost of Marketplace coverage may vary based on the employee’s household, location, income, selected plan, and eligibility for government subsidies.

Specific details regarding the company’s health insurance contribution or reimbursement will be explained during the hiring and enrollment process.

Benefit Eligibility

Some benefits are available only to employees who meet full-time status or other eligibility requirements.

Benefit eligibility, waiting periods, employee costs, company contributions, coverage terms, and plan availability are governed by the applicable company policies and benefit documents.

Benefits may be changed, replaced, or discontinued as permitted by law and company policy.

Other Information

A company laptop and other necessary equipment may be provided for business use.

Providing a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Because Bish Enterprises is a small and growing company, employees may occasionally be asked to perform reasonable duties outside their normal task list to support customers, coworkers, and changing business needs.

Regular and reliable attendance is an essential part of this position.

Employment with Bish Enterprises is at will. This means that either the employee or Bish Enterprises may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law.

Bish Enterprises is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Autonomous Vehicle Production & Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
A WORLD EMPOWERED BY AUTONOMY. WE BUILD ROBOTIC VEHICLES TO IMPROVE LOGISTICS SAFETY, FORGE A GREENER EARTH, AND ENHANCE HUMAN LIVES.



We are a closely-knit team aspiring to change the world through disruptive technology. We are innovators. We are tinkerers. We are problem-solvers. And we have a fair amount of magic dust up our sleeves. We have a plan for fleet-level deployment of autonomous vehicles, and we are looking for the best-of-the-best to join us in making this a reality.



ABOUT VENTI TECHNOLOGIES


Based in the U.S. and Asia, Venti Technologies is the leader in safe-speed autonomous logistics systems, developing the future of goods transportation. Using rigorous mathematics, deep learning, and theoretically-grounded algorithms, Venti has a proprietary collection of autonomy technologies including a suite of powerful logistics algorithms. Venti’s proven value proposition of saving costs, increasing vehicle utilization, and improving safety is recognized by customers and driving growth. 

Launched in 2018, Venti brings together an unsurpassed team internationally. The company has autonomous systems deployed in Asia for industrial and logistics sites and a growing pipeline. Venti has offices in Cambridge (Massachusetts, USA), Suzhou (China), and Singapore – our Asian headquarters.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior AV Production & Integration Engineer is the US engineering lead for producing, integrating and supporting AV kits on our autonomous terminal tractor fleet. You will manage production at our vendors, own the technical documentation, use fleet data to drive fixes, and give day-to-day direction to the Senior Technical Specialist.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Plan and manage AV kit production at vendor facilities: schedules, material and BOM readiness, quality checks, end-of-line testing and delivery.

 - Manage vendors on deliverables, quality issues and corrective actions, and feed improvements back to engineering.

 - Own the US supply chain for AV parts and kits: demand and supply planning, inventory, warehousing and distribution, transportation and logistics, import/export and customs compliance, order fulfillment, and sourcing and procurement.

 - Own US technical documentation (installation guides, work instructions, checklists, troubleshooting and maintenance procedures) under version control.

 - Be the main technical contact for onsite teams and give day-to-day direction to the Senior Technical Specialist.

 - Collect and analyze fleet performance data (faults, downtime, failure trends) to find recurring issues, and report to engineering and management.

 - Lead root cause analysis and track fixes through to verified closure.

 - Plan fleet hardware upgrades and retrofits and work hands-on at site when needed.

 - Develop jigs, fixtures and software tools that speed up production and improve diagnostics and maintenance.
   

Required Qualifications and Experience

 - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics or Automotive Engineering, or equivalent experience.

 - 2–5 years in system integration, field engineering or production support for vehicle or electro-mechanical systems. AV experience preferred.

 - Experience managing vendors or contract manufacturers on schedule and quality.

 - Strong root cause analysis (5-Why, 8D, FMEA) and data analysis skills.

 - Able to design jigs, fixtures or software tools (e.g., Python).

 - Able to read engineering drawings, wiring diagrams and schematics.

 - Strong written communication: high-quality documentation and reports using Confluence, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Slack.

 - Strong verbal communication: confident with vendors, customers, onsite teams and management.

 - Comfortable working with a remote team in Singapore across time zones, and willing to travel within the US.

 - Valid US driver's license (no CDL required). Able to lift 50 lbs, climb onto vehicles, work at height and work outdoors in all weather.



Bonus Points

 - Experience with AV sensors and compute hardware (LiDAR, radar, cameras, GNSS/IMU, industrial PCs).

 - CAN / J1939 and log analysis experience.

 - CAD (e.g., SolidWorks), SQL, or dashboard tools (Power BI, Grafana).

 - Document and change control (ECN/ECO) and Jira.

 - Experience with terminal tractors, heavy-duty trucks or port and logistics operations.




SALARY IS COMMENSURATE WITH EXPERIENCE. WE ALSO OFFER WORLD-CLASS BENEFITS, FANTASTIC CULTURE, FLEXIBLE WORKING ARRANGEMENTS, AND A GREAT INTERNATIONAL WORKING ENVIRONMENT. COME AND JOIN US!
