jobs.title: Nigeria Talent Acquisition Associate (Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

The Nigeria program, established in 2018, is headquartered in Minna, Niger State. We're currently serving over 100,000 unique farmers across the state via our inputs on credit 'Core' program, inputs on cash 'Retail' program, and have a free tree seedling distribution 'Agroforestry' program. To learn more about our work, look at our Nigeria program blog.

About the Role

The Nigeria Talent Acquisition Associate is responsible for proactively building pools of talent for the country program with the ultimate aim of a) increasing hire quality and b) reducing the time it takes to hire that talent. They will pursue a comprehensive talent strategy for the Nigeria program that will include networking, young talent programs, attending high value events and more. The TA Associate will work very closely with the country program to better understand their talent needs. The customer (Nigeria Program) will consider the Talent Acquisition Associate to be the key business partner on the Recruitment team and a key part of program success.

Responsibilities

Business Partner Relationship Owner for Nigeria Program

• Close integration within the Nigeria program to understand their hiring needs

• Participation in talent committees and other leadership groups

• Advice workforce planning for the country program for each year

• ‘Go to Gemba’ with department heads to understand the work that they do

• A willingness to commit to living in Minna for the full first year.

• Understand the talent landscape for the region and design approaches to solving staffing issues around specialised skills and gender balance.

• Develop and execute a brand strategy that positions One Acre Fund as an employer of choice.

Proactively Build Pools of Talent

• Identify all possible talent avenues and build strong talent pipelines that can be used to fill upcoming open roles

• Participation in events and other networking to build a portfolio of contacts across the country

• Pursue contacts in diaspora groups to bring talent back to OAF

• Identify employers and universities whose staff/students have the skills we need for the future

• Collaborate with in-county HR/recruitment teams to match pipelines and prospects with open roles

Manage internship/Graduate Programs

• Build relationships with the top universities in the country to develop an intern or graduate program that will bring young talent into OAF.

• Reduce the need for external hiring through the use of interns/grads who are converted to full time staff

• Design and implement other initiatives that equip future Nigeria program hiring i.e., Reduce time to hire High candidate quality Improve diversity of candidates

Reduce overall ‘Time to Hire’ for the Nigeria Program

• A key indicator of success for the TA role is the overall ‘time to hire’ for the program. Reducing this number indicates that the talent strategy is working

• A second key indicator of success is the ‘quality of the hire’ i.e., does the hire succeed on the job in the first 6 months to 1 year.

• A third key indicator of success in this role is ‘Time it took the successful applicant to apply.” If talent pools are up and running, this number should go down significantly.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, we want a professional with at least 4 years of experience, gained ideally in a social enterprise, high-growth, or multi-country environment.

Technical skills:

• Networking: Has an existing network of local contacts and is comfortable establishing new contacts

• Brand Positioning: Demonstrate the ability to sell the brand One Acre Fund as an employer of choice.

• Customer Service: Meets our customer where they are and invests in understanding their needs and challenges.

• Talent Identification: Can combine customer needs with skillsets that typically thrive at OAF and can covert those into candidates who do well at our organization.

• Ability to work independently: The TA Associate will need to build their own portfolio of talent and must be able to deal with some ambiguity in their work.

• People Management experience

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Abuja - Nigeria

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Contract Duration

2 years

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Nigeria

Application Deadline

21 February 2027. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable & Secretary
jobs.description:
• The Accounts Payable is in charge of the day to day processing of all invoices by ensuring that necessary backup and approvals are obtained in accordance with hotel accounting and financial controls, and within the policies and procedures as outlined in ECOMAN, hotel and corporate policies and guidelines, and the hotel’s business plan.
• To ensures that all accounts payable records are maintained properly and process timely payment for all hotel suppliers/ distributors.
• To provide administrative support to the Accounting Department to ensure that excellent records are maintained and all correspondence handled on a timely basis.
• Secretarial assistance to the Department.

TASKS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

ACCOUNTS PAYABLE

• Checks if the invoices are in order as per the hotel requirement.
• Verifies all details on the invoice i.e. quantities, prices and terms against purchase requisition/order and credit memo.
• Ensures all purchasing and proper receiving formalities are followed. Checks mark extension and footings, receiving stamps and signatures.
• Distributes the cost to the proper accounts with the assistance of the Assistant Controller.
• Audits bills for errors, corrects as necessary
• Attaches bills to purchase orders and receiving documents
• Ensures proper back up is attached to expense reports
• Ensures correct charging amount by coding invoices.
• Reconciles all statements, requests missing invoices, and makes adjustments as necessary.
• Summarizes payments due and communicates cash needs to the Controller for approval.

Ensures appropriate support documentation is obtained and attached to the invoices before payment is made.

• Maintains all necessary files and registers for accounts payable.
• Maintains paid and unpaid invoice files
• Prepares journal entry sheets and post in SCALA Purchase Ledger. After posting, all invoices should be stamped as posted and transaction number should be written for internal control purpose.
• Reconciles all supplier accounts at the end of every month and arrange to tape the invoices to prepare the cheque payment
• Verify all supplier’s statement with our records.
• Prepares all payment vouchers and type the local cheques with the necessary supporting documents for approval & signature.
• In case of Overseas suppliers, a bank transfer or draft application form has to be prepared. For demand drafts, a forwarding letter has to be prepared to the companies and send it by courier.
• After the releasing of cheques by the General Cashier, the payment should be posted in the Purchase Ledger Scala Accounting system.
• Implements and maintains an adequate system to ensure that "Paid" stamp is put on each paid invoice to prevent any duplicate payment.
• Maintains adequate up-to-date files for accounts payable records.
• Ensures that all local and overseas paid invoices are filed separately after the payment
• Prepares all appropriate period closing reports and entries
• Reconcile and print the aging of Accounts Payable and balance with the General ledger account.
• All invoices should have receiving stamp, signed by concerned persons, should be matched with purchase requisition/order, calculate manually, check, mark and have the initial.
• All PR’s/PO’s that are attached to the invoices has to be compared with each other and the account or department to be charged should be indicated.
• After posting, see to it that all invoices are stamped posted and with transaction reference.
• Before closing of the month, all invoices should be manually taped and reconciled with the Purchase Ledger Individual Supplier Account and General ledger corresponding account.
• Statement of Accounts from the supplier should be reconciled periodically.
• During payment preparation, all invoices and cheques has to be counter checked by the Asst. Controller before forwarding to the Controller and General Manager for signature.
• After they signed all the cheques, Accounts Payable clerk or General Cashier should double check whether all are signed and nothing is missing.
• Payment voucher should be posted and stamped (PAID) accordingly.
• All payments should be kept in proper filing.
• Ensures that the controls of ticket purchases order form by serial number and ensures that it is filed properly.
• General Manager’s expense including travel should be checked periodically (after month-end closing).
• All original documents related to GM should be filed separately and should be controlled and approved by the Regional Director.
• All TRAVEL application forms/requests should be approved by the GM and Regional Director before payment.
• All advertising bills should be confirmed and the sample of ads should be attached in the invoice.
• Eurobonus transactions should be counter checked from Fidelio Report after Revenue Manager signature and before payment preparation.
• Goldpoints transactions should be counter checked by the Revenue Manager before payment preparation.
• Reservation fee/Look to book charges and Third party reservations invoices should be counter checked after Revenue Manager signature and before payment preparation.
• Travel Agent commission invoice from WPS should be checked by Revenue Manager before payment preparation.
• ALL overseas orders/invoices/ and LCs should be checked properly before processing the payments and promissory notes.
• All chques and drafts should be stamped “A/C’S PAYEES ONLY” before sending.
• Reconcile all related Financial account as per the Assistant controller list.
• Reconcile Inter- Company account periodically
• Ensures all related party transactions are reconciled periodically (Submit all details with backup monthly)
• Keep a record of Rental/utilities/ and agreed monthly payment not to miss anything and to avoid double payment.

SECRETARY

• Acts as receptionist and co-ordinator for the Accounting Department.
• Clears the Hotel internal mailbox and distributes the papers to the concerned Accounting personnel.
• Handles the Controller’s correspondence.
• Schedules appointments for the Controller with regard to conferences and meetings with other division or department heads and outside companies.
• Coordinates the Controller’s files so that the past information that may be required can be ascertained quickly.
• Assist the Controller regarding Hotel Insurance and Claims.
• Assist the Controller in preparing Hotel contracts and Agreement.
• Assist the Controller and Assistant Controller in preparing the Financial/Operational Reports and other special reports.
• Assist the Controller in preparing the annual budget of the Hotel.
• Maintaining the schedule of reporting and co-ordinate with the Controller in timely reporting.
• Assists the Assistant Controller or other Accounting personnel in typing when necessary and time permits.
• All files of the controller should be properly filed and can easily be traced by the Controller.
• All internal and external information should be handled properly. (confidentiality)
• All confidential files like contracts, insurance policies and bank files should be in locked fire proof safe.
• Update the contract and insurance list periodically.
• Maintain office Stationery
• Prepares all necessary daily reports including the daily sales report.
• Prepares Weekly sales report for the Controller
• List down the all incoming cheques from mails.
• Keep an inventory of blank cheque books inside the safe.
• Prepare the daily cheque usage and issuance record.
• Reconcile all related Financial account as per the Assistant controller list.
• Assists the Assistant Controller in posting the revenue and journal entry sheets in General Ledger.
• Assist in handling day-to-day task of Assistant Controller especially during his absence.
• Assist the General Cashier in posting the Petty Cash Reimbursement and journal entry sheet in General Ledger.
• Relieves the General Cashier/Paymaster during his absence.
• Relieves the Accounts & IT assistant during his absence.
• Any other duties and responsibilities, which may be assigned from time to time.

LAWS, REGULATIONS AND POLICIES

• Follows all applicable laws relating to general accounting practices and tax regulations
• Complies fully with the set financial reporting deadlines and guidelines, as outlined in ECOMAN and by the Controller.

HEALTH AND SAFETY

• Maintains high confidentiality
• Ensures that all potential and real hazards are reported appropriately immediately.
• Fully understands the hotel’s fire, emergency, and bomb threat procedures
• Follows emergency procedures to provide for the security and safety of guests and employees
• Maintains the highest standards of personal hygiene, dress, uniform, appearance, body language and conduct.

• Diploma, Higher National Diploma (HND), or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• At least two years of experience in accounts payable or a similar accounting role. Experience in a hotel or hospitality environment is an advantage.
• Practical experience verifying supplier invoices against purchase orders and goods received, checking approvals, and preparing payments for local and overseas suppliers.
• Ability to reconcile supplier statements and the accounts payable ledger to the general ledger, post journal entries, and prepare aged payables and month-end reports.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software. Familiarity with the SCALA Purchase Ledger is an advantage.
• Good understanding of financial controls, including payment authorisation, supporting documentation, and prevention of duplicate payments.
• Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to meet payment and reporting deadlines.
• Good communication and organisational skills, with the ability to support the Finance Department with correspondence, filing, and confidential records.

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

jobs.title: Senior Autonomous Vehicle Hardware Technical Specialist
jobs.description:
A WORLD EMPOWERED BY AUTONOMY. WE BUILD ROBOTIC VEHICLES TO IMPROVE LOGISTICS SAFETY, FORGE A GREENER EARTH, AND ENHANCE HUMAN LIVES.



We are a closely-knit team aspiring to change the world through disruptive technology. We are innovators. We are tinkerers. We are problem-solvers. And we have a fair amount of magic dust up our sleeves. We have a plan for fleet-level deployment of autonomous vehicles, and we are looking for the best-of-the-best to join us in making this a reality.



ABOUT VENTI TECHNOLOGIES


Based in the U.S. and Asia, Venti Technologies is the leader in safe-speed autonomous logistics systems, developing the future of goods transportation. Using rigorous mathematics, deep learning, and theoretically-grounded algorithms, Venti has a proprietary collection of autonomy technologies including a suite of powerful logistics algorithms. Venti’s proven value proposition of saving costs, increasing vehicle utilization, and improving safety is recognized by customers and driving growth. 

Launched in 2018, Venti brings together an unsurpassed team internationally. The company has autonomous systems deployed in Asia for industrial and logistics sites and a growing pipeline. Venti has offices in Cambridge (Massachusetts, USA), Suzhou (China), and Singapore – our Asian headquarters.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior Technical Specialist is the hands-on hardware expert for our autonomous terminal tractors in the US. You will support AV kit production at our vendors and install, upgrade and troubleshoot AV hardware at vendor and customer sites.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Install, upgrade, repair and troubleshoot AV kits on terminal tractors at customer and vendor sites, including issues the onsite team cannot resolve.

 - Support AV kit production at vendor facilities, including build support, in-process inspection and end-of-line testing to drawings and specifications, with traceable build records.

 - Inspect fabricated parts and assemblies (harnesses, brackets, sub-assemblies) and carry out incoming QC on components.

 - Manage US component inventory at vendor and customer sites and stage kits for each build.

 - Assist with US supply chain activities for AV parts and kits: demand and supply planning, inventory, warehousing and distribution, shipping and logistics, import/export and customs, order fulfillment, and sourcing and procurement.

 - Train onsite Service Engineers and provide first-line remote support to identify and isolate faults.

 - Build and improve jigs, fixtures and simple diagnostic tools for production and maintenance.

 - Collect test and field data and help draft work instructions and troubleshooting guides.
   

Required Qualifications and Experience

 - 5–10 years of hands-on vehicle maintenance and troubleshooting, preferably on heavy-duty trucks or terminal tractors.

 - 2–5 years with AV hardware or electro-mechanical system integration, ideally in a production or upfitting environment.

 - Able to read engineering drawings, wiring diagrams and schematics, and follow engineering instructions accurately.

 - Proficient with diagnostic and test tools (multimeters, harness tools, vehicle diagnostic software).

 - Strong written communication: clear reports and records using Confluence, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Slack.

 - Strong verbal communication: confident with vendors, customers and internal teams, including hands-on training.

 - Comfortable working with a remote team in Singapore across time zones, and willing to travel within the US.

 - Valid US driver's license (no CDL required). Able to lift 50 lbs, climb onto vehicles, work at height and work outdoors in all weather.



Bonus Points

 - ASE certification, or a technical diploma in automotive, diesel or electrical technology.

 - Familiarity with AV sensors and compute hardware (LiDAR, radar, cameras, GNSS/IMU, industrial PCs).

 - CAN / J1939 experience, and knowledge of harness standards (IPC/WHMA-A-620).

 - Jig and fixture fabrication, or basic scripting (e.g., Python).

 - Experience with terminal tractors, drive-by-wire or electric heavy-duty vehicles.




SALARY IS COMMENSURATE WITH EXPERIENCE. WE ALSO OFFER WORLD-CLASS BENEFITS, FANTASTIC CULTURE, FLEXIBLE WORKING ARRANGEMENTS, AND A GREAT INTERNATIONAL WORKING ENVIRONMENT. COME AND JOIN US!

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At Rerun, we're building a new multimodal data stack for Physical l AI. Large parts of the physical-world economy will be transformed by these technologies, and we're building the data infrastructure and tools that enable it to happen.

Rerun's open source project is already loved by some of the best teams in the world. Our commercial product, Rerun Hub, is a catalog and storage engine that already handles petabytes of robot training data for early customers, and we're now ready to onboard more teams. Read our blog post on what we're building: A new data layer for robot learning https://rerun.io/blog/data-layer-for-robot-learning.

You’ll join a small team building Rerun Hub, and you’ll help build the control plane that runs Hub, including our Kubernetes operator that deploys cloud resources and workloads.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Contribute significantly to our Kubernetes operator: the control plane that provisions, configures, and manages Rerun Hub deployments across our own cloud infrastructure and inside customer accounts. This is real software engineering: CRDs, controllers, reconciliation, APIs, tests, releases.

 - Deep customer onboarding: When a customer brings new infrastructure requirements, you extend our control plane to accommodate that. The reconcilers you contribute will make Rerun Hub work end-to-end from networking, IAM, storage to cluster configuration.

 - Production reliability and scale: Observability, CI/CD, incident response, and the deployment experience from local dev through staging to prod.

 - Follow-the-sun on-call with the rest of the team.




WE'D LOVE IT IF YOU HAVE

 - A strong software engineering background. You think of infrastructure as software you build, not just systems you operate.

 - Deep Kubernetes experience, specifically with the operator pattern: you've designed CRDs, written controllers (controller-runtime / kubebuilder / operator-sdk), and shipped them to production. Earlier-career engineers with strong Go and distributed-systems/kubernetes fundamentals plus genuine interest in this work are equally welcome; we're hiring across levels.

 - Proficiency in Go, and ability to read and contribute to an asynchronous Rust codebase (or eagerness to learn; much of our stack is Rust).

 - Solid experience with AWS, infrastructure-as-code (ideally Terraform/OpenTofu), and production-grade observability.

 - You embrace AI as a core part of how you engineer software, integrating AI tools and agentic workflows into your daily work. You own all the code you and your agents ship.

 - Great communication in English, an ownership mindset, and a curious, helpful attitude.




BONUS

 - Experience with high-throughput, time-series, or analytical database systems

 - Background in data-intensive infrastructure

 - Interest in robotics, AR/VR, ML, or simulation




HOW WE WORK AT RERUN

 - This role is open to candidates in Europe, and especially on the US East Coast or in Canada

 - We're a remote company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with a growing hub in San Francisco.

 - We meet up in person for a week roughly once a quarter.

 - We're spread across European and US time zones. Rather than one fixed window, each team keeps a few hours of daily overlap that fits where its members are, and every role posting says what that looks like.

 - We've put together an uncommonly talented tech team, value agency and helpfulness highly, and expect everyone to take broad responsibility for what they build.

 - We offer competitive cash and equity compensation, six weeks paid vacation, and whatever hardware and software you need to do your job.

 - Parental leave: 12 weeks full pay for every parent, alongside your local statutory leave entitlements.

jobs.title: VP Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Swap

Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience.

Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence.

At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works.

About the role 

Swap’s partnerships function is established, proven, and entering a new phase of growth. We’re looking for an ambitious, commercially driven leader to make partnerships a core revenue engine. 

You’ll own partnerships across three partner types: referral partners (3PLs, warehouses, WMS, agencies and tech/solution providers), strategic partners (shopping carts, marketplaces and carriers), and enablement partners (tech enablers and solution providers). Reporting to the CRO, you’ll set the vision, lead a global team of six across London and the US, and carry a dedicated revenue target, separate from Sales. 

Our goal is to double partnerships’ contribution to company revenue within a year, with a longer-term ambition for partnerships to drive a significantly larger share of gross revenue. That means qualified referrals that shorten sales cycles, and scalable one-to-many channels that reach merchants outside our core ICP. 



Strategy & Revenue 

 - Partnerships Strategy: Define and execute the vision and roadmap across all three partner types. Sequence partner acquisition deliberately (label/shipping software, then WMS/TMS, then 3PLs), prioritising direct integrations over iPaaS or third-party connectors. 

 - Revenue Ownership: Carry and deliver a dedicated revenue quota, separate from Sales, through partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across Swap’s product suite (including Global, Returns, Checkout+, Agentic Storefront, and the Guaranteed Landed Cost API). Drive adoption of lower-penetration products such as Inventory and Tax through better positioning and bundling. 

 - Commercial Model Design: Own the partner commercial model, including revenue-share structures, payout terms, and the rules for sourced versus influenced attribution. Make sure incentives reward long-term customer success and multi-product adoption, not one-off transactions. Review and evolve it annually. 

 - Market Expansion: Lead regional growth, including US expansion (“Win the West”), and build our non-Shopify partner ecosystem across carts such as Adobe Magento, Shopware, Wix, Webflow, and WooCommerce
   
   Programme Leadership

 - Partner Programme Ownership: Own and evolve the Swap Partner Programme, including the three-tier model (Flock, Runway, Flagship), its revenue share, payout terms and shared-client requirements, and the biannual tier review. 

 - Partner Acquisition: Identify, tier, and recruit partners using clear prioritisation criteria: demand in Sales and BDR conversations, ICP and tech-stack fit, brand strength, and willingness to make active, qualified referrals. Run the process from the first fit conversation through to a signed Partner Agreement. 

 - Partner Enablement: Build and run certification and enablement programmes so partners can position, sell, and implement Swap. This includes training, sales collateral, and early access to roadmap and release information. Partner Portal, Lead Management & Payouts: Own the partner portal and the lead registration process (HubSpot attribution and the Euler Partner Management system), including qualification rules, the handraise window, conflict handling with Sales, and accurate, timely quarterly revenue-share payments.
   
   Go-To-Market

 - Joint Go-To-Market: Own account mapping and joint GTM plans with priority partners, aligned to shared target accounts and client profiles. 

 - Co-Selling: Run co-selling initiatives and manage the partner pipeline from first engagement to revenue, with Partner Managers supporting calls and shepherding deals. 

 - Co-Marketing: Partner with Marketing on co-created content, joint events and webinars, podcasts, and client case studies. Manage Marketing Development Funds (MDF) and tie spend to pipeline and influenced credit. 

 - Community & Events: Grow Swap’s partner and brand community (The Nest) and put partners at the centre of key campaigns, trade shows, summits, and merchant events.
   
   Partner Success

 - Technical Onboarding: Work with Solutions Engineers and Product to cut onboarding time (currently 45+ days in many cases) through pre-built WMS integrations, direct tech integrations, and partner-led or selfserve implementation. 

 - Partner Activation & Engagement: Drive activation, engagement, and shipment volume across the ecosystem, supported by dedicated Slack channels, named Partner Managers, and QBRs for top-tier partners. Encourage cross-referral between trusted 3PL and agency partners. 

 - Voice of the Partner: Act as the link between partners and Product. Run beta programmes with Flagship partners and feed partner insight into the roadmap.
   
   Team & Performance

 - Team Leadership: Lead, develop, and scale a global team of six across London and the US, covering logistics, agency, and strategic partnerships. Set the structure, hiring plan, and quotas. 

 - Performance Management: Report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue and pipeline, partnerships’ share of gross revenue, certified partners, activation rates, shipments influenced, co-sell wins, tier progression, and partner retention. 

 - Executive Engagement: Build senior relationships with strategic partners and represent Swap at industry events and partner forums. 

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the CRO, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, and Finance so partnership initiatives align with commercial objectives and partner compensation is paid accurately and on time.
   
   
   
   What we’re looking for 

 - 10+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel roles within logistics technology, e-commerce, or agency ecosystems, including 3–5+ years leading a partnerships team. 

 - A track record of building and scaling partner programmes, including tiering, certification, and revenueshare models, while consistently delivering against personal revenue targets.

 -  Experience recruiting, developing, and managing geographically distributed teams. 

 - Ability to develop joint GTM strategies and execute account mapping, partner engagement, and coselling. 

 - Working knowledge of logistics workflows, WMS/TMS, shipping software, and supply chain technology.

 -  Experience with cross-border commerce, agency ecosystems, or non-Shopify platforms is a strong advantage.

 -  Experience with strategic or “one-to-many” partnerships (carts, marketplaces, carriers) and API-based embedded integrations is a plus. 

 - Technical aptitude to design onboarding processes and work closely with Product and Solutions Engineering. 

 - Data-driven approach, with experience using CRM and partner management tools (e.g. HubSpot) to track attribution, pipeline, and activation. 

 - Strong executive communication and stakeholder management across partners, senior leadership, and internal teams.

What we offer

💰 Competitive base salary: Pay that reflects your experience and the impact you’ll have, reviewed regularly as you grow with us.

📈 Stock options: Own a piece of what we’re building. As a high-growth scale-up, you’ll share in the upside as the company grows.

🏖️ Generous PTO: Competitive annual leave, with public holidays on top, plus your birthday off so you can celebrate properly.

🏥 Private healthcare: Comprehensive private medical cover, so you can get the care you need quickly.

🏦 Pension contributions: Company contributions to help you build long-term financial security.

🧘 Wellness benefits: Support for your physical health and wellbeing, so you can look after yourself in the way that works for you.

💚 Mental health support: Access to mental health resources and support, because looking after your mind matters as much as your body.

👶 Enhanced maternity and paternity leave: Extra support when you’re growing your family, so you can focus on what matters most.

🏡 Flexible working: Choose how and where you do your best work, with the trust and autonomy to manage your own time.

✈️ Work abroad for 4 weeks a year: Take your laptop somewhere new for up to four weeks each year, whether that’s family, travel, or a change of scenery.

🎉 Quarterly team offsite budget: A dedicated budget each quarter for your team to get together, connect, and have fun.

🍻 Thursday happy hour: Wind down the week with your colleagues at our Thursday happy hour, held across all of our locations.

🥞 Breakfast Mondays: Start the week with a good meal and good company.



Diversity & Equal Opportunities:

We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's also the smart thing.

jobs.title: Client Partner
jobs.description:
This role spans across Cialfo and BridgeU, the two K12 brands of Manifest Global.

What This Role Is

Across Southeast Asia, the international school sector has grown faster than almost anywhere in the world. In Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, and Jakarta, new schools open with ambitious university outcomes promised to families. Established schools find their counsellors guiding larger cohorts toward a wider spread of destinations: the UK, the US, Australia, Europe, and increasingly Asia itself. The counsellor at the centre of that process is often one person, sometimes two, holding hundreds of applications, deadlines, and family expectations at once.

What that counsellor needs is not another tool to manage. They need a system that reduces the load and a partner who understands how their school actually works. When that combination is in place, students apply better, families trust the school more, and university outcomes become a reason families choose it. When it isn’t, the platform becomes a login nobody uses and the renewal becomes a negotiation.

Cialfo and BridgeU are built for exactly this problem. Cialfo owns the premium counsellor experience, and Saige, its AI layer, is live. BridgeU owns the student-first guidance journey and brings deep roots in international schools. Together they serve 2,000+ schools. In Southeast Asia, both brands already have a meaningful base of schools. There is a much larger set of schools in the region that should be using one of them and isn’t yet.

This role owns the K12 client relationship in Southeast Asia: keeping the schools already with us healthy and growing, and bringing new schools onto the platform. As that base grows, the remit extends into neighbouring markets across the wider region.

What Makes This Role Different

Most client roles in EdTech ask you to farm or to hunt. This one asks you to do both, in a region where the two are closely linked. International school leaders in Southeast Asia talk to each other, so an account you renew well in Kuala Lumpur becomes the reference that opens a conversation in Jakarta. You also carry two strong brands into every conversation. That means you can offer each school the platform that genuinely fits it, rather than forcing one product onto every situation.

Behind both brands sits the rest of Manifest Global. Explore connects with 1,000+ universities across 100+ countries, which gives the schools you work with a direct line to the university side of the equation. Kaaiser has guided students across India and Southeast Asia since 1997 and understands the family decisions behind every application. No standalone guidance platform can bring that breadth into a business review with a head of school.

The broader overseas education industry is contracting. Cialfo and BridgeU are growing. Southeast Asia is one of the regions where that growth is most visible. The client base here has reached the point where consistent, dedicated ownership can turn a set of accounts into a regional presence. That is why this seat matters now.

What You Own

The existing Southeast Asia school portfolio

• Own the health, retention, and renewal of your assigned Cialfo and BridgeU schools across Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia

• Run business reviews that change how a school uses the platform, not check-in calls that only update a status

• Spot at-risk accounts early from usage signals and relationship cues, and lead the recovery with enough lead time to matter

• Build relationships at every level of the school: the counsellor who uses the platform daily, the coordinator who manages access, and the head of school who signs the renewal

Account growth and expansion

• Grow contract value across your portfolio through upgrades, additional capabilities, and cross-brand conversations that serve what each school is trying to achieve

• Drive adoption of the full platform, including Saige, by connecting features to the workflows each school has already described to you

• Prepare every renewal well in advance so nothing surprises either side

New school pipeline

• Build and own a pipeline of new international and private schools across Southeast Asia, from first conversation to signed contract

• Turn your existing schools into references and the regional school community into a channel, through associations, counsellor networks, and events

• Position Cialfo or BridgeU based on what each school actually needs, and lead the commercial conversation through to close

Regional insight and rigour

• Keep every account and opportunity accurately recorded in the CRM so the whole team works from reality

• Bring structured insight from Southeast Asia back to product, marketing, and leadership on what schools in the region need next

• Identify where the Southeast Asia model can extend next across the wider region, and build the case before expanding into it

What Success Looks Like

The markers below reflect where the K12 business in Southeast Asia is today. We’ll calibrate the specifics once you’re in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.

In the first three months, you have met every school in your portfolio. You know which accounts are healthy, which need attention, and where the strongest growth opportunities sit. The CRM reflects reality, your first conversations with new schools are open, and you have a point of view on the region that is genuinely your own.

By six months, the portfolio is measurably healthier. Business reviews run on a cadence that matters, renewal conversations start earlier and carry less friction, and adoption is trending upward. Expansion conversations are in motion with existing schools, and new schools are moving through your pipeline toward signature.

By twelve months, you have built a regional book that renews, refers, and grows. Schools in Southeast Asia recommend Cialfo and BridgeU to their peers because someone showed up consistently and made the platform work for them. New schools have joined because of it, and you have a clear, evidence-based view of which neighbouring markets come next. The specifics will be calibrated once you’re in the role. The direction won’t change.

What You Bring

You have five to seven years in B2B client-facing commercial roles, ideally selling SaaS into education. You’ve owned a book of accounts where retention and growth were yours: if an account churned, you knew why and had seen it coming. You’ve also closed new business, and you know the difference between managing a relationship and opening one.

Your commercial instinct runs underneath the relationship work. You track what your portfolio is worth, what it should be worth, and you build the case to close the gap. Renewal targets and new-logo targets both motivate you, because hitting them means schools are getting real value. You’re comfortable with long sales cycles that follow the academic calendar, and you plan around them rather than fight them.

You understand how international and private schools in Southeast Asia make decisions. You know that relationships often come before contracts, that communication styles differ from Malaysia to Thailand to Indonesia, and that building trust with a counsellor is different from building it with a school owner or head of school. You think in terms of the region, not a list of accounts.

This is a remote role with a clear mandate and significant autonomy. You own the outcomes across your territory. You set your own cadence across several countries and make sound calls without waiting for direction. You don’t need someone looking over your shoulder to stay sharp.

Somewhere underneath the commercial instinct, you remember why this work matters. The counsellors you work with are guiding students through one of the most consequential decisions of their lives. How well Cialfo and BridgeU serve those counsellors shows up in where those students end up.

Most importantly, you read the description of what Cialfo and BridgeU are building in Southeast Asia and your first reaction was “I know these schools, I know how to grow this region, and I know what it looks like when it’s done well.” That’s the person this role is for.

Why Manifest

Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 150+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI-powered college counseling, 2,000+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), Explore (AI-powered university outreach, 1,000+ university partners), EduGo Abroad (India’s only dedicated platform for European education), and Flow AI (AI-native platform for study abroad agents, 1,000+ agent partners, 550+ universities). $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030. We’re building the operating system that changes that. $80M raised. Still early.

jobs.title: Email Designer
jobs.description:
LTV.ai http://LTV.ai is a set of AI agents that run email marketing for leading commerce brands. Every morning, our agents deliver finished campaigns into a brand's Slack for approval: strategy, segmentation, copy, and creative. 

We sit on top of the ESP a brand already uses (Klaviyo, Braze, Salesforce), so teams get more output without changing how they work. We work with some of the most recognizable retail and DTC brands in the world, and we're growing fast.




THE ROLE

Our agents produce a lot of email creative. Your job is to make sure every email our biggest brands see is one they'd be proud to send, and to make the agents better every day so they need you less over time.

This is not a traditional in-house design role. You'll be embedded with our largest customers, learning their brands deeply, reviewing and refining what our agents produce before it reaches them, and turning everything you learn into feedback that improves the product. You are the human in the loop and the person who teaches the machine what great looks like, while improving its evals over time.

This is a founding role, so there's no design team, playbook, or existing process to inherit. You'll build it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Spend time with our customers every day: in their Slack channels, on calls, in their brand guidelines. Know each brand better than anyone on our team.

 - Act as the quality gate for our top accounts. Review, fix, and elevate agent-generated emails before they go out.

 - Design emails and supporting graphics yourself when it matters: launches, hero campaigns, brand moments.

 - Run human evals on our creative output. Score it, explain what's wrong, and turn your judgment into rules, examples, and feedback our engineering team can build into the agents.

 - Build and maintain each brand's visual identity inside our system (layouts, type, color, imagery, tone) so the agents get it right on the first try.

 - Spot patterns across brands: what converts, what breaks, what customers keep pushing back on. Bring it to product.




WHO YOU ARE

jobs.title: Remote Video Director
jobs.description:
🎬 Interview & Testimonials Video Director WANTED

📍 Location: Remote, with occasional in-person shoots for Los Angeles-based directors
💰 Compensation: Up to $45/hour
🕒 Schedule: Flexible; weekdays, evenings, and occasional weekends
🎥 Primary Platform: OpenReel

🚀 About TubeScience

TubeScience is a performance marketing agency where world-class creative meets real-time data. Every month, our distributed team produces performance video ads for leading DTC brands and Fortune 500 companies, at a scale most teams never see.

💡 The Role

TubeScience is seeking experienced Remote Directors to lead remotely produced, performance-marketing video shoots with professional talent, content creators, real product users, and first-time on-camera participants.

Shoots take place primarily from the talent's home, using their personal phone connected through OpenReel, which lets you remotely control exposure, color balance, focus, and recording. With no crew on location, you're the primary creative and technical lead, guiding talent through performance, framing, lighting, sound, product interaction, and self-filming, often with people who have little or no production experience.

LA-based directors may also occasionally shoot in person at a talent's home, capturing content directly on an iPhone as a lightweight, one-man production unit.

🎬 What You'll Do

• Prep the shoot: Review the brief, scripts, and brand/compliance requirements, build an efficient shooting plan, and lead a pre-production call walking talent through expectations, OpenReel, phone setup, location, wardrobe, and products.

• Direct performance: Create a comfortable environment that encourages natural, authentic performances, and give clear, actionable adjustments to everyone from professional actors to first-time performers.

• Run the technical side remotely: Guide talent on iPhone positioning, framing, lighting, white balance, sound, background, and product placement, and troubleshoot connectivity, phone settings, and OpenReel issues.

• Shoot for social: Keep safe areas, text overlays, and vertical framing in mind, preserving the native, authentic quality performance-marketing content needs.

• Keep it moving: Run the session independently, adapt when circumstances change, and capture the unexpected moments and spontaneous B-roll that can strengthen the final creative.

• Wrap it up: Confirm all footage is uploaded, post a short production report on the Monday Job board (what worked, challenges, missing material), and handle any pickups or follow-up briefs.

• In-person shoots (LA-based only): Travel to talent homes and direct while filming on an iPhone, working respectfully and professionally inside private residences.

A typical assignment: about 1.5 hrs prep (including a ~45-min pre-pro call), 4–5 hrs shoot, and 1 hr wrap/upload. Whenever possible, the shoot takes place within four days of the pre-production call.

🧬 What We're Looking For

• Professional experience directing talent for commercials, branded content, UGC, social, film, TV, or comparable productions.

• Comfort directing both experienced professionals and people who have never been on camera before.

• Strong understanding of cinematography fundamentals (lighting, exposure, composition, camera placement, color, sound) and the ability to explain them clearly to non-filmmakers.

• Strong understanding of vertical, social-first content and of how performance advertising differs from traditional brand filmmaking.

• Excellent verbal and written communication, organization, and attention to detail.

• Ability to troubleshoot calmly and work independently while staying in close contact with a larger production team.

• Schedule flexibility: talent often has full-time jobs or limited daytime availability, so shoots may happen early mornings, evenings, or weekends.

➕ Nice to Have

• Experience with OpenReel or similar remote production platforms (training will be provided).

🎓 Training & Onboarding

All Remote Directors receive paid training before leading productions independently: OpenReel training, about two paid shadow assignments with an experienced TubeScience director, then about two trial assignments. After that, assignments come in on an ongoing basis.

🤝 Working Relationship

This is an hourly freelance/permalance position for directors who want an ongoing relationship with TubeScience. The starting rate covers approved time on prep, pre-production calls, shoot time, upload and wrap, reporting, and follow-up or pickup work. Assignment volume may vary based on client needs, availability, location, and performance.

TubeScience is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Chemisch Analist (Metalen)
jobs.description:
Voor Eurofins Analytico B.V. in Amersfoort zijn wij  per direct op zoek naar een  enthousiaste analist voor de afdeling metalen

Functie:

Ben je op zoek naar een leuke baan waarin geen enkele dag hetzelfde is, je dagen voorbij vliegen en je iedere dag nieuwe dingen leert? Dan is deze functie als analist bij de afdeling metalen echt iets voor jou! Op de afdeling metalen analyseren we diverse soorten grond- en watermonsters met behulp van ICP-MS en IC. Je wordt na een gedegen inwerkperiode verantwoordelijk voor bepaalde analyses. Dit houdt in dat je de apparatuur in goede conditie houdt, problemen ziet en oplost, de metingen start, analyses nakijkt en rapporteert en kwaliteitszaken zoals controlekaarten bijhoudt. Indien er vragen of problemen zijn kun je altijd terecht bij de senioranalisten en het afdelingshoofd. Je voert de analyses waar jij volgens de planning op staat zelfstandig uit, maar je werkt wel als een team samen en jullie helpen elkaar waar nodig.

Je komt te werken in een vlot team met betrokken en gezellige mensen. Op de afdeling heerst een open sfeer waar alles bespreekbaar is. Er is tevens veel ruimte voor groei en ontwikkeling, onder andere door middel van het volgen van cursussen en andere ontwikkelingstrajecten.

Kortom: Zoek je een uitdagende baan in een leuk team waar je altijd wat te doen hebt en kunt doorgroeien dan is dit de baan voor jou!

• Afgeronde MLO niveau 4 in analytische chemie of HLO richting chemie
• Ervaring met chemische analyse technieken is een pre
• Een harde werker die van aanpakken weet en flexibel inzetbaar is
• Probleemoplossend vermogen
• Kwaliteitsgericht, proactief en een team-player.

Ben jij enthousiast geworden na het lezen van de vacature en kan jij jezelf terugvinden in de bovenstaande criteria? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren, via de sollicitatie button!

Naast het salaris bieden wij jou:

• Een salaris passend bij je niveau en werkervaring
• Een vakantietoeslag van 8%;
• 25 vakantiedagen;
• Fulltime dienstverband, 32 uur per week is bespreekbaar;
• Een kwartaalbonus bij het behalen van de bedrijfsbrede doelstellingen;
• Een uitstekende pensioenregeling met een eigen bijdrage van slechts 3%;
• Een extra verlof dag op de dag na je verjaardag (uitslaapdag);
• Reiskostenvergoeding (>10 km);
• Een gezellig en collegiaal team dat jou van harte welkom heet;
• Een flexibele werksituatie met ruimte voor persoonlijke wensen/eisen/ontwikkeling.

Meer weten?

Meer informatie over deze vacature kun je inwinnen bij Graydon de Wit, Corporate Recruiter.

Wil je op de hoogte blijven van vacatures die matchen met jouw profiel, ook in de toekomst? Klik op deze link!

Beschrijving van het bedrijf

Eurofins Scientific is een internationaal beursgenoteerd life sciences bedrijf dat haar klanten voorziet van hoogwaardig laboratoriumonderzoek en advies. Eurofins is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van bio-analytische testen voor levensmiddelen, water, milieu, cosmetica, farmaceutische producten en contract research voor agro science. Daarnaast is Eurofins één van de grootste aanbieders ter wereld in testing en laboratorium services in genomics, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences, medicijnontwikkeling en clinical studies. Eurofins maakt daarbij gebruik van een unieke hoeveelheid analysemethoden en een ongekend hoog kennisniveau en expertise.

Eurofins bestaat wereldwijd uit ruim 63.000 medewerkers, verdeeld over 950 hyper moderne laboratoria en is actief in 60 landen met een pro-forma omzet van 6.95€ miljard in 2024. Naast zeer sterke autonome groei met vele eigen start-ups heeft Eurofins in 2024 in verschillende landen meer dan 25 acquisities gedaan.

De geaccrediteerde laboratoria van Eurofins Milieu bieden in Nederland en België een uitgebreid pakket aan chemische, fysische en biologische analyses in alle milieu matrices. Door jarenlange ervaring heeft zij uitvoerige kennis op het gebied van zowel routinematige analyses als niet standaard analyses waaronder analyses van bijzondere verbindingen en microverontreinigingen. Eurofins is marktleider op het gebied van specialistisch onderzoek; opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer waterkwaliteitsbeheerders, Rijkswaterstaat, provinciale en gemeentelijke overheden, milieu-adviesbureaus, industrie en aannemers. Circa 1000 gemotiveerde deskundigen verzorgen het traject van monstername tot aan de digitale rapportage van de analyseresultaten. Analyses vinden voornamelijk plaats in laboratoria in Amsterdam (Eurofins Omegam), Barneveld (Eurofins Analytico),  Merelbeke (Eurofins ECCA), Barendrecht (Eurofins Sanitas) en Deurningen (Eurofins ACMAA).

Voor meer informatie verwijzen we graag naar www.eurofins.com/careers.

jobs.title: BRAIINS FORGE: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Do našeho softwarového týmu hledáme kolegyni či kolegu, který se nebojí vývoje na zařízení s omezenými prostředky - Braiins Deck má pouze 256 MB paměti a běží na dvoujádrovém  STM32MP1 🙂

Braiins Forge s.r.o. je vznikající hardwarový startup vystavěný na základech Braiins – průkopníka na poli bitcoinového těžebního softwaru. Začali jsme před čtyřmi lety jako malé oddělení, postavili skvělý technický tým, vyvinuli několik produktů a nyní máme vlastní firmu! Ve firmě se nám rodí softwarové oddělení, které chceme mít blízko k hardwaru, který vyvíjíme. Neusínáme však na vavřínech a pronikáme do dalších oblastí – aktuálně v oblasti solo home miningu a home automation. Není Ti cizí embedded vývoj a nebojíš se hardwaru? Tak to hledáme právě Tebe!




S ČÍM POTŘEBUJEME POMOCT?

S vývojem naší aplikace bmc-main, která běží nejen na Braiins Decku, ale nově i na Braiins Mini Mineru 101. Najdeš ji na GitHubu https://github.com/BraiinsForge/bmc-main. Naší snahou je uživatelům přinést otevřený ekosystém, do kterého budou chtít sami přispívat.




NA ČEM PRACUJEM?

 - Braiins Deck je multifunkční tabletop zařízení, na kterém můžeš sledovat počasí, akcie, nebo třeba pozici mezinárodní vesmírné stanice. Krom toho si na něj může každý vyrobit vlastní widget - dnes je to otázka jednoho promptu!

 - Forge Axe je náš nový open frame hobby Bitcoin miner s BM1370. Stavíme ho na RP2350 a je to náš první bare-metal systém.


CO OD TEBE OČEKÁVÁME?

 - Znalost Rustu nebo chuť se Rust naučit. Píšem v něm skoro vše.

 - Nelekneš se hardwaru s omezeným výkonem a pamětí, kde se bez optimalizace rozhodně neobejdeš.

 - Schopnost efektivně pracovat s agentními systémy. K vývoji používáme Claude Code a Codex.

 - Zkušenosti s Linuxem na denní bázi. Vyvíjíme primárně na Linuxu a na našich zařízeních běží distro založené na OpenWrt.


VÝHODOU JE

 - Znalost Nixu, který používáme už nejen pro vývoj, ale i na našich zařízeních.

 - Zkušenost s embedded Linuxem na platformě ARMv7.

 - React a TypeScript, ve kterých je napsaný náš frontend.

 - Zkušenost s řízením projektů v rámci týmu i mimo něj, schopnost rozdělit větší problémy na dílčí části, atd…


CO NABÍZÍME MY?

 - Zajímavé technické výzvy v oblasti bitcoinového hardwaru i mimo ni.

 - Rychlý iterativní vývoj.

 - Full-time spolupráci formou plného úvazku nebo smlouvy.

 - Smlouvu na dobu neurčitou.

 - Kanceláře v širším centru Prahy s bezvadnou dostupností MHD i možností parkování zdarma v areálu firmy.

 - Práci na zajímavých projektech, které máš možnost ovlivnit od samotného začátku vývoje.

Jsme malý tým, který má velké ambice a sháníme mezi sebe někoho, kdo dá do práce srdce stejně jako my. Pojď to rozjet s námi!

jobs.title: Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
The Validation Department provides validation and lifecycle oversight for GMP processes supporting routine operations at the Westport manufacturing site. Its four workstreams are Process Validation, Cleaning Validation, Airflow Visualisation, and Sterilisation Validation (Ethylene Oxide (EtO) and Gamma).

The Validation Engineer plans, executes, reviews, documents, and maintains validation activities across assigned workstreams in accordance with the site Validation Master Plan, approved procedures, and regulatory requirements. Applying science- and risk-based principles, the role supports manufacturing and cross-functional teams and keeps validated processes in a state of control throughout their lifecycle. The engineer shall maintain current knowledge of EU GMP, FDA guidance, PDA Technical Reports, ISO 11135 and other relevant standards.

Responsibilities:

• Plan, author, execute, review, and, where authorised, approve validation strategies, risk assessments, protocols, reports, and supporting documentation for assigned workstreams.
• Support process validation, including qualification strategy, process performance qualification, continued process verification, change assessment, and lifecycle management.
• Support cleaning validation, including process assessment, product and equipment grouping, worst-case rationale, sampling strategies, acceptance criteria, execution, and periodic review.
• Plan, coordinate, execute, and assess airflow visualisation studies in qualified cleanroom and aseptic environments, ensuring compliant study design, records, conclusions, and traceability.
• Support EtO and Gamma sterilisation validation, revalidation, change assessment, and periodic review, and investigate atypical results in line with applicable standards.
• Analyse validation data against predefined acceptance criteria, identify trends or gaps, and prepare clear, timely technical conclusions.
• Apply quality risk management to define validation scope, assess changes, prioritise work, and plan proportionate remediation or requalification.
• Maintain validation plans, schedules, trackers, and metrics; collaborate with internal functions, external laboratories, and vendors; and escalate risks to quality, compliance, supply, or timelines and drive actions to closure.
• Support deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, regulatory submissions, and inspections, and participate in regulatory and internal audits as a validation subject-matter expert.
• Contribute to procedure development and continuous improvement, and comply with GMP, data integrity, documentation, and EHS requirements, including participation in APEX, quality, and safety initiatives.

• Bachelor’s degree (NFQ Level 8) in Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum four years’ relevant experience in validation, qualification, technical operations, engineering, manufacturing, microbiology, or quality within a regulated pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or medical-device environment.
• Preferred: experience in process validation, cleaning validation, airflow visualisation, EtO sterilisation, or Gamma sterilisation.
• Working knowledge of GMP and regulatory requirements, with the ability to interpret standards, procedures, and scientific data into compliant validation approaches.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities to agreed timelines. Ability to work independently, escalate issues appropriately, and maintain consistent GxP standards during changing priorities.
• Clear communicator who works effectively across multifunctional teams and builds alignment on validation decisions and actions.
• High attention to detail, sound technical judgement, and commitment to product quality, patient safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Senior Data Scientist

Brooklyn, NY (Rent the Runway HQ)

About Us:

Rent the Runway (RTR)  is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world’s first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in-house proprietary technology and a one-of-a-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC’s “Disruptor 50” five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies list multiple times.

About the Team:

Data is core to our growing business and has been ingrained in the company's DNA since its founding. As a member of the Data Analytics team, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Inventory, and other business stakeholders to identify opportunities where machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics can create meaningful customer and business value.

The Data Science team develops machine learning solutions, predictive models, recommendation systems, experimentation frameworks, and AI-powered capabilities that directly influence how Rent the Runway operates and how customers discover, engage with, and rent and buy inventory. Our work spans pricing optimization, inventory intelligence, personalization, predictive modeling, and intelligent customer experiences.

As RTR continues investing in Data Science and AI, the team plays a critical role in driving business performance and bringing new customer experiences to life — from intelligent pricing and inventory optimization to recommendation engines, personalized experiences, and future AI-powered products.

About the Job:

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Scientist to independently own and deliver high-impact machine learning and optimization solutions that drive measurable business results.

While this role will initially focus heavily on pricing optimization, predictive modeling, and inventory-related decision systems, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to a broad range of Data Science initiatives, including personalization, recommendation systems, and AI-powered customer experiences as business priorities evolve.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Inventory, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable, production-ready machine learning solutions. You will take ownership of projects end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining the analytical approach to building, deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

This is a highly hands-on individual contributor role with significant ownership and visibility. You will work closely with the Senior Data Science Manager while independently driving technical decisions, challenging assumptions, and helping shape how Data Science creates value across Rent the Runway.

We're looking for someone with strong technical expertise, business intuition, analytical rigor, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do:

• Own end-to-end Data Science initiatives, from problem definition and exploratory analysis to model development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

• Design, build, and optimize machine learning and statistical models that improve pricing decisions, revenue performance, inventory efficiency, and customer outcomes.

• Partner closely with Finance, Inventory, and business stakeholders to develop and continuously improve pricing strategies and optimization models across our rental and resale businesses.

• Analyze customer, product, transaction, and inventory data to identify opportunities where machine learning, predictive modeling, and advanced analytics can drive measurable business impact.

• Develop forecasting, optimization, and predictive modeling solutions to support inventory planning, demand estimation, profitability, and other business-critical decisions.

• Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, and statistical evaluation frameworks to measure the incremental impact of Data Science initiatives.

• Build, maintain, and continuously improve production machine learning models, ensuring reliability, accuracy, scalability, and ongoing business relevance.

• Contribute to personalization, recommendation systems, customer segmentation, and AI-powered experiences as the team's roadmap evolves.

• Partner across Product, Engineering, Finance, Inventory, and the broader Data organization to translate complex analytical solutions into scalable, production-ready capabilities.

• Independently evaluate different modeling approaches, make thoughtful technical trade-offs, and communicate the reasoning behind methodological decisions.

• Establish and follow best practices around model validation, monitoring, experimentation, documentation, and reproducibility.

• Communicate insights, model performance, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Contribute to the technical development of the Data Science function by sharing knowledge, improving processes, and supporting a collaborative, high-performing team.

About You:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Physics, Operations Research), or equivalent practical experience; advanced degrees and/or specializations are a plus.

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working with large-scale datasets and developing production-ready machine learning models.

• Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and model evaluation.

• Proven experience independently designing, building, and deploying machine learning or optimization solutions that solve real-world business problems.

• Experience with pricing optimization, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or revenue management is a strong plus.

• Experience with cloud AI/ML platforms and services (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure).

• Experience with GCP (including BigQuery and Vertex AI) is a strong plus.

• Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery or Snowflake).

• Experience with dbt and modern analytics engineering practices is a strong plus.

• Strong business intuition and ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable analytical solutions with measurable outcomes.

• Ability to critically evaluate results, challenge assumptions, troubleshoot unexpected model behavior, and clearly explain technical decisions.

• Self-driven, curious, proactive, and comfortable operating with ownership and ambiguity.

Benefits:

At Rent the Runway, we’re committed to the wellbeing of our employees, and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Paid Time Off, including vacation, paid bereavement, and family sick leave - every employee needs time to take care of themselves and their family.

In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant or employee based on any legally-recognized basis, including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age (40 and over), national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT PLAYLAB

Playlab is a tech non-profit dedicated to helping educators and students become critical consumers and creators of AI.

We believe that an open-source, community-driven approach is key to harnessing the potential of AI in education. We equip educators & students to build custom AI apps for their unique context. Over 100,000 educators have published apps on Playlab.

At Playlab, we believe that AI is a new design material, one that should be shaped by many to bring their ideas about learning to life. If you're passionate about building creative, equitable futures for students and teachers, we hope you'll join us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Playlab is looking for a Staff Applied AI Engineer to construct systems that enable teachers and students to build agents as capable as the best AI products in the world, and to make them good for learning. Educators on Playlab build their own AI apps, and increasingly their own agents. What those agents can do to support a classroom depends on the capabilities they can draw on, and on how well those capabilities work together.

We're moving from chatbots to a wider range of experiences that educators build, share and improve. Other fields have already pushed agentic products much further than education has. We want someone who has been there (building AI-native products where agents do real work for real users) to bring that experience and take it further for schools. You don't need a background in education; we'll bring you into the classrooms.

This is a staff level individual contributor role reporting to engineering leadership. Here, Staff means raising what the whole team can build with AI, not only shipping your own agents. You'll work closely with product engineers, our learning engineers, trust and safety, machine learning and the platform team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Make educators' built agents more capable

 - Turn new AI capabilities into building blocks educators can use. When something like memory, code execution or deep research becomes possible, decide how agents should use it, then ship it so a teacher can give it to an agent with appropriate controls.

 - Find the combinations that work. Tune and test capabilities together (search with memory, documents with code execution) and set the defaults that make the agents teachers build noticeably more powerful without new ways to fail.

 - Bring the frontier in fast. When a new model or capability is released, work out within days what it makes possible for teachers and students, backed by evals rather than demos.

Build the agents that set the bar

 - Build our most demanding agents. Take agents that understand a teacher's context and build software with them from prototype to something teachers can rely on, and use them to prove out capabilities before educators get them.

 - Improve agents with evidence. Build evals grounded in what great teachers and our learning engineers actually do, and change course when they show something isn't working.

Keep agents safe and good for students

 - Remove whole categories of failure. When agents built by educators go wrong with students, trace why and ship the eval and guardrail that prevents the whole category, working with trust and safety on what agents should never do.

Raise how the team builds with AI

 - Lead what's next for our agentic systems. Find where they fall short and what new models and capabilities make possible, prove it with evals and prototypes, and bring the team along to build it.

 - Set the patterns others build on. Turn what you've learned building agentic products into the patterns, evals and reviews our engineers use whenever they ship AI features.

 - Help shape what we build. Work with product engineers as they define requirements, bringing a sharp sense of what new AI capabilities can and can't do yet.




HOW YOU'LL WORK

 - Start from the classroom. Spend time with teachers, students and our learning engineers to see where agents help and where they get in the way, before you decide what to build.

 - Prototype in days, harden with evals. Get a rough version into real hands quickly, measure it, and decide what earns a permanent place in the product.

 - Decide when priorities are unclear. There will always be more promising capabilities than time. Pick which ones to pursue and then ship to learn.

 - Make tradeoffs explicit. When capability, cost, latency and safety pull in different directions, write down the options and why you chose one, so others can push back early.

 - Make the team stronger. Sometimes you'll lead; often you'll make a teammate's project succeed through design and review.




WHAT THE JOB IS REALLY LIKE

 - You're the person who's been there. Much of what you've seen work elsewhere hasn't been tried in education yet. People will look to your judgment, and part of the job is figuring out what transfers and what doesn't.

 - The builders aren't engineers. The people setting up agents are teachers, coaches and administrators. A capability has to work well for someone who has never thought about a context window.

 - Students are on the other end. Agents may talk with or power experiences for young people during the school day, so the bar on what an agent must never do is higher than in most products. You'll partner with Trust, Safety, Security, and Privacy.

 - The ground moves. Models, our agent runtime and the capabilities underneath change month to month, and you'll build on all three while they shift. The team is small, so you'll build things a larger company would spread across several teams.




YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU...

You've built AI-native products where agents do real work for real users, and you want to push them further. You'd rather make every teacher's agents better than perfect one agent of your own, and building for education makes the problem more interesting to you, not less.

 - Have shipped agentic systems (multi-step, tool-using) that real users relied on in production.

 - Have built capabilities or tools that other people composed into their own agents or products, whether they were engineers or end users.

 - Have built evals for agent behavior, including combinations of tools or capabilities, and changed course because of what they showed.

 - Have driven a change in how a team built with AI, from spotting the problem or opportunity to the team adopting it, backed by evidence.

 - Have taken a new model or capability from release to production quickly, and can explain what you tested before you trusted it.

 - Have chosen not to use an agent, or to use a simpler one, because it served users better.

 - Are hands-on enough in TypeScript or Python to build what you design yourself.

 - Care about what this technology does to how young people learn and teachers experience their job.

If you meet most of these and the work excites you, we'd love to hear from you.




BONUS POINTS FOR...

 - Building products where people who don't write code create their own agents, apps or automations.

 - Working on coding agents, or agents that build software for their users.

 - Building memory or personalization for agents, especially memory that stays accurate about a person over time.

 - Building guardrails or safety evaluations for AI products used by young people or other vulnerable users.

 - Building MCP servers or tool integrations used by many agents.

 - Fine-tuning or post-training experience, enough to work closely with our machine learning engineers.

 - Working in education or with student data.




TECHNOLOGIES

TypeScript, Python, Node, React Router 8, PostgreSQL, AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore), LiteLLM




WHY JOIN US?

 - Real impact: Your work shapes how 100,000+ educators around the world use AI with their students, and much of what we build is headed toward the public domain.

 - Real ownership: You'll help decide which AI capabilities educators and students can build with, the controls that come with them, and how they're tested and combined.

 - Room to grow: As Playlab and our agents grow, so does this role, with significant opportunities for learning and growth.

 - Real closeness to users: We're in schools every week (deep-dive 1:1s, group experimentation sessions, strategic planning with entire districts). Decisions here are grounded in real classrooms, not abstract personas.

 - Mission-aligned team: Join a small, passionate group committed to equity, creativity and joyful learning, backed by the Gates Foundation, Google, CZI and the Schwab Foundation.

 - Flexible work: Remote-first, with autonomy and a strong culture of collaboration.

 - Competitive pay and benefits: Competitive salary, healthcare covered 100% for you and 80% for dependents, dental/vision covered 100% for you and dependents, retirement, Life/AD&D, monthly wellness stipend, home office budget, new laptop, generous time off and opportunities for professional growth.
