jobs.description:
ABOUT AIR APPS

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.




THE ROLE

You will collaborate closely with product managers, frontend developers, and other cross-functional teams to deliver robust and scalable backend services that power critical features and support rapid growth.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Testing and Quality Assurance: Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and participate in code reviews to uphold code quality standards.

REQUIREMENTS

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

APPLICATION DISCLAIMER

Air Apps does not partner with nor is represented by any recruiting agencies, staffing firms, or third-party recruiters in connection with our hiring efforts. All legitimate communication regarding Air Apps opportunities will come exclusively from an official @airapps.com http://airapps.com email address. Additionally, all open positions are published only through our official careers platform, Ashby.
If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent Air Apps from a different email domain, through a recruiting agency, or via a job posting source other than Ashby, please exercise caution. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies, and any such submissions will not be considered.

jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

• Over $300 million raised in funding

• 3,000 Tideans globally

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team

The Paid Plans Support Team at Tide provides top-tier phone support to paid members, fostering relationships and driving revenue. What we are looking for

• You are comfortable talking to customers on the phone and have experience liaising with and responding to member queries (however difficult). A customer-focused mindset is a must!

• You have a minimum of 1.5 years of relevant experience as a phone customer support associate

• You have a very good verbal and written German and English language skills

• You are comfortable using industry tools like Kustomer, GSuite, Microsoft Office and Jira

• You are upbeat and energetic, with solid problem-solving skills

• You have robust communication with the customer and back to the business

• You can demonstrate the ability to self-drive and multitask, your role may vary day to day, as well as strong team collaboration skills, high ethics and morale

It would be considered as an asset if you have:

• Experience working in subscription and/or app-based business models

• Experience with membership programmes

• Analytics knowledge to understand member plan usage and optimisation

What you’ll get in return:

• 25 days paid annual leave

• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities

• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company

• Personal L&D budget

• Additional health & dental insurance

• Mental wellbeing platform

• Fully covered Multisports card

• Food vouchers

• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office

• WFH equipment allowance

• Flexible working from home

• Sabbatical Leave

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

jobs.title: People Operations Launch Principal
jobs.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As a People Operations Launch Principal, you will manage the launch of new Via deployments and take ownership of the People Operations work required to ensure our teams are ready for successful service launches. You will work cross-functionally across the business to bring together the people, processes, and systems required to stand up new operations. This is a fast-paced, highly cross-functional role that combines project management, problem-solving, and operational execution.

This role requires a willingness to travel based on the needs of our launches.

What You'll Do:

• Lead high-complexity, flagship launches: own the end-to-end People Operations strategy and execution for Via’s largest, most complex, or first-of-their-kind service launches—ensuring new markets are staffed, compliant, and operationally ready on time and to the highest standard.

• Drive cross-functional launch governance: architect and oversee comprehensive People Operations launch plans across multiple concurrent, high-stakes deployments, proactively managing critical dependencies, executive-level risks, and aggressive timelines.

• Orchestrate end-to-end workforce readiness: direct complex workforce readiness workstreams—spanning hiring, onboarding, payroll, benefits, HR systems, policies, and regulatory compliance—by aligning senior stakeholders across Operations, Expansion, Talent, Payroll, Benefits, Legal, IT, and local market leadership.

• Serve as a senior advisor on complex people and labor matters: act as the primary People Operations escalation point for local operational leaders and executive stakeholders during launches, navigating high-stakes workforce transitions, sensitive employee relations issues, and union/labor relations in close partnership with our People and Legal teams.

• Guide post-launch stabilization and handoff: lead the transition from launch to steady-state operations, diagnosing systemic post-launch workforce challenges and establishing sustainable local People Operations practices before formal handoff.

• Build and scale the Launch playbook: define the standard for Via’s People Operations launch function—designing repeatable frameworks, scalable tools, and best practices that elevate execution across all future deployments, while mentoring more junior team members on the Launch team.

Who You Are:

• A proven program leader with experience owning and delivering multiple complex, high-stakes, time-sensitive initiatives simultaneously while driving accountability across cross-functional teams without direct authority

• Highly organized and meticulous, with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through, and an eye for risks and dependencies before they become problems

• A strong problem solver who is comfortable in ambiguity and who can turn one-off launch solutions into scalable, repeatable frameworks that raise the bar for an entire organization

• An excellent communicator who is skilled at tailoring messaging for diverse audiences—from frontline employees and union representatives to local GM/operational leaders and senior executives—building trust and alignment quickly

• Adaptable, entrepreneurial, and equally comfortable shaping launch strategy with senior leadership and diving into the operational details required to unblock a critical dependency or keep a launch on track

• 5+ years of relevant experience in People Operations, HR, operations, project/program management, consulting, or another highly cross-functional environment, plus a Bachelor's degree and a record of strong academic and professional achievement

• Demonstrated experience leading operational launches, supporting frontline workforces, or navigating complex workforce transitions, employee relations, or labor/union environments is strongly preferred

Compensation and Benefits:

• Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

• Salary Range: $125,000-$150,000 per year

• Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans

• A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting

• Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options

• Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)

• 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacist - Ambulatory Care
jobs.description:
Akido builds AI-powered doctors. Akido is the first AI-native care provider, combining cutting-edge technology with a nationwide medical network to address America’s physician shortage and make exceptional healthcare universal. Its AI empowers doctors to deliver faster, more accurate, and more compassionate care.

Serving 500K+ patients across California, Rhode Island, and New York, Akido offers primary and specialty care in 26 specialties—from serving unhoused communities in Los Angeles to ride-share drivers in New York.

Founded in 2015 (YC W15), Akido is expanding its risk-bearing care models and scaling ScopeAI, its breakthrough clinical AI platform. Read more about Akido’s $60M Series B. More info at Akidolabs.com.

The Opportunity

The Clinical Pharmacist delivers ambulatory care pharmacy services within the RIPCPC Accountable Care Organization (ACO). Embedded in primary care practices, the pharmacist works as part of the interdisciplinary care team to provide evidence-based, patient-centered medication management, delivered through both in-person visits and telephonic outreach. The role focuses on optimizing medication regimens, improving chronic disease outcomes, and reducing avoidable emergency department visits, hospitalizations, and readmissions.

The pharmacist promotes the safe, effective, and cost-conscious use of medications and serves as a medication and drug information resource for patients, providers, and care team members.

What you’ll do

Direct patient care

• Deliver patient care services by telephone and in person, including medication education, adherence support, and outreach to close gaps in care

• Co-manage patients with primary care providers under collaborative practice agreements, initiating, modifying, or monitoring therapy through in-person visits or telephonic follow-up

• Manage chronic conditions including diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, heart failure, COPD, and asthma

• Order and interpret laboratory tests and monitoring parameters, as authorized under collaborative practice agreements, to assess the safety and effectiveness of therapy

• Perform medication reconciliation, particularly at transitions of care

• Identify and address barriers to medication access and affordability, including prior authorizations, formulary alternatives, and patient assistance programs

• Provide evidence-based, patient-centered medication therapy recommendations to patients and providers

• Educate patients and caregivers on medication use and disease state management

• Conduct Comprehensive Medication Reviews (CMRs) and Targeted Medication Reviews (TMRs) for identified patients

Population health and quality

• Use reports, risk stratification, and claims or EHR data to identify patients who would benefit from pharmacist intervention, and track the outcomes of that work

• Partner with the care team to reduce avoidable ED visits, hospitalizations, and readmissions by resolving medication-related problems, improving adherence, and strengthening chronic disease management

• Drive quality improvement initiatives to meet the organization's contractual obligations for Medicare Part C and Part D performance measures (e.g., Star Ratings medication adherence and statin use measures)

Collaboration and education

• Participate in care team huddles and care management meetings

• Provide drug information and education to providers and practice staff, including presentations at practice meetings and updates on clinical guidelines and formulary changes

• Collaborate and communicate effectively with interdisciplinary care team members

• Precept pharmacy students and contribute to the training of future pharmacists

General

• Document all patient encounters in the electronic health record and other required platforms

• Protect patient privacy in accordance with corporate privacy policies and procedures

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance

• Perform other duties as assigned by management

Who you are

Minimum Qualifications

Licensure and education

• Current, unrestricted pharmacist license in good standing with the Rhode Island Board of Pharmacy

• PharmD with at least 2 years of professional experience, or BS Pharmacy with at least 3 years of professional experience

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

• Practices in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Rhode Island Board of Pharmacy, Rhode Island Department of Health, U.S. Food and Drug Administration, and Drug Enforcement Administration, as well as departmental policies and procedures

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience communicating with patients and health care professionals by phone and in person

• Strong clinical knowledge and the skill to conduct thorough drug regimen reviews, kept current through continuing education and professional affiliations

• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage a patient panel across multiple practices

• Commitment to confidentiality, using only the minimum necessary protected health information (PHI) to perform job responsibilities

• Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel, and the ability to learn new systems

Preferred Education, Additional Qualifications, and Experience:

Licensure and education

• Current, unrestricted pharmacist license in good standing with the Rhode Island Board of Pharmacy

• PharmD with at least 2 years of professional experience, or BS Pharmacy with at least 3 years of professional experience

Knowledge, skills, and abilities

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience communicating with patients and health care professionals by phone and in person

• Strong clinical knowledge and the skill to conduct thorough drug regimen reviews, kept current through continuing education and professional affiliations

• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage a patient panel across multiple practices

• Commitment to confidentiality, using only the minimum necessary protected health information (PHI) to perform job responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience practicing under a collaborative practice agreement

• Board certification (e.g., BCACP, BCPS) or completion of an ASHP-accredited residency (PGY1 or PGY2) in an area relevant to the role

• Experience working as part of an interdisciplinary care team

Benefits

jobs.title: IT Systems Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com.

As our first dedicated internal IT hire, you'll take ownership of the systems, devices, and processes that keep our growing team productive and secure. You'll lead the implementation of company-wide device management, endpoint security, identity and access controls, and IT support processes across a distributed workforce.

With a significant engineering population running Ubuntu Linux, we're looking for someone who brings strong technical depth, practical security experience, and the ability to build reliable IT systems from the ground up.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership. You'll work closely with Engineering, Operations, and People teams, as well as external IT and security providers, to establish scalable processes without adding unnecessary complexity.




YOU WILL 

 - Own AeroVect's corporate IT infrastructure, including employee laptops, workstations, shared devices, and associated IT systems.

 - Lead the implementation and ongoing management of a company-wide device management platform across Ubuntu Linux, macOS, IpadOS and Windows.

 - Establish and maintain endpoint security standards, including disk encryption, patch management, endpoint protection, device monitoring, and recovery procedures.

 - Manage identity and access controls across Google Workspace and other business-critical applications, including MFA, permissions, and secure onboarding/offboarding.

 - Build and maintain automated workflows for device provisioning, software deployment, configuration management, and employee lifecycle management.

 - Own IT onboarding and offboarding, ensuring employees receive properly configured equipment and appropriate access from day one.

 - Provide hands-on technical support and troubleshooting for employees

 - Manage hardware procurement, inventory, equipment lifecycle, repairs, replacements, and device recovery.

 - Develop and maintain practical IT security policies, documentation, incident response procedures, and operational standards.

 - Partner with Engineering to ensure security controls are compatible with development tools, containers, drivers, and specialized engineering workflows.

 - Coordinate with external IT and security providers on implementation, escalations, monitoring, and incident response.

 - Support employees across multiple countries through remote administration, equipment logistics, and coordination with local service providers.

 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve security, automate repetitive tasks, and scale IT operations as AeroVect grows.


YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, systems administration, corporate IT, or a related technical role.

 - Strong hands-on experience administering Ubuntu Linux endpoints, including system configuration, troubleshooting, software management, and security.

 - Experience managing mixed operating system environments, including Linux, macOS, and Windows.

 - Experience implementing and administering endpoint or mobile device management (MDM) solutions.

 - Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace administration, identity and access management, MFA, and employee onboarding/offboarding.

 - Experience implementing endpoint security controls, including disk encryption, patch management, endpoint protection, and recovery processes.

 - Proficiency with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or similar tools.

 - Experience independently leading IT infrastructure projects, from initial assessment and tool selection through deployment and ongoing operations.

 - Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, endpoint hardware, networking, and business applications.

 - Ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and take ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Excellent communication skills and a service-oriented approach to supporting employees across technical and nontechnical teams.

 - Ability to work onsite in Atlanta and provide hands-on support for local equipment and employees.


WE PREFER

 - Experience as an early IT hire or IT systems owner at a rapidly growing technology or engineering company.

 - Experience supporting organizations with 100–500 employees and distributed international teams.

 - Familiarity with Fleet, JumpCloud, or similar cross-platform device management solutions.

 - Experience deploying and managing Linux disk encryption, including LUKS and recovery-key management.

 - Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR), security monitoring, and incident response coordination.

 - Familiarity with CIS Controls, NIST cybersecurity guidance, or similar security frameworks.

 - Experience working with managed service providers (MSPs) or external security vendors.

 - Familiarity with GitOps, infrastructure automation, or configuration management tools such as Ansible.

 - Experience supporting engineering environments involving Docker, Kubernetes, SSH, and specialized Linux development tools.

 - Experience establishing IT processes, documentation, and security standards from scratch.

jobs.title: Consultant I, Evidence & Strategy
jobs.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.


About the role 
Avalere Health is seeking a Consultant with experience in health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), real world evidence (RWE) generation, and/or real-world data analytics to join our Evidence & Strategy practice. 
You will manage and conduct RWE and HEOR studies, provide research support (including development of study protocol, technical reports, statistical analysis plans, manuscripts, abstracts, etc.), interpret quantitative and qualitative study results and convey the results in lay English to a variety of audiences. A background in healthcare research consulting is preferred. 
About the Evidence & Strategy Practice 
Avalere Health is a vibrant community of innovative thinkers dedicated to solving the challenges of the healthcare industry. We dig deep into the healthcare system and work closely with clients to develop practical solutions. At Avalere Health, we prize curiosity, resilience, a positive attitude, and an enthusiasm to embrace new challenges. Join us and get ready to make your mark on healthcare! 
Avalere’s Evidence & Strategy practice provides exceptional consultation, evidence, and insights on key aspects of healthcare – including patient-centric HEOR, US real world evidence (RWE) studies leveraging claims, EHR, and other data sources, data optimization, quality, shared decision-making, value-based care, and health equity – and to shape strategy for our clients.   
Our mission is to improve quality of care, craft data-driven strategies, drive patient-centric outcomes, and ultimately provide the highest value to all our partners, including life sciences companies, payers, providers, and patient advocates. Our work is focused in 3 intersecting strategic pillars: Patient-Centric Value, Evidence & Analytics, and Healthcare Strategy.

jobs.title: Global Transformation Leader (gn) – Finance & Process Excellence

The Quality Group (TQG) is a fast-growing multi-brand group in nutrition, performance and wellbeing, home to ESN, More Nutrition, RAW Nutrition and BUM Energy. To keep scaling as one group, we are building connected, end-to-end processes, data and systems.
As Finance Transformation Lead (gn), you will own our end-to-end Finance & Controlling processes. Together with the CFO, you will shape the roadmap towards a scalable, automated and data-driven finance organisation for ESN, More Nutrition, RAW Nutrition and BUM Energy.

If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place.

OUR MISSION 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

🙌 … and so much more



ABOUT US

Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. In this future, the depth and breadth of impact we can make through everyday actions will expand dramatically – benefiting both businesses and the world.

Businesses are expected to deliver on both profit and purpose and those that don’t are falling behind. We’re here to make it easy for any company, anywhere in the world, to integrate good into what they do. Doing this empowers everyone – companies, employees, consumers, and communities – to contribute to positive change and take meaningful action.

Let's do this! 💜

jobs.title: Manufacturing Analyst
jobs.description:
Manufacturing Analysts play a crucial role in Multidose compounding and aseptic filling operations at AbbVie Westport by acting as the subject matter expert (SME) for manufacturing in their area and as the key point of contact for regulatory queries and projects.

Their primary responsibilities include but are not limited to planning of daily work for Manufacturing Technicians while working closely with the shift manager in order to maintain production schedule and Eyecare projects. Additionally they will work closely to Quality, Engineering, Validations, Microbiology and Supply Chain.

The Senior Manufacturing Technician is a very demanding development role that will be key to ongoing development of talent in Multidose  and Abbvie Westport.

• Schedule daily tasks for the Manufacturing Technicians to ensure production schedule is achieved while working closely with Shift manager

• Assure compliance with applicable Plant, Division, Corporate and Government and Regulatory Agencies and cGMP practices.

• Active involvement and management of batch related CAPA’s as they arise in the business unit taking them from the initial review state through RCA, approval, batch disposition and delivery of corrective and preventive actions, liaising closely with the relevant Departments and QA Lead to ensure thorough investigation is completed and timely resolution and closure is met.

• Complete LIR investigations and actively track and review EM and aseptic alerts and excursions, using trend data to act before limits are breached and liaising with QC, Micro, ATL and central services.

• Lead and own change records for operations, including actions, approvals and effectiveness checks.

• Create, update and improve SOPs, SWIs, POMS recipes and manufacturing logs, and support risk assessments, ensuring compliance with cGMP and Plant, Division, Corporate and regulatory requirements as SME for compounding.

• Plan and monitor APS, revalidations and cleaning validation qualifications

• Act as an SME for ongoing projects within multidose, from URS generation through SOP creation and training delivery, and drive 1% continuous improvement projects for the business unit.

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for manufacturing equipment and process events, working with Engineering, Validations, Maintenance and Supply Chain to plan equipment availability and schedule changes.

• Support training effectiveness, including eLMS curricula assignment and delivery of classroom training on changes to Manufacturing Technicians.

• Support audit trail, system user access and FMS reviews, and promote EHS compliance and continuous improvement, including incident reporting, PPE and waste management.

• Understanding of the requirements of working in a regulated GMP industry (FDA/HPRA).

• 5+ years working in a manufacturing environment, preferably aseptic/sterile manufacturing, including experience in a Grade C or higher cleanroom.

• Excellent technical writing skills, with experience writing and updating SOPs and Standard Work Instructions.

• Experience in supporting investigations and RCA, and raising NCRs, LIRs, change controls and CAPAs in GTW or a similar quality system.

• Knowledge of contamination control and aseptic processing principles, including APS and environmental monitoring.

• Ability to build strong relationships and work within cross-functional teams.

• Excellent communication skills, including influencing and delivering training.

• Self-directed and self-motivated, able to prioritise competing demands and work under pressure in a fast, dynamic environment.

• Experience with data and process improvement, and with SAP and POMS (preferred).

• Third level degree preferable.

jobs.title: Técnico de Suporte a Aplicações
jobs.description:
Prestar suporte às aplicações de software da organização, assegurando a resolução de incidentes técnicos e a identificação de soluções para problemas aplicacionais. Contribuir para a manutenção do desempenho, segurança e estabilidade dos sistemas, apoiando atualizações, monitorizando a saúde das aplicações e garantindo o seu funcionamento eficiente e contínuo.

Funções Essenciais

Rever as especificações técnicas relativas a alterações das Plataformas do banco, assegurando que os requisitos estão claramente definidos e devidamente documentados.

Colaborar com analistas de negócio e analistas de sistemas na elaboração de especificações funcionais para novos sistemas e atualizações, garantindo o alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio.

Apoiar os requisitos de localização, incluindo moeda, transferência de dados e requisitos regulamentares, assegurando a conformidade com os padrões do Grupo.

Interagir com os utilizadores para compreender a sua experiência na utilização dos sistemas bancários e identificar oportunidades de melhoria através da automatização.

Avaliar o impacto de alterações propostas sobre os sistemas existentes e apoiar o planeamento da implementação para minimizar interrupções.

Apoiar a instalação de patches, atualizações e novas versões disponibilizadas pelos fornecedores, verificando a compatibilidade e estabilidade das aplicações.

Contribuir com conhecimento local durante sessões de desenho de soluções, propondo melhorias aos responsáveis globais pelos sistemas.

Apoiar a documentação e o acompanhamento de pedidos de alteração, assegurando a implementação atempada das mudanças.

Colaborar no desenvolvimento de aplicações locais, fornecendo requisitos técnicos e participando nas atividades de implementação dos projetos.

Participar em testes de segurança, incluindo testes de intrusão (Penetration Testing), colaborando com as equipas de segurança na mitigação de vulnerabilidades.

Monitorizar o desempenho das aplicações e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho, como disponibilidade (uptime), tempos de resposta e resolução de incidentes, garantindo elevados níveis de serviço.

Acompanhar pedidos de suporte, incidentes e problemas reportados pela equipa de suporte, assegurando a sua resolução dentro dos níveis de serviço estabelecidos (SLA).

Apoiar o carregamento de dados para os sistemas e para o centro de dados principal, analisando logs de erro e corrigindo falhas de transferência de dados para evitar indisponibilidades.

Apoiar a gestão das alterações aos sistemas e das atividades de manutenção, garantindo o cumprimento das políticas e normas internas.

Colaborar na atualização dos planos de continuidade do negócio e participar regularmente em testes de recuperação de desastre (Disaster Recovery), identificando oportunidades de melhoria.

Prestar suporte durante atividades de manutenção, atualizações e situações de emergência, assegurando a estabilidade dos sistemas e a rápida resolução de problemas.

Participar nos testes de novas funcionalidades, preparando ambientes de teste semelhantes ao ambiente de produção e identificando problemas antes da implementação.

Elaborar planos de reversão (Rollback Plans) para implementações de sistemas, minimizando impactos operacionais e apoiando a preparação de comunicações e materiais de formação.

Apoiar as decisões de implementação ("Go/No-Go"), avaliando a prontidão dos sistemas e os potenciais impactos das alterações.

Executar atividades diárias de manutenção das aplicações, assegurando a sua disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho.

Habilitações Literárias: Licenciatura

Área de Formação: Tecnologias de Informação

Experiência Requerida

Engenharia de Software | Tecnologia

3 a 4 anos de experiência

Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência prática no suporte a aplicações empresariais de grande dimensão, preferencialmente no setor bancário, financeiro ou áreas similares.

Experiência comprovada em sistemas core bancários, aplicações satélite (periféricas) e plataformas de integração, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus) ou middleware.

Capacidade demonstrada para diagnosticar e resolver incidentes técnicos dentro dos níveis de serviço (SLA) estabelecidos. Experiência na implementação e suporte de atualizações, patches e novas versões de aplicações.

Competências Comportamentais

• Adotar Abordagens Práticas
• Comunicação Clara e Eficaz
• Atenção ao Detalhe
• Documentação de Informação
• Adaptação à Mudança
• Cumprimento de Procedimentos
• Interpretação de Dados
• Orientação para Resultados
• Proatividade
• Trabalho em Equipa
• Pensamento Positivo
• Compromisso com os Padrões de Qualidade

Competências Técnicas

• Suporte a Aplicações
• Análise de Negócio (Ambientes e Perspetivas)
• Continuidade do Negócio e Recuperação de Desastre (Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery)
• Implementação Contínua (Continuous Deployment)
• Administração de Bases de Dados
• Gestão de Projetos
• Gestão de Stakeholders
• Testes de Software (Unitários, Regressão e Integração)

• Forte capacidade de comunicação e influência.
• Orientação para resultados e cumprimento de objetivos.

• Espírito de equipa e colaboração.
• Elevado sentido de responsabilidade e atenção à qualidade.

Competências Técnicas

• Conhecimento dos processos e procedimentos bancários.

jobs.title: Técnico de Atendimento ao Cliente
jobs.description:
Tratar de qualquer assunto relacionado com dinheiro (e/ou câmbios) (por exemplo, clientes sem marcação, caixas automáticos), ao mesmo tempo que se faz uma avaliação precisa e se compreende essa procura, de modo a agir de forma a garantir consistentemente uma experiência do cliente e o cumprimento dos requisitos estabelecidos.

Assegurar a execução eficiente, segura e rigorosa das operações de caixa, através da recepção, conferência, guarda e movimentação de numerário e outros valores, garantindo a qualidade do serviço ao cliente, a integridade dos activos do Banco e o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos internos.

Funções Essenciais

Interagir ativamente com os clientes que se apresentam pessoalmente para identificar oportunidades de geração de procura e promover a utilização de múltiplos canais, tanto nas agências como fora delas, para aumentar as oportunidades de vendas adicionais; recolher e registar a documentação correspondente e as informações dos clientes.

Cumprir todos os requisitos de dever de diligência, de acordo com os procedimentos operacionais da agência, para garantir que as taxas de erro e as perdas operacionais sejam minimizadas.

Analisar dados e informações para desenvolver e aplicar medidas de autocorreção, quando aplicável, de modo a permitir o cumprimento constante da procura dos clientes.

Avaliar o que é importante para o cliente em relação à capacidade dos processos e sistemas para satisfazer a procura dos clientes, a fim de fazer recomendações ao Responsável de Operações para que este tome medidas no sistema.

Recolher informações sobre valor, variação e falhas no sistema durante a execução dos processos de trabalho, de modo a contribuir para o desenvolvimento de informações de gestão para o departamento.

Elaborar relatórios e desempenhar tarefas administrativas pontuais, conforme necessário ou estipulado pelos procedimentos estabelecidos.

Realizar verificações eletrónicas de antecedentes criminais na base de dados do Serviço de Polícia de Angola, principalmente para fins de pré-contratação para várias empresas. O serviço é prestado mediante marcação e facilitado pela MIE através do seu sistema de marcação online. (MIE - Managed Integrity Evaluation (Pty) Ltd).

Realizar a manutenção necessária e a resolução de avarias em máquinas ATM/ANA, de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos, e comunicar imediatamente quaisquer problemas técnicos ou de sistema ao centro de controlo de ATM, para garantir que sejam tomadas medidas corretivas, que o tempo de funcionamento e o desempenho eficaz das máquinas sejam maximizados e que as máquinas se mantenham limpas, tanto interna como externamente.

Interagir com os clientes que se apresentam no balcão para compreender plenamente as suas necessidades e seguir os procedimentos exigidos, de modo a garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam satisfeitas de forma completa e consistente, mitigando simultaneamente quaisquer riscos potenciais ou incumprimentos.

Encaminhar quaisquer transações em dinheiro que excedam os limites prescritos para o chefe de equipa, de acordo com os procedimentos exigidos, para garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam satisfeitas com precisão, atempadamente e em conformidade com as normas e políticas internas.

Clientes atendidos

jobs.title: Product Design Engineer (Early Career)
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the role:

Skydio’s mechanical systems are the backbone of reliable autonomous flight. An intelligent flying machine depends on world-class engineering and an eye for detail while optimizing for simplicity; you will help architect, develop, and refine the structures, mechanisms and solutions that bring autonomous flight to a broad audience in a highly collaborative environment.



How you’ll make an impact:

 - Design mechanical parts and assemblies for our aircraft, ground stations, and accessories, working alongside senior engineers on new architectures and taking ownership of components as you grow.

 - Partner with electrical engineers to integrate custom PCBAs, flex circuits, antennas, and cable harnesses into mechanical designs.

 - Work with vendors on technical questions and part reviews, in collaboration with our operations and supply chain teams.

 - Plan and run engineering tests, and use analysis to evaluate design trade-offs and verify that your parts perform as intended.

 - Follow your designs through the full development cycle, from early prototypes to pre-production and mass production, and help our manufacturing teams with assembly processes and quality and inspection criteria.

 - Investigate and debug failures, digging into the details to find root causes.
   
   

What you’ll get:

 - Mentorship from experienced mechanical engineers and regular design reviews that help you build judgment quickly.

 - Hands-on exposure to the whole hardware lifecycle on products that ship at scale.

 - A growing scope of ownership as you show what you can do.
   
   

What makes you a good fit:

 - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field. 

 - 0-3 years of hands-on product or hardware experience through internships, co-ops, student design teams (e.g., Formula SAE, robotics, rocketry), research, or personal projects.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to use them to solve open-ended design problems.

 - Proficiency in 3D CAD (CATIA, SolidWorks, NX, Creo, or similar), including building multi-part assemblies.

 - Familiarity with common manufacturing processes such as injection molding, CNC machining, casting, or sheet metal, and how they affect design decisions.

 - Ability to create clear mechanical drawings, or eagerness to build this skill with mentorship.

 - Curiosity, attention to detail, and a love of well-designed hardware.

 - A collaborative mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift.
   
   

Nice to have:

 - Experience with CATIA specifically.

 - Exposure to GD&T, tolerance analysis, or FEA.

 - Experience with composites or electromechanical systems (drones, consumer electronics, robotics, etc.).

 - Experience rapidly prototyping with 3D printing, machine shop tools, or similar.

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.



Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $132,000 - $175,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

 

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

jobs.title: Content Strategy Manager, B2B Marketing (Bangkok Based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more.

Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our diverse global team fosters a work environment rich in creativity, collaboration, and innovation. Through technology, experimentation, and ownership, we strive to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Content Marketing Manager to help shape and scale our B2B content marketing efforts.

In this role, you will own the development and execution of a content strategy that strengthens brand awareness, establishes thought leadership, communicates our technology and solutions, and supports business growth across the marketing funnel.

You will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Strategy to uncover compelling stories, translate complex business insights into clear narratives, and develop high-impact content for B2B decision-makers.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines strong business acumen, exceptional storytelling, and sharp editorial judgment with the ability to turn strategy into execution. You will play a key role in building a scalable B2B content marketing engine.

Key Responsibilities

1. Content Strategy & Planning

• Own and execute a comprehensive B2B content strategy aligned with brand positioning, business priorities, go-to-market plans, and the customer journey.

• Define key content pillars, editorial priorities, and annual content roadmaps across awareness, consideration, conversion, and customer engagement.

• Identify content opportunities through industry trends, competitive intelligence, customer insights, and business performance data and insights

• Establish content performance metrics and continuously optimize the strategy based on audience engagement, lead generation, lead generation and pipeline contribution.

2. Thought Leadership, Research & Content Development

• Develop compelling, insight-led content that establishes our brand and executives as trusted voices in the B2B travel and technology industry.

• Lead the research, development, and writing of industry trends reports, market insights, original research publications, whitepapers, thought leadership articles, and executive perspectives, translating industry developments, proprietary data, and expert insights into differentiated narratives.

• Proactively identify and develop compelling stories by working with internal experts, commercial teams, and external partners.

• Translate complex technology, product capabilities, data, and business insights into clear, differentiated narratives tailored to senior B2B audiences.

• Repurpose research and thought leadership into engaging formats, including blog posts, executive LinkedIn content, infographics, and other digital content.

3. Customer Proof & Commercial Content

• Lead the development of partner case studies, customer success stories, testimonials, and use cases that demonstrate tangible business outcomes, product value, and partnership success.

• Collaborate with commercial teams and partners to identify compelling success stories, conduct interviews, validate results, and translate customer experiences into credible, persuasive narratives.

• Develop and adapt customer proof into partner-facing marketing and sales enablement assets, including presentations, website content, and other commercial materials.

• Support priority go-to-market initiatives with clear value propositions, solution narratives, and relevant product and business content.

4. Executive Communications, Presentations & Event Content Enablement

• Lead the end-to-end content development of executive keynotes, conference presentations, speaker talking points, panel discussion narratives, and strategic presentations for industry conferences, flagship events, partner summits, and executive engagements.

• Partner directly with senior executives and subject matter experts to shape compelling storylines, synthesize complex information, and translate strategic priorities, industry insights, and business data into persuasive narratives.

• Collaborate with Event Marketing and cross-functional teams to develop event content themes, session narratives, speaker briefs, and partner-facing content aligned with business priorities and audience interests.

• Synthesize key insights, discussions, and takeaways from events into valuable post-event content, including executive summaries, thought leadership articles, partner-facing recaps, and derivative content for digital channels and sales enablement.

• Coordinate cross-functional inputs, reconcile stakeholder feedback, and deliver executive-ready content under tight timelines, in collaboration with creative and design teams.

5. Content Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Manage end-to-end content production, from ideation, research, and briefing to development, stakeholder approvals, and publication.

• Work collaboratively across Product, Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and other teams to align content with business priorities and audience needs.

• Manage external agencies, freelancers, and creative partners, providing clear briefs and actionable editorial feedback.

• Leverage AI tools and scalable content workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and speed of execution while maintaining strong editorial standards.

• Ensure consistency of messaging, tone of voice, and content quality across channels and formats.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 5+ years of experience in B2B content marketing, corporate communications, business journalism, thought leadership, or related roles, preferably within technology, travel, e-commerce, or B2B services.

• Exceptional research, writing, and editorial skills, with demonstrated experience independently developing long-form, insight-led B2B content such as industry reports, whitepapers, executive thought leadership, and customer case studies.

• Proven ability to develop compelling customer success stories and testimonials by interviewing stakeholders, extracting business insights, and translating results into persuasive narratives.

• Strong ability to synthesize complex business, technology, and market information into clear, engaging content for senior business audiences.

• Experience developing executive presentations, conference keynotes, speaker narratives, and event-derived content is highly desirable.

• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work directly with senior executives and coordinate cross-functional inputs under tight deadlines.

• Experience managing external agencies, research partners, freelancers, and creative teams while maintaining high editorial standards.

• Familiarity with content performance measurement, digital distribution channels, and AI-assisted content development workflows.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with strong attention to detail, editorial judgment, and the ability to adapt tone and messaging across audiences and formats.

• Data-driven mindset: Ability to use research, customer insights, and performance data to inform content decisions and measure effectiveness.

• AI fluency: Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate research, content development, editing, and workflow efficiency while maintaining accuracy and originality.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with SEO, content distribution, CRM, marketing automation, and content performance analytics.

• Experience building content processes and scalable editorial workflows in a growing organization.

Why Join Us?

You will have the opportunity to shape the B2B content strategy, work directly with senior business leaders, and create compelling narratives that bring our technology, solutions, and partnerships to life.

This role offers a unique combination of strategic ownership, creative storytelling, and hands-on execution, with the opportunity to build meaningful content programs that influence brand perception and business growth.

Join us in shaping the future of B2B travel technology.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Discover more about working at Agoda

• Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com

• Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/

• LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda

• YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

Disclaimer

We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency’s representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Agoda

Agoda helps people explore the world through accommodation, flight and travel bookings. Founded in 2005 and now a Booking Holdings company, we bring together more than 7,000 colleagues from 90 countries. Our culture combines technology, experimentation and creativity to make travel more accessible and rewarding.

A bit about the Brand team

Agoda’s Brand team brings together brand managers, media planners, project managers, designers and creatives. We shape how consumers, business partners and employees experience Agoda, building recognition and confidence in our brand.

Working as an internal agency, we develop brand campaigns and marketing communications across digital channels and other brand touchpoints. This role connects our creative work with the everyday content customers discover, watch and engage with online.

About the role

We’re looking for a Japanese-speaking Social Media & Content Manager who combines strong agency management with hands-on social media expertise.

Reporting to the Creative Manager, you will manage agency partners and execute a content programme that helps customers feel confident booking with Agoda.

The programme spans creator content, product reviews, customer and partner testimonials, and practical product education videos. You’ll manage delivery from brief to publication, while personally executing the social calendar, writing captions and adapting content for Japanese audiences and different platforms.

The ideal candidate

You’re an experienced social media and content professional who combines creative judgement with strong organisation. You enjoy shaping content, giving agencies clear direction and seeing work through from the first brief to the published post.

You might currently be a Social Media Manager or Senior Social Account Manager at an agency, managing consumer brands in Japan across several platforms. Alternatively, you could come from an in-house team where you manage external production partners and personally execute the social calendar.

You bring around 3 – 5 years of relevant experience, supported by work examples that demonstrate your contribution and results. You speak and write Japanese fluently and understand the local social media landscape, cultural context and consumer expectations.

You understand both what makes people watch and what makes content useful. You can turn a customer question into a clear video, adapt a message so it feels natural to a Japanese audience, and use platform knowledge and performance insights to improve the work.

You’re proactive, comfortable expressing a creative opinion and dependable when managing deadlines and competing priorities.

In this role you will get to

• Give agencies clear briefs. Turn business objectives into clear briefs, challenge ideas constructively and give specific feedback on scripts, edits and copy. Manage agency scopes of work, deliverables, timelines and budgets, ensuring work meets the brief and provides value for money.

• Know what makes social content work. Shape creator videos, product reviews and testimonials around Japanese audiences and the platforms they use. Consider the opening hook, length, subtitles, format and what will make someone keep watching or share it. Apply relevant cultural trends and platform developments to improve the work.

• Handle everyday execution confidently. Write and edit Japanese captions and calls to action, select relevant hashtags, coordinate content adaptations, manage approvals and execute the publishing calendar accurately and on time.

• Make product information interesting and useful. Understand customers’ needs, questions and concerns, and turn them into relevant content. Work with Product and customer service teams to create simple how-to videos covering important product features that are key in customer journeys.

• Learn from results. Use platform analytics to understand what holds attention, generates engagement and helps customers. Test different approaches and turn the findings into better briefs, content and publishing decisions.

• Keep people and projects aligned. Coordinate agencies, local market teams, Product, CEG, PR and Legal. Resolve conflicting feedback, secure approvals and flag delays early, ensuring content is accurate, locally relevant and delivered on schedule.

What you will need to succeed

• Fluency in spoken and written Japanese, with the ability to write and review natural, engaging consumer-facing content.

• Previous professional experience delivering social media or content programmes for the Japanese market, with a strong understanding of local audiences, platforms and cultural nuances.

• Proven experience managing social channels and personally executing content calendars.

• Experience managing agencies or production partners, including scopes of work, briefs, feedback, budgets and deadlines.

• Strong copywriting and editing skills, with examples of Japanese captions, scripts or social content you have developed.

• A practical understanding of social platforms, their content formats, publishing tools and recommendation algorithms.

• Experience overseeing video production, from concept and scripting through editing, approvals and publication.

• The ability to translate customer needs and product information into clear, useful content.

• Familiarity with social analytics and the ability to use metrics such as reach, watch time, completion rates and engagement to improve content.

• Strong project management skills, attention to detail and confidence coordinating multiple stakeholders.

It is great if you have

• Experience in travel, technology, e-commerce or another consumer-facing business.

• Experience with creator programmes, testimonials or product education content.

• Experience using tools such as CapCut or Canva to make simple video edits, add subtitles and adapt assets for different social formats.

• Familiarity with social listening and community management in Japan.

• Experience using AI tools to support content ideation, adaptation and production, with careful editorial review.

jobs.title: Insurance Verification & Authorization Specialist
jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

ABOUT THIS ROLE

As an Insurance Verification & Authorization Specialist, you'll help children and families access care by verifying insurance benefits, coordinating prior authorizations and referrals, and identifying potential coverage barriers.

You'll review incoming patient requests, navigate complex behavioral health insurance requirements, and collaborate with internal teams and insurance carriers to ensure a smooth patient experience. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage a high-volume workflow.

Internally, this position is referred to as an Insurance Operations Specialist.

POSITION DETAILS

• Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly (Non-Exempt), Benefits Eligible

• Location: Fully Remote, Eastern Time Zone preferred

• Schedule: Monday-Friday, Eastern Time business hours

• Compensation: $23-$28/hour

HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

• Verify insurance eligibility, coverage, and behavioral health benefits for new and existing patients.

• Review incoming patient inquiries to confirm age, location, insurance participation, and service eligibility.

• Identify complexities within insurance plans, including third-party behavioral health administrators and payer-specific coverage requirements.

• Obtain, submit, and track prior authorizations and referrals to ensure timely access to care.

• Communicate with insurance carriers to resolve coverage discrepancies and explain patient financial responsibilities, including copays, coinsurance, and deductibles.

• Manage high-volume requests through internal ticketing and EHR systems, maintaining accurate documentation and collaborating with internal teams to resolve barriers to care.

WHO YOU ARE

• Experience in healthcare insurance verification, eligibility, benefits determination, prior authorizations, or referrals.

• Strong understanding of insurance terminology, including copays, coinsurance, deductibles, and out-of-pocket costs.

• Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to manage high-volume workflows, investigate coverage discrepancies, and maintain accuracy.

• Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills when working with patients, insurance carriers, and internal teams.

• Experience with behavioral health insurance benefits, prior authorizations, or specialty healthcare is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with EHR systems such as Athenahealth and insurance portals is a plus, along with the ability to maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements.

Salary Range

$23—$28 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

jobs.title: Staff IT Platform Architect
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

• Over $300 million raised in funding

• 3,000 Tideans globally

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

The IT team at Tide is a small, high-impact group of around 20 people, combining a responsive service desk with strong project-based engineering capability. The team operates in a cloud-native environment, with Google Workspace at the core, and supports a large, globally distributed workforce. The focus is on enabling the business through reliable, secure access to a wide range of SaaS platforms, while continuously improving how services are delivered as the organisation scales.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

You'll be the technical SME for our core IT platforms. As a senior individual contributor, you’ll own the architecture, configuration and health of the platforms every Tidean relies on. You’ll make the key design decisions, keep the platforms secure, well governed and documented, and drive improvements from design through to rollout. The major platforms in scope are:

• Google Workspace: identity and access policies, DLP, email security and ChromeOS management Netskope (SSE/SASE): SWG, CASB, DLP and ZTNA Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune: zero-touch provisioning, compliance, patching and encryption for the Mac and Windows fleet Atlassian: Jira Service Management as our ITSM platform and CMDB, plus Jira and Confluence

• Establish configuration as code mentality within the team: manage platform config through Terraform, Git and CI/CD where the tools allow it, and script everything else.

• Own the engineering side of endpoint security and compliance controls, including EDR integrations, OS and application patching, vulnerability remediation, encryption, device compliance and security baselines.

• Build monitoring, reporting and operational health metrics for workplace platforms, using APIs and automation to identify configuration drift, failures, capacity issues and emerging operational risks before they become incidents.

• Own technical design and architecture decisions for Workplace Technology, including platform standards, technical debt, vendor evaluation, proof of concepts, migration strategy and lifecycle planning.

• Act as L3 escalation for complex incidents, carry out root-cause analysis, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

• Support audit and compliance work (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, FCA and DORA requirements) with evidence, controls and documentation.

• Mentor engineers and service desk colleagues, raise the team's technical bar, and write the runbooks and Confluence documentation that let others work independently.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

• Extensive experience with CaC (Configuration as Code) on SaaS platforms.

• Confident scripting in Python, Bash and PowerShell, and comfort working with REST APIs.

• 7+ years in IT or workplace engineering, including at least 3 years at senior level in a cloud-native, SaaS-first organisation of 1,000+ users.

• Deep hands-on Google Workspace administration at enterprise scale, including automation with GAM/GAMADV-XTD3, the Admin SDK APIs or Apps Script.

• Production experience designing and running Netskope or a comparable SSE/SASE platform (Zscaler, Prisma Access, Cloudflare One), including ZTNA and DLP.

• Strong experience with both Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune, running a mixed Mac and Windows fleet end to end.

• Solid grasp of identity and access: SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, conditional access and device trust.

• Clear, confident communication with engineers, stakeholders and non-technical users alike.

Nice to have:

• Admin-level experience with Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, including JSM automation and Assets.

• Experience in fintech or regulated financial services (FCA, DORA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

• Working knowledge of GCP and AWS, particularly IAM and networking relevant to ZTNA.

• Relevant certifications (Google Workspace Administrator, Jamf 300/400, Netskope NSK200/300, MD-102, Atlassian ACP).

OUR TECH STACK:

• Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform

• Netskope (SSE/SASE)

• Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune

• Mac, Windows and ChromeOS endpoints

• Okta

• C1

• Cisco Meraki

• Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

• The gross annual salary for this position ranges from €62,000 to €87,200 but we are also open to discussing the salary further, taking into account your expertise and contributions.

• 25 days paid annual leave

• 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities

• Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company

• Personal L&D budget in the amount of 500 EUR per year

• Additional health & dental insurance

• Mental wellbeing platform

• Fully covered Multisports card

• Food vouchers

• Snacks, light food, drinks in the office

• WFH equipment allowance

• Flexible working from home

• Sabbatical Leave

• Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

#LI-MP1

#LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

As an Account Manager at Talabat, you will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with our restaurant and vendor partners. You will serve as the main point of contact, helping them optimize their presence on our platform, grow their sales, and ensure a high level of partner satisfaction.

WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE:

Partner Relationship Management:

• Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing restaurant and vendor partners.
• Ensure high partner satisfaction and retention through proactive communication, support, and service excellence.
• Serve as a trusted advisor, providing partners with insights that support their business growth on the platform.

Data-Driven Consulting:

• Analyze sales, operational, and engagement data to identify areas for improvement in menu performance, pricing, promotions, and delivery logistics.
• Share actionable recommendations based on performance metrics to drive revenue and efficiency.
• Conduct regular business reviews to align on results, opportunities, and growth plans.

Account Growth & Optimization:

• Identify growth opportunities within the portfolio – upsell services, suggest cross-promotions, and improve partner performance.
• Support partners in optimizing content (e.g., menu structure, images, delivery times) for better customer engagement and conversion.
• Recommend and coordinate marketing campaigns and promotional offers to drive order volume.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Logistics, and Operations to address partner needs and resolve issues promptly.

Contract Management & Compliance:

• Negotiate and renew commercial agreements to ensure a fair and strategic partnership.

• 2+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, or Partner Success (experience in food tech, FMCG, or e-commerce is a plus).

• Self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
