jobs.title: Regional Assistant Sales Manager, Cross Border (Ninja Freight)
jobs.description:
Ninja Van is a tech-enabled logistics company on a mission to provide hassle-free delivery services for businesses of all sizes across Southeast Asia. Launched in 2014, we started operations in Singapore and have become the region's largest and fastest growing last-mile logistics company, partnering with over 35,000 merchants and delivering more than 1,000 parcels every minute across six countries. 

At our core, we are a technology company that is disrupting a massive industry with cutting-edge software and operational concepts. Powered by algorithm-based optimisation, dynamic routing, end-to-end tracking and a data-driven approach, we provide best-of-class delivery services that delight both the shippers and end customers. But we are just getting started! We have much room for improvement and many ideas that will further shape the industry.

Ninja Freight exists to support the organization in achieving its revenue growth and diversification objectives by providing cross-border, non-ecommerce logistics services to Southeast Asian businesses.
The Assistant Sales Manager supports the Business Development efforts for Ninja Freight in Singapore  and reports to the Regional Senior Manager, Ninja Freight. This role plays a key part in driving sales growth by supporting new customer acquisition, managing assigned accounts, and contributing to the expansion of Ninja Freight’s presence in the Singapore market.
This is a hunter focused role that requires the incumbent to actively source leads, conduct cold calls, and identify new business opportunities. The Assistant Sales Manager will work closely with the Sales Manager and Regional team to execute sales strategies and may progressively take on leadership responsibilities, including mentoring Sales Associates as the team expands.
As Ninja Freight is a growing revenue stream within Cross Border, the incumbent is expected to be a self starter with strong execution capabilities, supporting the growth of Ninja Freight’s sales revenue through the promotion of international sea freight and airfreight solutions to customers based in Singapore. The ideal candidate should possess an existing network or some exposure to clients requiring freight forwarding services, as well as the initiative to develop new customer relationships.
Our primary customers are SME trade, retail, and wholesale businesses, with a focus on export lanes from Singapore to the rest of the world.

jobs.title: CEO - AI Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.



 


ABOUT THE ROLE

The CEO - AI Finance will build and own our AI-native finance business. The role will identify where AI can fundamentally improve how consumers manage money and build products across spending, saving, investing and other everyday financial needs.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Define the AI Finance product strategy, roadmap and business model.

 - Identify financial workflows where AI can materially improve the user experience, cost or speed.

 - Build AI-native financial products from concept through launch and scale.

 - Own P&L, customer growth, revenue, unit economics and operating performance.

 - Work deeply with product, engineering and AI teams on product capabilities and user experience.

 - Build the core team across product, technology, operations and commercial functions.

 - Expand into new financial products and markets as the business scales.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

 - Strong experience building consumer fintech, financial services or technology products.

 - Direct ownership of a meaningful product, business or P&L.

 - Strong understanding of consumer finance, business models and unit economics.

 - Strong product judgement and understanding of how AI can change existing financial workflows.

 - Experience building products and teams in high-growth technology environments.

 - Hands-on operating style - able to work directly through product, AI capabilities, economics and customer problems.
   
   


LOCATION

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.



 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.



 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
jobs.description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. 

 

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.



Key Deliverables:
Consistently achieve QA accuracy targets (95–98%+ or higher).

Complete assigned QA reviews within agreed SLAs.

Identify recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements.

Become proficient in CUBE's QA processes and regulatory data standards.

Support automation initiatives by identifying repetitive manual validation tasks.

Contribute to improving QA documentation and checklists.

Demonstrate strong collaboration across multiple Data Quality teams.


Roles & Responsibilites:
• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and ensure quality assurance objectives are met.

• Analyze data sets to identify inconsistencies, errors, and anomalies.

• Work closely with DQ teams to implement data quality controls, validations, and automated checks.

• Collaborate with data governance teams to ensure compliance with data management policies and regulations.

• Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to data quality. 

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Cooks- Qantas Lounges Perth

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Instrumentation and Controls
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ELECTRICAL ENGINEER, INSTRUMENTATION AND CONTROLS

This engineer is a systems-focused, automation-driven, multi-faceted individual. The engineer uses electrical and mechanical systems knowledge to inform the design of test stands, support facilities, avionics, and control systems. SpaceX control engineers develop and integrate physical hardware, including wire harnesses, PCBs, custom enclosures, PLCs, data acquisition systems, avionics systems, engine controllers, and various sensors. The engineer is responsible for transferring real-time data from these physical sensors and actuators to the stand operator, the responsible engineer, or the customer. Test articles include in-space systems, vehicles, avionics systems, and ground systems. Excellent operational support and accurate interpretation of data collected from these test systems are paramount. These critical automation & control systems support operations that enable safe, economical, and reliable access to space.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Maintain the operational capability of all control voltage level (<60V) electrical systems

• Develop and upgrade data acquisition and control systems

• Create new automation systems pertaining to avionics and engine testing

• Provide technical support and guidance for controls technicians and other non-controls engineering groups

• Develop new hardware and processes to improve capabilities, reduce cost, and setup time of electrical systems

• Analyze data to assess the function and health of electrical systems

• Assist in the design and analysis of experiments to evaluate test articles

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in physics, electrical engineering, computer engineering or other engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience working with data acquisition systems (professional work, internships, clubs, or other engineering activities qualify)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

• 2+ years of experience leading a team or project

• Passion for advancing the commercial space industry and human spaceflight

• Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and drive to succeed as part of a high functioning team

• Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment

• Ability to thrive in ambiguity, independently drive project progress, and manage multiple priorities

• Knowledge of high-reliability processes and related documentation practices

• Demonstrated ability to design, implement and troubleshoot data acquisition and control hardware

• Fundamental understanding of engineering principles behind electronic equipment, instrumentation, and commonly used industrial equipment

• Experience designing and installing instrumentation and control systems in hazardous areas (NFPA 70 Section 500 installations); class 1, division 1 and division 2 environments or IEC equivalence

• Familiarity with mixed signal electronics, power supply design, analog filtering; testing and troubleshooting techniques, signal integrity, layout and grounding principles

• General schematic capture and printed circuit board (PCB) design and/or verification and validation experience

• Experience with electrical power distribution, working knowledge of NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E

• First-hand experience with programming and software development

• Experience with industrial bus protocols such as Modbus, Profinet and EtherNet/IP

• Hands-on experience activating, building, and troubleshooting analog & digital electronic systems, including avionics

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings

• Ability to work at elevated heights (200+ feet)

• Ability to perform physical tasks such as climbing up and down stairs and/or ladders regularly throughout the day

• Ability to lift light weight supplies or materials (up to 25lbs unassisted)

• Available to work extended hours and weekends when needed based on site operational needs; flexibility required

• Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, flashing lights, heat, cold, rain, and noise

• Ability to travel to other SpaceX or 3rd party facilities (up to 25%)

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.



Job Summary

At Etched, every role is critical, but as an IT Engineer, you’ll be the key to ensuring everyone can perform at their highest level. You’ll be the trusted resource who keeps our high-performance engineering and operations environment running seamlessly, so teams can innovate without barriers. In this role, you’ll drive company-wide productivity, empower engineers with tools and infrastructure to move at maximum velocity, and champion a culture of operational excellence across all systems. From enabling cutting-edge chip development workflows to streamlining day-to-day IT operations, you’ll ensure nothing slows down our mission to build transformational AI innovation.



Key responsibilities

 - Provide hands-on IT delivery and support for the entire firm, including ASIC design teams, software and platform engineering, business operations, and scale-out computing teams.

 - Lead onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure seamless access aligned with engineering and leadership workflows.

 - Maintain robust documentation of IT assets, systems, access protocols, and ticket workflows.

 - Manage on-site and remote laptops, desktops, and networking equipment with attention to ease of use, security, and remote manageability.

 - Deploy and administer MDM and MAM solutions for Mac and Windows devices.

 - Implement and maintain antivirus, antimalware, Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), and Extended Detection & Response (XDR).

 - Drive hardware procurement, staging, imaging, and maintenance for development and operations teams.

 - Implement and administer Single Sign-On (SSO) across core services, ensuring secure and frictionless user authentication. Okta experience a bonus

 - Automate user provisioning and deprovisioning workflows using Rippling, Okta, Google Workspace, and FreeIPA to streamline access management and reduce errors.

 - Enforce role-based access controls and audit trails to align with compliance and security standards.

 - Design, deploy, and maintain wired and wireless networks, including Wi-Fi access points (WAPs) and controller administration.

 - Configure and manage VPN infrastructure to provide secure remote access for distributed teams.

 - Administer firewalls, ensuring proper segmentation, policy enforcement, and protection of sensitive environments.

 - Develop automation scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell) to streamline provisioning, patching, monitoring, and user lifecycle management.

 - Integrate monitoring and alerting systems to reduce manual workload and increase reliability.

 - Champion a culture of operational excellence, ensuring IT systems meet compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).

 - Coordinate with external vendors and partners to evaluate new products, support existing offerings, and to resolve IT issues.

 - Partner closely with engineering, security, and operations teams to align IT strategy with business and technical goals.



Representative projects:

 - Managing a mixed-OS engineering environment (Linux for EDA tools, Windows/macOS for general use) — including imaging, patching, and security hardening.

 - Designing and maintaining secure network infrastructure (VPNs, VLANs, firewalls, access control) to protect sensitive chip design IP.

 - Implementing and managing endpoint/device lifecycle systems (procurement, setup, MDM, retirement) for engineering and operations teams.

 - Deploying and integrating compute resources (on-prem servers and cloud environments) to support large-scale simulations and hardware workflows.

 - Building scalable onboarding/offboarding and IT automation workflows to ensure fast, secure ramp-up for new engineers and smooth transitions.

 - Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: VPNs, VLANs, firewalls.

 - Skilled in endpoint management, system imaging, and hardware lifecycle management.

 - Proficient with ticketing systems and adept at prioritizing tasks in busy environments.

 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with engineering teams in fast-paced, innovative settings.



You may be a good fit if you have:

 - 5-7+ years in an IT support or engineering role with experience across macOS, Windows and Linux

 - Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive and ownership-driven mindset.

 - Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - Proven experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., Jump,Cloud, Jamf, Intune, Kandji).

 - Hands-on expertise in enterprise VPNs, wireless networking, and zero-trust access models.

 - Strong background in EDR/XDR platforms (e.g., ThreadDown, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne).

 - Scripting and automation proficiency (Python, Bash, PowerShell).

 - Knowledge of security best practices, incident response, and identity/access management (IAM).

 - Strong networking expertise, including configuring and troubleshooting TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and firewalls.

 - Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or a developer-oriented compute infrastructure is a plus.



Benefits

 - Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
   
   - $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

 - Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office

 - Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

 - Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more

 - Daily lunch + dinner in our office

 - Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification



How we’re different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson http://www.incompleteideas.net/IncIdeas/BitterLesson.html. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

 

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE:

The Counsel, Debt partners with Hadrian’s Finance and Treasury teams on the legal strategy, structuring, and compliance that help finance our growth. This role will be responsible for advising teams on how to finance factories and capex, how to structure debt, and how to ensure ongoing compliance with our debt facility obligations.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Draft and drive negotiations on borrower-side credit agreements, security and pledge agreements, guarantees, and UCC collateral packages across revolvers, term loans, and equipment financings

 - Support sale-leaseback, equipment, and construction financings for our factory build-out, including intercreditor and subordination arrangements

 - Run closings and manage and coordinate outside counsel to deliver on schedule and on budget

 - Own covenant monitoring and the calendar for compliance certificates, borrowing base certificates, and lender reporting

 - Translate deal documents into practical terms Finance can model, and support Treasury on account control agreements, letters of credit, and lender consents and amendments

 - Build playbooks, templates, and checklists that make each financing faster than the last


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - JD and active bar membership in at least one U.S. jurisdiction

 - 5–8+ years of debt finance experience at a top-tier law firm and/or in-house

 - Hands-on experience negotiating credit facilities and security documents, ideally from the borrower side

 - Working knowledge of covenant packages, collateral and lien mechanics, and the UCC

 - Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple closings at once

 - Clear communicator who works well with Finance teams, lenders, and their counsel


WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience in a top-tier law firm’s structured finance practice

 - Exposure to borrowing base mechanics, especially government contract receivables

(GAQ128R87)

The Senior Sales Compensation Manager (L7) is the senior systems expert for Databricks' commissions platform. You will co-own how commissions get calculated: how the Xactly Incent plans are built, and the data integrations and pipelines that feed every calculation. You'll be the trusted co-owner of the system design, the technical roadmap, and the systems controls in a fast-growing, consumption-based SaaS business. You’ll take on ambiguous, cross-functional problems that span several systems. You'll influence senior leaders in Finance, GTM, and Engineering, and raise the bar for the team through documentation, enablement, and AI-first automation.

The impact you will have

Plan configuration and calculation engine

• Co-lead annual (and mid-year if applicable) plan builds in Xactly for every major plan family, including AE, sales leaders, xDR, field engineering, and partner plans. This covers rule logic, rate tables, accelerators, quotas, crediting hierarchies, and tuning the calculation engine.

• Partner with Plan Design to turn plan design decks into system specifications. Configure, run UAT on, and test new plans before they go to production. Co-own the system implementation timeline and the go-live schedule for the new fiscal year.

• Be the responder when calculations break, data sync fails, or configuration has defects.

Integrations, data pipelines and system design

• Co-own the integration layer between Salesforce and Xactly and the data loads from the Databricks lakehouse into Xactly. This covers object mappings, the API integration user, OAuth and IP restriction upkeep, and the schedules and dependencies of the pipelines that feed plan crediting.

• Collaborate and influence the future-state design and technical roadmap for the commissions platform. That includes evaluating the commission engine strategy and moving manual files onto governed pipelines with change management and SOX-aligned logging.

• Collaborate and influence vendor escalations and support cases, and lead day-to-day work with the Xactly account team.

Controls, close, and audit

• Co-own the commissions systems SOX controls: plan configuration and change management, system-to-system validation, plan reconciliation, quarterly user access reviews. Act as a subject-matter expert in walkthroughs with external auditors.

• Run the systems side of the monthly and quarterly close calendar with high precision.

• Make change requests to the change-approval board (CAB) audit-ready from the start, with full descriptions, approvals, and test evidence.

AI, automation and insight

• Collaborate and influence AI adoption. Use it to turn plan design into configuration, automatically generate documentation, and validate data with AI agents. Use AI-driven anomaly detection to find payout discrepancies before they reach payroll.

• Use predictive modeling to estimate commissions impact of proposed plan changes/adjustments or for accrual purposes.

• Turn prototypes into tools the team actually uses, and track the time saved and quality gained.

Cross-functional influence

• Represent Commissions Systems to Engineering, IT, Finance Data & Strategy, GTM Strategy & Ops, Accounting, FP&A, and Partner teams. Turn business requirements into engineering terms and the other way around, and agree on SLAs and intake processes.

• Be the voice telling downstream teams about system changes that affect their reporting and analysis.

Leadership & culture

• Help make the team resilient by design. Turn undocumented rules and configuration knowledge into playbooks, wikis, and recorded walkthroughs so no one person is a single point of failure.

• Mentor and cross-train other team members, including offshore resources. Help build a culture of continuous learning and AI adoption.

• Turn concerns into recommendations with clear trade-offs that win senior leaders' support.

What we look for

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.

• 12+ years in sales compensation, commissions systems, or sales/finance operations, including deep hands-on administration and configuration of an SPM platform.

• Expert skills in Xactly Incent and Connect. Experience with other SPM tools is a plus.

• Strong grasp of Salesforce data models and integrations, and of data pipeline concepts. SQL or lakehouse experience (e.g., Databricks) is strongly preferred.

• A track record of running SOX controls and ITGCs, and of leading audit walkthroughs.

• Fluency in SaaS go-to-market comp models: quotas, OTI, accelerators, overlays, SPIFFs, MBOs, and consumption-based crediting.

• A proven record of efficiency gains from automation and AI. You're comfortable prompting and evaluating LLMs, building practical tools, and judging where people still need to make the call.

• Experience in a fast-paced SaaS or tech company, plus strong communication and presentation skills for senior audiences.

jobs.title: Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
MeBe is a provider of evidence-based therapies for children with autism and other special needs. Our mission is to empower families, professionals, and communities by educating and training them on evidence-based approaches. Our secret sauce? Play-filled, research-based care across multi-disciplines including OT, Speech and ABA.



At MeBe, you’ll be offered more than a job.  You’ll receive training and support to launch a career in Behavior Therapy and grow as an individual. You’ll work with extraordinary team members who share a common goal, to help children with autism be their best selves.  Your days will be filled with meaning and purpose.



To help you prepare for the role, MeBe offers one of the top ABA training programs using the Vincent Carbone method. MeBe Family will also pair you with Supervisors to shadow, ask questions and guide you.



MeBe is growing our team and is on the lookout for empathetic, thoughtful individuals with a genuine passion for working with young children to join our fantastic crew. Whether you are an experienced RBT or curious and want to learn more, we would like to meet you.  



Behavior Technician - Kearny Mesa 



About You:

 - You are a caring, compassionate and empathetic individual who loves to learn.

 - You possess a strong work ethic and are reliable.

 - You take pride in your work, pay attention to the small details and have a reputation for doing high quality work.

 - You value transparency and operate with candor and compassion. You inspire others to be their best selves.

 - You love to weave fun and laughter into whatever you do. Making a positive impact is what drives you

 - You value individuality and find yourself gravitating towards people with other interests who think outside the box, and push the status quo.

 - You embrace the power of teamwork and thrive in both one-on-one and group settings – because you know collaboration is the core of achieving big goals.



About What You’ll Work On:

Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a group of developmental disabilities that can cause significant social, communication, mental health and behavioral challenges. 

Although autism can be diagnosed at any age, it is described as a “developmental disorder” because symptoms generally appear in the first 2 years of life. People with ASD may face a wide range of issues, which means that there is no single best treatment for ASD. Working closely with a health care provider like MeBe Family  is an important part of finding the right combination of treatment and services. (Reference, National Institute of Mental Health)



As a Behavior Technician,

 - You'll teach and nurture behavioral, social, communication, and daily living skills in a 1:1 setting to kiddos with autism in their home or at MeBe’s Learning Center clinic

 - You’ll follow treatment plans developed by BCBAs that help increase the kiddo's communication, self-help, social and play skills.

 - You’ll relay info on your kiddos’ progress to BCBAs to keep them informed and assist with BCBA assessments.

 - At the end of each session, you’ll accurately record the kiddo’s behavior analysis and progress in our data collection system Central Reach using your work assigned tablet.

 - You’ll be responsible for clocking in, submitting your session notes and clocking out to align with strict ABA and Insurance provider regulations.

 - You’ll help keep our workplace shipshape, safe, and super organized.

 - You’ll help our kiddos with lunch breaks, bathroom breaks and diaper changing.

 - You’ll help with projects and tasks as directed by your Site Director and Clinical Supervisors.

 - You’ll voice questions, issues and concerns to your supervisors as appropriate and take co-ownership of treatment planning.

 - You’ll help to build positive relationships with families while maintaining professional boundaries.

 - You’ll positively contribute to the MeBe Family culture.



Qualifications:

 - Consistent availability from Monday through Friday.  Part-time shifts available. 

 - Must be at least 18-years-old with a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

 - RBT/ CBT certification preferred. Must obtain RBT/CBT certification within 60 days of employment (MeBe will help you!)

 - Prefer a background in child care; teaching, counseling, babysitting.

 - Ability to frequently bend, lift (up to 50 lbs), squat, sit, stand, and/or run, (without reasonable accommodations), see with prescription lenses, and hear with hearing aids.

 - Previous training in First Aid Certified and CPR is preferred

 - Ability to pass a background check.

 - Ability to work with computers.

 - If residing in CA, AZ, or VA, must obtain CPR/BLS certification before working with clients 

 - Must have at minimum a high school diploma or equivalent- required. A bachelor’s degree in areas like Pediatrics or Human Development (Biology) is preferred.



Perks and Benefits:

   - Pay: $22-27/ hour, depending on experience and location

The Clinic Nurse, RN plays a vital role by caring directly for participants in the WelbeHealth clinic, including supporting clinic overflow and day center triage, checking vital signs, performing POC testing, administering medications, and supporting any other clinical needs in accordance with RN scope of practice.

This role is different because Clinic Nurse, RNs at WelbeHealth:

• Experience fast‑track career growth opportunities within a supportive team

• Enjoy consistent hours with no on‑call, weekend, or holiday work

• Focus on preventative care in a low‑stress, non‑acute environment

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

• Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days

• 401K savings + match

• Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus

• And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

• Aid with all wound care (including complex wounds), IV (hydration, therapies), medication management, and any additional procedures within RN scope of practice identified to meet evolving participant needs

• Provide clinical support to Medical Assistants performing procedures as needed

• Instruct participants, their families, and caregivers regarding the disease process, self-care techniques, and prevention strategies related to their medical conditions

• Record patient care delivery as planned to include any variation, as well as record observations and implement nursing measures related to impending issues

Job requirements include:

• Graduate of an accredited school of nursing; bachelor’s degree (BSN) preferred

• Unencumbered RN license required

• Reliable means of transportation

• Must obtain CPR and First Aid certification within 180 days of hire and maintain certification thereafter; CPR and First Aid certification upon hire preferred

We are seeking Clinic Nurse, RNs that ideally have triaging experience. If you’re ready to join a holistic care team that values both its participants and providers, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

Compensation Offering

$48.20—$63.26 USD

At WelbeHealth, our mission is to unlock the full potential of our vulnerable seniors. In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. WelbeHealth maintains required infection control and PPE standards and has requirements relevant to all team members regarding vaccinations.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At WelbeHealth, we embrace and cherish the diversity of our team members, and we're committed to building a culture of inclusion and belonging. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People seeking employment at WelbeHealth are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), pregnancy or other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Site Director - ABA Services
jobs.description:
MeBe Family is a provider of evidence-based therapies for children with autism and other special needs. Our mission is to empower families, professionals, and communities by educating and training them on evidence-based approaches. Our secret sauce? Play-filled, research-based care across multi-disciplines including ABA,  OT and Speech.



At MeBe Family, you’ll be offered more than a job.  You’ll receive training and support to develop your career and grow as an individual. You’ll work with extraordinary team members who share a common goal, to help children with autism be their best selves.  Your days will be filled with meaning and purpose.



MeBe is seeking a Site Director to lead both the clinical and day-to-day operations of a Learning Center, creating a high-quality, supportive environment where teams and families can thrive. This role oversees interdisciplinary services including ABA, Speech, and Occupational Therapy, ensuring strong clinical outcomes, operational excellence, and a positive team culture. The Site Director partners closely with clinical leaders, operational teams, and families to drive performance, maintain compliance, and support meaningful progress for the children we serve. This position is ideal for an experienced leader who blends clinical expertise with operational ownership and is energized by building strong teams and delivering exceptional care.



About you:

 - You take pride in your work, pay attention to the small details and have a reputation for doing high quality work.

 - You value transparency and operate with candor and compassion. You inspire others to be their best selves.

 - You love to weave fun and laughter into whatever you do. Making a positive impact is what drives you.

 - You value individuality and find yourself gravitating towards people with other interests who think outside the box, and push the status quo.



About what you’ll work on:



Leadership & Clinical Oversight

 - Provide day-to-day leadership and oversight of clinical and administrative staff and overall center operations.

 - Ensure treatment fidelity and client progress through regular quality assurance checks, clinical observations, and collaboration with BCBAs on complex cases.

 - Conduct Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) as needed.

 - Offer ongoing clinical mentorship through monthly individual and group meetings with ABA Supervisors.

 - Facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration by leading weekly team meetings with BCBAs, SLPs, and OTs.

 - Partner with Directors of Speech and OT to ensure onsite support and integration of services



Operations & Compliance

 - Drive regional performance by executing strategic operational plans aligned with organizational goals

 - Monitor and maintain billable productivity, ensuring achievement of weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenue targets

 - Oversee scheduling, staffing, and resource allocation to optimize efficiency and service delivery

 - Ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations, including HIPAA, BACB standards, and payer requirements

 - Manage site-level budgets and contribute to financial planning and forecasting initiatives



Client Services

 - Maintain an individual billable hour target aligned with site size and operational needs

 - Act as the primary liaison for families, addressing concerns, resolving grievances promptly, and ensuring overall client satisfaction

 - Oversee the client pipeline and onboarding process in collaboration with intake and administrative teams to maximize client conversion and retention

 - Collaborate with the clinical team to uphold exceptional standards of care and support positive client outcomes



Team Development & Culture

 - Lead recruitment, onboarding, and retention efforts for high-performing clinical and administrative staff, including BCBAs, RBTs, SLPs, OTs, and support personnel, to drive team productivity and excellence

 - Cultivate a positive, inclusive, and mission-aligned workplace culture that aligns with MeBe’s values.

 - Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide ongoing coaching and feedback to support professional growth

 - Collaborate with People Operations to address employee relations matters and manage sensitive issues with professionalism and integrity



Business Development & Community Engagement

 - Drive site growth by identifying and pursuing opportunities for client acquisition through community outreach and strategic partnerships

 - Serve as a company ambassador at local events, conferences, and with key referral sources to enhance visibility and build strong community relationships



Metrics for Success

 - Meet or exceed monthly revenue goals

 - Meet or exceed site-level profitability goals

 - BCBA and RBT productivity rate

 - Case Supervision rate

 - Employee satisfaction scores

 - Scheduled hours utilization

 - Authorization utilization

 - Staff turnover rate

 - Client satisfaction scores

 - Client retention

 - Parent training hours

 - Quality Assurance scores

 - Client progress on assessment




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Minimum 3–5 years of supervisory experience in ABA or a related healthcare setting.

 - Strong knowledge of ABA principles and clinical best practices.

 - Experience managing teams, operations.

 - Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR), scheduling software, and billing systems (CR experience preferred)

 - Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.

 - Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
   



Benefits Include:

 - Eligible for MeBe’s Flexible Time Off

jobs.title: Production Control Associate, 1st Shift, Site 2 (BSAT, CSAT, PLM, Bldgs 8/9/10/12)
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Production Control Associate responsible for coordinating and expediting the flow of materials, parts, and work orders throughout the manufacturing process to support production schedules and customer delivery requirements. This role monitors inventory, work-in-process (WIP), material shortages, and production priorities while working closely with Production, Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Warehouse teams to maintain operational efficiency and schedule adherence.

Base Pay: $22.00 per hour

Shift Schedules

• 1st Shift (Days): Monday-Thursday, 7:30 AM-5:30 PM (4x10 schedule) with paid lunch and breaks.

• 2nd Shift (Nights): Monday-Thursday, 6:00 PM-4:00 AM (4x10 schedule) with a 10% shift differential and paid lunch and breaks.

• 3rd Shift (Weekends): Friday-Sunday, 6:00 AM-6:00 PM (3x12 schedule) with a 20% shift differential and paid lunch and breaks.

• Additional night and weekend shifts may be available based on business needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Compile and maintain records regarding the quantity, cost, and type of materials received, shipped, inventoried, and in production.

• Expedite the movement of materials, parts, assemblies, and work orders within and between departments according to production schedules and customer requirements.

• Monitor material availability and identify actual or potential shortages; coordinate corrective actions to minimize production disruptions.

• Collaborate with Production, Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Warehouse teams to resolve material flow issues and support production priorities.

• Track inventory levels including Work-in-Process (WIP), On-Hold, Material Review Board (MRB), Inspection, and warehouse locations.

• Prioritize production orders and material movement to support manufacturing schedules and on-time delivery goals.

• Track production rates, lead times, and workflow status to support production planning activities.

• Ensure inventory transactions and material movements are accurately documented within ERP/MRP systems.

• Process and reconcile scrapped, obsolete, damaged, or nonconforming materials.

• Support cycle counts, inventory audits, and inventory accuracy initiatives.

• Coordinate with Material Planning and Purchasing teams to ensure material availability aligns with production schedules.

• Escalate material shortages, schedule conflicts, and production delays to appropriate stakeholders.

• Maintain accurate production, inventory, and material control records.

• Follow all company policies, quality requirements, and safety procedures.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Associate degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Manufacturing, or related field preferred.

Experience

• Minimum of two (2) years of experience in manufacturing, production control, inventory control, warehouse operations, logistics, materials management, or a related field.

• Experience supporting production schedules, inventory accuracy, and material movement activities.

• Experience utilizing ERP, MRP, inventory management, or manufacturing systems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as NetSuite, Epicor, Solumina, SAP, Oracle, or similar manufacturing software.

• Aerospace, manufacturing, production control, materials management, inventory control, or warehouse experience.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including filtering, sorting, reporting, and data analysis.

• Knowledge of production scheduling, inventory management, material planning, and manufacturing processes.

• Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing environments.

Soft Skills

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to inventory accuracy.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments.

• Ability to adapt in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Strong sense of accountability and ownership.

Technology Stack

• Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook)

• ERP/MRP Systems

• Inventory Management Systems

• Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) preferred

• Data reporting and spreadsheet applications

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in a manufacturing and warehouse environment with frequent standing, walking, and movement throughout the shift.

• Ability to sit, stand, and/or walk for extended periods.

• Ability to use hands and fingers for repetitive tasks, computer work, and data entry.

• Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, squat, climb, reach, and balance as required.

• Ability to lift, push, pull, and/or carry up to 35 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Ability to work around machinery, equipment, material handling devices, and production tooling.

• Ability to work near moving mechanical parts and equipment.

• Ability to visually inspect materials, inventory labels, documentation, and production information.

• Ability to communicate effectively through speaking and hearing.

• Ability to work in environments with exposure to noise, dust, fumes, airborne particles, and varying temperatures.

• Ability to follow safety procedures and wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Relocation Opportunity

If you are open to relocating to Midland, TX, this opportunity provides exposure to the high-tech aerospace industry, offering career growth, transferable manufacturing skills, and long-term employment stability in a rapidly growing organization.

This job description may not be inclusive of all duties and responsibilities. Additional tasks may be assigned from time to time, or the scope of the position may change based on business needs.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MINERVA

Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end-to-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting.

Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis.

We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge.


THE ROLE

Minerva runs on customer and vendor data that arrives late, changes shape and sometimes arrives twice. The data platform team makes that data dependable: it lands, it's correct, someone knows when it isn't, and anyone on the team can recover it.

You own the hardest technical delivery on that team and set the standards everyone else builds to. You design shared platform capabilities across ingestion, transformation, storage and downstream delivery, and you turn what you learn in production into patterns the rest of the team uses.

This is a senior individual contributor seat on the data platform team, reporting to our Head of Data Platform. Until we hire a dedicated observability engineer, pipeline health and alerting are yours too.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and deliver shared platform capabilities across ingestion, transformation, storage and downstream delivery.

 - Set the standards for data contracts, safe reprocessing, monitoring, alerting, releases and recovery, and get the team to adopt them.

 - Solve the scale and correctness problems: inconsistent data, partial failures and large backfills, balancing performance and cost.

 - Lead complex cross-system delivery, like moving consumers onto normalized lakehouse data with parity checks and a controlled cutover, and making sure a privacy request is verifiably carried out everywhere the data lives.

 - Make the team independent. Review designs, mentor engineers and hand over critical workflows with tested recovery.

 - Partner with our Head of Data Platform on architecture and priorities.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Proven ownership of a production data platform handling large, heterogeneous datasets, from design through ongoing operation.

 - Hands-on experience across ingestion, orchestration, storage and observability. You can explain real failure modes and the tradeoffs you made.

 - Evidence that you improved engineering standards and helped others deliver independently.

 - Clear communication in design reviews and during incidents.

 - You're in New York City or willing to relocate.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Lakehouse migrations.

 - Privacy-sensitive data: deletion and suppression that has to be provable.

 - Shared platform services used by other teams.

 - Depth of ownership matters more than an exact tool match. We run Dagster, Airflow, dbt, SQLMesh, Snowflake and a lakehouse on Spark, Iceberg, Trino and AWS Glue.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 90 days: you've delivered one complex platform improvement, the team runs on operating guidelines you wrote, and you've handed over a critical workflow with tested recovery.

 - First 6 months: the team runs two delivery streams that engineers own independently, and detection and recovery times are measured and falling.


COMPENSATION

$211,000–$236,000 base salary, depending on experience. Meaningful equity. Medical, dental and vision.


HOW TO APPLY

Skip the cover letter. Tell us about a production data problem you owned end to end: what failed, how you found it, how you fixed it and what standard you put in place so it wouldn't happen again.


WHERE WE WORK

We work in person from our office at 300 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.


BENEFITS

Every full-time role includes equity; medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; a monthly fitness stipend; and an annual company offsite. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses.


PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range in this posting is our good-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process.


APPLYING

Apply on this page. We don't take applications by email, and we don't accept unsolicited submissions from recruiting agencies. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io.


WORK AUTHORIZATION

You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. We consider visa sponsorship case by case, so tell us on the application if you'll need it.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Minerva is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, New York State or New York City law.


RECRUITMENT FRAUD

Our hiring runs through Ashby and @minerva.io http://minerva.io email addresses. We will never ask you for money, bank details or other financial information during the process. If a message claiming to be from Minerva looks wrong, forward it to hiring@minerva.io.

Pilot Company is seeking a Dealer Strategy Intern to join our team in Knoxville, Tennessee, for the summer of 2027. This is a unique opportunity to gain valuable insight into our dealer network of approximately 190 locations, helping manage critical operator relationships and drive network expansion across the U.S. and Canada.

In this role, you will be an essential member of our Dealer Strategy team, gaining direct exposure to the operations and partnership models that fuel our business growth. Your primary focus will be supporting relationship management with dealer locations, helping develop new value-added services, and driving high-impact strategic growth projects. Working side-by-side with experienced professionals who are dedicated to your growth, you will combine real-world account strategy with impactful business planning—offering a well-rounded foundation for your career.

What You’ll Do

• Drive Strategic Expansion Planning: Lead the development of a comprehensive strategic plan to model and integrate gasoline sales across our existing dealer network, expanding beyond our traditional diesel focus.

• Enhance Dealer Relationships & Operations: Support day-to-day relationship management and operational success for approximately 190 dealer locations across the U.S. and Canada, helping identify and launch new value-added services.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Merchandising, Procurement, and Marketing teams to execute network growth initiatives—with potential opportunities to travel alongside the team to field locations.

• Financial Modeling & Market Analysis: Build financial and operational models to evaluate network growth, forecast profitability, and optimize dealer network performance.

• Learn from Industry Leaders: Work side-by-side with experienced strategy and operations leaders who will provide hands-on mentorship, executive exposure, and real-world project ownership.

What We’re Looking For

• Education & Background: Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related business discipline.

• Technical & Financial Skills: Strong financial modeling experience and advanced Excel skills are essential. Familiarity with AI tools and capabilities is a plus.

• Work Ethic & Maturity: A self-starter with a high level of professional maturity who takes complete ownership of projects and runs with them independently.

• Soft Skills & Communication: Strong collaborative skills with the confidence to reach out across teams, ask timely questions, and build effective working relationships with internal partners and field leadership.

• Qualities: A desire to learn and an eagerness to contribute to a collaborative environment. We value individuals who are driven, reliable, authentic, and welcoming.

Why Pilot Company?

Our culture is built on four core virtues: Driven, Reliable, Authentic, and Welcoming. As an intern, you will see these values in action every day. You'll be part of a team that is driven to meet deadlines, reliable in its commitment to accuracy, authentic in its interactions, and welcoming to new ideas and perspectives.

This is a full-time, in-person internship running from June 7 – August 13, 2027.  You’ll be working alongside our team in our Knoxville headquarters, where you’ll have the opportunity to build meaningful relationships and experience the full scope of life at Pilot Company.

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding internship with a leading company, please submit your application. The interview process will include a screening with a recruiter, a phone screen with the hiring manager, followed by a final round interview with the team and leader of the Dealer Strategy team. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Engineer I, Data (NYC BASED)
jobs.description:
Equinox is looking for an Engineer to join our data team. In this hands-on role, you will build and evolve our data platform, business applications, and integration tools, which power the daily work of our data warehouse, analytics, and business intelligence teams. The work involves modern data processing, ETL pipelines, and custom APIs.

Our ideal candidate is someone who has a passion for building software, has strong knowledge of AWS Products, and someone who can accomplish tight timelines in a multi-project environment. You will work closely with and be mentored by fellow engineers. You will help champion new initiatives and best practices. You can make a huge impact on a team that is open to change and adopting the latest technologies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Integrate data from a variety of sources, assuring they adhere to all data quality and accessibility standards
• Leverage AWS services like Glue, Lambda, S3, Athena, and EMR to build modular, reusable data solution
• Hands on design, development and monitor of various Python web applications, APIs, data processing tools, and analytic technologies

jobs.title: HRIS and Systems Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE PEOPLE TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Build the people function from scratch, fast enough to keep up with 10x growth. We grew headcount 10x in the last year and we're not slowing down. You'll build the systems, programs, and team from nothing, and make them work before we outgrow them.

 - Reinvent people operations around AI. Doing this by hand doesn't scale to a workforce growing this fast on a team this lean. You'll put AI at the core of how the function runs, so a small team supports many times its number.

 - Own the culture and comms as the company scales. When a company scales this quickly, staying connected and aligned doesn't happen on its own. You'll own the internal comms, events, and rhythm that keep a multi-site team that's growing fast bound to a shared culture.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own Rippling end to end as the admin of record. Org structure, departments, job levels, custom fields, permission profiles and supergroups stay clean as headcount grows, and every other HR system (vendor setup, user access) stays in sync with Rippling as the source of truth.

 - Build the automated employee lifecycle in Rippling Workflow Studio. Hires, transfers, promotions, comp changes and terminations each trigger conditional approvals, app provisioning through SCIM, device shipments and offboarding with no manual follow-up.

 - Run the systems side of payroll, benefits, compensation and headcount planning cycles across US and international entities: pay-change audits, new-hire and termination data accuracy, open enrollment setup, carrier and EOR data feeds, and comp and headcount cycles built in Rippling and closed out with clean data.

 - Connect Rippling to internal tools with TA, IT, Finance and Engineering through native integrations, webhooks and custom APIs, owning each integration's field mapping, data transformations, field-level visibility, sync monitoring and error handling.

 - Keep employee data accurate and controlled. Run regular audits across Rippling and connected systems (duplicates, missing fields, mismatched values, orphaned records), fix errors at the source, add validation rules so they don't come back, and own role-based access, change management, privacy compliance and runbooks so every system change can be reviewed and undone.

 - Build the dashboards and reporting leadership runs on: headcount, attrition, and audit-ready reports for Finance and compliance.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You have five years of experience as the system owner of an HRIS, setting up configurations, deciding what gets automated, and being the person Payroll, Finance and People leadership relied on for accurate data, with a bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.

 - You've been the primary admin of Rippling: you built the workflows, custom objects, permissions and policies yourself instead of handing them to an implementation partner.

 - You've owned HRIS at a high-growth company, kept the data accurate as headcount scaled, and led an implementation or migration end to end, including data mapping, payroll parallel runs and cutover.

 - You've supported payroll and benefits across multiple states or countries, including employees hired through an EOR and international entities, kept their records, payroll data and compliance requirements consistent, and caught errors before they reached a paycheck.

 - You've built and debugged integrations between an HRIS and an ATS, identity provider or finance system using REST APIs, webhooks and middleware, and when a sync fails you trace it from the API logs.

 - You've built reports and dashboards that executive leadership used to make headcount, compensation and organizational decisions.

 - You document what you build and treat access to employee data as a security control: least privilege, regular audits and a clear change log.

 - Bonus: HRIS platforms beyond Rippling (Workday, Deel, BambooHR). Identity and access management (Okta, SSO, SCIM). Scripting and querying (SQL, Python). Equity administration (Carta, Shareworks).


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, Technical Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE CONTROLS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Deliver the controls behind gigawatt-scale data centers this decade.

 - Own real-time load control and MEP and behind-the-meter integration.

 - Automate Level 4 and Level 5 commissioning.

 - Drive autonomous, robotic deployment.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Lead the team of PLC and SCADA engineers who build the controls libraries every Fluidstack data center runs on, setting priorities, reviewing their work, and owning what ships to site.

 - Set the controls architecture and design standards for the fleet, from network topology and controller selection to equipment and controls specifications, so every new campus starts from one validated reference design.

 - Define the deliverables for every controls package, including template PLC programs, HMI screens, point lists, and sequences of operations, and build them as templates so deployment is low-touch configuration that can be automated.

 - Own the alarm philosophy and point naming standards that keep tags, alarms, and data models identical from the PLC through SCADA to the operator's screen at every site.

 - Onboard system integrators to Fluidstack standards, write the specifications they build to, and review their work before it reaches a live site.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've led a team of controls engineers and owned what they shipped, setting the coding and review standards the team works to as well as writing code yourself.

 - You've built a library of template PLC or SCADA programs for mechanical or electrical equipment that other engineers deployed across multiple sites without rewriting.

 - You've programmed PLCs across more than one platform (Siemens, Codesys, virtualized PLCs) and designed SCADA systems that bring field devices into a single, consistent data model.

 - You've written controls specifications, point naming conventions, and alarm standards that integrators and contractors built to, and you enforced them in design review.

 - You've managed system integrators on critical facility projects and caught a bad sequence, a mislabeled point, or a missing alarm in their submittals before it reached commissioning.

 - You test templates against failure and edge cases on real hardware, so field commissioning confirms the design instead of debugging it.

 - You write documentation precise enough that a new engineer or integrator can extend the library without reverse-engineering it.

 - Bonus: Data center mechanical and electrical systems (chiller plants, CRAHs, fan wall units, switchgear, generators). Industrial protocols (BACnet, Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA). SCADA platforms and historians (Ignition, AVEVA). Alarm management and HMI standards (ISA-18.2, ISA-101). Automated controls deployment (code generation, version control for PLC code, hardware-in-the-loop testing).



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer (Optical Comms)
jobs.description:
About Apolink

Apolink is building the first-ever backward-compatible data relay constellation in low Earth orbit. By enabling efficient data aggregation and relay through our hybrid RF-optical inter-satellite link (ISL) architecture, we support scalable and resilient space infrastructure across commercial, federal, and defense applications.


About The Role:

The Chief Engineer (Optical) is the company’s technical lead for optical communications across our LEO data relay constellation. They own the optical architecture, requirements, link design, and verification, and lead technical decisions with our optical terminal vendor. The vendor handles terminal manufacturing, while this role remains hands-on with analysis, integration, and testing. This is a sole-contributor leadership role.



Responsibilities:

 - Own optical ISL and feeder-link architecture: wavelength plan, modulation and coding, aperture and divergence sizing, data rate vs range tradespace.

 - Develop and maintain end-to-end optical link budgets, including coherent receiver sensitivity, PAT margin, platform jitter, point-ahead, Doppler, stray light, fade statistics, and BER against realistic FEC.

 - Author optical requirements and ICDs, and manage flowdown to the vendor and to internal bus, flight software, and ground teams.

 - Direct the vendor technically: down-select, diligence, SOW and NRE scoping, design review participation, and accountability for performance and schedule.

 - Adjudicate R&D direction with the vendor; what warrants NRE investment, what is technically unviable, what we buy versus co-develop.

 - May lead a ZR-class coherent transceiver NRE with the optical terminal.

 - Maintain compliance with applicable standards, including CCSDS O3K and SDA OCT where relevant to federal programs.



Qualifications:

 - Direct, hands-on experience with LEO-LEO optical inter-satellite links: designing, building, or verifying crosslink terminals between spacecraft in low Earth orbit.

 - 6+ years in free-space optical communications, coherent optical transport, or spaceborne photonics.

 - MS or PhD in optics, EE, or physics, or equivalent demonstrated depth.

 - Demonstrated experience directing vendor technical performance and NRE programs.

 - Capacity to exercise independent technical judgment as the sole optical authority and be accountable for it.



Preferred:

 - Direct experience with 400ZR, 800ZR, OpenZR+, or OIF coherent pluggables.

 - Flight heritage on an optical comms payload.



Benefits:

 - Competitive salary and benefits package

 - Meaningful early-stage equity

 - Opportunity to own optical for a constellation end to end

 - Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), relocation assistance
   
   Salary: $180,000-$220,000
   
   

Additional Information

To conform to the U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. 


Apolink is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
