jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We align cross-functional teams—including Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design—on key decisions, set strategy, and drive products from inception to launch.

What you’ll do

Processing a single expense is becoming commoditized. Managing expenses across an enterprise is not. Companies must distribute cards broadly while controlling risk, documenting transactions, enforcing policy, routing approvals, preparing for audit, and producing ERP-ready records.

As Staff Product Manager for Expenses, you will turn that complexity into one intelligent system for employees, managers, finance teams, and accountants. You will lead the strategy across documentation, policy, compliance, approvals, substantiation, audit, and accounting readiness.

You will align specialized product teams across Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Accounting, and GTM. Using AI and automation, you will eliminate routine work, surface meaningful exceptions, help finance teams close faster, and build capabilities that win major enterprise relationships.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end strategy for enterprise expense management.

• Unify documentation, policy, compliance, approvals, substantiation, audit, and ERP readiness.

• Define the systems, data models, configurations, and controls complex enterprises require.

• Align specialized product teams around the complete expense lifecycle.

• Use AI to automate routine work and route only judgment-heavy exceptions to people.

• Partner with Design to make sophisticated enterprise workflows intuitive.

• Align Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, Accounting, Sales, and Customer Success around enterprise outcomes.

• Own adoption, workflow completion, manual-work reduction, close speed, retention, and software revenue.

Requirements

• A track record of leading complex enterprise workflow or systems products.

• Strong technical fluency in backend systems, data models, integrations, and configurable product architecture.

• Experience supporting extensive customer permutations without sacrificing usability.

• Ability to unite multiple domains under one strategy and operating model.

• Strong customer and Design judgment across employee, manager, finance, and accounting experiences.

• Concrete judgment about where AI should remove work and where human review matters.

• Strong cross-functional influence and an understanding of how product capabilities affect enterprise sales and adoption.

• Expense management experience is preferred; accounting, ERP, procurement, compliance, or adjacent enterprise-software experience can substitute.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $184,000 - $230,000.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Remote WFH Response Associate, Roadside Assistance (CSR)
jobs.description:
About Agero:

Wherever drivers go, we’re leading the way. Agero’s mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients’ relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we’re pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

Note: For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.

Role Description and Mission: The Job & Why It Matters

Are you a quick-thinking problem solver who thrives on helping others in their time of need? Do you want to make a real difference and have a lasting impact on customers?

Agero is actively seeking Remote Response Associates to join our Roadside Assistance department, where you will help rescue stranded customers off the side of the road. When a vehicle breaks down, you are the driver's first point of contact. Taking real-time inbound calls from motorists across the U.S., you will be the calming voice that turns an unpredictable, highly stressful situation into a solved problem. You will provide a clear roadmap of what they can expect next, guiding them through an urgent and unplanned event. Just like an everyday superhero, you are stepping in to save their day and get their plans back on track!

As a Remote Response Associate, you serve as a lifeline for customers facing roadside emergencies such as flat tires, lockouts, dead batteries, fuel deliveries, and towing due to mechanical failures. Because customers often reach out feeling overwhelmed or unsafe on the side of the road, in dark parking lots, or while traveling in unfamiliar areas, you will manage these high-stress situations with calm, empathetic guidance and consistent reassurance.

Leading with a customer-first mindset, you will coordinate directly with external service providers to ensure the accurate and rapid dispatch of tow trucks and service vehicles. Your ability to stay calm and make quick decisions under pressure directly impacts customer safety, satisfaction, and our reputation for service excellence as a trusted, industry-leading roadside provider.

Key Outcomes: What you'll do

• Handle High-Volume Calls: Gather essential details regarding location and vehicle issues to dispatch assistance quickly for stranded motorists in real-time.

• Dispatch with Accuracy: Coordinate efficiently with external service providers to ensure the right help arrives at the right time.

• De-escalate & Support: Use active listening and empathy to calm frustrated or anxious customers, navigating heightened emotions during uncertain situations.

• Navigate Digital Tools: Utilize multiple web-based systems and dispatch tools simultaneously to track service progress accurately.

• Excel in a Virtual Team: Thrive in a performance-driven remote environment, collaborating with peers and managers via Zoom and Google Chat.

Skills, Education, & Experience: What We’re Looking For

This isn’t your typical, script-reading customer service role. We have a high bar for talent because our drivers need real help in real-time. Every single call involves a stressful situation - some customers will be panicking, others might be crying, and many won't even know exactly where they are stranded. To succeed here, you need to bring your A-game every shift, every call.

Here are the skills you'll bring to the team:

• Empathy in Action: You have a natural ability to genuinely understand what a stranded driver is going through. You can authentically connect with people, stay patient, validate their fears, and give them the real reassurance they need when they are stuck in a dark parking lot or on a busy highway.

• Effective Communication & Listening: True communication starts with listening. You need to actively listen to absorb the critical details from a worried caller, ask the right questions, and probe for missing information. From there, you'll use a steady, confident voice to give clear directions to our roadside partners and explain the next steps to the customer so they feel completely guided.

• Sound Judgment Under Pressure: You don’t fold when things get chaotic. You can keep a cool head, think clearly, and make smart, fast decisions during unpredictable events. You are comfortable thinking outside the box to solve problems safely, but you also have the awareness to know exactly when a situation needs to be escalated for extra help.

• Problem-Solving & De-escalation: You bring a calm, professional attitude to every interaction. You have a knack for turning a stressful, negative situation into a smooth, positive experience by focused problem-solving.

• Multitasking Mastery: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two calls are identical. You can comfortably talk to a stranded driver or a tow provider while simultaneously typing detailed notes, navigating multiple screens, and pulling resources from our system without breaking your focus.

• Service Excellence: We leave no one stranded. You take total ownership of every single call and call-back. You don't just check a box or process a dispatch; you focus on the person behind the problem, ensuring both our customers and our roadside partners get high-quality, accurate, and timely support.

• Tech Proficiency: You are comfortable working with digital tools and fast-paced systems. You can confidently navigate online databases, CRMs, and complex dispatch software all at once. You are familiar with and comfortable using AI tools, a pro at using Google Maps to pinpoint exact locations, fluent in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Chat), and can type at least 30 WPM accurately without breaking the flow of a live conversation.

• Accountability & Reliability: Even in a remote environment, we hold our team to a high standard and operate a structured contact center with top-tier client expectations. select a dedicated production schedule with set days off. We require your consistent commitment to this schedule because a stranded driver is counting on you when you are on the clock. At the same time, due to the nature of our business, things move fast. Call volumes spike, schedules adjust, teams shift, and supervisors change - meaning you must be highly adaptable and ready to pivot.

Position Requirements:

• Location: You must currently physically reside in Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Missouri, Tennessee, or Virginia.

• Customer-Facing Experience: You bring 1+ years of continuous customer service experience, ideally in a fast-paced contact center environment. A steady work history, proven career growth, and previous remote experience are highly valued. We also love and look for transferable skills from retail, fast-food, hospitality, administrative, or warehouse/production environments!

• Background Check: You must successfully pass a comprehensive criminal background screening (covering 10 years for misdemeanors and a lifetime check for felonies) to protect customer security and client integrity.

• Workspace Needs: You must have a dedicated, quiet home office setup completely free from family, pet, or background noise. Associates are responsible for providing their own work equipment.

Remote Technology Requirements (BYOD):

To ensure you can support stranded drivers without technical lag, your home office setup must meet these exact specifications. We will verify your system using the Harver System Checker during the application process.

Your PC & Equipment Setup:

• Computer: A personal desktop or laptop manufactured in 2021 or later. Chromebooks, Macs, and tablets are not allowed.

• Operating System: A current, supported version of Windows 11 (specifically version 24H2, 25H2, or newer). Important Note: Microsoft has discontinued support for older Windows 11 versions, so you must be updated to be eligible.

• Processor: Intel or AMD with 2+ cores, minimum 3.5 GHz (boosted/turbo speed).

• Memory & Storage: Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 20 GB of free hard drive space.

• Peripherals: A working webcam (used for training & company meetings) and a high-quality USB-wired headset. Dual monitors are not required, but may be used if preferred.

• Browser: Google Chrome (version 23+) or Mozilla Firefox (version 3+).

• Hardwired Internet: A secure, hard-wired high-speed connection hooked directly into your router (modem) via an Ethernet cable. Wi-Fi is absolutely not allowed while working.

• Required Internet Speeds: Minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload. Maximum latency up to 80ms–100ms.

• Mobile Device: An active cell phone capable of receiving SMS text messages and downloading security apps for our mandatory two-step authentication process.

What Will NOT Work (Incompatible Setups):

• Work-Issued PCs: You must have full Administrator privileges to install our tools. Devices owned by previous employers and schools have strict security locks and cannot be used.

• Incompatible Devices: MacBooks, iPads, iMacs, Chromebooks, Surface Pro/Go, Samsung Notebooks, or any machines built before 2020.

• Incompatible Connections: Mobile hotspots, Wi-Fi, satellite internet, or USB phone tethering.

• Banned Software: Active VPNs, privacy/proxy services, or hosted/virtual PC platforms.

• Unsupported OS: All versions of Windows 10 and older, expired versions of Windows 11.

Pay, Benefits, & Career Growth:

• Solid Starting Pay: Earn a dependable base rate of $16.25 per hour.

• Premium Shift Differentials & Incentives: Boost your earnings with an extra $1.75 to $2.50 per hour in shift differentials for working evenings, nights, and weekends. You also have direct access to monthly performance and attendance bonuses, plus regular overtime opportunities based on business needs, and scheduled raises through merit increases.

• Comprehensive Benefits Package: We have you covered. Enjoy a full suite of medical, dental, and vision insurance options, a 401(k) program with a company match, Paid Time Off (PTO), tuition reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), referral bonus program, complimentary roadside assistance, and more.

• A Clear Path Upward: We invest heavily in your future. You will have direct access to online skill-building courses, professional mentorship, and cross-training programs designed to give you the exact expertise you need to climb the ladder and fast-track your career at Agero.

Start Dates, Training, & Production Schedules:

• Up-Coming Start Date(s): January 4th, 2027

• Mandatory Paid Training: To set you up for absolute success, 100% attendance is required during your first two weeks of mandatory classroom training (Monday–Friday). Because this foundational period is packed with essential learning, schedules cannot be modified. We assess performance throughout this time and look for opportunities to cross-train you to expand your skill set early on.

• Skill Expansion, Cross-Training, & Professional Growth: Participate in hands-on, cross-functional training to broaden your knowledge of roadside support, expanding your skillset across specialized lines of business.

• Selecting Your Shift: You will choose your full-time production schedule during the job offer process on a first-come, first-served basis. Training dates & schedules are set by Agero and based on business needs. The Roadside Assistance department is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to support stranded motorists when they need us most. Available production schedules will vary by start date and are subject to change.

• Schedule Commitment: Your production schedule is static for your first 90 days after training. After this 90-day milestone, you become eligible to request schedule changes. Our team also participates in semi-annual shift bids to keep things fair and flexible.

• 24/7 Roadside Reality: Because breakdowns don't take days off, we provide 24/7/365 coverage. This means most full-time production schedules include working at least one weekend day and holiday coverage. Full Time only. Weekend availability/flexibility is required.

Upcoming Training Classes:

CLASS A: MONDAY, DECEMBER 7TH, 2026

• Training: 9:00am - 5:30pm EST, Monday - Friday for two weeks. (100% attendance required).

• Production Schedules: All shifts are listed in Eastern Standard Time (EST). Mornings/Days: 6:00 am - 2:30 pm, 7:00 am - 3:30 pm, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm, 8:30 am - 5:00 pm, 9:00 am - 5:30 pm, 9:30 am - 6:00 pm, 10:30am - 7:00 pm Afternoons/Evenings: 11:00 am - 7:30 pm, 11:30 am - 8:00 pm, 12:00 pm - 8:30 pm, and 12:30 pm - 9:00 pm. No evening shifts available for this start date. Overnights: No overnight shifts available for this start date.

• Days Off: Days off are fixed and vary by shift. All available production schedules require working at least one weekend day.

• Full time only

CLASS B: MONDAY, JANUARY 4TH, 2027

• Training: 1:00pm - 9:30pm EST, Monday - Friday for two weeks. (100% attendance required).

• Production Schedules: All shifts are listed in Eastern Standard Time (EST). Mornings/Days: No morning/day shifts available for this start date. Afternoons/Evenings: 1:00pm - 9:30pm, 1:30pm - 10:00pm, 2:00pm - 10:30pm, 2:30pm - 11:00pm, 3:00pm - 11:30pm, 3:30pm - 12:00am, & 4:00pm - 12:30am Overnights: No overnight shifts available for this start date. 4x10's: To Be Determined

• Days Off: Days off are fixed and vary by shift. All available production schedules require working at least one weekend day.

• Full time only

What to Expect After You Apply:

• Immediately after you apply, check your inbox (and Spam folder) for a "Magic Link" from our vendor partner, Harver.

• Complete your Harver Computer Skills Assessment and Remote Technology Diagnostic right away. It only takes about 10 mins total to do this step.

• Keep an eye on your text messages and email for an update. Qualified candidates will be sent a calendar link to schedule an interview on Zoom with a Recruiter.

Hiring In:

• United States: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Missouri, Tennessee, and Virginia

The anticipated closing date to submit applications for this role is (Class A: 12/7/2026 start date) November 30th, 2026 by 5:00 pm and (Class B: 1/4/2027 start date) December 18th, 2026 by 5:00 pm EST. Join our Greenhouse Candidate Portal to track your application status and receive instant alerts for future openings.

The base salary range presented represents the anticipated low and high end salary range for new hires in this position. Your final base salary will be determined based on factors such as work location, experience, job related skills, and relevant training and education. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package provided by Agero to employees.

National Pay Range

$16.25 per hour USD

Life at Agero:

At Agero, you'll find a workplace where your unique perspective is not just welcomed, it's celebrated. We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we're committed to creating an environment where every employee feels a sense of belonging. If you're looking for a company that values your individuality, provides opportunities for growth, and champions open communication, Agero is the place for you. Join our team and help us drive the future of driver assistance, while experiencing a workplace where you can truly thrive.

Benefits Built for Well-being:

Agero’s innovation is driven by a workforce where all associates feel like they can truly thrive. Agero offers a wide range of benefits to promote well-being, encourage personal development, and ensure financial stability. Our benefits include:

• Health and Wellness: Healthcare, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and mental health benefits for associates and their families.

• Financial Security: 401(k) plan with company match and tuition assistance to support your future goals.

• Work-Life Balance: Flexible time off, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually. For Contact Center Roles: Accrual of up to 3 weeks Paid Time Off per year, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays annually.

Join Agero and experience a workplace that invests in your success both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Mental Health Therapist - W2 - Telehealth (Unrestricted LCSW,  LMFT w/Diagnostic Privilege - New York)
jobs.description:
About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.


About the Role
Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. With this program, you’ll have the resources and support you need to ensure that your clients get better—all while improving access to mental health care from your home or preferred setting. 
 
Daily: As a Lyra Care Therapist, you’ll provide short-term, evidence-based treatment via live video, maintaining a caseload of diverse and varied clinical needs. You’ll assign digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. An important note: Lyra's clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.
 
Regularly: Our therapists enjoy connecting with their peers, who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend one-on-one and peer group clinical consultation meetings, conduct peer-based quality assurance reviews, and attend robust training to enhance your clinical skills. You’ll always have access to expert consultation and support for your most complex clients. It’s like a safety net of resources to help plan the best options—from specialty consultations to culturally responsive care—you’re not alone, even while working remotely within the US. 
 
This role is a great fit if you're a licensed clinician with excellent interpersonal skills, who wants continuous learning and development in their professional career, and thrives in a feedback rich environment. If you have experience with caseloads that include a comprehensive spectrum of mental health needs, from milder presentations to more complex and severe support, we encourage you to apply. If you're comfortable with evolving processes and excited by a rapidly growing business, then this role is for you!

jobs.description:
Position Title: Project Finance & Infrastructure - Director (NY)

Entity: Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: New York, New York, United States

Summary/Overview:

Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC (KBRA, LLC) is seeking a Director to join our growing team with a focus on managing a complex, cross-jurisdictional, multi-sector portfolio of project finance and infrastructure transactions. The Associate Director/Director will work in a highly collaborative team that liaises with internal and external stakeholders to produce high quality and timely infrastructure and project finance credit opinions on a timely basis. The Associate Director/Director will also help conduct credit research on a variety of sectors, including analyzing and publishing trends, key rating factors, and evolving credit metrics. This individual will have significant interaction with senior management of issuers, and their advisors. This position is based in our New York office.

About the Job:

• Own and manage the surveillance portfolio for the Americas Project Finance & Infrastructure team, including surveillance calendars, review prioritization, upcoming committee requirements, watch items, and coordination of workload across the team.

• Lead the credit rating surveillance process by preparing and reviewing internal credit memos, analyzing cash flows, performing sector and transaction analysis, leading rating committees, and publishing credit reports. The role will involve ongoing monitoring of complex credits and identification of emerging credit risks.

• Identify, track, and escalate material credit developments and watch items, including changes in operating performance, construction progress, counterparties, financial performance, liquidity, covenant compliance, and other factors that could affect outstanding ratings.

• Oversee and review surveillance work performed by junior analysts, including delegation of assignments, review of financial models and credit analysis, and maintenance of consistent analytical and documentation standards across the portfolio.

• Monitor the application of procedures and processes as transactions transition from new issuance into surveillance, including the appropriate handoff of financial models, key rating assumptions, monitoring requirements, and transaction-specific risks.

• Analyze and sensitize complex Microsoft Excel-based financial models and maintain surveillance cases incorporating updated operating performance, financial information, and rating assumptions. Advanced financial modeling skills are an essential requirement.

• Coordinate with transaction leads and senior management on material portfolio developments, providing clear recommendations regarding ratings, outlooks, watch status, and the need for additional committee review.

• Maintain relationships with sponsors, management teams, financial advisors, and other transaction parties to facilitate ongoing surveillance and ensure the timely receipt of financial, operational, and other information necessary to monitor credit quality.

• Participate in live transactions and new rating assignments alongside the broader Project Finance & Infrastructure team, including transaction analysis, financial model review, evaluation of key credit risks, and participation in rating committees.

• Drive continuous improvement in surveillance processes and analytical tools, including identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and other technologies to improve portfolio monitoring, financial and document analysis, consistency, efficiency, and workflow management.

• Author sector research and portfolio commentary for investors and lenders across private credit, direct lending, and public debt markets.

• Assist in the development and evolution of rating processes, methodologies, analytical tools, and portfolio-monitoring frameworks.

• Mentor less experienced colleagues, providing guidance on credit analysis, financial modeling, surveillance processes, prioritization, professional judgment, and career development.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, management, or a related field.

• 6+ years of experience performing credit analysis in a rating agency, banking, buy-side, credit research, or similar environment, including financial modeling, cash flow analysis, and evaluation of complex credit risks.

• 3+ years of experience with deal execution, surveillance, or credit risk analysis of project and infrastructure finance transactions, including power and renewable energy project financings.

• Demonstrated experience monitoring a portfolio of complex credits, identifying and escalating emerging risks, managing multiple priorities and deadlines, and exercising independent credit judgment.

• Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, data insights, and general productivity is a plus.

Salary Range:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $150,000 to $200,000. Offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience, skills, geography, and other job-related factors.

Benefits:

• A hybrid work schedule (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday in the office)

• Competitive benefits and paid time off

• Paid family and disability leave

• 401(k) plan, including employer match (100% vested)

• Educational and professional development financial assistance

• Employee referral bonus program

About Us:

Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC (KBRA) is a full-service credit rating agency registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission as an NRSRO. Kroll Bond Rating Agency Europe Limited is registered as a CRA with the European Securities and Markets Authority. Kroll Bond Rating Agency UK Limited is registered as a CRA with the UK Financial Conduct Authority pursuant to the Temporary Registration Regime. In addition, KBRA is designated as a designated rating organization by the Ontario Securities Commission for issuers of asset-backed securities to file a short form prospectus or shelf prospectus. KBRA is also recognized by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners as a Credit Rating Provider.

More Info:

KBRA encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, and veteran status or any other basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Mid-Market Enterprise
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineeriIng teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As a Mid-Market Enterprise Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. 

This is a rare opportunity to work as one of the early hires for a new segment within Applied AI Engineering, contributing real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in our SF or NYC office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Partner directly with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

 - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

 - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

 - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

 - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

 - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

 - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

 - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Program Intern, Energy Settlements
jobs.description:
Are you a curious and driven student with a passion for numbers and a fresh perspective? Pilot Company is seeking a Program Intern for our Energy Settlements team in Houston, Texas, for the summer of 2027. This is a unique opportunity to directly support our core business operations by assisting with monthly tie outs, account reconciliations, and report generation.

In this role, you will be an integral part of our team, tackling key responsibilities that directly impact our operations. Your work will reduce the workload across the team, allowing our members to focus on high-priority projects. This will not only increase our overall delivery capacity but will also provide you with valuable experience and a fresh perspective that can spark new ideas for process and system improvements.

What You’ll Do

• Support Commodity Settlements: Assist with daily, weekly, and monthly settlement activities for physical oil-related products while learning the primary and secondary settlement processes.

• Assist with Invoice Reconciliation: Review invoices and supporting documentation to help identify discrepancies. Partner with the Settlements team and internal scheduling and trading teams to research contract terms and support timely resolution.

• Support Cash and Accrual Tracking: Help monitor incoming cash, review outstanding items, and research accrual balances to support the team’s internal cash and financial reporting goals.

• Review Contract and Payment Information: Assist with reviewing payment schedules, fees, rates, contract details, and payment timelines to help confirm that information is accurate.

• Provide Customer and Team Support: Help respond to questions from internal partners and external counterparties while developing an understanding of how timely resolution supports the business and helps prevent negative financial impacts.

• Contribute to Process Improvement: Bring a fresh perspective to existing settlement and accounting processes. Help identify opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and collaboration across the team.

• Apply Analytical Skills: Use analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills to research issues, organize information, and support business decisions.

• Support Pilot's Purpose and Standards: Model behaviors that support Pilot’s common purpose, provide excellent service to internal and external partners, and complete work in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.

What We’re Looking For

• Education: A student pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

• Technical Skills: Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. An interest in learning about accounts payable, accounts receivable, commodity settlements, and their impact on financial reporting is preferred.

• Analytical Skills: Strong attention to detail with the ability to apply analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

• Organization: Ability to prioritize assignments, manage deadlines, and produce accurate work in a fast-paced business environment.

• Communication and Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

• Learning Agility: A willingness to learn new processes and technologies, take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and apply feedback.

• Qualities: We value individuals who are Driven, Reliable, Authentic, and Welcoming.

Why Pilot Company?

Our culture is built on four core virtues: Driven, Reliable, Authentic, and Welcoming. As an intern, you will see these values in action every day. You'll be part of a team that is driven to meet deadlines, reliable in its commitment to accuracy, authentic in its interactions, and welcoming to new ideas and perspectives.

This is a full-time, in-person internship running from June 7 – August 13, 2027.  You’ll be working alongside our team in Houston, TX, where you’ll have the opportunity to build meaningful relationships and experience the full scope of life at Pilot Company.

jobs.title: Mental Health Therapist - Telehealth (Unrestricted LCSW, LMFT, LPC - New Jersey)
jobs.description:
About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.


About the Role
Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. With this program, you’ll have the resources and support you need to ensure that your clients get better—all while improving access to mental health care from your home or preferred setting. 
 
Daily: As a Lyra Care Therapist, you’ll provide short-term, evidence-based treatment via live video, maintaining a caseload of diverse and varied clinical needs. You’ll assign digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. An important note: Lyra's clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.
 
Regularly: Our therapists enjoy connecting with their peers, who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend one-on-one and peer group clinical consultation meetings, conduct peer-based quality assurance reviews, and attend robust training to enhance your clinical skills. You’ll always have access to expert consultation and support for your most complex clients. It’s like a safety net of resources to help plan the best options—from specialty consultations to culturally responsive care—you’re not alone, even while working remotely within the US. 
 
This role is a great fit if you're a licensed clinician with excellent interpersonal skills, who wants continuous learning and development in their professional career, and thrives in a feedback rich environment. If you have experience with caseloads that include a comprehensive spectrum of mental health needs, from milder presentations to more complex and severe support, we encourage you to apply. If you're comfortable with evolving processes and excited by a rapidly growing business, then this role is for you!

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Retail Partnerships & Channel Marketing
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

The Senior Manager, Retail Marketing & Retail Partnerships owns retail marketing end to end across Tonal's owned and operated stores and our retail partner locations — a footprint of roughly 130 doors. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Retail, this role is the bridge between Tonal's brand vision and the retail floor experience.

This is a build role. Corporate and field communications do not exist as a program today, and this person will create them: the cadence, the channels, and the content that keep every team selling Tonal aligned. Alongside that, they will own the retail marketing calendar and channel plan, the in-store experience, and the corporate-level relationship with our retail partners.

If you want to own a function rather than run a calendar, this is that role.




WHAT YOU WILL DO


RETAIL MARKETING STRATEGY & CHANNEL PLANNING

 - Own the annual and quarterly retail marketing calendar across owned and operated stores and retail partner locations

 - Set the retail channel plan — what runs where, when, and why — aligned to key sales periods, product launches, and brand moments

 - Provide retail channel input to the Marketing team on creative, messaging, and format requirements before assets go into production

 - Partner with the Marketing and Growth teams on geo marketing plans tied to store trade areas, translating national brand moments into market-level activation

 - Feed door-level performance and local market insight back into growth and lifecycle planning

 - Identify growth opportunities across the retail footprint and propose programs that drive incremental revenue


BUILD & OWN RETAIL COMMUNICATIONS

 - Build Tonal's retail communications function from the ground up — corporate communications and field communications for owned and operated teams and retail partners

 - Establish the recurring communication rhythm: what is launching, what is promoting, what changes on the floor, and what the team needs to say

 - Own the channels, templates, and calendar that make retail communications consistent and dependable rather than ad hoc

 - Partner with the Learning & Development Lead so communications and training reinforce one another; L&D owns curriculum, this role owns the communication function


RETAIL PARTNERSHIPS — CORPORATE ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT

 - Serve as the corporate-level relationship owner for Tonal's retail partnerships, managing the day-to-day operating rhythm

 - Prepare and lead retail partner business reviews — performance, program results, and forward plan

 - Own recurring retail partner marketing updates so partner-facing content never goes stale

 - Build the evergreen and promotional campaign resource kits retail partners need to execute independently

 - Support retail partner onboarding and launch as the retail footprint grows

 - Partner closely with our Field Leaders, who own selling behaviors and in-field sales performance, so corporate programs and field execution stay connected


IN-STORE EXPERIENCE, MERCHANDISING & PRODUCTION

 - Own planograms, seasonal resets, and visual merchandising standards across owned and partner locations

 - Ensure planogram compliance and brand standards are consistently upheld across all retail locations

 - Receive final production files from the Marketing team and own everything downstream: print vendor management, spec accuracy, timelines, distribution, and install

 - Manage print and fixture vendors against clear deliverables, budgets, and deadlines

 - Own the retail asset library so every location always has current, on-brand materials


ANALYTICS & REPORTING

 - Track and report on retail marketing KPIs including traffic, demos, conversion, and return on ad spend

 - Manage co-op and program budgets and joint planning with retail marketing counterparts

 - Conduct competitive landscape analysis and provide actionable recommendations to leadership

 - Manage agency relationships and hold external partners accountable to deliverables and performance benchmarks




WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years of marketing experience, with a minimum of 3 years in a retail, channel, or partner marketing role

 - Demonstrated success developing and executing retail marketing programs at scale

 - Experience across both owned retail and partner retail channels

 - A builder: you have created a program, a process, or a communications function that did not exist before you got there

 - Exceptional written communication

 - Hands-on print production and vendor management: you have checked the spec, chased the vendor, and seen the install through

 - Planogram and visual merchandising fluency across multiple store formats

 - Experience managing partner relationships and co-op or program budgets

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - Comfortable presenting to senior internal and partner stakeholders

 - Proficiency in marketing analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Salesforce)

 - Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred




EXTRA CREDIT

 - Experience in consumer electronics, fitness, or premium lifestyle categories

jobs.description:
About Lyra
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.
 
FURTHER EXPANDING ACCESS: We are currently prioritizing hiring clinicians, counselors, mental health providers, psychologists, and therapists in Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Massachusetts, New York, North Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington.
 
We will continue to welcome applications from all other states, and sponsor cross-licensure across selected states to ensure clinicians are set up for success to support caseload goals. As always, thank you for your continued interest in Lyra Health!
 
 
About the Role
Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. With this program, you’ll have the resources and support you need to ensure that your clients get better—all while improving access to mental health care from your home or preferred setting. 
 
Daily: As a Lyra Care Therapist, you’ll provide short-term, evidence-based treatment via live video, maintaining a caseload of diverse and varied clinical needs. You’ll assign digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. An important note: Lyra's clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.
 
Regularly: Our therapists enjoy connecting with their peers, who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend one-on-one and peer group clinical consultation meetings, conduct peer-based quality assurance reviews, and attend robust training to enhance your clinical skills. You’ll always have access to expert consultation and support for your most complex clients. It’s like a safety net of resources to help plan the best options—from specialty consultations to culturally responsive care—you’re not alone, even while working remotely within the US. 
 
This role is a great fit if you're a licensed clinician with excellent interpersonal skills, who wants continuous learning and development in their professional career, and thrives in a feedback rich environment. If you have experience with caseloads that include a comprehensive spectrum of mental health needs, from milder presentations to more complex and severe support, we encourage you to apply. If you're comfortable with evolving processes and excited by a rapidly growing business, then this role is for you!

jobs.title: Senior Behavior Therapist
jobs.description:
SENIOR BEHAVIOR THERAPIST (SR. BT) — ABA THERAPY

Starting at $50k to $52k annnual pay| | Full-Time | No Evenings or Weekends

ANNA Autism Care is hiring experienced, dedicated Senior Behavior Therapists (Sr. BTs) to deliver expert-level therapy to children with Autism using the Naturalistic Developmental Behavioral Intervention (NDBI) approach. Senior BTs combine advanced clinical practice with peer coaching, mentorship, and support for ANNA’s clinical quality initiatives.

As the highest level of ANNA’s Behavior Therapist career ladder, this role connects hands-on clinical care with opportunities for leadership development. Working under the guidance of a BCBA or Clinical Director, Senior BTs model clinical excellence, support fellow therapists, and exemplify ANNA’s core values through professionalism, expertise, and leadership.




WHAT ANNA AUTISM CARE OFFERS:

 - Pay & Benefits: starts at $50,000 to $52,000 annnual pay; Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, and paid time off.

 - Clinic-Based Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM. No evenings, no weekends.

 - Leadership & Mentorship Opportunities: Coach BT1–BT3 staff, model high-quality therapy practices, and help onboard and train new employees.

 - Advanced Clinical Experience: Deliver expert-level NDBI interventions while contributing to client assessments, clinical quality initiatives, and collaborative care.

 - Training & Clinical Support: Participate in training, supervision, and competency evaluations with guidance from BCBAs and Clinical Directors.

 - Career Development: Grow at the highest level of ANNA’s Behavior Therapist career ladder, with opportunities to develop leadership and mentoring skills.

 - Collaborative Team Culture: Work alongside a team guided by ANNA’s core values of Growth, Excellent Care, Kindness, Inclusion, and Teamwork.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Implement individualized therapy plans using evidence-based NDBI approaches, working independently under BCBA guidance while maintaining consistent clinical quality.

 - Follow prescribed behavior-reduction and skill-acquisition protocols with high fidelity. Achieve 90% fidelity in intervention implementation across three clients, as assessed through observation by a BCBA or Clinical Director.

 - Collect accurate, real-time data on client behavior and skill acquisition using approved electronic data systems.

 - Assist with client assessments and communicate client progress, behavioral trends, and skill mastery to BCBAs, Clinical Directors, and fellow team members. Report progress according to BCBA guidance.

 - Lead peer mentorship, fidelity modeling, and training initiatives for BT1–BT3 staff.

 - Support onboarding and training activities for new employees.

 - Prepare and organize therapy materials, spaces, and session environments to promote client engagement and maintain a safe, positive atmosphere.

 - Assist with client transitions while maintaining professional boundaries, clinical integrity, and a calm, organized therapy environment.

 - Facilitate clinic initiatives, organize circle time sessions, and coordinate group activities.

 - Support daily clinic operations by maintaining clean, organized spaces, preparing necessary materials, and assisting staff as needed.

 - Participate actively in all required training, supervision, and competency evaluations.

 - Maintain client confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and all ANNA privacy policies.


QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Education: Either a bachelor’s degree or a high school diploma (or equivalent) and at least one year of experience working with children.

 - Experience: Strong performance and fidelity record.

 - Advanced Clinical Competence: Demonstrated understanding of NDBI principles, advanced data collection skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality services independently under BCBA guidance.

 - Leadership & Mentorship: Strong leadership and peer coaching skills, with the ability to model effective clinical practices and support fellow therapists.

 - Collaboration & Professionalism: Ability to work effectively within a team, incorporate feedback productively, and maintain a proactive, professional approach.

 - Required Certification & Training: CPR certification, HIPAA training, and Mandated Reporter training are required.

 - ANNA Training: Completion of ANNA Autism Care’s BT Training Program is mandatory.

 - Reliability: Consistently meet attendance, punctuality, and communication expectations.


PROFESSIONAL EXPECTATIONS:

 - Attendance & Punctuality: Arrive on time, ready to work, and prepared for all assigned sessions. Notify your supervisor at least two hours in advance when running late or unable to attend a scheduled shift. More than two unexcused absences or three tardy occurrences within a 90-day period may result in corrective action.

 - Communication & Schedule Awareness: Check all communication channels multiple times daily, respond promptly, and monitor your work schedule throughout the day for changes. Employees are responsible for staying informed and arriving on time; failure to review communications is not an acceptable reason for missed updates or shifts.

 - Professional Conduct: Maintain professionalism in appearance, language, and demeanor. Treat clients, families, and colleagues respectfully, and follow ANNA’s confidentiality, ethical, and conduct standards at all times.

Apply today! ANNA is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

ANNA is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, disability, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), or any other characteristic protected by law. If you're passionate about our mission but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective might be exactly what we need.

We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.
 
Regularly: Our therapists enjoy connecting with their peers, who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend one-on-one and peer group clinical consultation meetings, conduct peer-based quality assurance reviews, and attend robust training to enhance your clinical skills. You’ll always have access to expert consultation and support for your most complex clients. It’s like a safety net of resources to help plan the best options—from specialty consultations to culturally responsive care—you’re not alone, even while working remotely within the US. 
 
This role is a great fit if you're a licensed clinician with excellent interpersonal skills, who wants continuous learning and development in their professional career, and thrives in a feedback rich environment. If you have experience with caseloads that include a comprehensive spectrum of mental health needs, from milder presentations to more complex and severe support, we encourage you to apply. If you're comfortable with evolving processes and excited by a rapidly growing business, then this role is for you!

jobs.title: Software Systems Integration Engineer II
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

At Relativity Space, the success of our Terran R vehicle operations relies on software systems that are robust, well-integrated, and rigorously tested. The Software Systems Engineering team is a multidisciplinary function responsible for ensuring that the integrated software system that supports vehicle operations is functional, scalable, performant, and ready for test and launch activities in alignment with the program schedule and risk posture. We bridge the gap between vehicle software, ground systems, and hardware teams to ensure reliable end-to-end system functionality. Our focus includes system-level requirements development, safety engineering and analysis, software-hardware integration, risk management, system-level debugging, launch-readiness verification, and operations support. We play a critical role in mission success by ensuring all software components work seamlessly across the full stack—from control centers to the vehicle in flight.

About the Role:

• Own and drive Software system-level design verification and validation activities, including development and execution of test matrices and test plans with traceability to requirements, and identification of pass/fail criteria

• Develop manuals, documentation, and data dashboards for monitoring of Software systems health and performance during engine and vehicle integration, test, and launch activities

• Define and build process around software configuration and change management and related tooling; provide critical feedback and input to tooling development teams; help educate users and software development teams

• Coordinate Software readiness reviews of all Software systems in advance of test and launch operations

• Support test and launch activities on behalf of Software -- coordination of integration and test activities between Engineering and Operations, anomaly investigations, pre-test/launch readiness evaluations, post-test/launch data reviews, and on-console support

About You:

• Undergraduate or graduate degree (BS/MS/PhD) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• 2+ years of experience in software systems design/analysis; system-level test; systems engineering; or equivalent

• Familiarity with basic software development and test/verification concepts such as version control, configuration management, debugging, static analysis, unit/integration/system testing, etc.

• Familiarity with Python, GitLab/Git, CI/CD

• 25-50% travel to our Stennis and Cape Canaveral sites to support software bring up and vehicle test/launch operations

• Demonstrated problem-solving and communication skills

Nice to haves but not required:

• Familiarity with C++, Rust

• Working knowledge of fundamentals of launch vehicles

• Experience with data analysis and visualization, especially with time series data and SQL databases

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Hiring Range:

$130,000—$196,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@relativityspace.com.

Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.

jobs.description:
Skeletons, lasers, tattoo buses — the Torq brand grabs attention like nothing else in cybersecurity. And we're growing like crazy, backed by Series D funding, 200% employee growth, and 300% revenue growth. Fueling Torq's momentum is our game-changing AI SOC platform, backed by a team and culture that makes Torq one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in America, and a Business Insider 'startup to bet your career on'.

jobs.title: Principal Sourcer, Executive Recruiting
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Principal Sourcer to join our Executive Recruiting team as an analytical talent consultant, not a traditional sourcer. This role is part senior sourcer, part executive search researcher. You'll support our active executive searches and also build leadership talent ahead of need. You'll find, map and engage the Director+ and IC6+ leaders who will build the future of the AI Data Cloud across Engineering, Product Management and Frontier Engineering.




AS A PRINCIPAL SOURCER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Prepare and contribute search intake with Executive Recruiters and hiring leaders across Engineering, Product Management and Frontier Engineering. Set target companies, target profiles for Engineering and Product Management Director+ and IC roles, including principal and distinguished engineers.

 - Engage directly with senior leaders via networking and assessment to identify and pitch top talent, while garnering valuable insights that will fuel shifts in sourcing strategies over time.

 - Map the full talent landscape and build complete, calibrated slates, so leaders choose from the whole market rather than a few known names. Keep long-term executive pipelines and succession benches for critical leadership roles.

 - Leave no stone unturned when researching thin, competitive and emerging talent markets. Build talent in circles out from direct competitors to adjacent spaces, and find unusual channels for niche leadership roles in databases, distributed systems, AI/ML, data engineering, security and developer platforms.

 - Reverse-engineer competitor organizations by mapping org charts, how many people each leader manages, and who reports to whom across hyperscalers, data and AI platform companies, research labs and high-growth startups.

 - Utilize a combination of news and AI to track and share competitive intelligence, including leadership moves, reorgs and layoffs at peer companies, and send leaders regular talent market updates.

 - Give hiring leaders data-driven talent insights, with frank advice on market realities, how much talent exists, hiring trends, and pay and org design benchmarks for leadership roles.

 - Write highly personalized outreach that speaks to what motivates senior executives and stands out in a crowded market, creating moments that matter for leaders from first contact through handoff to the search team.

 - Own research operations: keep mapping data, tools and recruiting-system records clean, and build research assets the team can reuse. Tools include LinkedIn Recruiter, patents, academic and industry publications, and AI-powered tools.

 - Experiment, innovate and build with Snowflake’s internal AI tools, helping shape the next generation of executive recruiting and talent intelligence capabilities.


OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOURCER WILL HAVE:

 - 10+ years of experience in sourcing, executive research or front-end recruiting at an executive search firm or a specialized in-house talent acquisition team.

 - Executive research experience on Director, Senior Director and VP searches, or senior technical IC searches, across complex technology companies.

 - Deep experience in market mapping, competitive intelligence and reaching passive executives, rather than relying on inbound or transactional channels.

 - Strong skills in reverse-engineering organizations, with a proven ability to rebuild competitor org structures and leadership reporting lines.

 - Enough technical fluency to engage senior engineers and product leaders credibly and judge their technical depth.

 - An advisory style, with the ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and influence them with data-driven recommendations.

 - Excellent writing skills, plus sound judgment and discretion on confidential searches.

 - A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Research experience at a retained executive search firm plus in-house executive recruiting at a high-growth technology company.

 - Familiarity with the AI, data and cloud ecosystem, including research labs and AI-native startups.

 - Experience building talent intelligence or market mapping programs from scratch.

 - Experience using generative AI tools to scale research, mapping and outreach.




WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Our Executive Recruiting team shapes the leadership that will define Snowflake's next chapter. You will work directly with senior technical leaders on the searches that matter most, and help shape how Snowflake attracts and builds world-class leadership talent across Engineering, Product and Frontier Engineering.



Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com
