jobs.title: Creative Technologist, Audio
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a musician who builds. Someone who uses generative audio every day, knows where it breaks, and can’t stop asking what it does next.

You’ll join the Applied Research team, part of the Creative Team at Stability AI, and report to the Head of Creative. We’re artists who can’t help building the tools we wish we had. We’re always experimenting, making, and thinking about what should come next. Music, films, worlds, games. We believe anything is possible. We just have to make it.

Your mission is to build with the Stable Audio models our Research team creates. You hear every new model before anyone else does. You push it past its documented limits, unlock new functionality, and turn that into something people want to use.

You’ll also be the hands behind our customer work. Film studios, game teams, agencies, and music platforms bring us their hardest audio problems. You’ll partner with Revenue to turn their brief into something they can hear, build the prototype that solves it, and get them as excited about it as we are. Then you’ll make it work for every customer after.

Your experiments become the tracks the company passes around like a mixtape. Your demos get the room talking. And everything you build is aimed at the product. This role will evolve as the company grows. That’s part of the fun.

What you’ll do

• Own your work end to end: your prototypes, your fine-tunes, and your builds around research and customer projects, from first demo to delivery.

• Be the first user of every model, API, and feature we make, and give Research, Product, and Engineering honest feedback.

• Move fast. We’re a startup in an industry that changes every week, and we keep up by shipping, not planning.

• Know what’s relevant right now in music, sound, and AI, and what the community is excited about.

• Develop smart, provocative ideas, and make music and sound that impress musicians, sound designers, and customers.

• Partner with Revenue and lead the creative and technical side of customer conversations. Find the real problem behind the ask and shape the right solution, even if it's not the one they came in with. Then turn the best ones into products.

• Fine-tune Stable Audio with LoRA and adapters for styles, instruments, sound libraries, and artist identities.

• Experiment with control: key, chords, tempo, structure, inpainting, audio-to-audio, stems, and stacking LoRAs.

• Prototype for real use cases like remixing, sound design, library expansion, sonic branding, video scoring, and tools for people who aren’t musicians.

• Support the research and product roadmaps so your code fits their codebase, and with Product and Engineering to move prototypes into the product and make them fast.

• Partner with our Art Director and Designer to present your prototypes and demos at their best.

• Demo to the company and make demo videos for the community, using the team’s internal tools and AI toolkits.

What you’ll need

• 4+ years of hands-on experience with generative audio, ML, or creative technology, including projects you owned from first idea to delivery, or equivalent work you can show us.

• You’re a musician first. You write, produce, perform, or design sound, and you’re fluent in at least one DAW like Ableton, Logic, or Pro Tools.

• Hands-on experience training LoRA and other parameter-efficient adapters on diffusion models. You know how rank, learning rate, and dataset size trade off against overfitting.

• Experience with conditioning and control: conditioning adapters (ControlNet, T2I-Adapter, IP-Adapter, or their audio counterparts), new conditioning signals like chroma or structure, and how captions shape what a model responds to.

• Solid understanding of latent diffusion and diffusion transformers (DiT): latent spaces and VAEs, text encoders, samplers, and guidance.

• You can build a training set from scratch: source it, clean it, and write captions that teach the model the right vocabulary.

• You can read a research paper, get its code running, and adapt it to Stable Audio. You’re comfortable in Python and PyTorch, whether you write it yourself or build with AI tools like Claude.

• You thrive in ambiguity and can explain technical work to anyone, from researchers to a customer on a call. You bring warmth and energy, build trust fast, make non-musicians feel smart, and take feedback with open ears.

• You have an up-to-date portfolio of music, models, or tools you’ve made. Show us your demos and how you present them to the world.

Nice to haves

• Experience with Stable Audio and its open weights.

• Working knowledge of music theory: keys, harmony, chord progressions, and rhythm.

• Curiosity about visual generative AI, especially building on top of video models and video-to-audio.

• Experience building workflows in ComfyUI or other node-based tools.

• Experience building plugins or interfaces for DAWs, MIDI, or Web Audio.

• Open-source contributions to audio, music, or AI tools.

• Background in film and TV post, game audio (Wwise, FMOD), advertising, or music libraries.

• Experience at a startup or a creative audio tool company.

• You make content. Video editing, social, or an audience that already follows your work.

Benefits & Compensation

• A remote-first company with teammates across multiple countries who bring diverse perspectives, and flexibility built into how we collaborate.

• Health coverage for you and your family. Choose from PPO and HMO plans, including select plans where Stability AI covers 100% of premiums for you and your eligible dependents.

• HSA and FSA accounts to set aside pre-tax dollars for healthcare and other eligible expenses.

• Company-paid life insurance, with the option to add voluntary coverage for yourself, your spouse, and your children.

• Short- and long-term disability coverage, to protect part of your income if illness or injury keeps you from working.

• 401(k) with company match of up to 4%.

• Paid parental leave to support you as your family grows.

• Flexible paid time off, plus paid company holidays.

• The equipment you need to do your best work, provided by Stability AI.

At Stability AI, we aim to pay fairly and competitively, and we believe you should know what a role pays before you invest time in getting to know us. The annual base salary range for this role is $122,850 - $175,500 USD. It reflects our good-faith expectation for the role as posted and applies to candidates hired within the United States.

Where you fall within that range depends on the depth and relevance of your experience, your skills, and how you perform in our interview process. Because great candidates don’t always map neatly to a single level, we may also consider someone for a level above or below the one posted. If we do, the range will be adjusted to match, and we’ll talk it through with you openly.

Base salary is also just one part of your total compensation. Eligible employees take part in our equity program and receive the benefits described above. We’d rather talk about all of this early than leave you guessing, so your recruiter is happy to walk you through the range, how offers come together, and anything else that matters to you, at any point in the process.

Privacy Policy

To learn how we collect, use, and protect your information during the hiring process, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Technical Training Manager
jobs.description:
Why DH Pace?

The DH Pace Company is a family-owned and privately held business with annual sales over $1 billion through 60+ offices located across the continental United States. The Company is an industry leader in the distribution, installation, maintenance, and repair of a complete range of commercial, industrial, and residential door, docking and security products. In 2026, DH Pace is celebrating its 100th anniversary in business.

DH Pace Company, Inc. is hiring a Technical Training Manager in our Olathe, KS office! The Technical Trainer Manager designs and delivers hands-on technical training that builds safe, consistent, and skilled technicians across DH Pace locations. This role owns the path from new-hire technical onboarding through product and skill progression for residential garage door technicians, with planned expansion into select commercial applications over time.

What You'll Do

• Design, maintain, and update technical curricula for new and experienced technicians, aligned to residential garage door product lines, including doors, springs and hardware, openers, and related accessories. Curricula may expand over time to cover select commercial applications.

• Build a clear hand on competency model and skill progression (for example: helper / trainee, technician, senior technician) with observable standards for install, service, troubleshooting, and customer interaction.

• Write job aids, checklists, and standard work that field supervisors can use after formal training ends.

• Keep materials current with manufacturer updates, code changes, and lessons from warranty, callbacks, and safety incidents

• Deliver new-hire technical onboarding: safety fundamentals, tools, product identification, basic electrical and mechanical principles, and supervised practice on training equipment.

• Run hands-on courses and skills labs at a training location and at branches, including spring and cable systems, openers, controls, and safe work at heights.

• Conduct field coaching and ride-alongs to close the gap between classroom performance and job-site performance.

• Assess competency through practical demonstrations, not paper tests alone. Document results and recommend readiness for independent work.

• Partner with the National Service Sales Manager to identify when to recommend repair versus replacement and to present good, better, best options to customers.

• Coach branch managers and lead technicians so on-the-job training is consistent after the trainer leaves the branch.

• Embed safety into every module: lockout/tagout, fall protection, ladder and lift use, spring and counterbalance hazards, electrical safety, and PPE. Training does not replace the safety program; it reinforces it.

• Partner with Safety, Operations, and Employee Relations on incident learnings and repeat failure modes, and convert those into training changes.

• Support quality goals: fewer callbacks, cleaner installs, accurate paperwork, and technicians who can explain the work to the customer.

jobs.title: Staff Optical Network Engineering
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.




*Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.


Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

Our vision is bold and is not an incremental exercise. We will continually re-evaluate and reinvent our current ways of working and the automation underneath all of it, while operating the existing network flawlessly for all customer workloads.

Lambda has 10x'd over the last three years, and the network engineering organization is scaling to match. We're looking for a Staff Optical Network Engineer to lead building our metro, backbone and customer interconnectivity. This connectivity is going to play a critical role to ensure a flawless customer connectivity experience to our GPU cloud infrastructure. We're looking for an experienced senior engineer with deep technical expertise to own optical based outcomes end to end — and to set the technical direction for how it scales. You'll mentor and grow engineers across the organization, automate everything we do, shape team culture, and partner with technical leadership to deliver other mechanisms needed to stay ahead of our scale ambitions.

This role will report to the Director of Network Capacity Delivery, working alongside a highly capable and passionate team of engineers.

If you'd like to join a great team of customer obsessed engineers building the world's best AI cloud, come join us.


What You'll Do

 - Own optical network planning, design, delivery and operation end to end — and be accountable for capacity landing ahead of demand

 - Set optical standards, reference designs and runbooks used by engineers and field teams

 - Shape the multi-year technical optical transport strategy for capacity, performance and delivery to ensure it continually scales

 - Be a subject matter expert for our automation strategy - the goal is a capacity pipeline that runs without heroics, not a better-organized set of runbooks

 - Own the operational bar for the optical network: how capacity work is planned, reviewed, shipped, measured and learned from when it goes wrong

 - Mentor peer engineers and grow their scope and technical depth in optical networking

 - Partner and support our Interconnect team who negotiate, acquire and coordinate on external connectivity

 - Partner with engineers and technical leadership to maintain a high engineering bar across design, code quality and operational reliability

 - Own vendor relationships for optical systems and evaluate new platforms and pluggables and recommend what we adopt to scale capacity

 - Partner with Infrastructure, Supply Chain, Data Center Operations, Product and Finance to align capacity roadmaps, forecast demand and manage long-lead dependencies

 - Represent organization’s work and technical direction to senior leadership, and to enterprise customers and partners where appropriate

 - Contribute to org-wide engineering process improvements — how we plan, how we ship, how we learn from incidents

You

 - Have 8+ years of optical engineering experience

 - Proven track record designing, delivering and operating mission-critical, high performance optical networks at scale

 - Production experience with long haul and metro DWDM systems, coherent optics, optical link engineering, line system balancing, troubleshooting and operations

 - Collaborate effectively with vendors on optical systems and fiber teams on route design, diversity and acceptance

 - Bring a data driven, automation first, high velocity organization

 - Strong automation skills and track record accelerating delivery velocity at scale

 - Raise the technical bar around you through design reviews, standards and mentoring

 - Are skilled at translating ambiguous business and product goals into clear technical design and executable plans

 - Show strong judgment about when to go deep technically and when to escalate

 - Track record of successful project and product delivery in fast-paced, high-pressure environments

 - Excellent communicator both written and verbal. You leverage high quality written artifacts to inform high quality decision making and drive alignment on problems and solutions

Nice to Have

 - Experience in GPU cloud, HPC, or AI/ML infrastructure environments

 - Familiarity with large-scale data center or cloud networking — fabric build-out, capacity modeling, or network supply chain

 - Experience with infrastructure capacity forecasting and long-lead hardware planning

 - Prior experience at a high-growth infrastructure or cloud company

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.




About Lambda

 - Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

 - Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

jobs.title: Vehicle Fluids Engineer I
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Stage Fluids team is responsible for the design and delivery of propellant, pressurant, pneumatics, and other fluid systems that turn structures into functioning rockets! The team has full ownership across design, production, test, and flight, maintaining a holistic view of Terran R, focused not on isolated parts but integrated functionality. Working on-site at the factory means you’re never far from the hardware, enabling rapid iteration and tight feedback loops across design and manufacturing. You won’t just be handed requirements: you’ll be expected to ask the right questions, collaborate with partners across the company, and ultimately find the best solutions for Terran R.

About the Role:

In this role, you will be responsible for the hardware design and implementation of the vehicle fluid architecture, ensuring a reliable and efficient operation of our Terran R launch vehicle. Your primary tasks will be focused on:

Primary Responsibilities:
• Fluid routing and system-level trade studies
• Mechanical verification of fluid system hardware (hand calculations and FEA)
• Structural design of pressure components, mounting hardware, and tubing
• Hardware testing, validation, and health assessment
• Basic fluid system analysis and general architecture support
• Production support, on-floor troubleshooting and incorporation of direct feedback to improve hardware designs

To succeed in this role, you will bring a solid foundation in fundamental physics and the ability to apply first principles thinking to complex problems. You are self-motivated, adaptable, and thrive in a fast-paced, highly
integrated and collaborative vehicle development environment.  This role offers the opportunity to directly contribute to vehicle stage hardware while accelerating your professional growth in a culture that values collaboration, ownership, technical rigor, and calculated risk-taking.

The right person for this role will need to be someone who enjoys collaboration in a highly dynamic team environment. They will have end to end ownership of their designs and immediately see hardware you designed come to fruition. They must be flexible to changes in strategic direction and willing to take full ownership of their projects to ensure we as a company produce the best

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in a science, engineering, technology, or mathematics field

• Hands-on hardware experience with fluid and/or mechanical systems

• Demonstrated drive to deliver on ambitious schedules, especially if unconventional & creative solutions are necessary to do so

• 1+ years of related experience (full time, internships or projects)

• Hiring Timeline: We are actively hiring for immediate openings. Candidates should have completed their degree requirements and be available to begin full-time employment within 30–60 days of applying. If your availability falls outside this window, we encourage you to return and apply when you are within 30–60 days of being available to start full-time employment.

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

jobs.description:
About Snorkel

Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

About the Role

Snorkel AI is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead a team building the foundational systems of our AI data factory. Customers come to us for evals, benchmarks and training data. This agent-first platform is how we produce at scale and quality. You’ll be responsible for large eval workflows that run end to end, from the infrastructure that executes them to the tooling that tunes them. It also includes the tools to create and review both data and the RL environments across many current and future modalities.

You’ll own the roadmap, technical strategy, and execution quality of your team. You’ll find where the biggest leverage is for our internal teams and build the systems that remove bottlenecks, whether that’s cutting the time to stand up a new eval, supporting a new modality, or making expert review faster and more reliable. You’ll work across our Platform, Delivery and Research teams to build reusable platform capabilities. You’ll know the systems well enough to challenge designs and propose better ones while meeting the urgency required at the frontier of AI.

What You’ll Do

• Set the team’s technical direction, operating model, roadmap, and execution standards.

• Lead engineers as they turn one-off scripts, notebooks, and prototypes into systematized, scalable, production-grade services.

• Own technical and execution decisions, partnering with tech leads on architecture, design reviews, and quality.

• Partner with teams across the company to understand what they’ve proven out and translate it into scalable engineering solutions.

• Establish standards for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, observability, on-call, and SLOs so systems run reliably at scale.

• Set clear priorities, plans, and delivery commitments, balancing systematization work with reliability, governance, cost, and developer velocity.

• Build scalable playbooks, internal tooling, and shared libraries so promising ideas can be systematized more quickly.

• Hire, develop, and retain a strong engineering team.

• Coach engineers and tech leads to take ownership beyond their immediate projects.

• Provide technical guidance, review designs, unblock difficult problems, and step into the code when it matters.

• Help productionize new approaches and continuously improve Snorkel’s engineering capabilities.

What You’ll Bring

• 6+ years of software engineering experience, with strong technical depth.

• 2+ years of experience managing a team of engineers.

• A track record of taking promising but one-off approaches—such as scripts, prototypes, or experimental workflows—and turning them into reliable, scaled production systems.

• Strong technical judgment across backend and data-platform engineering, including distributed systems, data pipelines, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. You can evaluate architecture decisions, not just delegate them.

• Experience hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to understand stakeholder needs and translate them into engineering plans.

• Experience establishing engineering standards and operational practices, including testing, CI/CD, observability, and on-call, in a fast-moving environment.

• A pragmatic approach to systematization: you know the difference between infrastructure for its own sake and infrastructure that helps the company ship.

• Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration; you can set direction before every requirement is settled.

Locations

New York; San Francisco Bay Area

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $260,000 – $350,000. This range reflects multiple factors, including role level and work location. The final offer within this range will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, interview performance, and other business considerations. Offers include equity and benefits.

#LI-CG1

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

Salary range(s) for this role

$260,000—$350,000 USD

Be Your Best at Snorkel

Joining Snorkel AI means becoming part of a company that has market proven solutions, robust funding, and is scaling rapidly—offering a unique combination of stability and the excitement of high growth. As a member of our team, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to shape priorities and initiatives, influence key strategic decisions, and directly impact our ongoing success. Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical expertise, explore leadership opportunities, or learn new skills across multiple functions, you’re fully supported in building your career in an environment designed for growth, learning, and shared success.

Snorkel AI is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. jobs.description:
ABOUT PROMETHEUS

Founded in 1965, Prometheus is the largest privately held owner of apartments in the San Francisco Bay Area, with a portfolio of over 13,000 apartments in the Silicon Valley, Portland, and Seattle regions. We invest in real estate long-term and the focus on enduring quality drives every element of what we do - from our selection of locations to design decisions, reinvestments into our Neighborhoods and our operating strategy.

We are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, part of a group of companies that meets the highest standards for using business as a force for good. We have more than 500 Prometheans, and have a home office in San Mateo, with satellite offices in Portland, Oregon, and in the Bay Area. We are a vertically integrated company with four main core competencies in-house: acquisitions/investments, development, value-add renovations, and operations/property management. Prometheus has a long history of award-winning approaches to what we do, receiving over 100 awards for design and excellence including Fortune Magazine’s list of 100 Best Small & Medium Companies, the 100 Best Workplaces for Women and Best Places to Work in the Bay Area.

OUR PURPOSE

We are focused on Good Living for the Greater Good. This means providing a true sense of home and belonging for our Neighbors, Clients and Prometheans and giving our time and resources to bring positive change locally and beyond. It also means supporting you in your career goals with the very best working experience, and that starts with us having fun in the work we do together.

YOUR ROLE AND IMPACT

Our Commercial team is looking for a Property Administrator to oversee our California Cupertino Commercial Real Estate Management Office. This role requires someone who is detail oriented, a great multitasker and an excellent communicator. The Property Administrator will be responsible for overseeing the daily office operations, financial transactions across the commercial portfolio, and more. A few specific skills and traits that we are looking for are:

• Daily Operations - As the first point of contact for tenants, visitors, vendors, and employees you take it upon yourself to provide a seamless customer experience. From answering phones, to supporting an emergency service request or welcoming a new tenant, you communicate quickly, clearly and professionally making everyone around you feel ridiculously cared for.

• Financial and Accounting Responsibility – This role is detailed oriented and requires basic math skills, working knowledge of excel and an understanding of fundamental accounting principles. As the Property Administrator, you will oversee office invoices, code accounts payable and review accounts receivable, prepare and review contracts, and prepare various reports. You will also oversee accurate rent billing, review operating expenses, maintain insurance policies, and monitor budgets for accuracy and variance.

• Office Management – Not only are you responsible for the overall operations, coordination, and organization of the commercial office, you will also oversee updating the department's policies and procedures as well as creating a fun office team environment. Whether it is ordering supplies or planning a team event, the team can count on you to tackle these administrative tasks to support the Commercial team.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

• Education & Experience - High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required. Bachelor's degree is preferred. Minimum of two (2) years in an office administration role and experience as a property administrator is preferred. Minimum of one to two years in residential or commercial property management. Minimum of one year of accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, and billing experience.

• Core Competencies - Ability to focus and maintain attention to performance of tasks and to work and complete assignments on time despite frequent stressful, emergency, critical or unusual interruptions. Effective written communication, active listening, and verbal articulation in is required.

• Technical Competencies - Microsoft Office; Strong math and Excel skills are required. Basic accounting experience is preferred, with the ability to review and understand ledgers.

• Your Cultural Traits - Although we’re a highly dispersed organization by the nature of our business, our Prometheans are strongly united by our Purpose, Mission and our Cultural Traits. These are the defining characteristics of a Promethean: Team Oriented, Communicator, Entrepreneurial, Passionate, Self-Starter, Creative, Principled, and Brand Ambassador.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

We offer a variety of benefits that take compensation well beyond a paycheck. This includes traditional benefits and benefits you might not expect or know about. The provided salary range is based on a number of factors, including location, job-related skills, experience and qualifications.

OFFICE MANAGER

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Office Manager to support day-to-day office operations at our Memphis/Southaven site. The Office Manager will partner with site leadership and support teams to drive efficiencies and best practices that enhance the experience of employees, customers, visitors, and VIPs. The successful candidate is passionate about our mission, a strategic thinker with a can-do attitude, a strong communicator, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide exceptional customer service to internal and external customers via phone, email, chat, and face-to-face.

• Welcome guests and travelers with wayfinding, temporary workspace, arrival information, and guidance to site events and operations.

• Manage executive, conference room, and event calendars; support leadership teams with company travel and expense reports.

• Organize, prepare, and host meetings, including content, food and beverage, furniture, and audio-visual needs; coordinate meetings with site teams for other SpaceX departments and locations.

• Support site leadership with site-wide communications and updates.

• Partner with security to keep all guests compliant with badging, credentialing, and visitor management expectations; assist with ITAR/NDA form execution and processing.

• Manage site tour requests from community outreach and customer partners, including vetting, scheduling, and coordinating logistics across teams.

• Partner with facilities, food services, and other support teams on site improvements, fixes, office moves, and keeping the site clean and organized; track employee feedback on site services such as food trucks.

• Partner with spaceport operations on employee parking and shuttle logistics.

• Handle administrative needs such as supply orders, POs, shipping, budgets, internal tracking, and specialty employee gifts.

• Partner with employee experience to plan site social events, holiday parties, team building, and employee recognition.

• Partner with hiring managers, HR, facilities, and IT so new hires have their desk and equipment ready on day one; answer new hire questions.

jobs.title: Asset Protection Specialist (Part Time), Henderson (Boulder)
jobs.description:
The Role

At Green Thumb Industries and RISE Dispensaries, we believe the first impression is everything and that starts with you. As an Asset Protection Specialist (APS), you’re not just a security presence, you’re the warm, welcoming face of the dispensary and a key part of creating an elevated, friendly, concierge-style experience for our guests. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy connecting with others, maintaining physical readiness to act with urgency, and ensuring everyone feels safe, respected, and cared for.

This is not your traditional security role. It’s a dynamic blend of hospitality, customer service, and safety leadership, designed to enhance both the customer journey and team member experience. Asset Protection Specialists are active, professional, and approachable stewards of our culture, safety, and brand values.

Key Responsibilities

Welcoming & Check-In Experience

• Be the first smiling face our guests see—greet all visitors with warmth and positivity.

• Manage check-in with professionalism and efficiency, while upholding compliance standards.

• Set the “RISE Vibe” from the moment customers enter our doors.

• Provide basic concierge-level support: answering common questions and directing traffic.

Safety, Security & Support

• Serve as a visible, approachable, and responsive presence to deter incidents and ensure a sense of calm and order.

• Monitor various areas of the premises, including the store entry/exit and site perimeters, to ensure safety, comfort, and compliance.

• De-escalate situations with empathy, tact, and clear communication.

• Support team members and store operations in matters of safety, cleanliness, compliance, and guest flow by escorting customers and visitors and remaining alert and mobile at all times.

• Report and respond appropriately and urgently to any safety, security, or compliance incidents.

• Support emergency procedures and preparedness, including fire, evacuation, or weather response.

• Conduct visual inspections and checks per SOPs to maintain a secure and hazard-free environment.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Foster strong relationships and mutual trust with store teams, leadership, and customers.

• Share insights on guest interactions, safety concerns, and security risks with transparency and discretion.

• Support training of new APS team members to model warm, professional, and compliant behavior.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• At least one year of customer-facing or concierge experience strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with POS systems and/or compliance technology preferred.

• Security, military, or law enforcement experience is a plus when paired with a strong commitment to guest-first, hospitality-focused service.

• Meet the scheduling and availability requirements (i.e., ability to work a schedule inclusive of varying shifts such as mornings, days, nights, and weekends) to meet business needs.

• Must have reliable, responsible, and dependable attendance.

• Must pass all required background checks including state-specific cannabis employment requirements.

• Possess valid driver’s license or state ID.

• Must be 21 years or older and meet all state-specific cannabis employment requirements.

• Must be and remain compliant with all legal or company regulations for working in the cannabis industry.

Additional Requirements

Must have the ability to perform the following tasks for prolonged periods of time (i.e., up to the duration of a scheduled shift or workday)

• Capable of remaining alert and responsive during extended periods of time.

• Move about the dispensary to fulfill work assignments and assist patients and/or customers in various locations of the dispensary.

• Remain in a stationary position, if required, to meet the needs of the business.

• Converse and communicate with individuals and groups of people directly.

• Operate point of sale system, computer, and other office productivity machinery to use online programming and software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications and email.

• Inspect and receive detailed information, such as patients' and/or customers' dates of birth, order information, or inquiries.

• Move inventory and materials weighing up to 30 pounds independently.

• Position self to move inventory and materials in storage areas.

• Comfortable standing or walking for extended periods, up to the duration of a scheduled shift or workday and working both indoors and outdoors.

• Asset Protection Specialists are expected to maintain a visible and mobile presence throughout their shift. This is not a desk job—APS team members are regularly on their feet, engaging with guests, monitoring site activity, and supporting operations across the dispensary floor.

Skills

• Friendly, professional demeanor with excellent interpersonal skills.

• Ability to remain calm and empathetic in stressful situations.

• Consistent demonstration of excellent customer service skills.

• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all employees.

• Ability to listen well and effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, with various audiences.

• Understanding of applicable cannabis laws and regulations, safety regulations, local municipal codes and organizational rules, and standard operating procedures.

• Employee must be able to follow instructions as directed and incorporate constructive criticism from managers.

• Operate with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information and complying with HIPAA requirements.

Working Conditions

• Engaging, fast-paced patient and customer-facing retail environment.

• Outdoor duties in varying weather conditions may be required.

• Exposure to cannabis and/or allergens that might be present in an environment where cannabis is present and prevalent.

Our Mission: To promote well-being through the power of cannabis.

We’re humble—We prefer quiet confidence and don’t shout about our success.
We’re hardworking—We put our heads down and get the job done.
We’re grateful—Working in our industry is a privilege and an act of service.
We’re transparent—Honest and open communication keeps us healthy as an organization.
We’re collaborative—And believe good ideas can come from anywhere.
We have a growth mindset—One that’s grounded in well-being.

At GTI we believe that our corporate community should be a reflection of the communities we serve. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity across race, sex, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, nationality, religion, experience, and thought—not only because it is right, but because it makes us better. Our mission—the right to wellness—informs our commitment to champion economic opportunities in communities disproportionately affected by the war on drugs through employment and community involvement. GTI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

We can't wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Staff Firmware and Hardware Architect
jobs.description:
Title: Staff Firmware and Hardware Architect

Location: Santa Clara, CA

Job Term: Full-Time, On-site

The Opportunity:

Picarro is pioneering a unique confluence of hardware, software, and cloud-based computing unlike anything being done today. By manufacturing the precision instruments at the core of this technology as well as developing the algorithms that enable cogent information to be derived from the data, we are transforming how world-class scientific, industrial and regulatory compliance measurements are made, and more importantly, who makes them.

Picarro is seeking a Staff / Principal Firmware and Hardware Architect to define and lead the next generation of electronic and embedded computing architectures for Picarro gas analyzers. This senior technical leadership role has end-to-end ownership of the architecture connecting precision sensing electronics, FPGA-based real-time processing and control, embedded compute, high-speed data acquisition, communications, and system software. The architect will lead a team of FPGA design engineers and work across Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Software, Systems, Optics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to deliver a scalable analyzer platform from concept through verification, qualification, production transfer, and manufacturing ramp. The platform must support current and future cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) products while meeting demanding requirements for measurement performance, deterministic control, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, cybersecurity, and long-term component availability.

The ideal candidate is a systems-level architect who combines deep, hands-on FPGA and embedded-platform expertise with the judgment to make product-wide technical decisions. They have successfully taken complex precision instruments or similarly demanding embedded products from early concept through production, can move comfortably between architecture and detailed technical problem-solving, and know how to balance measurement performance, deterministic behavior, reliability, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and long-term platform scalability. They are an effective technical leader who can align experienced engineers across disciplines, mentor an FPGA development team, communicate trade-offs clearly to business and engineering leadership, and maintain ownership until the product is stable in production.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end electronics and embedded architecture for Picarro's next-generation gas analyzer platform.

• Translate spectroscopy, measurement, reliability, serviceability, cost, and product requirements into scalable system architectures.

• Define hardware, FPGA, firmware, embedded Linux, and application-software partitioning, including processing, memory, timing, clocking, synchronization, control, safety, and data-flow architectures.

• Lead and mentor a team of FPGA design engineers; establish technical direction, design standards, reusable IP, review practices, and development priorities.

• Architect FPGA functions for high-speed acquisition, deterministic control, signal processing, timing and triggering, laser and thermal control, safety interlocks, and system interfaces.

• Lead technology selection and trade studies for FPGA/SoC devices, processors, memory, ADC/DAC interfaces, communication buses, operating systems, and development toolchains.

• Drive the platform through concept, requirements, architecture, proof of concept, detailed design, integration, verification, qualification, pilot production, and manufacturing release.

• Define and execute risk-reduction prototypes for critical issues such as latency, clock synchronization, data throughput, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal performance, and measurement noise.

• Ensure designs support DFM, DFT, calibration, diagnostics, field service, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and component lifecycle management.

• Establish modern FPGA and firmware practices, including version-controlled builds, automated simulation, regression testing, continuous integration, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and traceable verification.

• Lead architecture and design reviews, clearly communicate technical trade-offs, and drive timely technical decisions across product and engineering leadership.

• Support system integration and lead root-cause investigations during qualification, pilot builds, manufacturing ramp, and sustaining engineering.

• Manage technical engagement with external design partners, FPGA vendors, component suppliers, and development-tool providers as required.

Required Qualifications

• BS or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field;

• Typically 10+ years of relevant product-development experience for Staff level and 15+ years, or equivalent demonstrated scope and impact, for Principal level.

• Demonstrated experience architecting complex embedded electronic systems that successfully transitioned from concept into production.

• Deep FPGA architecture and development experience, including RTL design, high-speed interfaces, deterministic control, timing closure, clock-domain crossing, DSP, state machines, and processor/FPGA interfaces.

• Strong experience with modern FPGA/SoC platforms such as AMD/Xilinx Zynq, Zynq UltraScale+, Versal, Artix, or Kintex; comparable Intel FPGA/SoC experience is also applicable.

• Strong embedded-systems background spanning processors, memory, buses, DMA, interrupts, peripherals, board-level electronics, firmware, and embedded Linux.

• Experience architecting high-bandwidth data-acquisition systems involving ADC/DAC interfaces, FPGA processing, DMA, memory, and host communications.

• Demonstrated ability to make hardware/software/FPGA partitioning decisions based on measurable performance, latency, reliability, cost, power, and schedule requirements.

• Experience leading technically complex, cross-functional development programs through integration, verification, qualification, and production transfer.

• Demonstrated ability to technically lead and mentor senior FPGA, firmware, and hardware engineers without relying solely on management authority.

• Strong understanding of DFM, DFT, reliability, verification and validation, component lifecycle management, configuration control, and sustaining engineering.

• Excellent technical judgment, structured problem-solving, written communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing scientific instruments, analytical instruments, spectroscopy systems, semiconductor equipment, medical instrumentation, or other precision-measurement products.

• Experience with cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS), tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS), or gas-analysis instrumentation.

• Experience with laser control, photodetector acquisition, high-resolution ADC systems, precision analog electronics, low-noise mixed-signal design, or real-time signal processing.

• Experience combining Linux-class compute with FPGA-based deterministic real-time control.

• Experience with PCIe, Ethernet, JESD204, USB, SPI, I2C, CAN, LVDS, or similar board- and system-level interfaces.

• Working knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, grounding, clock jitter, and thermal design.

• Experience with SystemVerilog/VHDL, C/C++, Python, Linux device drivers, Buildroot or Yocto, Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience building automated FPGA verification, simulation, regression, and hardware-in-the-loop environments.

• Experience defining reusable architectures that support multiple products, configurations, and product generations.

• Knowledge of secure boot, hardware root of trust, signed firmware, update strategies, and embedded-product cybersecurity.

• Experience operating within formal quality or regulatory environments and supporting product certification.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $220K to $260K. Our total compensation packages include base salary, bonus eligibility, and equity. Your base salary range and title will be determined based on the location, experience, qualifications, skills, knowledge, level, and pay of employees in similar positions.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) plans

• Life, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• Employee Referral Program

• 401K

• Social events (summer picnic, holiday party, team lunches, etc.)

• On-site Health & Wellness programs (fitness challenges, outdoor bootcamp, flu-shots, etc.)

About Picarro:

We are the world's leader in timely, trusted, and actionable data using enhanced optical spectroscopy. Our solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including natural gas leak detection, ethylene oxide emissions monitoring, semiconductor fabrication, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, atmospheric science, air quality, greenhouse gas measurements, food safety, hydrology, ecology, and more. Our software and hardware are designed and manufactured in Santa Clara, California and are used in over 90 countries worldwide based on over 65 patents related to cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) technology and are unparalleled in their precision, ease of use, and reliability.

At Picarro, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, social orientation, or disability. Posted positions are not open to third-party recruiters/agencies, and unsolicited resume submissions will be considered free referrals.

At Picarro, we strive to ensure that all individuals, regardless of their abilities, have equal opportunities. If you are an individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, please contact Picarro, Inc. at disabilityassistance@picarro.com for assistance.

jobs.title: B2B Partnerships Lead, Business Development
jobs.description:
About the Team: 

We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We develop strategic and product partnerships across the B2B ecosystem, bringing together OpenAI’s capabilities and partners’ technology, expertise, data, workflows, and customer relationships. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales, we turn these opportunities into useful offerings and new ways for businesses to adopt and benefit from OpenAI.

About the Role: 

As a B2B Partnerships Lead, you will identify, develop, and execute strategic and product partnerships across B2B segments. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning opportunity assessment, partnership design, commercial negotiation, and execution. You will own the partner work behind product initiatives, from defining partner needs through launch and sustained adoption at scale. These may include Sign in with ChatGPT and industry-specific offerings. You bring a generalist’s ability to connect product priorities with partner capabilities, build a business case, and align teams around a practical path forward. You will remain accountable after signing and launch, including for selected high-touch strategic partnerships.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Identify strategic and product partnership opportunities across B2B segments; translate product priorities and customer needs into partner plans, joint value propositions, and a focused set of prospective partners.

 - Own the partner work stream for assigned product initiatives, aligning requirements, commitments, milestones, and ongoing responsibilities with Product, Engineering, and partner teams.

 - Develop business cases and negotiate product and commercial partnerships with Legal, Finance, and Product, including selected high-touch strategic deals in coordination with other partnership owners.

 - Take partner initiatives from pilot through launch and scale, defining readiness criteria, coordinating integrations, and expanding successful offerings to more partners and business customers.

 - Work with Sales and partner teams on target accounts, referrals, joint selling, and customer introductions, with clear responsibilities for follow-up and opportunity tracking.

 - Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Security, Policy, and Operations to resolve launch and adoption barriers, with clear ownership and handoffs into ongoing partner programs.

 - Maintain partner relationships after launch and bring customer feedback, integration gaps, and adoption barriers back to Product and Engineering; help turn early implementations into repeatable offerings.

 - Define success measures with product and go-to-market teams, track activation, sustained usage, customer outcomes, and commercial impact, and drive follow-up when an initiative falls short.

Qualifications:

 - 8+ years of experience in business development, strategic or product partnerships, or related roles developing commercial opportunities in technology or other B2B businesses.

 - Experience developing B2B partnerships and taking a product, integration, or partner initiative from concept or pilot through launch and sustained adoption, working closely with product and technical teams.

 - A broad business perspective and the ability to learn unfamiliar industries, evaluate partner capabilities and strategic fit, and turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear business case and partnership plan.

 - Understanding of how businesses use software, data, and services, and how product integrations, distribution, and complementary capabilities create value. Experience across B2B sectors and business models is a plus.

 - Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to assess economics, prioritize competing opportunities, and use performance data to guide decisions.

 - Ability to build relationships with partner practitioners and leaders, work effectively across technical and business teams, and move projects forward without formal authority.

 - Clear writing and communication, curiosity about AI, and a willingness to do the detailed work of growing partnerships. You combine initiative and adaptability with disciplined follow-through.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. jobs.title: Staff Battery Safety and Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Staff Battery Safety & Certification Engineer directs safety certification and abuse testing for Redwood's battery energy storage products, including systems built from repurposed electric vehicle batteries. The role owns the certification path from test planning through certificate issuance and serves as the technical lead with UL and other certification bodies. The position develops test methods and compliance approaches where existing standards do not directly address repurposed batteries, and represents Redwood on standards development committees. Errors in this role can delay product certification or limit the company's ability to test and ship product. This is a hybrid role with three days per week on-site at 100 Hooper in San Francisco, CA, or in Reno or Carson City, NV, with travel up to 10% of the time.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Directs product safety certification programs against UL 1973, UL 1974, and UL 9540, from test planning through certificate issuance

• Directs cell, module, and pack abuse and thermal runaway testing, including UL 9540A and SAE J2464 (or equivalent regulations/standards) test programs, and the environmental permits that govern on-site testing

• Develops test methods and compliance approaches for repurposed batteries where no existing standard directly applies

• Guides certification body audits, witness testing, and responses to reviewer findings

• Directs transport testing and classification of lithium batteries under UN 38.3

• Develops Redwood's comments on proposed revisions to battery safety standards and coordinates research testing with national laboratories

• Guides product, firmware, and operations teams on safety requirements by translating standard clauses into design and production requirements

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, or materials engineering; Master's degree preferred

• 8+ years of battery safety, testing, or certification engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6+ years with a Master's degree, including lithium-ion battery or energy storage system products

• Working knowledge of UL 1973, UL 1974, UL 9540, and UL 9540A

• Working knowledge of UN 38.3, FMVSS No. 305/305a, ECE R100, GB 38031 and/or SAE battery safety standards such as SAE J2464 strongly preferred

• Working knowledge of NFPA 855, NFPA 68, and NFPA 69 as they apply to energy storage systems and battery test facilities strongly preferred

• Ability to develop and defend test methods and compliance arguments for products or conditions that existing standards do not directly address · Ability to travel up to 10% of the time to test laboratories, certification bodies, and project sites

In accordance with California pay transparency laws, the salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and skills.

California Pay Range:

$187,500—$247,500 USD

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Models are what they eat. But a large portion of training compute is wasted training on data that are already learned, irrelevant, or even harmful, leading to worse models that cost more to train and deploy.



At DatologyAI, we’ve built a state of the art data curation suite to automatically curate and optimize petabytes of data to create the best possible training data for your models. Training on curated data can dramatically reduce training time and cost (7-40x faster training depending on the use case), dramatically increase model performance as if you had trained on >10x more raw data without increasing the cost of training, and allow smaller models with fewer than half the parameters to outperform larger models despite using far less compute at inference time, substantially reducing the cost of deployment. For more details, check out our recent research on synthetic data scaling (BeyondWeb https://www.datologyai.com/blog/beyondweb) and pretraining with domain-specific data (The Finetuner’s Fallacy https://www.datologyai.com/blog/finetuners-fallacy).



We raised a total of $57.5M in two rounds, a Seed and Series A. Our investors include Felicis Ventures, Radical Ventures, Amplify Partners, Microsoft, Amazon, and AI visionaries like Geoff Hinton, Yann LeCun, Jeff Dean, and many others who deeply understand the importance and difficulty of identifying and optimizing the best possible training data for models. Our team has pioneered this frontier research area and has the deep expertise on both data research and data engineering necessary to solve this incredibly challenging problem and make data curation easy for anyone who wants to train their own model on their own data.



This role is based in San Mateo, CA. We are in the office 4 days a week.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to build and run the operational backbone of our People team. You'll own HRIS, payroll, benefits, compliance, immigration operations, and our UK expansion, reporting directly to our Head of People.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

   Payroll, benefits, and leave

   Compliance

   - Own I-9s, required postings, mandatory trainings, and audit readiness
   
   - Spot risk early and bring it to the Head of People with a recommendation
   
   Immigration operations
   
   - Manage visa and green card case timelines with our external immigration counsel
   
   - Be the clear, calm point of contact for employees navigating the process
   
   UK and international
   
   - Stand up UK payroll, benefits, contracts, and right-to-work processes
   
   - Partner with our Business Ops team and leadership as we grow internationally


ABOUT YOU

 - 5+ years in People Operations or HR, with at least 2 years at a startup scaling from roughly 50 to 200+ people

 - Hands-on ownership of payroll, benefits administration, and an HRIS (Rippling preferred)

 - Strong working knowledge of California and multi-state employment compliance

 - A builder's instinct: you see a manual process and automate, document, or kill it

COMPENSATION

At DatologyAI, we are dedicated to rewarding talent with competitive salary and meaningful equity. The salary for this position ranges from $140,000 to $190,000.

BENEFITS

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Senior Systems Engineer, Propulsion System

At Lucid, propulsion is not just a collection of components. It is an integrated vehicle capability that unifies electric drive units, battery systems, thermal management, control software, and vehicle dynamics into a seamless system that delivers industry-leading efficiency, performance, and customer satisfaction.

We are currently seeking Senior Systems Engineer for Propulsion System, to be part of a passionate, highly driven multi-disciplinary engineering team developing highly efficient and class leading propulsion system for Lucid vehicles. The successful candidate will exhibit a clear understanding of electric vehicle propulsion system and development thereof. The candidate will be responsible for definition of Model Based Systems Engineering deliverables of more than one features and functions of propulsion system.

The role will require cross-functional engagement with product management, vehicle engineering teams, software engineers, hardware engineers, and verification & validation teams. A thorough understanding of system development lifecycle(s) is required to be successful in this role, gained through prior OEM or Tier 1 industry experience.

Our ideal candidate exhibits a proactive, can-do attitude and approaches their work systematically with vigor, determination and accuracy. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to learn quickly and to strive for perfection within a fast-paced environment.

What you will do:

• Lead the end-to-end capture and definition of requirements for advancing class leading vehicle propulsion system functions, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to shape cutting-edge EV experiences.

• Shape propulsion system architectures using Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), driving functional decomposition, signal definition, and cross-domain integration across vehicle systems.

• Translate high-level feature concepts into robust, implementable subsystem and component-level requirements that enable precise vehicle functionality

• Drive alignment with verification & validation teams to define comprehensive test strategies and ensure successful execution against requirements

• Collaborate closely with HV domain, Chassis domain, Vehicle HMI systems and software engineering teams to define, refine, and manage performance requirements for propulsion system controls

• Contribute to the development and execution of product-level validation plans, ensuring features meet performance, safety, and customer expectations

• Investigate and resolve real-world vehicle propulsion issues through data-driven analysis, continuously enhancing system performance and user experience

• Coordinate systems engineering lifecycle activities with program management to successfully deliver milestones and product releases on schedule

• Champion continuous improvement of systems engineering practices, driving innovation and excellence across the organization

What you bring:

• 4+ years of experience delivering systems engineering solutions for automotive controls products in a production environment

• 4+ years of hands-on application of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) to drive design, analysis, and development workflows

• Deep knowledge of vehicle lateral and longitudinal controls, torque and gear management functions of the vehicle control unit.

• Experience with Automotive embedded electronic product development

• Solid experience applying ISO 26262 to drive system requirements, architecture, and safety-driven design decisions

• Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver across multiple vehicle programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

• Strong data-driven problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze and debug complex vehicle issues

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

• Highly detail-oriented with a disciplined approach to documentation, traceability, and reporting

• Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership, a proactive mindset, and a collaborative approach to problem solving

Ways to Standout:

• Hands-on expertise with Cameo/Magic Cyber Systems Engineer and strong proficiency in SysML-based modeling

• Proven experience applying FMEA and structured risk management methodologies in complex engineering environments

• Solid understanding of electrical, electronic, and programmable systems, with the ability to connect system behavior to component-level design

• Familiarity with AUTOSAR architecture and its application in modern automotive software platforms

• INCOSE Systems Engineering certification (ASEP or CSEP), demonstrating a strong foundation in industry best practices

Education Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in electrical, computer, mechanical or other technical engineering discipline is required.

• Master’s degree or higher education (in engineering or related technical field) is preferred.

Salary Range: The compensation range for this position is specific to the locations listed below and is the range Lucid reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; and other relevant business and organizational factors.

$144,000—$198,000 USD

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.
