jobs.title: New ER Doctor (NERD) Program: Practicing Veterinarians - Greensboro, NC
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE PROGRAM

The VEG New ER Doctor (NERD) program is designed to transform practicing non-emergency veterinarians into exceptional, confident VEG ER doctors. This six-month deep dive into the action of emergency is a structured, immersive program like no other that allows participants to transition into full-time ER doctors at VEG after successful completion. Integrating academic and clinical teachings with individualized mentorship, this program fuels a passion for ER and creates a deeper meaning around life-saving veterinary heroics. If you’re hungry to learn how to do ER, perform surgeries, advance your endoscopy skills, learn about exotics, and discover the unique rewards of customer-focused care in an open concept hospital, we find a way to say yes to training you in our NERD program.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Work side-by-side with experienced VEG doctors who will mentor you through real ER cases, offering guidance and feedback every step of the way. This isn’t just shadowing—it’s hands-on learning with built-in mentorship.

• New ER Doctors (a.k.a. NERDS!) get up-close, firsthand ER experience, working 3-4 hospital shifts per week (days, swings, and nights), as well as through weekly case discussions, literature reviews, and hands-on training at state-of-the-art facilities.

• Learn best practices for client-centered communication and care, the VEG Way.

What CE experiences can you expect to attend during the program?

From hands-on training to weekly didactic learning, NERD program participants earn over 160 RACE-approved CE hours in just six months—which takes most doctors 10 years to complete! Some CE highlights include:

• Abdominal, thoracic and cardiac point-of care ultrasound

• Exotic companion animals in the ER

• Flexible GI endoscopy

• Small animal emergency surgery

• Small animal critical care lab

• RECOVER ALS and BLS Rescuer CPR certification

All paid for by VEG!

WHAT YOU NEED

• A passion for helping people and their pets

• A valid DVM, VMD, or equivalent degree

• Be a practicing veterinarian for 1+ years

• A desire to live and breathe emergency medicine

• A valid license to practice veterinary medicine, as well as a valid DEA registration in the state you will be completing your program by your start date

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor, as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

• Can commit to a predetermined schedule for a consecutive six-month period

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

*Please note: Once you apply, you will be asked to provide the names and email addresses of one to two references. Please make them aware that we’ll be sending them a letter of recommendation questionnaire through a platform called RefApp.

*Please also note: Relocation for the NERD program may be required. All New ER Doctor graduates are guaranteed a spot at VEG as an emergency doctor at a hospital location of our choosing upon successful completion of the program in the required time frame and passing all required program competencies and benchmarks. Training and post-placement will be discussed with your talent manager.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

As a NERD, you’ll spend six months learning from specialists and experts in emergency medicine, all while receiving competitive compensation and benefits. Between base salary and all the components of the training program, VEG invests $100,000 in each NERD! We do this because we believe you want you to be an experienced ER doctor who will save pet’s lives the VEG Way.

• Competitive compensation + benefits that start on day one

• 160+ hours of RACE-approved CE during your six-month program and a BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!)

• Equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• Student loan repayment (after your 1st year with VEG)

• Free exams and 50% off VEG treatments

• Pet bereavement leave

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOUBLE

Bookkeepers today are stuck working in excel spreadsheets, stitched together Claude/ChatGPT workflows, and homegrown project management solutions to support their clients. Double is on a mission to change that.



With our AI agents, bookkeepers only need to review completed books instead of having to do the entire month-end close end-to-end.



Founded in 2021, Double has raised $13M in funding, backed by leading tech investors like Y Combinator and founders at top startups like Lattice, Front, Superhuman, Plaid, and more. Double currently helps thousands of bookkeepers and accountants manage the books for startups and small businesses across the US.



We're growing fast, and we're looking for a Product Manager to ship high-leverage product improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work with the CEO, CTO, designers, and engineering team to design new features and improve existing features

 - Talk to lots of customers and prospects to understand what's important to them

 - Talk to the Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams to prioritize features that would help them achieve company goals

 - Write lots of tickets and answer clarifying questions from the engineers

 - Use product as a lever to drive business outcomes (MRR, new product adoption, etc.)




WHO YOU ARE

 - You want to ship, iterate, ship and iterate...

 - You care intensely about user experience

 - You use AI tools daily and are extremely AI-pilled

 - You have some experience doing bookkeeping/accounting work




BENEFITS

 - Competitive pay and equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance



Double provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Head of Sales Development
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

The Head of Sales Development leads the global Sales Development organization responsible for new-logo pipeline creation across inbound and outbound motions. This role owns the strategy, playbooks, tooling, and performance standards that convert marketing demand and prospecting activity into qualified opportunities that Account Executives (AEs) accept and close.

The Sales Development leader works closely with Field Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to keep SDR team output aligned with new-logo targets, and to make the function scalable, measurable, and AI-enabled.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Performance and Targets

• Own team delivery against new-logo targets, including SAL and SQL volume, pipeline contribution, and appointment acceptance.

• Develop recommendations for team and individual quotas and capacity models for leadership approval; ensure appointments fit within defined ICP, targeting, and territory coverage.

• Determine the right KPIs and success measures for the function, and use them to manage and optimize performance.

• Own data integrity in the CRM for leads, contacts, campaigns, activities, and dispositions.

AI Strategy

• Define and govern the AI roadmap for sales development, covering prospecting, account research, lead management, call coaching, and reporting.

• Evaluate, pilot, and scale AI tools and agents; measure impact on productivity and conversion, not only on adoption.

• Set human-in-the-loop standards for what AI may execute autonomously and what requires SDR review (for example, messaging, persona targeting, and compliance).

• Build AI fluency into onboarding and playbooks, and maintain a use-case backlog informed by field feedback.

Inbound and Outbound Strategy

• Lead the inbound model in collaboration with Marketing: lead routing, speed-to-lead SLAs, MQL/MQC definitions, lead scoring criteria, and handoff to AEs.

• Partner with Marketing on demand generation, campaign follow-up, and prioritization of marketing-qualified leads.

• Monitor and improve inbound conversion (lead to SQL to SAL).

• Define lead ownership and activity-window rules, and resolve routing exceptions.

• Own the outbound targeting strategy: ICP definition, account tiering, persona targeting, and cadence design.

• Maintain a documented playbook to contact, engage, qualify, and develop prospects across channels.

• Align with Field Sales on target accounts, outreach plans, and appointment acceptance criteria.

• Review targeting adherence and outbound quality on a regular cadence.

• Define the strategy to re-engage stalled opportunities passed back by Field Sales.

AE Collaboration and Alignment

• Maintain a written SDR-to-AE operating agreement covering SAL definition, SAL acceptance criteria, disposition reasons, and feedback loops.

• Define and lead a standing cadence with AE leadership such as weekly acceptance and pipeline review, monthly targeting review, and quarterly planning.

• Set clear rules for account ownership, opportunity holds, and dispute resolution, and enforce them consistently.

• Use structured feedback on rejected or stalled SALs to refine targeting and qualification.

• Coordinate with Sales leadership on territory and account changes so SDR coverage stays aligned with AE coverage.

Marketing and Cross-Functional Partnership

• Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, events, content, and inbound demand.

• Partner with Revenue Operations on dashboards, lead routing, CRM configuration, and compensation data.

• Represent SDR leadership at key events and tradeshows as needed.

People Leadership and Development

• Lead, coach, and develop SDR managers and individual contributors across all locations.

• Own hiring plans, onboarding, ramp, and certification, and ensure hiring supports growth initiatives.

• Define SDR career paths and performance-based promotion criteria, including progression to AE, CSM, and management roles.

• Provide regular 1:1s, call and message coaching, and structured feedback.

• Address performance and personnel issues early, in partnership with HR and senior leadership.

• Build a culture of open communication, accountability, and team collaboration.

Activity and Operating Standards

• Define and enforce activity standards by role, balancing volume with quality.

• Define and track speed-to-lead and handoff SLAs by lead type, including out-of-hours and holiday coverage.

• Enforce CRM hygiene: timely activity logging, required fields, and accurate dispositions.

• Establish a regular review cadence for activity, SLA, and disposition performance.

Reporting and Executive Communication

• Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reporting for executive leadership, including results, risks, and forecast impact.

• Escalate operational challenges and resourcing needs early.

• Research and deploy methods to improve team productivity and conversion.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION & TRAINING:

• 5 years in B2B SaaS sales development, sales, or go-to-market leadership

• 3 years leading SDR or BDR teams, including managing managers

• Proven record of building and scaling pipeline-generation teams with measurable conversion results

• Hands-on experience running both inbound and outbound motions

• Demonstrated use of AI tools in sales development such as prospecting, research, or workflow automation

• Proficiency in Salesforce or another CRM; sales engagement platforms such as Gong Engage; conversation-intelligence tools (e.g. Gong); and data platforms like ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

• Strong analytical skills: funnel analysis, KPI design, and compensation modeling

• Experience aligning SDR output with AE and field sales leaders

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Experience with consultative, solution-based, or enterprise SaaS sales models

• Experience in B2B industries with contractor, supplier, or EHS compliance requirements

• Experience leading distributed or multi-region teams

• 4-year degree or commensurate experience

jobs.title: Executive Director Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

About Hudson Rouge

Hudson Rouge is part of WPP | Ford, the integrated global WPP team bringing together creative, media, production, experience, technology, data, and other specialist capabilities in support of Ford Motor Company and its brands. WPP | Ford connects expertise across WPP agencies and markets to deliver coordinated solutions and a consistent client experience. Hudson Rouge brings its distinct luxury expertise and focus on Lincoln to this broader partnership. As Lincoln advances its luxury ambition and enters an important period of brand evolution, this leader will partner with the CEO of Hudson Rouge and agency senior leadership to assess the current operating environment, identify high-impact opportunities, and build the capabilities and discipline needed to deliver today while modernizing how the agency works for the future.

The Opportunity

Hudson Rouge, WPP's luxury boutique and the integrated agency supporting Lincoln, is seeking an Executive Director of Operations & Transformation to help shape the next chapter of the agency and its partnership with the brand. The Executive Director will connect business strategy with people, processes, systems, technology, scope, resources, and financial performance. They will diagnose barriers to effectiveness, introduce fit-for-purpose methodologies, and drive an agency-wide transformation agenda that improves efficiency, collaboration, decision-making, and accountability.

Leadership profile

A strategic and pragmatic business operator who is energized by building what comes next. This leader is an integrator and a change agent: collaborative, influential, comfortable with complexity, and able to bring clarity without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. They combine low ego with high accountability and understand the creativity, pace, technology, and standards required to build a modern luxury brand.

Above all, this is a hands-on change leader who can quickly assess how the agency operates, challenge established practices constructively, and identify where changes to processes, systems, organizational capabilities, and ways of working will create meaningful improvements. They bring fresh methodologies, turn opportunities into practical plans, and mobilize leaders across the agency to deliver measurable, lasting change.

As a key member of the Hudson Rouge leadership team, this individual will set a clear transformation roadmap, establish timelines and decision points, and create shared accountability for execution across agency leadership and throughout the organization.

Key responsibilities

Lead the operating model

• Partner with leadership to evolve the operating model for Hudson Rouge and its partnership with the broader WPPecosystem.

• Establish clear roles, decision rights, governance, and leadership operating rhythms.

• Translate business priorities and diagnostic findings into actionable organizational goals, improvement initiatives, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

• Assess and redesign processes, systems, governance, meetings, reporting, and ways of working to eliminate friction and improve quality, speed, and effectiveness.

• Balance the agency’s boutique, entrepreneurial culture with the structure required to support a complex, integrated business.

Reimagine the agency through AI and technology

• Partner with capability leads to define Hudson Rouge’s AI priorities and roadmap, identifying where AI can have the greatest impact on how the agency operates and delivers for Lincoln.

• Translate Hudson Rouge’s business, client, and operational needs into clear opportunities and requirements for the central AI team.

• Partner closely with the central AI team, which will lead AI strategy, solution design, governance, and implementation.

• Coordinate adoption across Hudson Rouge, ensuring leaders and teams are prepared to incorporate new AI-enabled ways of working into their day-to-day operations.

Drive transformation

• Partner with the CEO of Hudson Rouge and leadership team to diagnose operational gaps, prioritize opportunities, and collectively own a focused, agency-wide transformation agenda.

• Build and manage a sequenced transformation roadmap with clear workstreams, accountable leaders, milestones, timelines, success measures, and regular progress reviews.

• Lead change management from leadership alignment through agency-wide adoption, equipping teams with the tools, communication, and support to sustain new ways of working.

• Track progress and measurable business impact, surface risks and missed commitments, and hold leadership accountable for course correction and delivery.

Lead Project Management and delivery excellence

• Provide leadership and direction for Project Management as a core agency discipline.

• Partner with the Head of Project Management to define the PM model, standards, talent expectations, tools, and measures of effectiveness.

• Ensure portfolio visibility supports leadership decisions around priorities, resources, dependencies, timing, and risk.

• Strengthen connections across Project Management, Account, Creative, Strategy, Production, Finance, and specialist capabilities.

• Position Project Management as a strategic business and delivery partner, with the Head of PM accountable for day-to-day PM leadership and execution.

Integrate business, scope, resources, and performance

• Connect client priorities, scope, staffing, resources, financial performance, and delivery into a cohesive operating view.

• Establish effective operating reviews around business performance, scope, staffing, investment, and organizational priorities.

• Help leadership evaluate trade-offs involving priorities, resources, timing, and investment.

• Support annual scope and staffing planning by connecting client ambition with the capabilities and capacity required to deliver it.

Strengthen integration across Hudson Rouge and WPP

• Build stronger connections across Hudson Rouge and the WPP capabilities supporting Lincoln.

• Establish clear ownership, governance, and ways of working across functions and specialist partners.

• Create greater continuity across strategy, creative, production, media, experience, CRM, analytics, social, PR, retail, and other disciplines.

• Help create an experience in which the client and internal teams operate as one connected Lincoln partnership.

Experience and capabilities

The ideal candidate will bring:

• Leadership experience in agency operations, business transformation, consulting, or a similarly complex client-service organization.

• Proven record as a change agent: diagnosing organizational opportunities, redesigning operating models, and leading complex, measurable transformation through implementation and adoption.

• Experience introducing new operating methodologies and translating recommendations into practical roadmaps, timelines, governance, and sustained results.

• A strong point of view on how AI, technology, data, and automation can reshape creative and client-service organizations.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and transformation across functions, locations, or organizational entities.

• Experience leading or partnering closely with strong Project Management or integrated-delivery capabilities.

• Strong understanding of agency economics, scope, staffing, resource planning, and commercial management.

jobs.title: Director, Comms Strategy & Performance
jobs.description:
The Director, Communications Strategy and Performance serves as a strategic operating and performance partner to the EVP, Communications building the priorities, measurement systems, and executive insights that strengthen decision-making, campaign effectiveness, and accountability across the Entertainment Communications function.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, performance, and insights, connecting information and priorities across the Communications organization to strengthen decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and business impact. The Director will establish frameworks and operating mechanisms that provide greater visibility into performance, identify emerging opportunities and risks, strengthen accountability, and enable leadership to make informed decisions. Additionally, this role will help modernize how Communications measures impact and operates by advancing the use of audience and business insights, available measurement platforms and technologies, automation, and cross-functional data capabilities.

Responsibilities:

Strategy, Performance, & Executive Decision-Making

• Serve as a strategic operating partner to the EVP, Communications and Communications leadership team, helping translate business and leadership priorities into clear objectives, workstreams, and measurable success
• Synthesize business priorities, organizational performance, audience and communications insights, and emerging trends to identify opportunities, risks, and areas requiring leadership attention
• Develop executive-level insights, recommendations, and presentations that distill complex information into clear implications, decisions, and actions
• Drive strategic and cross-functional priorities on behalf of Communications leadership, building alignment and accountability across stakeholders without reliance on direct authority
• Communication Measurement & Insights
• Establish and evolve an integrated performance framework across the Entertainment Communications function, connecting functional and organizational priorities to meaningful KPIs, success criteria, and business outcomes
• Develop executive-level reporting and insights that provide visibility into organizational priorities, communications performance, opportunities, risks, and progress against key objectives
• Advance measurement of priority NBC and Peacock publicity and awards campaigns, partnering with Publicity and cross-functional teams to establish objectives, measurement strategies, and actionable performance insights
• Lead communications insights efforts, including reputation and sentiment analysis, executive visibility, message penetration, competitive benchmarking, media insights, and industry trends relevant to business priorities
• Translate performance data and insights into recommendations that inform communications strategy, resource allocation, and execution

Operating Effectiveness & Transformation

• Establish and manage operating rhythms that strengthen priority-setting, decision-making, accountability, and follow-through across the Communications leadership team
• Connect priorities and information across Communications functions to identify dependencies, gaps, emerging issues, and opportunities for greater organizational alignment
• Lead or facilitate cross-functional initiatives requiring coordination across multiple Communications functions and business partners
• Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, automate recurring work, and increase organizational effectiveness
• Design leadership operating rhythms and decision forums that improve prioritization, information flow, accountability and timely decision-making
• Identify and advance technologies and emerging capabilities that strengthen research, insights, monitoring, measurement, reporting, and workflow effectiveness
• Partner with Audience Insights, Decision Sciences, Marketing, Media, Social, Product, Peacock, Human Resources, and other teams to leverage enterprise capabilities and data in support of Communications priorities
• Establish shared measurement practices, definitions, and governance that improve consistency, credibility, and usability of communications performance information
• Champion new approaches and ways of working that strengthen the Entertainment Communications organization's ability to operate with greater insight, agility, and impact

Key Deliverables

• Executive-level Communications performance, priorities, and decision-support reporting
• Organizational and functional performance frameworks, KPIs, and measures of success
• Measurement strategies and actionable performance insights for priority NBC and Peacock publicity campaigns
• Reputation, sentiment, executive visibility, competitive, and industry insights aligned to business priorities
• Leadership operating rhythms and mechanisms that strengthen prioritization, accountability, and cross-functional execution
• Annual Communications performance assessment highlighting impact, key learnings, opportunities, and forward-looking priorities
• Advance tools, automation, and process improvements that enhance organizational effectiveness and decision-making
• A regular cadence of executive ready reports, decks and presentations

Success Measures

• Communications priorities, resources, and performance measures are increasingly aligned to business and leadership objectives
• Leadership has clear, timely, and actionable visibility into organizational performance, opportunities, risks, and areas requiring decision or intervention
• Data and insights meaningfully inform communications strategy, campaign planning, resource allocation, and organizational decision-making
• Communications measurement practices provide increasingly credible and consistent visibility into impact and inform continuous improvement
• Strategic and cross-functional priorities advance with clear ownership, accountability, and follow-through
• Advance technology, and process improvements generate meaningful gains in insights, quality, speed, and organizational effectiveness
• A clear strategic reporting cadence that demonstrates the impact of the Communications team on business goals

Basic Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in communications, data analytics, business, marketing, research, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
• 10+ years of relevant experience in communications analytics, business insights, research, measurement, media insights, digital analytics, or a related discipline
• Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, executive reports, presentations, scorecards, measurement frameworks, and data-driven recommendations
• Working knowledge of AI-enabled and advanced tools and their application to research, reporting, content analysis, monitoring, and workflow automation
• Experience analyzing media, reputation, employee engagement, stakeholder perception, or campaign-performance data
• Strong proficiency with data visualization, reporting, presentation, and productivity tools
• Experience working with senior executives and translating complex findings into concise, decision-ready insights
• Experience partnering across Communications, Human Resources, Publicity, Marketing, or similarly matrixed functions

Desired Characteristics:

• Strategic, analytical thinker with strong business judgment and the ability to connect insights to broader organizational and business priorities
• Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information, identify what matters most, and translate insights into clear narratives, recommendations, and actions
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with judgment, discretion, and confidence to work effectively with senior leaders
• Highly collaborative and influential, with the ability to build trust, navigate competing priorities, and drive alignment across functions without direct authority
• Comfortable operating in ambiguity and bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to complex or evolving priorities
• Strong operating discipline and a rigorous attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize effectively, manage multiple workstreams, and drive initiatives from concept through execution
• Intellectually curious and forward-looking, with a practical orientation toward emerging technologies, AI, data, and new ways of working
• High standards for quality, accuracy, credibility, and integrity, with sound judgment in the responsible use of data and AI-enabled technologies
• Agile and adaptable, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment

Additional Requirements:

• Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $130,000 - $170,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible)

jobs.title: Energy Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DEVELOPMENT TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Find enough land to deploy multiple gigawatts a week. By 2030 we need to bring on multiple gigawatts of new capacity every week, which means securing sites at a pace and scale no one in the industry has operated at. You'll own finding and locking that land ahead of the build.

 - Get power online in months, not years. Most of the clock runs before the lease is ever signed. You'll optimize the pre-signature work, site diligence, permitting, and development, so a site goes from signed lease to live power in under six months.

 - Acquire 10s to 100s of GWs behind the meter. Reaching that scale means generating on-site instead of waiting on grid interconnection. You'll secure the land and behind-the-meter solar generation to get there.

 
 

Role Scope

 - Own commercial relationships with utilities, energy suppliers, and market operators across every active US data center market, from initial engagement through long-term agreement execution.

 - Shape energy supply outcomes by actively participating in regulatory and rate-making processes, engaging ISOs, policymakers, and utilities before constraints land on the build pipeline.

 - Negotiate retail power agreements, PPAs, and behind-the-meter offtake deals with commercial counterparties, structuring terms that create fungible capacity options and running scenario analyses to extend the shelf life of existing options or accelerate delivery of new ones.

 - Partner with the site acquisition team to assess energy requirements for prospective locations before lease commitments, and with legal to structure and refine commercial arrangements for existing facilities.

 - Quarterback across design, construction, finance, sustainability, and on-site operations on all energy workstreams, and distil technical, market, and regulatory developments into clear decisions for leadership.

 
 

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You've managed large-load interconnection processes from application to executed agreement at a utility, developer, or industrial operator, and you know what can go wrong at each step.

 - You've read and modeled from utility tariff filings, rate schedules, and service agreements well enough to build power cost estimates that hold up through project finance and final deal terms.

 - You've maintained working-level relationships with utility project managers and engineers across multiple active projects simultaneously, and you know how to keep a queue item from going dormant.

 - You catch schedule risks and cost exposure before they surface to leadership, and you document project status with enough precision that someone else could pick up a file mid-process without losing context.

 - You quarterback across development, legal, engineering, and finance on site-specific energy questions, and you're the person who knows exactly where each site stands in the interconnection process at any given moment.

 - Bonus: Direct experience across multiple ISO/RTO markets (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, WECC). Background at a utility, ISO, or energy developer. Familiarity with substation design, service entrance requirements, or transmission cost allocation studies. International utility experience in UK or EU markets.


Salary & Benefits

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

AI Screening Notice https://fluidstack.io/legal/ai-screening-notice
Ashby Bias Audit https://fluidstack.io/legal/ashby-bias-audit

If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: SEO / AEO Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.



Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.



We’ve been a fully remote team https://articles.helpscout.com/blog/remote-culture/ since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.



If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Come join the Brand & Content team at Help Scout! For years, we've been far more visible in search than a company our size usually is. Now we're changing how we position Help Scout as we move upmarket. As our SEO / AEO Lead, you'll make sure that new story comes through wherever people look for answers: in classic search, and in AI answers from tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and the like. Your work will help more businesses around the world discover a platform that will empower them to deliver the kind of excellent service that keeps customers for years.

You'll own SEO and AEO across core search surfaces, from strategy to results. You'll get to own your work and priorities with the help of your manager, the Director of Demand Generation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

 - In your first few months, you'll take over our SEO and AEO roadmap, briefs, and reports, and change the strategy where the data says you should.

 - You'll set a baseline for rankings, citations, and signups from each surface, and build out the reporting structure we use to make decisions.

 - You'll write briefs for our content partners on the blog and YouTube, and use your technical SEO chops to set the requirements for key site pages, including our key website pages and integration pages.

 - You'll run our off-site programs: paid listicle placements, sponsored creators, Reddit, and more. You'll make the case for the budget behind them and judge them by results, not activity.

 - You'll do regular deep dives on what's working and use them to change our strategy, investments, and priorities.

 - You'll bring a quarterly plan and budget to marketing leadership.




ABOUT YOU

 - You've grown visibility in both AI answers and classic search, and you can explain what moved the numbers and why.

 - You've run paid placements, creator sponsorships, or community programs, and you've stopped the ones that didn't work.

 - You connect search work to business results. You build reporting that links citations and rankings to signups, and you use it to make decisions.

 - You write and edit well in a remote work environment. Your briefs are clear enough that partners can act on them without a meeting, and your recommendations make sense without you in the room.

 - You're scrappy and creative. We have a small fraction of the resources our competitors have, and you see that as an opportunity.

 - You take ownership with little oversight. You set your own priorities and you're comfortable defending them to leadership.


COMPANY VALUES



WE CARE DEEPLY

Help Scout has always been built on care, for our customers and for each other. We measure that care by its impact: what our work actually does for the businesses we serve and the people we work alongside. That still means sweating the little details, whether we're tackling a tough request in the queue or offering a teammate feedback.




WE MAKE EACH OTHER BETTER

The best people here are multipliers. They make everyone around them better, and they do it on purpose. Working remotely makes that harder and more important, so we're open with our work, direct with each other, and generous with what we know.




WE REINVENT HOW WE WORK

What’s possible keeps evolving, and we treat that as an invitation. We experiment and find new and better ways to get work done. Through all of it, our judgment stays at the center of what we ship.




WE OWN THE OUTCOME

When something is ours, we see it through. Every important piece of work has one clear owner who is accountable for the result, not just the effort, including what happens after the work is done. We keep our commitments, raise problems early, and when we miss, we own it without pointing elsewhere. We expect quality and speed together, and we hold each other to that standard.







BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

 - Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

 - 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

 - A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

 - A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

 - A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

 - If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.




HIRING GUIDELINES:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion https://www.helpscout.com/dei/. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.




A NOTE ON THE USE OF AI IN OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com http://helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

jobs.title: Manager / Sr.Manager - Supply Planner
jobs.description:
We are seeking a seasoned Supply Chain Planner to support our Rx/SRx business. You will ensure inventory planning for all Rx and SRx products meets market demands. You will collaborate closely with the Lead Supply Planner to understand product demand and execute supply planning activities to ensure continuous product availability in the market.

The role will be based in Princeton (NJ) with hybrid work schedule (4days in office) and report to Lead Supply Planner.

Responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for inventory planning for all Rx and SRx products to meet market demands.
• Oversee the movement of goods from production to delivery to the end customer.
• Track key performance indicators to monitor and report performance.
• Optimize the inventory holdings to limit excess Stocks while ensuring fulfilling timely customer orders

jobs.title: Clinical Lab Scientist - Part-Time
jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

**This role qualifies for shift differential**

The Part-Time Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) performs testing in the CLIA-certified laboratory, participates in quality control, quality assurance and troubleshooting activities. A CLS performs duties under general direction, carrying out work assignments in accordance with policies and objectives established by the Clinical Laboratory Manager (CLM)or designee. A CLS is expected to plan and organize his or her own work, determining work methods and assisting in the determination of priorities and deadlines. Completed work is reviewed by the CLM or designee to verify the achievement of expected results.

Shift Schedule: Part-Time (20-29 hrs/week, preferably Tuesday-Thursday 230pm-1030pm, and coverage for Saturdays if needed)

Responsibilities:

• Handle and process patient samples, analyze test results, prepare reports and maintain records of test results.

• May be required to accession samples into the laboratory information management system (LIMS) to facilitate sample throughput.

• Comply with CareDx quality control policies and document QC activities including instrument and procedural calibrations and maintenance

• Maintain confidentiality of personal health information (PHI).

• Identify problems that may affect test performance or results and, following established protocols, correct problems or escalate to Clinical Laboratory Manager, technical supervisor, clinical consultant or lab director.

• Identify test systems that deviate from acceptable performance specifications and follow established policies and procedures to correct operation.

• Document corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from established performance specifications.

• Teach/train CareDx policy, methods and techniques to new employees; may perform inservice and competency testing of employees.

• Participate in drafting and developing standard operating procedures for tasks in which proficiency has been demonstrated.

• Represent the Reference lab testing, quality control and quality assurance program in interactions with other groups.

• Under direction of the CLM, investigate and follow-up on proficiency testing, quality control results and patient testing that does not meet standards.

• Perform additional duties and projects assigned by the Clinical Laboratory Manager.

• Demonstrate knowledge of, and support, the CareDx mission, vision, value statements, standards, policies and procedures, operating instructions, confidentiality standards, and ethical behavior.

• Comply with all local, state, and federal laws and regulations governing clinical laboratory operations

Qualifications:

• Held California Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license

• Education: BS/BA in a biology-related science

• Experience: At least 1-6 years of experience performing high-complexity testing in a clinical laboratory

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

• Demonstrated analytical skills, including working with databases and Excel

• Strong interpersonal skills

• Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with CareDx employees at all levels as well as customers and vendors.

• Demonstrated proficiency in the performance of molecular testing techniques (PCR, real-time PCR, etc.) is highly desirable

• Experience in immunology, microbiology or related fields is preferred

• Demonstrated understanding of a disease with complex treatment algorithms highly desired

• Upon hire, candidates will be required to complete an experience attestation and provide documentation verifying relevant high-complexity laboratory experience, including molecular laboratory experience, as required for CLIA qualification compliance.

Growth:

• CLS, II: Fully meets the qualifications listed above in addition to the following: 3-5 years of licensed clinical laboratory experience.

• CLS, III: Fully meets the qualifications listed above in addition to the following: 6 + years of licensed experience

• Lead: Fully meets qualification section of this description in addition to the following: Must have a minimum of 2 years of licensed clinical laboratory experience Knowledge of workflow timing and efficiency Strong communication with the Lab Leadership team including other leads, supervisors, managers, and director.

jobs.title: Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for people who want to fly spacecraft. As an Operations Engineer, you will be in the command-and-control position on our operations team: commanding on-orbit vehicles, monitoring their health, and working through the unexpected in real time. Some of our operators arrive with years of console experience, and others arrive with a degree, curiosity, and a drive to learn the job. Both paths work here. As you grow in the role, your operational experience will shape how our missions and vehicles are designed, planned, and tested. You will gain experience at every phase of a spacecraft program, from design and launch through on-orbit checkout, mission execution, and customer training. Our culture is one of innovation and speed, so if you are looking for a place where you can take on real responsibility early and keep growing, this is the job to consider.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Operate on-orbit space vehicles from the console: send commands, monitor vehicle health, and run scheduled contacts with the spacecraft

• Investigate and diagnose unexpected vehicle behavior

• Work time-sensitive spacecraft anomalies through to resolution

• Plan missions and assess the risk of each activity before it is executed

• Help develop the concept of operations (CONOP), the plan for how a mission will be flown and what the team and vehicle must do to fly it

• Give operator input to the spacecraft and ground system design teams through every phase of a program

• Run mission-level tests during assembly, integration, and test (AI&T), the campaign where the vehicle is built and proven on the ground before launch

• Participate in, lead, and design rehearsals for mission and launch activities, where the team practices the mission and likely anomalies before the real event

• Brief mission status to leadership and customers with recommended courses of action

• Develop and maintain operational procedures and processes

• Build and deliver training for other operators and for customers

• Coordinate and support system maintenance

QUALIFICATIONS

•    U.S. citizen
•    BS degree in aerospace engineering or related discipline (relevant experience may be substituted for a degree on a case-by-case basis)
•    Basic understanding of the space domain and orbital mechanics
•    Ability to develop and maintain operational procedures and training materials
•    Experience with creating and delivering technical presentations
•    Ability to perform shift work, at times including nights and/or weekends
•    Experience making decisions in high pressure environments
•    Ability to maintain composure in stressful situations

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

•    MS degree in aerospace engineering or related discipline
•    Strong technical background in orbital mechanics and astrodynamics
•    Operational space experience with rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) or space domain awareness (SDA)
•    Experience in modeling, simulation, and analysis
•    Experience with analysis, troubleshooting, and anomaly resolution of operational spacecraft
•    Current Secret or Top Secret security clearance
•    Able to identify and solve complex problems with little to no supervision or direction

COMPENSATION

• Base Salary: $70,000 - $100,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Colorado Springs. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

• Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

• Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Production Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise.

We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows.

Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence.

Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Production Engineers at Mercor are software engineers who own the reliability, performance, and operability of the systems that run our business. You'll sit at the intersection of software and systems: writing code that automates operations, building the observability and deployment foundations every team depends on, and debugging the hardest problems live in production.

Our traffic and compute demands are growing fast, and the systems behind them (Kubernetes, Temporal, Postgres, MongoDB, and the gateway that fronts every model provider we use) need to hold up at the next 10x. You'll be the engineer who makes that true, and who makes deploys, alerts, and incidents boring.



This is a coding role. We expect you to automate your way out of toil rather than absorb it.


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Own the reliability program: define SLOs that matter, kill noisy alerts, and turn every incident into a durable fix rather than a runbook entry.

 - Design, build, and run our observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, and alerting) so any engineer can answer "what's broken and why" in minutes.

 - Own CI/CD and the deployment path to production: progressive rollouts, automated rollbacks, and a pipeline that lets an org shipping dozens of times a day (with coding agents as first-class users) do so safely.

 - Manage our AWS footprint and Kubernetes fleet through infrastructure as code (Terraform), with configuration management and change processes that scale.

 - Operate and tune Temporal, Postgres, MongoDB, and other stateful systems for performance, availability, and recoverability, including backups, failover, and capacity planning.

 - Design network and identity boundaries across production, preprod, and research compute, and keep Linux hosts and containers secure and well tuned.

 - Lead incident response: participate in a weekly on-call rotation, serve as an escalation point, run blameless site event reviews, and drive the follow-ups to completion.

 - Extend our AI-triaged, auto-assigned on-call: decide what gets automated next and build it.

 - Dig into data to find the root of a problem, then partner with product, research, and backend infrastructure engineers on the fix.

 - Make cost legible: attribute spend across cloud, data centers, and inference providers, and find the changes that bend the curve.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years in production engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles operating systems that real users depend on, and the scars to prove it.

 - Strong Linux and networking fundamentals: processes, memory, file systems, TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and TLS.

 - Advanced proficiency in Python or Go. You write tested, reviewable code to automate operations rather than relying on scripts and consoles.

 - Hands-on experience with AWS (for example EKS/ECS, EC2, S3, ALB, VPC, IAM) and infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred).

 - Production experience with containers and Kubernetes.

 - Deep experience with observability tooling (for example Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) and with designing alerts people trust.

 - Experience building and running CI/CD pipelines at scale.

 - A clear model of how distributed systems fail: cascading failures, backpressure, retries and idempotency, and capacity limits.

 - Calm, structured incident leadership and the ability to work through ambiguous problems with engineering, security, and IT stakeholders.

 - High ownership: you see a gap, write the proposal, ship it, and carry the pager for it.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience operating Postgres, MongoDB, message queues, or workflow engines such as Temporal at meaningful scale.

 - Experience with GPU or inference workloads, or with multi-provider LLM traffic.

 - Security and identity experience: Okta, SSO, secrets management, least-privilege IAM, and provisioning automation.

 - Experience with chaos engineering, load testing, or disaster recovery exercises.

 - A track record of integrating AI tools into operational workflows with measurable results (faster triage, fewer pages, shorter MTTR).

 - Experience managing vendors and negotiating contracts, such as cloud commitments, observability or tooling licenses, and inference provider agreements, to balance cost, reliability, and flexibility.


HOW WE WORK

 - Small, senior team with direct access to the Head of Infrastructure and to engineering leadership.

 - In-person five days a week in SF. Infra is a team sport for us.

 - We use AI coding agents heavily and expect you to as well; the interesting work is deciding what they should do, not typing.

 - Weekly on-call rotation with structured handoffs. On-call load is a metric we actively drive down, and this role owns much of that work.
   
   Benefits

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

Benefits: 

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Unlimited paid vacation and sick days

 - Parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

 - Free mental health services

 - $200 monthly wellness reimbursement

 - $1.5K monthly meal stipend

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - Free Equinox membership

 - Up to $15K relocation bonus

jobs.title: Senior Character & Motion Designer – Robotics
jobs.description:
About Mind Robotics

At Mind Robotics, we put code into motion—designing and building AI-enabled industrial robots that master real-world physics and dexterous manipulation on the factory floor. We build hardware engineered to work safely alongside people, making manufacturing safer, more efficient, and more globally competitive.

 

Why Work at Mind: We pair the speed of a startup with the resources and built-in deployment scale of an industrial pioneer—joining a team that values ownership, humility, and turning physical AI into iconic, factory-ready hardware.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Character & Motion Designer (5–7 years of experience) with a background in feature animation, VFX, games, or expressive robotics (such as Pixar, DreamWorks, Disney, or leading character-driven studios).



Operating at the intersection of character performance, physical user experience, and robotics engineering, you will define how our machines move, communicate, and feel alive in the real world. Rather than treating movement purely as mechanical path planning, you will apply classic animation principles- weight, timing, anticipation, follow-through, and appeal- to give our industrial robots unmistakable character, clear intent, and natural, non-robotic grace alongside human operators. 

Key Responsibilities

Character Performance, Expressive Motion & Physical UX

 - Character & Motion Vocabulary: Define the core movement language, idle behaviors, gestures, and emotional/functional expressions that give our robots distinct personality and warmth without sacrificing industrial utility.

 - Human-Robot Spatial Choreography: Translate human social cues and factory-floor workflows into intuitive physical behaviors- designing clear movement anticipation, gaze/head-tilt intent, and non-threatening spatial presence so people immediately understand what the robot is doing next. 

 - Physical-Digital Feedback Loops: Collaborate with Industrial Design, HMI/UI, and Sound design teams to synchronize body language with status lighting, audio cues, and physical interaction points. 

 - Constraint-Driven Performance: Adapt expressive character acting to real-world hardware realities- working within joint limits, motor torque curves, payload dynamics, and safety envelopes so animations translate seamlessly from simulation to physical hardware. 

Rigging, Runtime Pipelines & AI-Accelerated Workflow

 - Mechanical Rigging & Post Libraries: Build FK/IK mechanical rigs matching exact robot kinematics and author modular motion libraries, blended state machines, and procedural animation layers that our AI behavior systems execute in real time. 

 - Hardware-in-the Loop Testing: Deploy motion studies directly onto physical prototype robots, iterating on timing, weight, and readability in person from multiple viewing angles. 

 - Simulation & Pre-Visualization: Produce high-craft pre-vis sequences, kinematic motion studies, and interactive real-time demos to align leadership, industrial designers, and controls engineers on robot behavior. 

 - AI & Generative Workflow Integration: Leverage AI-assisted motion/visualization tools and multimodal LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini) to accelerate behavioral ideation, motion documentation, scripting, and cross-functional communication. 

Required Qualifications

 - Experience: 5–7 years of professional  experience in character animation, motion design, or technical animation across feature film, television, AAA games, animatronics, or expressive robotics. 

 - Demo Reel: A standout demo reel demonstrating mastery of character acting, weight, timing, anticipation, balance, and personality-driven motion (non-human, mechanical, or prop-based character work is a major plus).

 - Physical UX & Behavioral Intuition: Deep understanding of how movement communicates intent, emotion, and safety in a physical world, making complex machines feel approachable and legible to human coworkers.

 - Animation & Rigging Software Mastery: Expert proficiency in industry-standard 3D animation, rigging, and real-time tools-specificially Autodesk Maya, Blender, MotionBuilder, and Unreal Engine or Unity. 

 - Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing mastery over high-complexity assemblies, expressive yet functional surfacing, physical mockups, and tight integration of mechanical and electrical constraints.

 - Technical & Pipeline Fluency: Working knowledge of mechanical rigging (FK/IK, constraints), state machines, and scripting (Python or MEL) to bridge animation tools with robotics control pipelines. 

 - AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI workflows—specifically Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini—into daily design research, ideation, synthesis, and workflow acceleration.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience animating or programming motion for physical hardware, theme park animatronics, puppetry, or live robotics platforms.

 - Familiarity with robotics middleware/simulation environments (e.g., ROS/ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) or CAD tools (SolidWorks, Rhino). 

 - Deep understanding of volume production methods for complex hardware: structural composites, high-pressure aluminum die castings, structural foam molding, CNC machining, and performance textiles/elastomers.

 - Strong live sketching and sequential storyboard skills to illustrate functional movement arcs and human-robot interaction flows.
