• Training: All new Faculty Members receive specific training from Walden University in teaching techniques, use of the electronic learning platform, policies and procedures of the School or College in which they will teach, socialization into Walden University culture, assessment of academic integrity of student work (including use of www.turnitin.com), and research supervision of theses and dissertations.
• Course Teaching (Secondary Responsibility): When assigned a course, Faculty Members teach using the Canvas platform and are responsible for interacting with students within it. Discussion boards are open 24/7; postings may be made at any time but must be completed in a timely manner per the Faculty Handbook. Responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hours. Faculty Members are required to verify the accuracy of student postings and submissions and to provide feedback and grades through Canvas.
• Availability: Faculty are expected to be reasonably accessible to students, including outside the course discussion board, and to provide substantive feedback on assignments and postings. Faculty publish their availability through course syllabi, instructor information in the classroom, and/or other appropriate documents. Regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or chats, is suggested.
• Residencies: Faculty Members may be required to attend residencies held domestically or internationally to teach intensives and colloquia and facilitate school- and university-wide discussions. (Part-time faculty may, but are not required to, attend.)
• Performs other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. 



About the Role:
We are looking for a Software Engineer, Security to build the capabilities that protect customer data and help enterprise customers use our products with confidence. Your primary focus will be shipping product security and compliance features, from access controls and auditability to safe handling of sensitive data.

You'll also shape the shared security architecture, libraries, and tooling that make secure defaults part of how Nooks engineers build. Working with Security, Engineering, Product, Design, and Compliance, you'll own problems from technical design through production rollout and help secure an expanding set of AI-enabled products.



What you’ll do:

 - Build product security capabilities and compliance features. Design and ship authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, audit logging, and customer data controls with partner teams.

 - Create secure defaults. Build shared libraries, frameworks, service patterns, and baselines that make secure implementations straightforward to adopt.

 - Find and fix risks in production software. Threat-model features, review designs and code, remediate vulnerabilities, and harden web, backend/API, and mobile components with tests that prevent recurrence.

 - Turn requirements into working controls. Partner with Compliance and product teams to translate applicable customer and framework requirements, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001, into practical engineering controls and verifiable evidence.

 - Improve security through automation. Build tooling and CI/CD guardrails, reduce repetitive security work, and use AI to assist code review, triage, and threat modeling while validating its output.

 - Lead cross-functional security initiatives. Work with Engineering, Product, and Design from prioritization through rollout, including production controls for AI features, agents, and integrations that address data exposure, excessive permissions, prompt injection, and unsafe tool use.



We’re looking for someone who has:

 - 6+ years of relevant experience in security-focused software engineering, product security, application security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager(09162) - 2081 Barrington Rd
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Additional Job Details

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Member Experience Specialist (Bilingual)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As part of our Member Experience team, you will play a vital role in delivering unparalleled support, working directly with customers to provide a world-class experience. You will be the voice and advocate of our brand, ensuring every interaction leaves a lasting impression of trust, satisfaction, and delight. By actively addressing customer needs and exceeding their expectations, you will contribute not only to the success of our customers but also to the growth and reputation of our company. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop real-world expertise in customer service, creative problem-solving, and impactful communication, all while making a tangible difference in the lives of our customers and the future of Base. 

 

What You'll Do

 - Engage with members across phone, email, text, and other communication channels, delivering personalized and delightful experiences that leave a lasting impact.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve member issues related to Base Power's innovative products, ensuring seamless and satisfying solutions.

 - Utilize tools to track, manage, troubleshoot, and prioritize member interactions, ensuring every concern is addressed promptly and efficiently.

 - Partner with engineering, marketing, and operations teams to streamline processes, enhance the member experience, and drive continuous improvement.

 - Act as the “voice of the customer”, gathering valuable feedback and insights to shape the future of our products and services.

 - Create and maintain detailed documentation, knowledge bases, playbooks, and team resources to ensure consistency in service.

 - Support new members during onboarding to ensure they understand and can fully utilize Base Power's products from the start.
   
    

What You'll Bring

 - 0-5 years of experience.

 - Fluency in Spanish (written and verbal) is required.

 - Empathetic communicator who loves connecting with people and making them feel heard.

 - Strong writing skills with excellent grammar, tone, and clarity.

 - Ability to think analytically and creatively to resolve complex issues and suggest process improvements.

 - Attention to detail in communicating accurately and clearly, tracking customer interactions, and documenting solutions.

 - Skilled at managing multiple tasks and inquiries simultaneously while meeting deadlines and response time goals.

 - Natural inclination to stay calm under pressure and step up to proactively de-escalate frustrating situations.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-paced environment to quickly adapt to changes while maintaining high-quality support.

 - Tech savvy, with a knack for quickly mastering new tools and systems.

 - Team player motivated by the mission who always puts the company’s best interests first.

 

About the Team

The Member Experience team is the face of Base to our members—and the voice of our members back to Base. We’re deeply customer-obsessed and uniquely cross-functional, with a strong understanding of what every team does and how it all connects. By seeing firsthand what’s working well and what should be improved, we surface insights that help inform what the business builds and prioritizes next. Every day brings a new challenge, balancing high ownership and accountability with constant collaboration and support from the team.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Standing

Walking

Sitting

Lifting

Hand Tasks

jobs.title: Executive Director, Research Program Management
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

As Executive Director of Research Program Management (RPM), you will lead the team that connects scientific strategy with coordinated execution across RevMed’s discovery and preclinical portfolio. Reporting to the Head of the Integrated Research Hub (IRH) and serving on the IRH Leadership Team, you will shape RPM strategy, elevate PM capabilities, and partner with senior Research leaders to translate portfolio and organizational priorities into coordinated action across discovery programs, Research Pillars, and cross-functional initiatives.

This role offers scope to influence Research-wide priorities, lead cross-functional change, and build leadership depth within RPM and IRH. We seek a leader with strategic and organizational judgment, the ability to develop others as influential partners to scientific teams, and the potential to assume broader leadership responsibilities over time.

• Set a clear strategy for RPM aligned with Research priorities; demonstrate its value through decision-readiness, effective execution, and strong partnerships with Project Team Leaders (PTLs) and functions.

• Lead, recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing PM team. Elevate PMs’ strategic thinking, scientific fluency, and influence; provide actionable coaching, hold PMs accountable for outcomes, and develop future leaders.

• Align PM assignments and capabilities with the priorities of programs, Research Pillars, and cross-functional initiatives; coach PMs to tailor support to each team and recommend efficient staffing and capability investments as needs evolve.

• Guide PMs in translating scientific objectives and key questions into integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, and resource needs; adapt plans as evidence and priorities change.

• Strengthen preparation for governance and milestone decisions, helping teams present evidence, alternatives, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leaders.

• Support senior Research leadership forums by framing issues and decisions, integrating stakeholder perspectives, and coordinating follow-through on agreed priorities

• Maintain portfolio-wide visibility to progress, risks, and dependencies. Surface recurring barriers and capacity constraints, recommend solutions, and escalate issues requiring Research leadership decisions.

• Establish practical PM standards, tools, and measures of effectiveness; simplify workflows and reporting while preserving flexibility for different discovery stages and team needs.

• Partner with Development and function-based PM groups, including Pharmaceutical Development Management (PDM) and Regulatory, to coordinate program handoffs and align planning practices.

• Partner with the Integrated Research Management Lead, Research Pillar leaders, and other stakeholders to improve application of the RevMed Operating Model and translate agreed changes into team practices.

• Help shape IRH strategy and organizational capabilities as an IRH Leadership Team member. Lead shared priorities across functions, align stakeholders, and model accountability, coordinated communication, and follow-through.

Required Experience, Skills and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline; typically 14 or more years in biotechnology or pharmaceuticals, including at least 8 years of cross-functional R&D program management experience.

• Substantial discovery and preclinical program experience, with a strong understanding of scientific functions, stage-appropriate evidence, and transitions into clinical development.

• Proven people leader with success building PM teams, strengthening individual and team performance, and developing PMs into strategic partners and future leaders.

• Strong program management expertise across integrated planning, risk and dependency management, resourcing, and governance preparation; applies methods proportionately in a changing research environment.

• Ability to connect program issues with portfolio and organizational priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, and influence senior leaders through sound scientific and business judgment.

• Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, resolve cross-functional disagreements, and lead practical changes through adoption and sustained use.

• Excellent written, verbal, and facilitation skills; communicates complex issues succinctly and moves effectively between strategic discussions and execution details.

• Demonstrated experience improving portfolio reporting and PM workflows through dashboards, automation, and applicable AI-enabled tools, with sound judgment on data quality and appropriate use to turn portfolio information into actionable insights.

• A collaborative, adaptable leadership approach consistent with RevMed’s values and commitment to patients.

Preferred Skills:

• Advanced scientific degree or MBA; PMP or equivalent program management certification.

• Oncology experience and exposure to clinical development, regulatory strategy, and pharmaceutical development; experience connecting research plans with downstream development needs.

• Experience with the R&D–commercial interface or external collaborations and partnered programs

jobs.title: Delivery Driver(07924) - 1045 N Wilson Way
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

QUALIFICATIONS

General job duties for all store team members

Operate all equipment.

Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

Prepare product.

Receive and process telephone orders.

Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

Must be able to make correct monetary change.

Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

Fumes from food odors.

Exposure to cornmeal dust.

Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agent and Partner Experiences
jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

As a Staff Engineer for the Agent & Partner Experiences team, you’ll be a key technical leader empowering internal and partner developers to build reliably and efficiently on Gusto Embedded Payroll. You’ll collaborate across product and engineering teams to design, build, and evolve tooling, APIs, SDKs, documentation, and workflows that reduce friction and improve velocity for those who integrate with Gusto Embedded Payroll.

This role combines hands-on engineering with strategic thinking about how developers interact with our products—identifying root causes of friction, validating solutions with users, and delivering scalable improvements.

Your influence will span teams, including product, platform, and partnerships, while your primary impact will be through execution and technical ownership rather than setting org-wide policy.

About the Team:

Gusto Agent & Partner Experiences is how Gusto shows up wherever our customers want to work. We build the APIs, SDKs, and AI interfaces that let partners embed payroll directly into their own software, and let AI agents act on payroll on a customer's behalf. That means a small business can run payroll from the tools it already uses, whether that's a vertical SaaS product, a fintech or neobank app, or an AI-native experience. We've taken Gusto's payroll infrastructure and opened it up beyond Gusto itself, so anyone can build the best payroll experience for their customers, with Gusto powering it behind the scenes.

Learn more about Gusto Embedded Payroll here.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Own and deliver high-impact initiatives that improve the experience of external developers integrating with Gusto Embedded Payroll and Solutions Architects supporting those integrations, balancing partner needs, business impact, and technical complexity.

• Partner with Solutions Architects to understand recurring integration challenges and translate them into scalable platform, tooling, or documentation improvements.

• Design, build, and evolve developer-facing APIs, SDKs, reference implementations, and tooling with a strong focus on clarity, consistency, backwards compatibility, and long-term maintainability.

• Improve onboarding, debugging, and operational workflows for partners through better docs, examples, error messages, observability, and feedback loops that inform iteration.

• Engage directly with external developers and partners to gather feedback, validate solutions, and evaluate effectiveness based on real-world usage.

• Work closely with product and engineering teams to ensure partner and Solutions Architect needs are actively advocated for and appropriately weighted in technical decisions and tradeoffs.

• Lead by example through hands-on development, shipping well-tested, maintainable code that supports long-term platform health.

• Mentor engineers and collaborate with peers to raise the quality, consistency, and shared technical direction of developer-facing systems across teams.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• Experience: 8+ years of professional software development experience, with ownership of complex initiatives from problem definition and prioritization through delivery and iteration.

• Technical Expertise: Strong backend engineering expertise, with deep experience working in large, production systems (Ruby on Rails experience is a plus). You’re comfortable working across multiple layers of abstraction and making pragmatic tradeoffs.

• Developer First: A developer-first mindset, with deep empathy for integrators and a focus on clear contracts, predictable behavior, actionable error messages, and high-quality documentation.

• Mentoring: You enjoy mentoring and raising the technical bar for your team and adjacent teams through guidance, collaboration, and example.

• Effective Communicator: You possess the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and constraints to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can influence technical direction through execution, collaboration, and technical leadership rather than formal authority.

• AI-native Curiosity: Curiosity in an AI-native engineering environment, leveraging intelligence, automation, and experimentation to improve developer tooling, workflows, and partner-facing payroll APIs at scale.

Please note that travel to Gusto's office for onboarding is required for this position. If you have any questions regarding this requirement, please share with your recruiter.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at 163,000–204,000 in Denver, and 197,000–247,000 for San Francisco & New York. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

jobs.description:
SUMMARY

Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

Avetta’s Solution Engineering team helps turn complex business challenges into clear, compelling solutions. You’ll work alongside a curious, collaborative group that values thoughtful storytelling, practical problem-solving, and sharing what we learn in the field.

The opportunity extends well beyond customer conversations. In close partnership with Sales, Product, Marketing, Implementation, and leaders across Avetta, you’ll help shape how we bring our solutions to market, contribute to cross-functional initiatives, and make customer and industry insights useful across the business. If you enjoy connecting people and ideas—and want your work to have impact across a growing organization—you’ll find room to make a meaningful contribution here.

The Solution Engineer partners with Sales to understand prospect and customer needs, shape and validate solution approaches, and communicate Avetta’s value through consultative discovery, tailored demonstrations, and technical guidance. The role helps advance opportunities by connecting business requirements to product capabilities, surfacing risks and gaps, and coordinating with Product, Implementation, and other teams to support a clear transition from evaluation to delivery.

This role requires Spanish / Portugues lanague proficiency.  If you reside within 30 miles of an Avetta office location the position will require a 3 day per week on-site hybrid work schedule.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Support in region enterprise and mid-market opportunities.

• Own the technical strategy for assigned opportunities, using account and industry research to align Avetta’s capabilities with customer priorities.

• Engage prospects throughout the sales journey, including exploratory conversations, product demonstrations, and technical handoff to implementation.

• Collaborate in crafting proposals, presentations, workflows, and value propositions.

• Clearly communicate Avetta’s value to stakeholders, tailoring the message to their roles and industries.

• Build and maintain knowledge of Avetta’s differentiators and the regional competitive landscape.

• Leverage AI tools such as Glean and Microsoft Copilot to streamline account and industry research, synthesize customer insights, and support the development of tailored demonstrations, proposals, and presentations; validate AI-generated content before sharing.

• Regular domestic travel required to support clients and Avetta events; with international travel potential.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES:

• Take the lead on pivotal cross-functional projects, including maintenance of the Avetta solution suite demonstration environments.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on defined new product releases.

• Partner with Marketing to support brand building events including webinars, conferences, industry gatherings, and client events.

• Cultivate customer relationships with sales, identifying growth opportunities.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION & TRAINING:

• 0-3 years of sales, pre-sales or similar client-facing experience, ideally showcasing technical aptitude.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, computer science or equivalent experience.

• HSE, Risk Management, Procurement or Sustainability experience is an asset.

• Experience with technical writing, analytics and / or process visualization a plus.

jobs.title: Community Engagement Specialist
jobs.description:
At Yerba Madre, we’re more than a beverage company—we’re a movement inspired to help people Come to Life. Rooted in the sacred energy of yerba mate,  a magical drink like no other, our products are designed to make you feel not just awake, but truly alive. Through a regenerative, circular business model—from sip to seed to shelf—we turn fans into agents of change who give back more than they take. By honoring yerba mate culture, strengthening communities, and restoring the Atlantic Forest, we create a positive impact on both people and planet.

As a company, our core values and fundamental beliefs are guided by these four principles that shape how our company operates:

• Alive with Energy: We bring vitality to everything we do

• Brave the Unknown: We lead with conviction and unafraid to disrupt

• Sacred Service: We lead with care and serve from the heart

• Resilient Roots: We grow stronger together a help others do the same

If this resonates with you, we invite you to Come to Life with us.

We're looking for a Community Engagement Specialist to help elevate the Yerba Madre’s community and customer experience. You will bring Yerba Madre’s unmistakable voice to life in comments and DMs, find new friends and stories worth celebrating and turn everyday interactions in community moments. We are looking for an enthusiastic, positive connection builder that lives and breathes the value of community. Emotionally intelligent and digitally astute, you'll work collaboratively with the Quality Assurance and Communications team to deliver a fun, human and positive experience for our Yerba Madre customers and social fans. This is a full-time position reporting to the Community Marketing Manager. You will handle day-to-day community engagement across our social comments, direct messages and in the Ambacebador (community app) where 10,000 Yerba Madre super fans connect. You’ll also handle consumer response across social and work with quality assurance and communications when questions or issues need their input to perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

THIS ROLE REQUIRED TO WORK ON-SITE IN OUR VIBRANT DOWNTOWN LOS ANGELES, CA OFFICE 3 DAYS A WEEK.

What You'll Do:

Social Community Engagement

• Engage authentically with our community in the Yerba Madre voice, joining relevant conversations, responding thoughtfully to tags and mentions, and proactively connecting with fans whose content and stories are worth celebrating.

• Bring surprise and delight moments to life in partnership with the Community Marketing Manager, finding creative ways to recognize loyal fans, celebrate memorable interactions, and deepen community connection.

• Surface community insights and trends by sharing recurring questions, audience sentiment, emerging themes, and standout fan content with the Social Media Manager and Community Marketing Manager to help inform content and engagement strategies.

Ambacebador App Engagement

• Build an active and welcoming community in the Amby app, engaging new members, answering questions, responding to posts, and helping spark conversations that strengthen connection and participation.

• Bring community programming to life in Amby by sharing prompts and program updates, executing planned activities, and surfacing meaningful member stories, feedback, and engagement opportunities for the Community Marketing Manager.

Consumer Response

• Deliver thoughtful, timely consumer care across channels, monitoring the Outlook consumer inbox, social comments, and direct messages daily; responding to routine questions in the Yerba Madre voice; and connecting consumers with the appropriate internal teams when additional support is needed.

• Own accurate tracking and escalation of consumer concerns, documenting complaints, maintaining current case details and follow-ups, and promptly escalating product quality concerns or sensitive issues to Quality Assurance, Communications, or other appropriate partners.

• Meet regularly with Quality Assurance Team to share recurring product concerns and follow up on open cases.

What you'll bring to the table:

• 2-5 years of Community Management or Communications experience, preferably within a fast moving brand

• Education level: Bachelor’s Degree

• Demonstrated passion in Yerba Madre’s regeneration-driven business model, the brand, and the product

• Thoroughly know, understand, and engage in meaningful discussions about the company's values and products.

• Personable and accountable to both internal and external stakeholders

• Emotional intelligence and empathy

• Strong written and verbal communications skills

• Self-motivated, curious, and proactive

• Approaches new and different ideas with curiosity and open-mindedness

• Reliably commit to contracted hours and tasks allocated, show transparency with line manager and act professionally in all interactions with the business.

What we offer:

The pay range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors; actual pay offered may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Sales commissions and/or variable pay plans are also offered depending on the position (ex: monthly, quarterly, annual bonuses). Additionally, we offer a competitive benefits package including top-tier benefits, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, employee life and disability, mental health benefits, paid medical leave, paid company holidays, and paid time off, as well as opportunities for career growth and advancement within our team!

Salary Range

$59,000—$75,000 USD

Yerba Madre—formerly Guayakí Yerba Mate—is the nearly 30-year pioneer of regenerative yerba mate [yer-bah ma-tay] and the category leader in ready-to-drink mate beverages across North America. The name Yerba Madre, meaning “Mother Herb,” is a tribute to Mother Earth and the ancestral wisdom of the Indigenous communities who have cultivated yerba mate for generations —a reflection of the values the brand has championed since day one.

Headquartered in Oakland and Los Angeles, California, Yerba Madre sources organic, shade-grown yerba mate in direct partnership with 255 family farmers and Indigenous communities across Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay. Using its Market Driven Regeneration™ model, every purchase helps reforest the Atlantic Forest, support fair trade premiums, and build long-term economic resilience for grower communities.

In 2025, the brand became the world’s first yerba mate to achieve Regenerative Organic Certified™ Gold® status——setting a new global standard for ecological integrity, cultural respect, and environmental restoration.

As an original founding member of the B Corp community and a founding member of the Purpose Pledge, Yerba Madre is committed to ethical business practices across ten key pillars, including climate positivity, living wages, circularity, and inclusion. Yerba Madre is available in over 45,000 retail locations across the U.S. and Canada. To learn more, visit www.YerbaMadre.com.

jobs.title: 27-28 Special Education (ESE) Teacher

Here’s what you need to know:

Our schools are seeking awe-inspiring teachers to guide our students as they climb the mountain to college and beyond. Our teachers are dynamic leaders both in and outside of their classroom. They love students, working with families and the community they serve.

Special Education/ ESE Teacher

As a Special Education Teacher you'll be responsible for the academic, socio-emotional growth, and development of students by creating a learning experience that provides opportunities for each student to reach their full potential regardless of their disabilities.

Here’s what you’ll be doing:

Joining our schools as a teacher comes with a lot of growth opportunities, but with great power comes great responsibility. Your role as a Special Education Teacher will involve a number of responsibilities which will include but are not limited to:

Teaching and Classroom Responsibilities

• Teach in an inclusive class, sharing all responsibilities with a general education teacher
• Provides resource small group support as needed
• Provides an alternative or parallel teaching to a group of students and provides 1:1 teaching, as needed
• Employs multisensory teaching strategies and specialized instruction as needed based on student’s specific disabilities
• Implements all modifications and accommodations for the classroom and in testing
• Create IEPs in collaboration with Child Response Team to ensure services are being delivered at ahigh level and are in compliance.
• Uses student IEPs, evaluations, and present levels of performance to ensure services are being delivered at a high level.
• Collaborate with student support team to conduct annual IEP meetings
• Use data to responsively teach to mastery of academic skills
• Tracks student performance and progress and is responsible for continual improvement in student growth objectives
• Administers and tracks weekly assessment data to both monitor progress towards grade level goals as well as IEP goals
• Create action plans to improve performance when students are not on track to meet goals
• Consistently and clearly communicates progress to all shared stakeholders
• Participate in school, departmental, and parent meetings
• Participate in school events, activities, and programs both during and outside of regular class instruction hours.

IEP Management

• Assumes responsibility for writing both initial and updated IEPs based on present levels of performance and developing goals that related to curriculum standards and content
• Track student progress towards IEP goals on a weekly and quarterly basis
• Uses tracking of student progress to determine changes in student programming
• Report achievement of goals and objectives at the end of every advisory period and issues quarterly progress reports
• Maintain a portfolio of student grades, work samples, anecdotal data, and classroom observation information

Case Management

• Assume responsibility for case compliance and student academic progress as documented through both academic and compliance tracking tools.
• Assume responsibility for reviewing and analyzing all student information and developing a corrective action plan for students who need additional testing and/or a change in service.
• Maintain special education files, in collaboration with the grade level social worker, and ensure that all evaluation recommendations are followed up and completed.
• Help to coordinate all IEP meetings for the grade level (Initial, Eligibility, IEP, Re-eligibility, Triennial), providing all academic data
• Communicates IEP notes and updates to GL teams / teachers and paraprofessionals
• Ensure that related services are represented in the IEPs and are being delivered in an integrated way and practically applied in the classroom.
• Review monthly data as to student performance with Assistant Principal.

Team and Family Engagement

• Collaborate closely with students, families and colleagues to create an environment that is supportive of student progress.
• Effectively communicate academic and behavior performance to families
• Participate in school, departmental and parent meetings as required.

Professional Development

• Engage actively in the Performance Management Process.
• Continue personal development in your subject matter knowledge and teaching methods.
• Attend and actively participate in school sponsored professional development.
• Participate in school events, activities and programs both during and outside of regular class instruction hours.

Must Haves

• A belief in every student’s limitless potential
• A Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university required (Official transcripts showing degree conferred are required prior to the starting date of employment)
• Valid Florida ESE (Exceptional Student Education) Teaching Certification
• Subject matter expertise
• A minimum of two years of teaching experience, with demonstrated interest in working with students from diverse economic and cultural backgrounds
• A track record of success in the classroom
• A collaborative attitude towards teaching and learning

Nice to Haves:

• Masters in Special Education/ Teaching Students with Disabilities
• A record of exceptional student achievement and results at a high-performing charter network/charter management organization.
• A belief that all students deserve a world class education which can be achieved through education reform

The usual and customary methods of performing the job’s functions require the following physical demands:

• Often required to stand and sit; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, bend, or squat.
• Some lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling and significant fine finger dexterity.
• Walk frequently and climb stairs.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision
Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Technical Project Manager, you will plan and drive complex, cross-team delivery across GridUnity’s engineering organization. You will help shape scope, timing, and phasing with Customer Success, Product and Engineering, then own the path from that plan to a successful release: turning goals into plans, surfacing dependencies and risks early, and keeping work moving across teams.

This is a technical role. You will understand the architecture, integrations, and environments behind the work well enough to ask the right questions, challenge estimates, and help engineers resolve blockers. You will partner with engineering leadership on planning, capacity, and delivery practices, and with Product, Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Customer Experience on scope, timing, and customer commitments.

Your success will be reflected in predictable delivery, fewer late surprises, and stakeholders who trust the status they receive because it is clear, current, and grounded in evidence.




PLAN AND DRIVE DELIVERY

 - Lead planning for cross-team initiatives and releases, turning goals and scope into milestones, sequencing, and clear ownership.

 - Work with engineering leads to break down work, validate estimates, and build plans that reflect real capacity, dependencies, and risk.

 - Run engineering team ceremonies and the broader delivery cadence for your programs, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, dependency reviews, and release readiness reviews. Keep meetings purposeful and decisions recorded.

 - Establish a clear definition of ready and definition of done with Product and Engineering. Ensure work meets the definition of ready before a sprint commits to it, and meets the definition of done before it is considered complete.

 - Track progress against plan in Jira and related tools, keeping boards, epics, and roadmaps accurate enough to support real decisions.

 - Identify blockers early and drive them to resolution, escalating through the established path when a decision is needed.


MANAGE TECHNICAL RISK AND DEPENDENCIES

 - Understand the architecture, integrations, data flows, and environments behind each initiative well enough to anticipate where work will get hard.

 - Map dependencies across teams, systems, and third parties, and make sure each one has an owner and a date.

 - Maintain a living risk log for your programs, with likelihood, impact, mitigation, and accountable owners.

 - Partner with Quality Engineering to align validation plans and exit criteria with the release plan before deadlines are committed.

 - Coordinate release and deployment planning with Engineering and DevOps, including cutover steps, rollback plans, and customer-facing timing.


COMMUNICATE AND ALIGN STAKEHOLDERS

 - Provide clear, regular status to engineering leadership, Product, and Customer Experience: what is on track, what is at risk, and what decision is needed.

 - Make tradeoffs between scope, timing, and quality visible, and help stakeholders make informed decisions rather than discovering them late.

 - Translate technical detail into language that nontechnical stakeholders and customer-facing teams can act on.

 - Support customer implementation and utility-facing commitments by keeping delivery dates realistic and changes communicated early.


IMPROVE HOW WE DELIVER

 - Partner with engineering leadership to improve planning, estimation, capacity management, and delivery practices across teams.

 - Define and use meaningful delivery measures, such as predictability against plan, cycle time, dependency lead time, and release outcomes.

 - Lead retrospectives on major initiatives and follow through on improvements that reduce recurring delays.

 - Use AI-assisted tools where they improve planning, reporting, or coordination, with appropriate review so their output is trusted only when it has been checked.

 - Share effective practices across GridUnity’s product lines, adapting the approach to each team’s size, maturity, and risk profile.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING


REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

 - 6+ years of experience in technical project management, program management, software engineering, or a related technical delivery role, including 3+ years managing cross-team software initiatives.

 - A track record of delivering complex SaaS releases on time by building realistic plans, managing dependencies, and adapting as conditions change.

 - Enough technical depth to understand system architecture, APIs, integrations, environments, and CI/CD workflows, and to engage credibly with engineers on design and estimation.

 - Experience running Agile delivery (Scrum, Kanban, or a hybrid) and adapting processes to fit the team rather than the other way around.

 - Proficiency with Jira or comparable tools for planning, tracking, and reporting on work across multiple teams.

 - Ability to identify, quantify, and communicate risk, and to drive decisions on scope, timing, and quality tradeoffs.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to give concise status to executives and detailed direction to engineering teams.

 - Comfort leading through influence: aligning people who do not report to you around shared plans and priorities.

 - Strong organizational skills and follow-through, with a habit of making ownership and next steps explicit.


PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

 - Domain Expertise: Background in energy, utilities, grid management, or regulated sectors with extended customer sign-off cycles.

 - Enterprise Implementation: Proven success deploying enterprise software or complex integrations for large clients alongside continuous core product releases.

 - Scale & Governance: Track record of maturing delivery processes or establishing project management frameworks within expanding SaaS organizations.

 - Roadmapping & Collaboration Tools: Proficiency with Confluence, Jira Advanced Roadmaps, or equivalent platforms for documentation and cross-functional alignment.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Competitive Intelligence
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Director, Global Competitive Intelligence, the Senior Manager / Associate Director, Competitive Intelligence the Competitive Intelligence role requires strategic thinking and expertise to provide critical contributions to brand strategy, launch and life-cycle planning, forecasting, and product and portfolio decisions.  As a key member of the Global Competitive Intelligence team, this role is instrumental in delivering the disease area insights that shape brand strategy, launch planning, forecasting, and clinical development decisions for our assets in development.

The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in monitoring and evaluating the competitive landscape, conducting comprehensive threat assessments, and collaborating with key stakeholders to inform strategic planning.  This position would ideally be based at our headquarters in Redwood City, CA., however open to remote candidates who are willing to travel to our CA office on a regular basis.

Responsibilities Include

• Integrates disease area findings and cross-functional perspectives into a company-wide view of the external environment and translates findings into implications and recommendations for the portfolio.

• Contributes to competitive coverage across conferences, publications, data releases, earnings and investor events, and commercial activities and messaging, based on agreed cross-functional priorities. Integrate with cross functional and regional expertise and shares timely implications for development and commercialization. Builds and maintains the disease area competitive landscape across early and metastatic disease setting and inclusive of in and out-of-class competition.

• Benchmarks competitor clinical data, business models, and capabilities.

• Collaborates with stakeholders across the company (including Commercial, Medical Affairs, and R&D) to integrate internal and external information, analytics, and data.

• Aligns stakeholders on research and competitive intelligence objectives and outputs. Distinguishes evidence from assumptions and communicates data quality, uncertainty, and limitations.

• Maintains an in-depth understanding of Revolution Medicines’ diverse product offerings, competitive positioning, and the broader market dynamics shaping the industry's future.

• Runs scenario planning and leads competitive simulations ahead of key competitor readouts and our own launch milestones.

• Supplies competitive assumptions for internal forecasts, including expected competitor entry timing and biomarker defined patient segments.

• Contributes competitive input to target product profiles, clinical trial design discussions, and lifecycle plans for the disease area.

• Manages day to day work with CI vendors, congress coverage agencies, and secondary data sources), keeping deliverables on scope, schedule, and budget. Proactively facilitates the identification and prioritization of intelligence efforts critical to strategic planning and execution in partnership with key stakeholders; provides direction for the design and refinement of intelligence plans.

• Conducts all intelligence gathering activities in compliance with legal, ethical, and SCIP standards, and with company policies on information handling.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor's degree in life sciences, business, or a related field.

• Minimum of 8-11 years of experience in the same fields, including at least 3 years supporting oncology programs.

• Working knowledge of solid tumor oncology drug development and commercialization, with the ability to read and interpret clinical trial data, statistical endpoints, and regulatory documents.

• Hands on experience covering major oncology congresses and producing congress summaries for brand and medical teams.

• Proficiency with clinicaltrials.gov, PubMed, and at least two commercial CI databases (e.g., Citeline, Evaluate, AlphaSense, GlobalData).

• Strong written and verbal communication.

• Track record of being a collaborative team player, and adaptive to meet the needs of a growing business.

• Excellent organizational skills and an ability to prioritize effectively to deliver results within reasonably established timelines.

• Ability to represent Revolution Medicines well: strong interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, with a tolerance for ambiguity, and a passion for helping cancer patients.

Preferred Skills:

• Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, MS, or MBA).

• Previous experience within any analytics & insights function or similar roles at a biotech / pharmaceutical company.

• Direct experience supporting oncology products across life cycle.

jobs.title: Senior Industrial Designer- Robotics
jobs.description:
About Mind Robotics

At Mind Robotics, we put code into motion—designing and building AI-enabled industrial robots that master real-world physics and dexterous manipulation on the factory floor. We build hardware engineered to work safely alongside people, making manufacturing safer, more efficient, and more globally competitive.

 

Why Work at Mind: We pair the speed of a startup with the resources and built-in deployment scale of an industrial pioneer—joining a team that values ownership, humility, and turning physical AI into iconic, factory-ready hardware.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Industrial Designer (5–7 years of total experience, with 3–5 years dedicated to robotics or equivalent complex hardware) who has successfully executed and shipped robotics products or sophisticated consumer electronics.

 

Operating at the intersection of industrial design, complex mechatronics, and physical user experience, you will take ownership of flagship industrial robot embodiments from zero-to-one concept exploration through production release. You will partner daily with Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Actuation, Embedded Sensors, Human Factors, and CMF teams to translate ambitious mechanical architectures into intuitive, approachable, and durable physical realities.

Key Responsibilities

Physical UX, Kinematic Architecture & Robotic Form

 - Physical User Experience & Interaction: Translate human needs, operator workflows, and behavioral cues into tangible physical interactions—designing intuitive touchpoints, spatial choreography, clear affordances, and seamless physical-digital feedback loops on the factory floor.

 - Articulated Form & Enclosures: Lead the end-to-end industrial design of complex multi-segment assemblies, articulating limbs, kinetic joints, lightweight skeletal structures, and protective outer shells.

 - Sensor & Payload Packaging: Seamlessly integrate dense sensor suites—optical arrays, depth cameras, LiDAR, acoustic components, and status lighting—maximizing fields of view and thermal/mechanical performance while preserving clean, cohesive proportions.

 - Cable Routing & Ingress Protection: Engineer dynamic harness routing, flex-zones, dust/liquid seals, and articulated joint cowls that maintain structural integrity and visual cleanliness through continuous multi-degree-of-freedom motion.

 - Human-Machine Spatial Presence: Balance expressive, functional mechanical posture with human-scale ergonomics, non-threatening gestures, and approachable physical presence alongside human workers.

Prototyping, Concept Modeling & AI-Accelerated Workflow

 - Full-Lifecycle Execution: Drive designs from early volumetric architecture through DFM/DFA, tooling sign-off, and mass production validation, drawing on prior experience shipping complex consumer electronics or robotics hardware.

 - Kinematic & Scale Mockups: Direct and evaluate full-scale physical assemblies (3D-printed parts, CNC foam, sheet metal, benchtop test rigs) to validate balance, volumetric footprint, joint clearance, and real-world operator interactions.

 - Concept Modeling & Production CAD: Execute high-craft concept modeling, complex surfacing, and tight mechanical packaging using Rhino, SolidWorks, Alias Studio Tools, and Blender, validating tolerances and engineering feasibility directly with mechanical and tooling teams.

 - AI & Generative Design Integration: Leverage generative AI visualization tools (Vizcom) and multimodal LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate early form exploration, rapid CMF iteration, design documentation, and cross-functional communication.

 - Visualization & Motion Studies: Produce photo-real renderings, kinematic motion studies, and exploded assembly visualizations to communicate dynamic mechanism intent and user scenarios to leadership and engineering partners.

Required Qualifications

 - Experience: 5–7 years of professional industrial design experience, including 3–5 years in robotics or equivalent electromechanical systems.

 - Proven Shipped Track Record: Demonstrated history of executing and bringing robotics products or high-complexity consumer electronics from concept to production.

 - Physical UX Sensibility: Strong understanding of how industrial design shapes user experience in the physical world—translating ergonomics, spatial awareness, and physical affordances into intuitive human-machine interactions.

 - Mechatronic Packaging: Proven ability to package around moving centers of rotation, complex hinges, linkages, actuators, and motor housings without compromising proportion or surface quality.

 - Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing mastery over high-complexity assemblies, expressive yet functional surfacing, physical mockups, and tight integration of mechanical and electrical constraints.

 - 3D Modeling & Visualization Mastery: Advanced proficiency in modern surfacing, concept modeling, CAD, and visualization tools, specifically Rhino, SolidWorks, Alias Studio Tools, Blender, and Vizcom, backed by Adobe Creative Suite.

 - AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI workflows—specifically Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini—into daily design research, ideation, synthesis, and workflow acceleration.

 - Physical Prototyping & Validation: Hands-on ability to assemble, modify, and evaluate physical mockups and volumetric test rigs in collaboration with model shop and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Design.

 - Deep understanding of volume production methods for complex hardware: structural composites, high-pressure aluminum die castings, structural foam molding, CNC machining, and performance textiles/elastomers.

 - Strong live sketching and sequential storyboard skills to illustrate functional movement arcs and human-robot interaction flows.

jobs.title: Manager, Vision Configuration
jobs.description:
US – Seattle only:

This position is open to candidates in the Seattle, WA area. You will have a hybrid remote/in-office schedule where you will work from our casual, pet-friendly office at least 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday).

The Vision Configuration Manager leads the Vision Implementation team, which turns Trupanion’s insurance products, pricing, and regulatory requirements into working configuration in Vision, our proprietary insurance platform. The team owns document templates, rate cards, and product rules across states, products, and brands, and is accountable for getting them into production accurately and on time for state-designated launch dates.

This leader manages a team of implementation consultants and QA analysts, and partners closely with Actuarial, Filing Operations, Legal & Compliance, business stakeholders, and engineering. Beyond day-to-day delivery, the role will mature how the team operates by standardizing processes, strengthening controls, clarifying requirements, and building self-service. A key part of that is introducing automation and responsible use of AI to remove manual, error-prone work, so that rate changes, rate notices, and regulatory documents are delivered with consistency, speed, and confidence.

Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Operating Model

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of implementation consultants and implementation QA analysts; set priorities, manage capacity, and hold the team accountable for quality and deadlines.

• Define the team’s scope, ownership boundaries, and operating model, including how work is taken in, prioritized, handed off, and closed out.

• Standardize configuration processes and introduce controls (peer review, sign-offs, audit trails) and self-service tools that reduce errors and rework.

• Build a strong partnership with Filing Operations, Actuarial, and Legal & Compliance to gain early awareness of product and rate updates, align responsibilities, and coordinate recurring rate audits.

• Define and report on team metrics, such as on-time rate and product launches, configuration defect rates, and production issue trends.

Vision Configuration Ownership

• Document Templates – Own the configuration of outbound document templates, including declarations pages, rate notices, and other policyholder communications and attachments, and how they vary by state, product, and brand.

• Pricing – Own which rate cards are in place for each state and product; take in data from the Actuarial team, validate it, and get it into Vision production in time for each state-designated launch date.

• Product Configuration – Own which products are available in which states and for which brands, and ensure product rules support and restrict user behavior in line with legal and compliance requirements.

• Billing Configuration – Oversee related billing configuration in Zuora (products, payment gateways, taxes) in coordination with Finance and technology partners.

• Documentation – Maintain accurate, current configuration documentation, and codify requirements for declarations pages and notifications with a scheduled cadence for recurring review.

Discovery & Solution Design

• Work with business stakeholders to understand and document requirements for templates, pricing, and product configuration.

• Interpret insurance policy and regulatory requirements and translate them into configuration designs in Vision.

• Provide technical support and prototyping for Business Analyst teams, and support requirements gathering and handoffs for new product rollouts.

Testing & Release

Enterprise Systems | Service Operations, Product Ownership, and Customer Experience

The Service Product Owner & Customer Support Manager owns the technology-enabled service lifecycle across Orion's Operating Companies—from customer request and dispatch through technician execution, cost capture, billing readiness, and financial posting. Use support data, field feedback, adoption measures, and operating results to prioritize automation, configuration, integration, training, and process improvements.

Bachelor's degree in business, operations, information systems, engineering, construction management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

COINS service management and mTech, BuildOps, ServiceTitan, or a comparable service-management and mobile field-service platform.

Multi-entity or acquisition-driven organizations requiring enterprise standards across varied Operating Company practices.
