jobs.title: Propulsion Engineer, Components Manufacturing Fabrication (Raptor)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROPULSION ENGINEER, COMPONENTS MANUFACTURING FABRICATION (RAPTOR)

The Raptor Components team develops the most advanced engine control components in the world. Our engineers are hardware experts for flow control devices that enable the Raptor engine, integrating pneumatics, mechanical, electrical, and software into integrated packages that enable streamlined manufacturing and engine operation. We design, analyze, build, test, and fly components for simplicity, manufacturability, and reliability in extreme thermal, pressure, and vibe environments. You will use and expand your knowledge, experience, and creativity to develop solutions at the cutting edge of space technology. You will own the relationship between your hardware and suppliers, customers, and test teams while spearheading your own projects. You will provide input into vehicle architecture trades and take a lead role in design and flight readiness on Starship, the vehicle that will make humanity multi-planetary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop fabrication manufacturing & integration processes for thermal protection, components & assemblies in the Raptor engine family. Question requirements, delete parts and processes, simplify/optimize, accelerate, and automate component deliveries

• Conceptualize, demonstrate, and drive to completion innovative manufacturing processes to support high rate production targets

• Regularly challenge each process, part, and operation while working closely with design/development engineers to create the most manufacturable and reliable engine hardware possible

• Oversee introduction and implementation of new products and product revisions, frequently multiple at a given time

• Maintain a sense of holistic ownership over the production line, including process consistency, quality, tooling, capital equipment, ergonomics, and safety

• Spearhead root cause investigations that arise in development, production, test, integration and launch, implementing corrective actions, proactively seeking out hardware issues and implementing solutions early

• Coordinate team of peers through informal leadership and self-directed program organization to achieve goals. Assign clear responsibilities, motivating and holding teammates accountable for execution

• Interface with internal fabrication shops as well as vendors to meet production goals

• Work with production teams to ensure the hardware you are responsible for is delivered on time or ahead of schedule

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience with engine, fluid, or system design, development, fabrication, assembly, or test (internship or project team experience is applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, enthusiasm for problem solving, and desire to optimize modern rocket production and launch processes

• Strong leadership project management skills and experience, and effective communication of technical concepts across multi-disciplinary teams

• Experience working with liquid rocket engines, spacecraft systems, and/or pressurized fluid systems

• Expertise in design for manufacturability (DFM), with demonstrable success at taking products through development, testing, and production

• Understanding of fundamental principals in fluid systems, solid mechanics, and/or electrical systems

• Highly detail oriented with excellent organizational skills

• Track record of success in a rapidly growing, changing and highly technical environment

• Ability and desire to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, team environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This is a hands-on position that will require standing for long durations of your day and working directly with hardware on the floor

• Must be comfortable stooping, bending, and standing

• Position may require occasional travel, long hours, or weekend work

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - San Francisco
jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco, CA

Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: In person

About Flai

AI has transformed how software companies work, but it has barely touched the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native communications platform for car dealerships.

Dealerships are a $1.3 trillion industry. They sell 96% of the 16 million new cars bought in the U.S. each year, yet they run on outdated systems and manual processes while spending $36B a year on operations. That's the opportunity we’re going after.

Today Flai is live in hundreds of dealerships, including more than 20% of the top 50 dealer groups, and we've partnered with the second-largest automaker in the country. We raised a $27M Series A led by Base10, alongside First Round Capital, Toyota Ventures, Y Combinator, Innovation Endeavors, SV Angel and Liquid 2.

Role Overview

A Deployment Strategist makes our AI work inside a dealership, then makes it indispensable. You'll take a single store or a 20-rooftop group from signed contract to live, figure out where Flai creates the most value in their operation, prove it in their numbers, and spot where the account can grow next. Ultimately, you manage the customer relationship from the moment we sign through renewals.

The job is people-first but requires technical curiosity. In one day you might map a dealer's phone and scheduling setup, configure Flai around how their service drive actually runs, and walk a General Manager through why their missed-call rate dropped and how to fix it.

Your customers are some of the most direct, numbers-driven operators in American business. They don't care about AI. They care about booked appointments, customers who actually show up, and profit. You'll earn their trust by delivering all three.

We're hiring both in person in San Francisco and remote. We have a deployment playbook; it's young, and we want you to be one of the people who makes it better.

What You'll Do

 - Be the person your dealers trust. Own a portfolio of dealership accounts. Build real relationships with GMs and their employees, and learn their world well enough to speak their language and to push back when they're wrong.

 - Run deployments end to end. Own kickoff to go-live for single rooftops and multi-store groups: timelines, configuration, integrations with dealer systems, training and launch day.

 - Find the value and prove it. Learn each store's workflows, decide which use cases to launch first and what comes next, and track the outcomes dealers care about: missed-call capture, appointment set rate, response time, show rate and retention.

 - Get under the hood. Configure the product, troubleshoot integrations with DMS, CRM and phone systems, and dig into call data to find out why a number moved. When something breaks, triage fast and work directly with engineering.

 - Run the operating rhythm. Monthly check-ins, launch reviews and QBRs that tie Flai to the store's KPIs and keep both sides accountable.

 - Spot the next big opportunity. Find where an account can grow, such as more rooftops or new use cases, and bring in our account management team to land it.

 - Shape the product. You'll see patterns nobody inside the building can. Turn them into clear, specific feedback that changes what we build.

 - Sharpen the playbook. Make onboarding, training and expansion faster and more repeatable as we scale.

Who you are

 - Great with people. You've been very successful leading people and convincing them to act. Client-facing experience such as consulting or customer success is a plus, but a track record of winning people over matters more than a job title. You can run a meeting, write a crisp follow-up, and train a team without it feeling like training.

 - Curious and technically inclined. You want to know how things work and you'll go deep to find out. You'll dig into how our systems work until you can explain it to a service manager and show how to deploy it better for their store.

 - Structured. You turn a messy situation into a plan with owners and dates, and you keep notes tight enough that nothing slips.

 - An owner. Your accounts are yours. You follow through without being chased.

 - Commercially minded. You think about what the customer gets for their money and how to make that number bigger.

 - Excited to be early. You'd rather shape how something works than inherit a finished process, and you're fine figuring some of it out as you go.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with dealer tech: DMS, CRM, schedulers, call tracking, BDC workflows

 - An implementation, solutions engineering or technical onboarding background

 - Experience with multi-location accounts or franchise groups

 - QBRs tied to dealership KPIs such as RO count, appointments, CSI and retention

Why Flai

This is about as early as it gets: real traction, customers who genuinely love the product, and investors who've backed some of the best companies in the world betting big on us. You'll be living inside one of the most exciting build-outs in AI right now, in an industry that's about to look completely different because of what we're building. How you run a call, handle an escalation, or close a renewal in the next 12 months will directly shape how Flai serves customers for years to come. We move fast and we have fun doing it. Come be part of the story while it's still being written.

What We Offer

 - $110K-$150K OTE depending on experience

 - Equity

 - Full benefits including medical, dental, and vision

 - Flexible PTO

 - Small, high-trust team where your work has real impact from day one

jobs.title: Manager, Fraud
jobs.description:
About Arena Club

Arena Club is building the number one digital marketplace for collectibles. We started by reinventing the hobby with the first-ever digital card show, and we are expanding into new categories so collectors can buy, sell, grade, and showcase everything they care about in one place. Spearheaded by 5x World Series Champion Derek Jeter and serial entrepreneur Brian Lee, our fully digital marketplace is grounded in trust, transparency, and fun, featuring grading and authentication, vaulting, and digital pack openings that let collectors build and display their collections in a personalized online showroom from anywhere in the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager to build and lead our fraud program. As our founding fraud hire, you will shape how Arena Club prevents, detects, and responds to fraud across a fast-growing digital marketplace, setting the strategy, standards, and processes that protect our collectors and our business. This is a hands-on role with room to grow. You will work cases and tune controls yourself while laying the foundation for a fraud team. We welcome experienced fraud professionals ready to step up and own a program, and you will have real influence over how it takes shape.

What You Will Do

• Build and own the fraud program, including policies, playbooks, case management processes, and escalation paths

• Define fraud policies, rules, and thresholds that maximize detection while minimizing friction for legitimate collectors

• Secure the full money cycle: pay-ins, wallet and balance movement, and payouts

• Manage and optimize fraud detection and identity verification tools, and evaluate new vendors as the business scales

• Lead fraud investigations, diagnose loss drivers and control gaps, and deliver actionable recommendations

• Identify and mitigate transactional fraud, including payment fraud, account takeover, promotional and referral abuse, card cashing, and money laundering

• Report on key metrics, including fraud loss rates, approval rates, and false-positive rates, to surface emerging risks

• Partner with Finance, Data, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Compliance to strengthen our fraud strategy and support new launches

• Work with Compliance to align fraud controls with BSA/AML policies, escalation procedures, and regulatory reporting

• Report fraud trends, risk exposure, and program results to leadership

• Help define the structure and hiring plan for a future fraud team

Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in fraud, risk, or payments operations within an e-commerce or neobank environment

• Depth and breadth in fraud operations, transactional fraud, AML, and money schemes

• Working knowledge of the full money cycle: pay-ins, wallet and balance movement, and payouts

• Hands-on experience with account takeover, card-not-present, ACH, first-party, and promotional abuse fraud, including chargebacks and disputes

• Knowledge of AML and BSA fundamentals, KYC, and transaction monitoring

• Understanding of core fraud program components, including policy, risk rules and velocity checks, case management, vendor tooling, and loss reporting

• Experience in a startup or lean environment, with the ability to operate independently and document processes

Preferred Qualifications

• Marketplace experience, or experience at a high-volume gaming, gambling, fintech, or payment processing company

• Experience building or scaling a fraud function from zero to one

• Experience with fraud platforms such as Sardine, SEON, or Stripe Radar, or comparable tools

• SQL proficiency for fraud trend and rules performance analysis

• Background in trust and safety or platform integrity alongside financial fraud prevention

The base salary range listed is a guideline. Actual compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the impact you bring. Total compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity.

Salary Range

$110,000—$150,000 USD

Territory & Account Management

Southern California covers the greater LA metro, San Diego, Orange County, and the Inland Empire — territory maps should reflect the geographic complexity of the market.

• Top accounts: Personally own and grow the top 10 accounts in the region, including multi-door chain and delivery-platform accounts that pay centrally; conduct quarterly business reviews with each.

• Credit & collections partnership: Work with Credit and Finance to keep orders flowing.

• New business: Drive net-new account acquisition and reactivate dormant accounts in partnership with the inside sales team.

• Field cadence: Ensure every rep is making a minimum of 25 in-person account visits per week with documented call notes in CRM.

Cross-Functional & Brand Partnership

• Brand partners: Serve as the regional point of contact for brand partners; coordinate ride-alongs, demo days, and market activations; join brand sales meetings, work through order rejections and redeliveries, and align on brand-backed promotion orders.

• Cross-sell: Drive multi-brand penetration across the portfolio — partner with brand and marketing on regional sell-in campaigns.

• CRM discipline: Enforce daily HubSpot logging — visits, orders, samples, next steps — by every rep, and keep account ownership current.

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years in B2B field sales, with 2+ years managing a quota-carrying team.

• Proven track record building or rebuilding a sales team and delivering aggressive revenue growth.

• Experience selling into cannabis, beverage, CPG, or another regulated three-tier distribution channel.

• Deep familiarity with the Southern California retail and dispensary landscape — including LA, San Diego, Orange County, and the Inland Empire.

• Fluency with CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable) and dashboard tools such as Retool, with a data-driven approach to pacing, forecasting, and coaching.

• Working knowledge of credit, payment terms, and collections in a wholesale environment, including accounts that pay centrally.

• Comfortable in the field 3+ days per week; valid CA driver's license and reliable vehicle.

Preferred

• Existing relationships with California licensed retailers and buyers in Southern California markets.

• Experience launching or scaling a new brand within an existing distribution book.

• Experience managing multi-door chain, delivery-platform, or centrally paid accounts.

• Demonstrated success leading through change — restructures, brand transitions, or aggressive ramp periods.

jobs.title: 3rd Shift Equipment Operator/High Bay
jobs.description:
Address: 450 Ingenuity Ave Sparks, NV 89441

Shift: 7:00pm-5:30am Sunday-Wednesday

Pay: $19.00 + $2.00 shift differential

What's the Short Version?

The Equipment Operator safely and efficiently locates product by using a radio frequency (RF) unit, manually pulls product from locations, and transports product to various departments and/or locations. They process a portion of customer orders throughout the production day and restock product into bins.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Operate powered lift equipment to move product and materials as assigned using a radio frequency (RF) unit to scan movement of product, identify locations, etc.

• Load, unload, move, stack, and stage product.

• Restock, pick, and pack product for customer orders.

• Inspect assigned equipment daily at start of shift; is responsible for checking out equipment and returning in same condition on a daily basis.

• Follow procedures for proper care and use of equipment, to include keys.

• Adhere to all safety requirements and guidelines.

• Complete and maintain SanMar's Lift Operator Certification in compliance with OSHA guidelines every three years.

• Perform other duties as assigned

• Comply with all policies and standards

What Are We Looking For?

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• 1-3 years of lift operator experience

• Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information

• Basic math skills in counting and quantity required

• Demonstrates ability to follow directions and change priorities or job duties as business needs require; rotate to other production functions as needed

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume environment while meeting deadlines

• Able to work both independently and within a team

• Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills

• Comprehend verbal and written instructions

• Essential days or overtime may be required

What's Our Offer?

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity/paternity leave

• Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal protective equipment such as a Protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Paid Media Associate

RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

The Associate, Paid Media is a hands-on role on our Digital Performance Marketing team, managing the paid campaigns that power sponsored health content programs for leading pharma and health brands across Healthline, Medical News Today, Healthgrades and Bezzy. You’ll own day-to-day campaign execution, learn how media, data and partnerships come together to hit delivery goals, and grow alongside a team that invests in your development.

Where You'll Be

Location: Charlotte Metro Area (Fort Mill, SC) | Hybrid or Remote

We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we’re in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish.

Office address: 1101 Red Ventures Dr Fort Mill, SC 29707

What You’ll Do

• Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns, primarily on Meta and Google, that drive qualified traffic to sponsored health content and community programs.

• Use audience, targeting and creative testing to reach the right people for each condition-specific program, while maintaining the audience quality our partners pay for.

• Collaborate with Ad Operations, Site Marketing, Newsletter, Product Marketing and Performance teams to launch programs on time and deliver against goals.

• Monitor pacing and performance daily, analyze trends, and recommend optimizations that improve cost efficiency and delivery.

• Manage campaign budgets against delivery goals, adjusting spend to avoid under- or over-delivery and flagging risks early.

• Demonstrate an eagerness to grow and learn, strong self-awareness and a desire to use feedback to drive growth.

• Support pacing reports, monthly cost forecasts and performance readouts for internal stakeholders, highlighting wins, risks and opportunities.

• Stay current on paid media platforms, privacy changes and emerging channels, and help test new traffic sources and automation that make the work more efficient

What We’re Looking For

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 1–3 years of experience in paid media or digital marketing, ideally at an agency, publisher or in-house performance team.

• Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and/or Google Ads, including campaign setup and budget management.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn performance data into clear optimization decisions.

• Excellent attention to detail and organization; able to manage multiple programs and deadlines at once.

• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, pacing trackers) and comfort with other data tools.

• Ability to work collaboratively across teams in a fast-moving environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred:

• Experience in health, pharma or publisher-side media.

• Basic SQL or experience working with large datasets (e.g., Databricks).

• Familiarity with automation tools (e.g., Hightouch) or AI-assisted workflows.

RVO Health is a health-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group’s Optum. Together, we’ve brought some of the most trusted names in healthcare under one roof, including Healthline, Healthgrades, Fullspan Health, Medical News Today, Optum Perks, and more. jobs.title: Sales & Category Insights Manager

As our Sales & Category Insights Manager, you'll be the analytical engine behind our retail strategy. • Build AI-enabled analyses, dashboards, and automations that replace manual reporting and deck building, then train the team to use them

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 6+ years in category management, retail or shopper insights, or retail analytics at a CPG supplier, retailer, or consulting or research firm, including at least 3 years in retail or category analytics

• Has owned an account or category end to end and recommended actions, not just reported results

• Has built category reviews, line review materials, or pitches for buyers. Direct, external-facing experience with Walmart, Target, club, or grocery is a significant plus

• Has deep hands-on experience with syndicated, panel, and retailer POS data (e.g., SPINS, NIQ/Nielsen, Circana, Numerator, retailer data portals), including evaluating and onboarding new sources

• Is advanced in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides

• Has used AI tools to build analyses, automations, or dashboards that other people rely on

• Holds a bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, or a related field, or has equivalent experience

Approach to the role:

• Decision-first. You start with the business decision, turn ambiguous requests into sharp questions, and judge how much analysis each one deserves

• A storyteller. You lead with what happened, why it matters, and what to do about it, whether the audience is a buyer, a sales lead, or an executive

• A commercial partner. You work shoulder to shoulder with sales and account teams, understand how each retailer plans and decides, and are comfortable presenting to buyers

• A builder. You use AI and automation to remove repetitive work, and you share what you build so the whole team benefits

• An owner. You take responsibility for outcomes end to end, including data quality, vendors, brokers, and follow-through

• High-agency. You're proactive and love challenging conventional thinking

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $115,000 - $130,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Senior SDR, Events - US
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem https://www.perk.com/shadow-work-report.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com http://www.perk.com to learn more.





About the Role
As Senior SDR - Events at Perk, you will be the dedicated growth engine for our events and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions) proposition, but entirely within our existing client base. Rather than chasing new logos, your mission is to deepen relationships, uncover untapped event potential, and convert existing Perk accounts into active, repeat-event buyers. You will combine strategic proactive outreach into the Perk Travel customer base with fast follow-up on warm inbound leads.

This is an ideal role for someone who knows how to ask the right questions, and thrives on building trusted-advisor relationships with procurement, EA, HR, and executive stakeholders within companies we already work with. This is a new function at Perk. Targets, tooling and outreach sequences are still evolving, and you will help shape them as you go.



What You’ll Do

Account Development & Opportunity Identification

 - Conduct structured discovery conversations with existing Perk account contacts to uncover current events spend, upcoming programmes and unmet needs.

 - Map stakeholder landscapes within accounts, identifying who owns MICE and events budgets, who influences decisions and where Perk Events currently has no footprint.

 - Build and maintain an opportunity pipeline sourced entirely from existing Perk accounts, tracked in CRM (Salesforce) with accurate forecasting and data hygiene.

 - Proactively identify seasonal triggers (team off-sites, sales kick-offs, client entertainment, awards, product launches) and engage accounts ahead of planning cycles.

 - Respond quickly to warm inbound leads, such as customers flagged through product usage, onboarding conversations and group-style booking patterns, and turn them into event conversations.

Events Proposition Selling

 - Articulate Perk Events value proposition and MICE capability - venue sourcing, event management, incentive travel, conferencing, etc. - clearly and convincingly to account stakeholders at all levels.

 - Deliver engaging and effective sales demos of the Perk Events product - ensuring you remain up to date on the latest product developments

 - Qualify and brief events leads internally, ensuring a smooth handover to the Perk Events conversion team with full context on client requirements and expectations.

 - Position Perk Events as the natural home for an account's full events calendar, not just individual transactions.

 - Build genuine, multi-threaded relationships within accounts,  going beyond the day-to-day contact to engage senior decision-makers and budget holders.

 - Act as the bridge between existing commercial account relationships and the events/MICE proposition, working closely with Account Managers to ensure joined-up client engagement.



Reporting & Commercial Contribution

 - Own and manage your pipeline in CRM, maintaining accurate stage progression, deal values and qualification

 - Report weekly on activity metrics, pipeline health and pipeline generation against target

 - Share market intelligence and client feedback with the wider Events and Commercial teams to inform product development and go-to-market strategy.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Essential Experience & Skills

 - Demonstrable experience in a business development, account growth or sales role within the events SaaS space, corporate travel management company (TMC), events agency, or hospitality group.

 - A proactive account-growth mindset: a proven track record of growing revenue within an existing account base through structured outreach, while moving fast on warm leads.

 - Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills - able to build rapport quickly, navigate complex organisations and influence without authority.

 - Excellent communication and video skills; fluent in English, written and spoken, to a professional business standard

 - Experience working in European and/or North American markets

 - Commercially minded with the ability to build and manage a pipeline, forecast accurately, and work to revenue targets.

 - Hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and considered in your approach

 - Able to perform as an individual contributor while remaining a collaborative and supportive team player

 - Customer-centric mindset - always focused on delivering value before extracting it

 - Proficient in CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and comfortable with pipeline reporting.

 - Must have the legal right to work in the applicable location



The person who will thrive in this role will bring:

 - Curiosity: genuinely interested in understanding a client's business, not just selling to them.

 - Tenacity:  persistent and organised in following up, without being pushy.

 - Collaboration: works closely with Account Management, the wider Perk Events team (sales and builders) and Marketing; does not operate in isolation.

 - Accountability: owns their pipeline and results; doesn't wait to be chased.

 - Commercial instinct: spots opportunities others might miss and moves quickly to qualify and develop them.



Our benefits:

 - Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

 - Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

 - Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

 - Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

 - Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

 - Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

 - Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

 - Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

 - Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

 - Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

 - Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

 - Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

 - Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

 - Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

 - Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

 

Compensation:

Compensation for this role is a combination of salary, commissions, and stock options. The base salary is $66,000, and the on-target variable earnings are $30,000. The commission structure will be tied to achieving revenue & retention targets.        

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.



How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.



Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com http://perk.com or @externalperk.com http://externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Principal Kubernetes Engineer
jobs.description:

CIQ builds the enterprise infrastructure that powers the world's most demanding workloads. From the operating system layer through AI infrastructure, high-performance computing, and cloud-native orchestration, CIQ delivers the speed, security, scalability, and sovereignty that major enterprises, government agencies, and research institutions depend on.

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Principal Kubernetes Engineer, you will work within the Engineering department to design, develop, and support enterprise Kubernetes solutions by contributing to the products and infrastructure for CIQ. You will also maintain our systems' capacity and performance. You need to be able to troubleshoot and improve applications and processes. You’ll analyze current code and industry developments to design engineering solutions to solve problems and create seamless user experiences. • implementation.

NEEDED TO SUCCEED

BENEFITS

jobs.title: Design Systems Designer (Contract)
jobs.description:
DESIGN SYSTEMS DESIGNER (CONTRACT)

About Cambly: Our mission is to bring high quality English education to every English learner in the world by building a learning platform that optimally combines human tutors and artificial intelligence. By accomplishing our mission, we strive to become the world's largest English language learning marketplace.

We’re looking for a talented hands-on design systems designer who is passionate about building the infrastructure great products are made of and wants to change the way people learn languages. You’ll take Cambly’s existing design system, and modernize it into a comprehensive system: a variable-based token architecture with theming built in, and a documented component library on top of it. You’ll write clear rules for when and how to use each component, precise enough that our designers, engineers and AI coding agents can all implement them correctly. You’ll join a small, fast-moving design team, where your work shapes how quickly and how well we ship across the whole product.

Come join us in building the best place to learn and teach English!

Job Requirements

 - Mid-to-senior-level, hands-on design systems expert, with a track record of building and maintaining design systems with tokens, theming, and component libraries in Figma using a variable-based token architecture and provide continuous recommendations that enhance overall velocity and quality

 - A systems and codification mindset: able to translate design intent into precise, unambiguous rules and documentation that designers, engineers, and AI coding agents can all use.

 - A strong, well-rounded digital product designer at core — someone whose anchor is design systems work, but who is also a versatile product designer able to contribute beyond systems alone.

 - Strong foundation in mobile product design.

 - Experience (and deep curiosity) working with AI as part of the core development flow.

 - Self-directed and comfortable operating without a fully perfected process or handoff; this is a fast-moving, still-forming team.

 - Proven ability to communicate clearly and collaborate with both design and engineering stakeholders.

Preferred

 - Comfortable working beyond Figma, with the curiosity and confidence to learn how design system decisions translate into code (e.g., Swift/React), collaborate with engineers and AI coding agents, and contribute to the design system codebase with support. Prior coding experience is a plus, but not required.

 - Genuine interest in Cambly's team and mission — there's a real possibility of this expanding into a bigger or longer-term role.

Engagement Details

 - Role Type: Contract, 3-5 months, with the option to extend or convert

 - Length: 30-40hrs/week

 - Location: Hybrid, San Francisco; in the office 3 days a week

 - Rate: $130–160/hr, depending on experience.

As a part-time Assistant Teacher (Float) at Bezos Academy (internally titled Assistant Teacher I), you share our passion for early childhood education and commitment to creating nurturing, high-quality learning environments for all children. While exact responsibilities will vary from school to school, you may assist in classrooms, serve and supervise mealtimes, and support the overall operations of the school. Drawing on your organizational skills, professionalism, and commitment to children, you will support high quality, tuition-free, Montessori-inspired programs that enable every child to thrive in our growing network of preschools in under-resourced communities.

LOCATION

We are actively hiring for an Assistant Teacher (Float) to support our preschool in Pasco (333 W Court St Pasco, WA 99301).

SCHEDULES, BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION

• This is a part-time, non-exempt/hourly position requiring a minimum of 25 hours per week, with occasional opportunities to work additional hours based on school needs.

• You will work a five-hour shift, Monday through Friday, totaling 25 hours per week. Specific school schedules are determined by school leaders when considering all staff, classroom, and community needs but is expected to be 8:30am-1:30pm.

• This role includes paid care (sick) time, accrued based on hours worked, and a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match.

• The full compensation range for this position is $26-$29 per hour. The starting pay for all new employees is $26 per hour.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Age 18 with high school diploma or GED

• Ability to pass background checks, clear tuberculosis screenings, and (upon hire) successfully complete trainings required by the state of Washington to supervise children independently

• Ability to independently supervise, communicate effectively with, and care for young children safely, including ability to lift a minimum of 40 lbs

• Access to reliable transportation to and from work and ability to consistently attend work as scheduled to ensure proper staff-to-child classroom ratios and support smooth school operations

• Must have a valid Food Handler’s Permit or be willing to obtain one upon hire

• Ability to complete 20 hours of onboarding by your seventh day of employment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior experience supporting or teaching children ages 3–5 in a Montessori or early childhood classroom setting

• Experience working effectively across lines of difference and fostering an inclusive, welcoming environment for all children and families

• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage daily operational tasks such as classroom setup, safety checks, and basic clerical responsibilities

• Demonstrated reliability and flexibility in supporting school operations, including meal service, playground supervision, assisting with classroom coverage as needed, and lead after-school activities

RESPONSIBILITIES

*NOTE: The combination of responsibilities may vary based on the needs of the school site, students, and prior experiences of the Assistant Teacher.

Instructional

• Serve as a floating assistant teacher, providing support wherever and however the school most needs it each day

• As needed, independently supervise children throughout the day in classrooms and a variety of other situations, including but not limited to arrival/departure, transitions, outside time, rest/nap time, and (if offered) extended hours

• Assist in maintaining accurate child and family records

• Complete Montessori basics training and credentialing/licensing requirements within seven days of hire

Operational

• Support Bezos Academy classrooms by following regulations and guidelines in the day-to-day operation of the classroom and school (e.g. cleaning/preparing materials, meal prep and cleanup, nap time transitions, laundry, bathroom supervision, etc.)

• Support school leadership and teachers to foster a nurturing, safe, and stimulating, non-competitive school environment

Other

jobs.description:
ABOUT BEZOS ACADEMY

At Bezos Academy, we believe all children deserve the great start that excellent early education provides, including in under-resourced communities. Our mission is to nurture the potential in every child to become a creative leader, original thinker, and lifelong learner by inventing the solutions needed to scale early childhood education. We are a unique organization that realizes our mission in two distinct ways. First, we operate a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori preschool at no cost to families. Second, we invest in creating tools, products, technology, and other solutions designed to reach children well beyond the walls of our schools. We aspire to have a profound, large-scale impact on children ages zero to five.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the first product marketer at Bezos Academy, you will lead a product marketing strategy to help parents and caregivers unlock their children’s potential during the most critical years of brain development. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing and Communications Officer, you will join a founding group that is inventing scalable solutions to challenges in early childhood education, combining AI technology, mobile apps, and curated learning materials to put a coach in the pocket of every parent.

You are a hands-on, impact-driven marketing leader who thrives on translating research and customer insight into messaging, brand, and growth strategy that resonates with families of all kinds. You have a track record of building marketing functions and brands, working resourcefully across channels and audiences despite constraints on time and resources. You have a customer-first mindset and are comfortable defining problems and resolving ambiguity. You know exceptional consumer marketing when you see it, and you instill this passion in others.

You will find yourself in a fast-paced, start-up environment where you will set the strategy, build the plan, and own the results for marketing programs for children and families, while working with executives and agencies. You are motivated equally by great products and great impact and are inspired by our mission to expand access to early childhood development programs for families of all kinds.

LOCATION

The upper third of the salary range is typically reserved for employees who have been in the role for multiple years and have demonstrated strong performance over time. • A track record of setting direct-to-consumer, go-to-market strategies geared towards parents and caregivers of young children, including positioning, messaging, distribution, and channels, and answering for the results

jobs.description:
At New Relic, we shape the future of intelligent observability, building technology that helps companies understand and optimize their complex systems. We are a collaborative, global team that values curiosity, mutual support, and solving hard technical challenges together. As we grow, we are looking for thoughtful problem-solvers ready to make a real impact.

That open, forward-thinking approach extends to how we hire. We actively work with modern AI tools every day and support candidates using them to prepare for interviews. To keep our process authentic and fair, please review our Candidate AI Interview Guide to see our general guidelines, including where AI is encouraged and what practices are prohibited before you apply.

Your opportunity

The Group Vice President of AI Applications & Technology, reporting into the Chief Technology Officer, is a pivotal executive leader responsible for developing and executing the strategic vision for next-generation enterprise AI products, systems and platform architectures.

This is a foundational builder role, and engineering executive who will be both employing existing AI models as well as building core AI capabilities. You will lead the research, pre-training/post-training, customization, and deployment of proprietary models, specialized base architectures, and autonomous agent-driven skills.You will lead a world-class team spanning AI engineering, data engineering, and applied research.

What you'll do

• Select and leverage existing AI models as appropriate from a performance and cost perspective to build agentic capabilities for New Relic’s broad observability and remediation capabilities

• Develop a model strategy that recognizes the speed of evolution of this important technology and adapts quickly to leverage new technology as it rapidly becomes available

• Architect and operationalize high-performance, agentic-driven (AE) skills that leverage our custom models for multi-step reasoning, autonomous planning, and real-time execution.

• Architect, train, and deliver our core base models optimized for our domain workflows, serving as the foundational engine for company-wide AI applications.

• Design and optimize autonomous agentic skills powered by our custom models, ensuring high reasoning capability, tool-execution fidelity, low latency, and efficient compute cost.

• Lead, scale, and mentor a high-performing organization of AI engineering leaders,data platform engineers, and machine learning engineers and architects.

• Foster a culture of technical rigor, scientific experimentation, rapid prototyping,and production-grade software delivery.

• Partner closely with peer executive leaders across the organization to embed AI capabilities into core customer offerings.

• Partner with executive peers (People, Finance, Operations, Product) to democratize agentic capabilities internally, championing the transition from passive AI consumption (chatbots) to autonomous, agentic-first workflow design across the company.

• Establish the internal sandbox infrastructure, API/MCP connection schemes, and enterprise agent marketplaces that allow non-engineering teams to securely build, share, and scale operational agents.

• Design agent frameworks that incorporate practical human-in-the-loop gating, multi-tiered permissioning (read vs. state-changing write actions), self-correction, and drift monitoring.

• Champion an organizational culture that solves operational bottlenecks through autonomous systems and workflow redesign rather than linear headcount expansion.

This role requires

• 15+ years of technology leadership experience, with 10+ years leading teams, and 5+ years in executive capacity (VP or equivalent) overseeing AI, Machine Learning, or advanced data platform organizations at scale.

• Deep expertise with large-scale distributed systems

• Proven track record not merely managing AI as an assistive copilot, but designing end-to-end autonomous loops that decouple business throughput from headcount.

• Ability to walk through live, production-grade agentic artifacts they have designed or sponsored- including prompt architectures, API/tool-calling schemas, failure handling, and iterative fixes.

• Hands-on experience development autonomous multi-agent systems, tool-use execution paradigms, agentic memory frameworks, and protocols.

• Deep understanding of enterprise governance frameworks, balancing autonomous retrieval and reasoning with auditable, human-in-the-loop approval thresholds for high-stakes business actions.

• Experience establishing internal AI guilds, hackathons/sprints, or modular workflow marketplaces that elevate workforce technical fluency from passive tooling to applied automation.

• Comprehensive understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, loss formulations, synthetic data generation, and post-training alignment

• Proven ability to translate ambiguous, cutting edge AI breakthroughs into production ready software products that drive business value and technological differentiation.

• Outstanding communication and influence skills, and ability to communicate complex model architectures and technical roadmaps to C-level executives, board members, customers and other cross-functional leaders.

Bonus points if you have

• Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline.

• Observability experience

jobs.title: Resident Solution Architect
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re seeking an experienced Resident Solution Architect with a passion for solving challenging problems with dbt to join our Professional Services team. RSAs are billable to dbt Platform Enterprise customers and help achieve our mission to empower data developers to create and disseminate organizational knowledge.

This is a full-time remote position.

Technologies You’ll Use

• dbt Platform and dbt Core for data modeling, testing, documentation, development workflows, and jobs

• SQL and Jinja for building and maintaining data transformations; Python for scripting and integrations as needed

• Cloud data platforms, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift

• Git and GitHub, including branching, pull requests, and CI/CD workflows

• Data ingestion and integration tools, including Fivetran, plus APIs and connectors

• Cloud and orchestration tools used in customer environments; the specific tools will vary by engagement

What You’ll Do

• Work on a variety of impactful customer technical projects — inclusive of implementation, troubleshooting configurations, instilling best practices, and solutioning MVPs and long term solutions to customer specific requirements

• Consult on architecture and design

• Ensure our most strategic dbt platform customers are adopting the product

• Collaborate with other internal customer facing teams at dbt Labs - Sales, Solution Architects, Training, Support

• Provide critical feedback to dbt Labs product and engineering teams to improve and prioritize customer requests and ensure rapid resolution for engagement specific issues

• Become a product expert with dbt in the context of the modern data stack (if you aren't already)

Skills We’re Looking For

• You have deep experience working with enterprise customers across a variety of use cases, ideally in a customer-facing post-sales, technical architect, or consulting role

• You have deep expertise in at least one data platform (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift)

• You have at least 2 years of experience with dbt, ideally including 1 year with dbt platform

• You are proficient in writing SQL and have some python experience

• You look forward to building skills in technical areas that support deployment and integration of dbt platform solutions to complete customer projects

• You are customer focused - embracing one of our core values that users are our best advocates

• You are highly organized. Comfort with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines, and deliverables - this role will be staffed on multiple engagements at once

• You communicate clearly and concisely with internal and external stakeholders - demonstrating a capacity to clearly and concisely communicate about complex technical, architectural, and/or organizational problems and propose thorough iterative solutions

• You thrive in a remote organization that highly values transparency and cross-collaboration

• ~10% travel should be expected (occasional customer visits, company retreat and offsites)

Bonus Skills

• You have obtained the dbt Analytics Engineering Certification

• You have the ability to advise on dbt Platform recommendations, and build direction/consensus with the customer to move forward

• Experience with traditional Enterprise ETL tooling (Informatica, Datastage, Talend)

jobs.title: Associate Director, Clinical Operations
jobs.description:

Spyre's pipeline includes investigational extended half-life antibodies targeting α4β7, TL1A, IL-23, and IL-17A/F as well as rational combination programs.

Role Summary:

The Associate Director, Clinical Operations, is a pivotal role responsible for executing the clinical operational strategy to ensure that all clinical development activities within the company are conducted efficiently to agreed corporate timelines and in compliance with local and global requirements. You will support the clinical team with the implementation and oversight of clinical trials, focusing on the areas of clinical operational strategy, trial logistics planning, enrollment, site monitoring, data quality, and study reporting. This role will be the critical interface between Sponsor, CRO, and team at study sites.

Key Responsibilities:

• Direct input into the clinical operational strategy and plans.

• Implementation and management of the clinical operational plans and programs to meet corporate goals and objectives.

• Work with Clinical Development to draft clinical trial protocols and other trial-related documents, and work with other departments and functions to implement clinical trial protocols.

• Serve as an interface with clinical investigators.

• Effectively negotiate contracts with consultants, clinical investigators, and contract research organizations.

• Support the management of site-related activities, development of tracking tools, and manage recruitment timelines.

• Generate clinical department SOPs and conduct trainings as necessary.

Ideal Candidate:

• Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline required; advanced degree preferred. A minimum of 7+ years of global clinical research experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• In-depth understanding and experience across clinical operations with a track record of success in study planning, execution, data cleaning, database locking, study report generation and regulatory inspection.

jobs.title: Head of Content
jobs.description:
Compensation: $175K - $225K CAD base

Location: Kelowna, BC (In-Office)

About Martell Group

The Martell Group exists to build people, brands, and ventures that create meaningful impact. Across our four companies, we combine audience, operators, and execution to launch scalable products and empower ambitious leaders in Media, B2B SaaS, and AI.

Founded by serial entrepreneur and investor Dan Martell (investor in Udemy, Intercom, and Unbounce), we're building a company that values leadership, growth, and simplicity, and we're looking for people who live those values too.

Our goal is to attract world-class talent and align people where their impact is greatest. When you apply to Martell Group, you'll automatically be considered for all open roles across our companies, not just the one you applied for.

Why you shouldn't work here: Radical Transparency from our CEO

About Martell

Martell Media is a founder-led media company based in Kelowna, BC. We make long-form YouTube and short-form content for the personal brands of Dan Martell, Renée Warren, Sam Gaudet and more. Dan's audience has grown from under 100K to over 13 million followers across platforms.

We don't just post content. We build a world: characters people connect with, places and rhythms they recognize, and language that sticks ("buy back your time" started here).

About the Role

We're hiring a Head of Content to build and run the engine behind our content, from approved idea to published piece.

Our writer's room and creators bring the ideas. You make sure every great idea gets made, gets made well, and ships on time, every week, across every brand and format. One client training becomes a YouTube video. That video becomes short-form. The short-form becomes posts. You build the system that makes that happen.

This is the producer seat, with a creative spine. You won't be the one writing every script, but you'll know a strong hook from a weak one, because you can't lead the people making the content if you can't judge it. You'll lead the team that makes it happen, and report to our CEO.

What You'll Do

1. Build and run the content engine

• Run one calendar, budget and deadline system across all brands, long-form and short-form.

• Own capture and editing, from the studio floor to publish.

• Build repeatable formats and playbooks, so adding a new brand or series doesn't mean rebuilding the machine.

• Use AI to multiply output: more volume, same or better quality.

2. Get great ideas shipped

• Take ideas from the writer's room through script, approval, shoot, edit and publish.

• Run the weekly greenlight and the daily standup so blockers surface early, not the day of the shoot.

• Keep approved scripts well ahead of shoots, so the weekly drop never slips.

3. Lead and build the team

• Lead editors, capture, freelancers and the short-form clip pipeline.

• Give every area a clear owner and one manager.

• Grow people into leads, so the team can ship without you in every room.

4. Partner with the writer's room and creators

• Work closely with the writer's room today, and with a creative lead as the team grows.

• Protect the details that make our world recognizable across every piece: the places, the rhythms, the language.

• Report what's shipping and what's performing, so the team gets sharper every week.

What You Bring

Required

• You've led a media or content production function and owned outcomes, not just tasks.

• You've run production cycles from brief or script to publish across multiple clients, brands or channels.

• You've led editors, capture, freelancers or production staff.

• You own calendars, budgets and deadlines, and you ship on time.

• You've run freelancer, editor, capture or short-form clip pipelines, and you raise blockers early with a proposal and an owner.

Preferred

• You can judge an idea on its topic, angle and format, and partner with writers and creators on your team.

• You've worked across long-form, short-form and multiple channels, ideally for founder-led or personal brands.

• You've used AI-enabled workflows to scale production volume without dropping quality.

• You read YouTube analytics comfortably and use them to make decisions.

Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• The engine is running. One calendar, budget and deadline system is live across the brands in scope, and the weekly publishing rhythm holds.

• Ideas ship on time. Ideas from the writer's room are taken through to publish. Approved scripts are ready ahead of shoots, and the weekly greenlight and daily standup catch problems early.

• The team is led. Editors, capture, freelancers and the clip pipeline each have a clear owner and one manager, and you run the cycle rather than carrying it yourself.

• AI is in the workflow. At least one part of the production cycle is running faster with AI, and it's documented so the team can repeat it.
