jobs.title: Senior P2P Systems Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril's ArsenalOS team builds the digital infrastructure that powers how Anduril designs, sources, manufactures, delivers, and sustains hardware at scale. We are not a traditional internal IT organization. We build, buy, customize, integrate, and operate the systems that make Anduril's physical operations faster, more reliable, and more scalable.

We are hiring a P2P Systems Specialist to own punchout configuration, supplier punchout onboarding, and touchless PO adoption across Anduril's supply chain. You will manage the full punchout lifecycle — catalog setup, cXML/OCI integration, supplier testing, and go-live , as well as expanded coverage to additional business units. Beyond punchouts, you will identify and address upstream PO data quality issues that drive downstream invoice mismatches and manual AP intervention. This role works closely with our Digital Tools and product teams to make purchasing faster, cleaner, and more automated.

What You'll Do

• Diagnose and resolve existing punchout configuration issues that are blocking supplier transactions and onboarding

• Own the end-to-end punchout setup process for new suppliers: catalog configuration, cXML/OCI integration testing, and go-live validation

• Expand punchout coverage to additional business units beyond the current footprint

• Partner with the Digital Tools feature lead to execute against punchout roadmap

• Work with suppliers directly to troubleshoot integration issues, validate catalog data, and ensure successful onboarding

• Document punchout configuration standards and runbooks for sustainment after the initial backlog is cleared

• Identify and address upstream PO data quality issues that break downstream invoice matching, contributing to manual AP work

• Monitor punchout health metrics and supplier adoption rates post go-live

What Success Looks Like

• The punchout configuration backlog is cleared within one quarter of start date

• Touchless PO rates move measurably with near 100% reliability

• Suppliers that were blocked on onboarding are live and transacting

• New BU punchout setups have a repeatable, documented process that does not require engineering support

• Upstream PO data quality issues that cause AP invoice mismatches are identified and addressed, reducing the manual intervention rate

Required Characteristics

• Configuration depth: You have lived in punchout setup. cXML, OCI, catalog configuration, supplier testing, the whole cycle. You can diagnose why a supplier's catalog is not rendering and fix it without escalating.

• Supplier facing: You are comfortable working directly with external suppliers, walking them through integration requirements, and troubleshooting issues in real time. You do not need someone else to be the interface.

• Urgency: You move quickly, document as you go, and escalate blockers immediately.

• End-to-end P2P thinking: You understand that punchout quality affects everything downstream: PO accuracy, invoice matching, AP workload. You think about the full chain, not just your configuration.

• Sustainment mindset: You do not just fix things; you build the runbooks and standards so the next person can maintain what you set up.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience with procure-to-pay systems, specifically punchout catalog configuration and supplier punchout onboarding

• Hands-on experience with cXML or OCI punchout protocols

• Working knowledge of Oracle Cloud Procurement or similar ERP purchasing modules

• Experience troubleshooting supplier integration issues in a production environment

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high volume of configuration tasks simultaneously

Preferred

• Experience with Oracle Cloud punchout setup specifically

• Background in defense, aerospace, or manufacturing procurement

• Familiarity with EDI and other electronic transaction methods

• Experience measuring and improving touchless PO rates or straight-through processing metrics

US Salary Range

$147,000—$197,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: KIPP -  Paraeducator - High School (26-27)
jobs.location: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
jobs.description:
Position Summary

• Reporting to the school leader & under the direction of the Education Specialist or other certificated employee, the Paraeducator will primarily assist by performing a variety of academic and behavior support duties to individual or small groups of students within the special education classroom, regular classroom and other school settings (both in an in-person classroom setting and virtually).
• These duties shall be designed to complement the instructional program to maximize learning opportunities for students in a variety of educational settings.
• The Paraeducator will also assist in the establishment and implementation of appropriate classroom and school-wide behavior and assist students to access all aspects of the educational environment of the school and the community.
• This role is paid over a 12 month period, including scheduled school breaks and summer break. The salary range for this position is $20.92 - $24.84 / hour. This rate, coupled with the additional 60 days of school break pay we offer, results in annualized pay that is, on average, significantly more than our district peers.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience:

• Paid or volunteer experience working with or serving individuals with academic, behavioral, or functional needs preferred.

Education:

• Title I paraprofessionals whose duties include instructional support must have:
• High school diploma or the equivalent, and
• A.A. degree or
• B.A. degree (or minimum 48 units in process) or
• Pass the ETS ParaPro Assessment (passing score = 460)

Knowledge/skills required:

• Commitment to KIPP mission and vision
• Commitment to being an anti-racist educator
• Believe all students can achieve at the highest academic levels
• Possess strong content area knowledge
• Strong skills building relationships with students, families, and communities
• Communicate well with students, families, and colleagues
• Have proficient knowledge of Google Suite applications (Google Classroom, Hangout, Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc.)
• Have the ability to learn and utilize instructional technology to support in-class and distance learning when needed (i.e. Zoom, Nearpod)
• Bilingual in languages that reflect our student populations (preferred)

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

• Under the direction of the Education Specialist, work with students in small groups or in one-to-one assignments to reinforce or follow up learning activities in core academic, language, and/or specialized subject areas (for both in-class instruction and distance learning).
• Assist in the implementation of behavior intervention plans which may involve use of approved positive reinforcement strategies, behavior modification, and other skills or knowledge to establish and maintain appropriate behaviors.
• Facilitate and support social interactions and foster the development of positive relationships between students with disabilities and their non-disabled peers.
• Assist all students by modeling appropriate behavior and attitudes and providing emotional support and general guidance.
• Support students to be active participants on field trips and school assemblies or productions.
• Provide testing accommodations, including supervising students completing tests in a separate location or during an extended time.
• Provide the Education Specialist with information on student progress through observation, daily contact, and maintenance of accurate data trackers, student progress records/logs.
• Assist in establishing and maintaining a clean, safe, and cooperative classroom and learning environment.
• Assist physically disabled students with personal hygiene and grooming functions, including toileting, diapering, eating, dressing, and other self-help skills.
• Report suspected health problems to the appropriate school personnel.
• Maintain confidentiality of student records and classroom information in accordance with legal requirements and KIPP policies.
• Maintain instructional program in case of temporary absence of the Education Specialist.
• Attend and participate in IEP meetings, parent‐teacher conferences, and Student Study Meetings.
• Maintain professional standards and competence through participation in professional growth opportunities provided by KIPP Bay Area Public Schools and in self‐directed professional growth activities.
• Consistent & on time attendance during school work hours.
• Adhere to KIPP’s health and safety guidelines as outlined by the CDC, CDE, and public health agencies’ recommendations
• Perform other duties as assigned

Physical, Mental and Environmental Demands

Physical: Ability to navigate school and classroom settings. Ability to access and utilize technology. Occasional lifting/carrying of equipment 1-20 lbs. Physical agility to move self in various positions in order to execute duties effectively, which may include kneeling, walking, pushing/pulling, squatting, twisting, turning, bending, stooping and reaching overhead.

Mental: Stress of deadlines and normal work standards, ability to analyze problems and generate alternatives, work with interruptions, concentrate for long periods of time, read, calculate, perform routine math problems, memorize and recall objects and people.

Environmental: School and classroom environment subject to constant interruptions and distractions. Adhere to KIPP’s health and safety guidelines as outlined by the CDC, CDE, and public health agencies’ recommendations

Classification

This is a full-time, 40 hour a week, non-exempt position based on a school year calendar cycle and time off policy, located at our school sites.

About KIPP Public Schools Northern California

We are a thriving nonprofit network of free, public charter schools open to all students. Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career, and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and build a more just world.

We value the dedication, hard work, and passion that our teachers bring each day. KIPP Northern California supports you with professional development, coaching, and collaboration. We offer competitive pay and benefits that reflect the appreciation we have for our teachers and their dedication to students

Our student community consists of over 7,000 elementary, middle, and high school students in East Palo Alto, Oakland, San Francisco, San Lorenzo, San Jose, and Redwood City, and Stockton. 79% qualify for free or reduced price lunch, 23% are multilingual learners, and 10% have special needs. We strive to cultivate a representative team of teachers and leaders that reflect our students’ diversity

Compensation

KIPP Northern California is dedicated to you and your family's well-being! We offer a competitive salary as well as a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and transportation benefits.

How to Apply

Please submit a cover letter and resume by clicking apply on this page.

Questions? Email teach@kippnorcal.org

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Summer 2027: Firmware Engineering Intern, Advanced Development (May to August)
jobs.description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Location & Schedule: This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with 5 days per week onsite in Needham, MA. There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position.

Join the SharkNinja Early Edge Experience: Built for early career talent. Geared toward impact. Driven by speed. Whether you're in a co-op or internship, our early talent program is designed to provide valuable exposure to the industry and a fast-paced professional environment. You’ll dive into meaningful projects and tasks that sharpen your skills and deepen your knowledge. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development opportunities, community events, and connections that make your experience well-rounded and enriching. Your time with us will culminate in an opportunity to showcase your contributions and learnings to SharkNinja leaders because this is a program for those ready to shape what’s next — fast.

This role: We are looking for a curious and hands-on firmware engineer to support the development of breakthrough technologies and system architectures that will power the next generation of products. This role focuses on embedded firmware development and hardware-software integration, working closely with electrical and systems engineers to bring early-stage concepts to life. You will contribute to firmware architecture, embedded software development, and rapid prototyping, helping bridge cutting-edge technologies with real-world consumer applications.

Here are some of the exciting things you’ll get to do:

• Develop and test embedded firmware in C for microcontrollers and embedded systems

• Assist in bringing up new hardware by writing low-level drivers and debugging firmware-hardware interfaces

• Support rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept development for advanced technology modules

• Execute firmware validation tests and collect data for system and module characterization

• Collaborate with electrical engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces

• Debug embedded systems using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers

• Participate in the systems-thinking culture within the advanced development team

• Work cross-functionally with global engineering, ID/UX, product management, and manufacturing teams

Key Attributes & Skills:

• Education: Current student in a bachelor's or master's program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline

• Must be able to come into the office 5 days per week

• Must have strong C programming experience for embedded systems

• Coursework or project experience involving embedded programming in C

• Previous internship, research project, or hands-on embedded systems experience is a plus but not required

• Embedded firmware development for ARM-based microcontrollers and other MCU platforms

• Low-level firmware concepts: interrupts, timers, peripherals, memory management, and communication protocols

• Hardware interfaces: SPI, I²C, UART, GPIO, PWM, ADC/DAC

• Debugging embedded systems using JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers

• Experience with RTOS concepts or bare-metal firmware development

• Sensor integration and data acquisition

• Wireless protocols such as Bluetooth or Wi-Fi (a plus)

• Rapid prototyping with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar platforms (a plus)

Due to the high volume of applications for early talent roles, response times may vary depending on the specific role and timeline. Our team appreciates your patience!

Salary and Other Compensation: The hourly salary range for this position is displayed below. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, health savings account (HSA) with company contribution, sick time, company holidays, employee product discount, product testing opportunities, referral bonuses, and more.

Hourly Pay Range

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Nashville, Tennessee

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this pivotal role, you will help lead Cloudflare’s strategic customer engagements, securing and expanding platform partnerships across key accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong sales leadership, a deep understanding of enterprise architecture (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare integrates into modern cloud operating models.

As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will position Cloudflare’s Developer Platform, Application Security, SASE/Zero Trust Services, and Network and Content Delivery offerings against incumbents. You will drive predictable sales performance, foster healthy pipeline growth, and deliver on revenue objectives. You will act as a trusted advisor, educating customers and partners on Cloudflare’s evolving product ecosystem and security capabilities. This role involves leveraging executive sponsorship programs, partnering with senior leaders (including CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs), and collaborating with cross-functional teams to navigate and successfully close complex customer opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Leadership: Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts.

• Predictable Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasting and proactive pipeline management, sharing insights to support broader sales strategy.

• Enterprise Architecture Alignment: Demonstrate a strong understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across business, data, applications, and technology pillars, connecting Cloudflare solutions directly to customer business outcomes.

• Executive & C-Suite Engagement: Manage complex customer engagements across multiple business units, building strong relationships with executive sponsors and C-level stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with cross-functional teams—including Product Managers and executive leadership—to advance strategic deals and resolve operational friction.

• Digital Transformation Guidance: Serve as a key advisor on digital transformation, helping customers navigate market shifts and position Cloudflare as a core strategic partner.

• Clear Communication & Feedback: Connect insights across global departments to deliver clear messaging, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous team growth.

• Long-Term Strategic Vision: Make balanced decisions aligned with long-term organizational value, building trust through open communication and knowledge sharing.

• Goal Setting & Operational Efficiency: Partner with teams to set clear metrics, address operational roadblocks, and improve cross-departmental workflows.

• Collaborative Problem Solving: Proactively identify customer and internal needs, fostering positive change and contributing to continuous team improvement.

• Inclusive Leadership: Champion diverse perspectives to solve complex business challenges and support a supportive, forward-thinking team environment.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Demonstrated track record of success in B2B enterprise sales, closing multi-year, complex technology agreements demonstrating a track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.

• Deep understanding of enterprise cloud platforms, network security, and modern IT architecture.

• Proven capability to align solutions with customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and enterprise business models mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.

• Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and managing executive sponsorship initiatives.

• Strong collaborative skills with experience working alongside cross-functional leadership teams.

• Familiarity with digital transformation trends and the ability to translate market insights into customer solutions.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.

• Thoughtful decision-making approach focused on sustainable, long-term business success.

• Experience setting clear performance indicators and facilitating cross-team alignment.

• Proficiency with enterprise sales tools and methodologies (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, MEDDPICC, or similar frameworks).

• Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed.

• Willingness to travel as needed to foster strong customer and internal team relationships.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

jobs.title: Scientist I, Sample Processing
jobs.description:
AbbVie's Quantitative Medicine and Genomics (QM&G) functional area promotes data-driven innovation in drug discovery by integrating diverse quantitative data and leveraging advanced computational models to turn human data into AbbVie Pipeline. QM&G develops world-class genetics and genomics research to identify and validate therapeutic targets, deepen understanding of human disease biology, and characterize drug response across clinical programs and therapeutic areas.

The Scientist I, Sample Processing role within Genomic Technologies (GTECH) applies high-throughput and customized nucleic acid extraction methodologies and QC workflows to deliver high-quality sample sets that drive GTECH’s data-generating profiling platforms. Working in a matrixed environment, this scientist aligns their expertise and workflows to project goals to ensure timely delivery of nucleic acid products for omic profiling, supporting the success of QM&G strategic partnerships and related research programs.

This role integrates biobanking, sample processing, and LIMS capabilities to provide seamless, end-to-end sample traceability from receipt through delivery to downstream molecular omic workflows. The scientist will also regularly apply their expertise to enhance extraction methodologies, automated liquid handling techniques, and LIMS workflows, aligning with shared standards, coordinated priorities, and scalable delivery for Discovery Research and Development pipeline programs.

The successful candidate is proficient in following established wet lab SOPs and protocols, executes responsibilities autonomously, and demonstrates technical precision, scientific integrity, attention to detail, and strong data interpretation skills, along with an understanding of the core disciplines of biology, molecular genetics, and genomics.

Why Join Us

• As a scientist in the Genomic Technologies (GTECH) team, you will support the operating model that connects biospecimen readiness with high-throughput omics data generation. Your contributions will influence the decision-ready datasets that advance discovery and translational programs. We offer a highly collaborative environment, where GTECH aims to be a scientific partner from concept to impact, delivering actionable omic insights to expedite breakthrough therapies for patients.

Key Responsibilities

Biospecimen & Biobanking Operations

• Delivers results within agreed timelines through autonomous execution of routine and complex wet lab workflows aligned to laboratory and safety SOPs, policies, and procedures.
• Maintain sample integrity and traceability through LIMS documentation.
• Perform high-throughput and customized nucleic acid extraction, sample aliquoting, and handling methods to prepare high-quality material for omic profiling platforms.
• Drive nucleic acid QC data curation and preliminary analysis and interpretation, maintaining scientific integrity for success of downstream omics workflows.

Quality, Compliance, Systems, and Resources

• Maintain high scientific integrity in a GxP adjacent environment
• Use LIMS to track samples, data, and workflows with accuracy and data integrity.
• Contribute to LIMS workflow development to increase throughput, quality, and scalability.
• Develop, co-author, and contribute to laboratory workflow or process SOPs.
• Maintain wet lab instrumentation, including extraction platforms, automated liquid handlers, and nucleic acid QC instruments, and keep instrument documentation current.

Stakeholder and Cross-Functional Contributions

• Maintain open, proactive communication within direct and matrixed teams to align priorities, timelines, and sample delivery expectations.
• Present data and progress updates in scientific and technical meetings, as applicable.
• Active contributor to the success of project goals through collaboration and scientific contributions.
• Ensure effective and clear handoffs, strategies for assay success to downstream scientists.

Scientific Impact and Innovation

• Ideation through validation of improved extraction methodologies, automated liquid handling techniques, and or LIMS workflows to increase throughput, quality, and scalability.
• Apply data-driven insights from QC trends to recommend process enhancements that support QM&G strategic partnerships.
• Continually raise the bar through development and increasing understanding in GTECH workflows to enable skillset of “operational user” to support high demand workflows as required through manager direction.

Professional Skills

• Ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities with minimal stepwise direction.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail and scientific rigor.
• Strong collaboration initiative and active communicator.
• Experienced in delivering scientific presentations and drafting formal project reports for managers and senior leaders.
• Independent research to stay current in field- conducts and evaluates scientific landscape.

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education with typically 5 years of experience, or Master’s Degree or equivalent education with typically two years of experience.
• Theoretical and practical knowledge to carry out the job functions.
• LIMS or equivalent end-to-end sample traceability documentation experience.
• Ability to draw from and evolve laboratory skills to elevate expected deliverables.
• Nucleic acid extraction techniques including but not limited to organic phase extraction, silica column extraction, precipitation extraction.
• Nucleic acid quality control analysis including but not limited to automated electrophoresis, fluorescent quantification, absorbance.
• Experience in regulated laboratory environments, especially with Good Scientific Practice documentation and experimental execution.
• Proficiency in micropipetting and liquid handler program execution, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting.
• Experience with methodology and instrument validation testing.

jobs.title: AI-Based Scale & Performance Test Automation Intern
jobs.description:
ONWARDS TOGETHER!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.


THIS IS A 12 WEEK INTERNSHIP PROGRAM BEGINNING ON MAY 24TH 2027 OR JUNE 21ST 2027. 



LOCATION: ONSITE AT HEADQUARTERS IN SUNNYVALE, CA



OUR TEAM'S VISION:

Illumio's Quality Engineering team builds and maintains the automation that validates the Policy Compute Engine (PCE) at scale — from individual REST API correctness to multi-thousand-rule policy regressions, RBAC enforcement, and traffic-simulation-driven load testing across large, distributed environments. Our framework drives real PCE clusters through thousands of generated test scenarios, simulates network traffic and VEN workloads at scale, and verifies that policy decisions, traffic reporting, and system performance all hold up under production-scale conditions.

About the Role

We're looking for an intern to help modernize how we approach scale and performance testing by applying AI-driven techniques to test analysis, generation, and infrastructure management. You'll work directly with our existing large-scale test suites and tooling, with the opportunity to materially improve both test quality and the efficiency of the infrastructure that runs it.



YOUR IMPACT:

 - Develop AI-driven automation to improve scale and performance testing across large-scale environments.

 - Analyze existing test suites to identify coverage gaps, redundant tests, and opportunities for improvement, and implement additional scenarios to address those gaps.

 - Explore the use of AI for intelligent test generation, execution, analysis, and optimization of scale-testing workflows.

 - Design and implement automatic scaling of cloud test infrastructure based on workload and testing requirements, improving cloud resource utilization.

 - Optimize infrastructure usage to reduce unnecessary cloud consumption and associated costs while maintaining the capacity required for scale and performance testing.

 - Refactor and optimize existing test suites and automation to improve efficiency, maintainability, repeatability, and overall testing effectiveness.




YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 - Programming experience in Ruby, Python, or a similar language; comfort reading and modifying existing codebases.

 - Familiarity with REST APIs and automated testing concepts (unit, integration, or end-to-end testing).

 - Interest in applying AI/ML techniques (e.g., LLM-based tooling, test generation, anomaly detection) to real engineering problems.

 - Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar) and infrastructure-as-code concepts is a plus.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large, complex systems.

 - Clear written communication and a collaborative approach to working with an established engineering team.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with load/performance testing tools (e.g., Gatling, JMeter, Locust).

 - Familiarity with network security, policy-based access control, or firewall/segmentation concepts.

 - Prior exposure to CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure automation.




EXTRA PERKS!

To support you throughout your internship, Illumio interns can look forward to:

 - Stipend: A stipend to help support you during your internship.

 - Events & Experiences: Fun and meaningful events providing opportunities to connect with fellow Illumineers to build new skills and experience our culture.

 - Giving Back: Opportunities to volunteer and make an impact in our community.

 - Meals & Snacks: Stay fueled with a fully stocked office, snacks and beverages, plus catered lunch from local restaurants every day!
   
    

#LI-PO1 #LI-ONSITE

 

Candidates selected for an internship must have valid U.S. work authorization for the full duration of the internship. Illumio does not provide immigration sponsorship for internship positions; however, candidates who are independently eligible for employment authorization, including eligible F-1 students who obtain appropriate CPT or OPT authorization, may be considered.

 

Any required employment authorization must be in place before employment begins. If an intern is later considered for a full-time position, any need for future immigration sponsorship will be evaluated separately under Illumio’s immigration policy and the requirements of the position.

Our Commitment



Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.



All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant - San Ramon, CA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

VEG is a rapidly growing emergency company with hospital locations across the United States. Our mission is helping people and their pets when they need it most. We are revolutionizing emergency medicine with a “customer first” mentality and a true, employee-centric work environment.

TALENT + CULTURE AT VEG

At VEG, we want people and their pets to feel safe, secure, and valued; we want our employees to feel the same way. What we’re aiming to achieve on the customer side is equivalent in nature to what we want for our employees: to have the best experience possible. With the highest NPS score in our industry, we’re ready to ensure that VEG remains the place where the best and brightest in the emergency world not only want to work, but stay and grow. For our customers and their pets, we strive to find a way to say, “yes.” We do the same and more for our teams. In fact, VEG is one of this year’s nominees for INC Magazine’s Best Places to Work!

WHO WE NEED

You are passionate and motivated. You value learning and are a team player that is honest and respectful to your peers. You love what you do. You love working with animals and people. You are comfortable adapting to new scenarios, willing to learn new techniques, and think outside the box. You have excellent interpersonal capabilities across a diverse group. You’re happy to pitch in wherever and whenever you are needed, with a positive attitude. You demonstrate the ability to accomplish assigned tasks for all areas involved, knowing when to ask for assistance. You display excellent communication skills with your peers, customers, and team.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO

• Treat each patient and customer with the highest level of compassion and care.

• Perform basic to intermediate nursing care tasks, patient monitoring, and treatments.

• Use understanding of common diseases and conditions, physical assessment, and monitoring parameters to accurately triage incoming patients.

• Administer subcutaneous, intramuscular, and intravenous medications and understand potential adverse effects of medications.

• Set-up, monitor, and administer intravenous fluid therapy including constant rate infusions and blood transfusion therapy.

• Contribute as a team member to incoming outpatient care and ongoing inpatient care.

• Participate in giving and receiving patient rounds to ensure continuity of care.

• Be trained to properly perform all aspects of CPR as a RECOVER Certified Rescuer.

• Collect samples and perform diagnostic tests including in-house and point-of-care tests and diagnostic imaging.

• Assist in setting-up, performing, monitoring sedation and surgical anesthesia with LVT or DVM supervision.

• Perform nursing care tasks such as placing and maintaining urinary catheters and nasal oxygen tubes, and

• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot oxygen cages and other oxygen administration techniques.

• Work alongside licensed veterinary technicians as a vital member of the nursing care team.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as veterinary technician credentialing, trainer role, community outreach, and leadership.

Veterinary Assistants can additionally (where permitted by law):

• Administer, monitor, and maintain patients under general anesthesia with or without mechanical ventilation for patients with varied levels of risk.

• Perform advanced vascular access techniques including jugular catheter placement, sampling line placement, central line placement, intraosseous catheterization, and arterial catheterization.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée «STAGE 2027 - Gestion de Projet IA & Innovation Qualité  - Structure A350 (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Découvrez le site en vidéo :

Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 30 personnes au sein du département  « Qualité A350 Structure » en charge de la Qualité Produit de l'unité de production A350 Structure

Encadré par votre tutrice, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Stratégie et feuille de route IA : Définir et déployer la roadmap métier d'intégration de l'IA, explorer les opportunités de digitalisation et co-animer le « Tech Bar Qualité IA ».
• Pilotage de Proofs of Concept (PoC) : Déployer des preuves de concept ciblées par métier pour valider l'efficacité des solutions et favoriser leur adoption opérationnelle.
• Excellence opérationnelle par la data : Optimiser la surveillance qualité grâce à la clusterisation des non-conformités (NC) et renforcer le ciblage des risques lors des mini-audits.
• Conformité et amélioration continue : Garantir l'alignement des évolutions liées à l'IA avec les référentiels qualité et collaborer avec la production et l'ingénierie de fabrication pour enrichir le système de management de la qualité (SMQ).
• Acculturation et tutorat innovant : Accompagner la montée en compétences de l'équipe qualité sur les outils et usages de l'IA via un format de formation ludique.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Déploiement de solutions Data/IA en milieu industriel : traduction d'un besoin métier complexe en solutions digitales (algorithmes, data analyse)
• Pilotage de projets Innovation & IA : de la construction d'une roadmap stratégique au déploiement de Preuve de concept concrets sur le terrain
• Conduite du changement et Leadership : vulgarisation technique, animation d'ateliers et transfert de compétences pour embarquer les équipes
• Management de la Qualité & Excellence Opérationnelle : maîtrise des référentiels aéronautiques et utilisation de l'analyse de données pour optimiser la résolution de problèmes

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de l'Intelligence Artificielle, de la Data Science, de l'Informatique  ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Vous êtes passionné par les nouvelles technologies et l'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle (IA).
• Vous avez des notions de conduite du changement.
• Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse face à des situations complexes et faites preuve d'esprit de synthèse.
• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation

Langues:

• Anglais : courant
• Français : courant

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Working Week: 37.5 hours per week (Monday to Thursdays)

Location: Larne, NI

• 25 days annual leave + Bank Holidays

• Contributory pension scheme - Caterpillar will contribute up to 6%
• Contributory share scheme - Caterpillar will match 50% of the employee's contribution.
• Optional flexible benefits including access to health and dental care plans, EV car lease, additional holiday purchase.

Join our team to help build a better, more sustainable world for future generations!

Why Join Caterpillar?

Join a global industry leader where your skills help build products that power critical infrastructure around the world. In return, you'll benefit from a four-day working week, competitive pay, bonus potential, generous pension contributions, and a flexible benefits package.

With a strong focus on employee development, safety, and wellbeing, Caterpillar offers long-term career opportunities within a supportive and collaborative environment.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a skilled Fabricator/Welders to join our manufacturing team in Larne. In this hands-on role, you'll use your expertise to produce high-quality components and assemblies, working with a range of fabrication and welding techniques to support world-class products.

You'll be part of a team that values craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and problem-solving, with opportunities to further develop your skills while making a direct contribution to our manufacturing success.

What You Will Do:

• Carry out a range of welding activities, MIG, gas welding, brazing, and soldering across a variety of materials.
• Fabricate, assemble, modify, and rework generator set components, including skid bases, silencers, tanks, and container systems.
• Perform welding and fabrication work with minimal supervision, interpreting engineering drawings and determining appropriate methods and work sequences.
• Produce high-quality work that meets required safety, quality, and production standards.
• Conduct fabrication and welding operations on bespoke and special-order products.
• Maintain a safe, clean, and organised working environment in line with 5S principles and site safety requirements.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, quality, and workplace safety.
• Demonstrate behaviours aligned with our Values in Action and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.
• Provide guidance and training to colleagues when required, helping to develop team capability and skills.
• Undertake other duties appropriate to the role and business needs.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

• Successfully completed a recognised apprenticeship, NVQ Level 3, or equivalent qualification in Fabrication and Welding.
• Able to follow detailed work instructions, technical procedures, and verbal guidance accurately.
• Comfortable performing measurements and calculations required for fabrication and welding activities.
• Proven ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and assembly plans.
• Flexible approach to working patterns, including overtime and shift work when required.

Desirable Skills & Experience

• Lean manufacturing experience.
• Overhead crane and slinging experience.
• Proficient in the use of measuring and inspection equipment.
• Ability to work safely at height.
• Strong focus on quality, accuracy, and workmanship.
• Effective planning and prioritisation skills.

Additional information:

• Uniform and PPE will be provided
• Onsite Canteen
• Free onsite parking
• Overtime opportunities may be available on Fridays, subject to business requirements

About Our Larne Facility

Located in Northern Ireland, our Larne facility designs and manufactures large generator sets that power critical industries worldwide, supporting sectors such as data centres, healthcare, construction and utilities in more than 100 countries.

As a vertically integrated manufacturing site, Larne brings together expertise across engineering design, project management, fabrication, welding, electrical systems, assembly and testing. It’s a place where innovative thinking, technical excellence and teamwork come together to deliver products that keep essential infrastructure running around the globe.

Beyond manufacturing, Larne is committed to developing future talent through apprenticeships, training programmes and community partnerships, offering employees the opportunity to build rewarding careers while making a positive impact both locally and globally.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For over 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

负责无人驾驶产品电气系统原理及电气线束的设计、开发、集成和验证。根据产品及无人驾驶系统需求，制定电气技术方案，确保设计满足功能、安全、可靠性、可制造性和成本目标；协同跨职能团队及供应商解决复杂技术问题，并支持产品从概念开发到量产及现场应用。

Responsible for the design, development, integration, and validation of electrical schematics and wiring harnesses for autonomous wide-body trucks. Develop electrical solutions based on vehicle and autonomous system requirements, ensuring that designs meet functional, safety, reliability, manufacturability, and cost targets. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and suppliers to resolve complex technical issues and support products from concept development through production and field deployment.

Key Responsibilities

• 分析产品、无人驾驶系统及客户应用需求，协助主管工程师制定电气系统技术方案和设计规范。
• Analyze machine, autonomous system, and customer application requirements; assist lead engineer to develop electrical system solutions and design specifications.
• 协助主管工程师设计产品电气原理和架构，包括电源分配、接地与保护、控制回路、传感器与执行器接口及通信网络设计。
• Assist lead engineer to design machine electrical schematics and system architecture, including power distribution, grounding and protection, control circuits, sensor and actuator interfaces, and communication networks.
• 负责电气线束设计，包括线径与器件选型、连接器定义、布线、线束图纸及BOM发布。
• Design electrical harnesses and cables, including wire and component selection, connector definition, routing, harness drawings, and BOM release.
• 开展设计评审、DFMEA及设计验证，确保电气系统满足安全、可靠性、可制造性、可维护性和成本要求。
• Conduct design reviews, DFMEA, and design validation to ensure compliance with safety, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and cost requirements.
• 制定并执行台架、产品及现场测试计划，分析测试结果并推动问题闭环。
• Develop and execute bench, machine, and field test plans; analyze test results and drive issue resolution.
• 管理电气设计变更、配置、技术文件及产品生命周期内的持续改进。
• Manage electrical design changes, configuration, technical documentation, and continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle.
• 与整车团队，各系统团队、采购及供应商团队协作，解决复杂的电气集成和质量问题。
• Collaborate with machine team, subsystem teams, procurement, and supplier teams to resolve complex electrical integration and quality issues.

Education:

工程类本科及以上学历，专业包括：自动化； 车辆工程；电气工程；机械工程；控制工程；机器人。

Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, with a major in Automation, Vehicle Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Control Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.

Required Skills:
Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Knowledge of design for manufacturability guidelines, methodologies, and use cases; ability to use this knowledge to optimize product designs and manufacturing operations.

Engineering - MFG: Knowledge of processes, techniques and methods of engineering in a manufacturing environment; ability to design and implement materials, structures, machines, devices, systems and processes that safely realize a desired objective or invention.

Manufacturing Equipment: Knowledge of the electrical, mechanical and logistics equipment used in manufacturing; ability to safely operate, maintain, update and store them.

Product Testing: Knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques and tools; ability to design, plan and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure product quality at all stages of manufacturing.

Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing or product development environment.

Ability to speak and write English fluently

Job Title ： 嵌入式网络安全开发工程师

岗位职责（Job Responsibilities）

面向 DCU（NVIDIA Orin / Thor，嵌入式 Linux）平台的网络安全功能实现岗位。在安全架构师给定的安全方案与需求下，负责 Secure Boot、设备证书与 mTLS 通信、ROS2 DDS Security、Linux 系统加固、OTA 签名校验、漏洞修复等具体安全功能的编码实现、集成、测试与交付，并输出配套的部署脚本、测试记录与使用文档

• 实现并集成设备安全通信mTLS，配合 Nginx / MQTT / HTTP 等服务完成双向认证接入，并完成握手失败、证书过期、吊销等异常路径处理与测试。
• 实现设备证书全生命周期的端侧功能：证书请求（CSR）生成、证书与私钥的安全存储（文件权限、TPM / 安全分区）、证书部署与更新脚本、过期检测与轮换逻辑，并编写对应的自动化测试。
• 在 Orin / Thor 平台上完成 Secure Boot 相关功能的实现与验证：按方案完成签名密钥配置、镜像 / 内核 / 设备树签名流程脚本化、Fuse 烧写步骤验证、启动链完整性测试，输出可重复执行的操作手册。
• 实现 ROS2 DDS Security 配置与集成：生成并部署 Identity / Permissions / Governance 文件，完成节点级访问控制配置，验证加密与认证对带宽、时延的影响并给出调优结果。
• 实现 Linux 系统安全加固项：用户与权限最小化、SSH 与服务配置收敛、防火墙（iptables / nftables）规则、安全基线脚本化检查，并在目标机上验证不影响业务功能。
• 实现 OTA 安全校验功能：升级包签名验证、完整性校验、版本防回滚检查的端侧代码，覆盖签名无效、包损坏、版本降级等负向用例。
• 编写并维护安全功能的单元测试、集成测试与部署脚本，输出测试报告、配置说明与故障排查文档；参与代码评审。
• 配合安全架构师、平台软件、测试与现场团队完成安全功能联调、问题定位与修复

任职要求（Required Qualifications）

• 本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、网络安全、电子信息等相关专业，3 年以上嵌入式 Linux 开发经验，其中 1 年以上网络安全功能开发或集成经验。

• 熟悉 Linux 系统基础：用户与权限模型、systemd 服务管理、网络配置、日志系统，
• 熟悉 OpenSSL 命令行与 API，理解 X.509 证书、CA 签发、证书链校验、具备 TLS / mTLS 实际集成经验。
• 了解 Secure Boot 与信任链的基本流程，有 NVIDIA Jetson / Orin 或其他嵌入式平台 Secure Boot 使能经验者优先。
• 具备良好的文档编写能力，能够输出清晰的操作手册、配置说明与测试记录

Build our future together:

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Senior Supply Chain Compliance Manager to join our IOPS Supply Chain and Logistics team, managing and overseeing all compliance-related activities — including investigations, change controls, and CAPA — across Supply Chain and Logistics operations at IOPS sites globally. In this role, you will lead and develop a compliance team, drive inspection readiness, and build a proactive compliance culture — while serving as a go-to technical mentor and collaborating with Quality, Regulatory, and cross-functional partners across the organization. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, science-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.

When & where:

• Location: Troy, New York

• Travel percentage: 25% to Ireland

Discover your role:

• Lead, develop, and guide a global team performing Supply Chain and Logistics compliance activities, fostering a healthy working environment where team members feel valued, respected, and accountable for results
• Manage teams responsible for completing change controls, preparing investigation reports with root cause analysis, product impact assessments, and corrective action recommendations for medium and high severity non-conformances
• Oversee risk assessments and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) activities; ensure Corrective and Preventive Actions are appropriate, implemented as planned, and demonstrate intended effectiveness

• Track and trend compliance activities including investigations and CAPAs to identify improvement opportunities; ensure all training is maintained and documented in accordance with cGMP standards

• Build and maintain a robust training program; provide support to groups and supervisors on the initiation, review, and follow-up of CCs, NOEs, DNFs, impact statements, and corrective action plans

This role requires:

• BS/BA degree with 8+ years of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience; level determined based on qualifications

Job Responsibilities

本岗位是一个以嵌入式软件开发、功能安全机制实现和高质量软件交付为核心的功能安全软件开发岗位。负责在 Infineon TC397 安全 MCU 上完成功能安全架构与各类安全机制（看门狗、ECC、SMU、Lockstep、BIST 等）的软件实现，开发、集成并验证功能安全相关的底层软件（MCAL、OS、CDD 及安全库），并实现安全 MCU 与高算力计算平台（NVIDIA Orin / Thor）之间的安全协同软件及自动驾驶域控平台。

• 实现基于 Infineon TC397 的功能安全架构：将安全概念（Safety Concept）、技术安全需求（TSR）和软件安全需求（SSR）转化为可运行、可测试的 C 代码与配置，完成安全机制到软件模块的分配、实现与追溯。
• 实现并验证芯片级与系统级安全机制，包括：内部/外部看门狗（窗口看门狗、Q&A 模式）服务与监督逻辑、软件分区与内存保护、Flash/SRAM ECC 告警处理与错误记录、SMU 告警路由配置与反应处理、Lockstep 核比对异常处理与复位后恢复、上电/运行期 BIST（LBIST/MBIST）调度与结果判定等，并在目标硬件上验证每一项机制的有效性。
• 开发、集成并交付功能安全相关的底层软件：完成 Infineon MCAL / iLLD 驱动配置、安全扩展与寄存器回读校验，安全 RTOS 的分区、MPU 与时间保护配置，复杂设备驱动（CDD）编写，SafeTlib / 安全库集成与启动时序对接，保证底层软件在目标硬件上稳定运行。
• 实现安全 MCU 与 Orin / Thor 高算力平台之间的协作软件：心跳与存活监控、E2E 保护通信（CRC/Counter/Timeout）编解码库、跨平台故障上报与安全状态同步协议、安全降级与进入安全状态（Safe State）的决策与执行逻辑，并与 SoC 侧团队联调直至闭环。
• 对交付软件的质量负责：遵循 MISRA C 与项目编码规范编写代码，完成单元测试（语句/分支/MC/DC 覆盖达标）、静态分析零未论证缺陷、代码评审、集成测试与故障注入测试（FIT），输出测试报告与追溯矩阵，确保安全机制的诊断覆盖率（DC）与反应时间满足目标 ASIL 与 FTTI 要求。
• 参与 FMEA / FTA / DFA/FMEDA/MTTFd/DCavg分析，为软件安全机制提供检测范围、周期和验证证据，支持硬件指标（SPFM/LFM/PMHF/MTTFd等）计算。
• 与硬件、系统工程、Orin/Thor 平台软件、测试及质量团队紧密协作，推动功能安全要求在整车/整机层面的实现与验证闭环
• 支持功能安全合规审核及safety case所需底软功能安全相关设计文档准备

Qualifications:

l  计算机、软件工程、电子工程、自动化或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

l  3年以上嵌入式软件开发经验。

l  熟悉AUTOSAR AP/CP架构以及相应安全机制技术原理。

l  熟悉嵌入式 MCU 软件开发流程，具备等车规/工业级 MCU 平台开发经验。

l  扎实的嵌入式 C 编码能力：能够独立编写、调试并交付高质量的底层驱动与安全机制代码，熟练掌握 MISRA C:2012，熟悉多核、中断、DMA、内存保护、原子操作与确定性时序编程

l  熟悉 E2E 通信保护（CRC / 计数器 / 超时）、看门狗管理、程序流监控、时间监控等安全机制的软件实现，具备安全状态机与故障管理器的实现经验。

l  具备良好的代码质量意识和文档能力，能够输出有效的技术方案与评审材料。

jobs.title: Lead Cloud Data Architect
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Technology

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$173,700.00 - $286,600.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Lead Architect to join our organization as we grow and transform our Enterprise Technology Solutions organization. Our Architects are responsible for designing and guiding the technology vision that enables business transformation, specializing in creating enterprise-wide solutions that bridge current capabilities with future possibilities. This strategic position requires expertise in cloud-native technologies, APIs, AI/ML, and emerging platforms to establish scalable architectures where business applications can evolve and thrive. The ideal candidate orchestrates the technical strategy that empowers development teams - defining target states, creating technology roadmaps, and establishing architectural frameworks that accelerate innovation while maintaining standards and governance. As the essential bridge between business strategy and technical implementation, this role directly impacts organizational agility, system integration, and the enterprise's ability to rapidly adapt and scale technology solutions across the business landscape.

What Will You Do?

• Scope:
• Responsible for architecture for multiple technology and or/ business segments/domains for a single business unit.
• Technical Execution:
• Responsible for the enterprise database migration and modernization strategy, governing the transition of SQL Server, Oracle, open-source databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB), and MongoDB from on-premises environments to cloud-native platforms (AWS RDS, Aurora, DMS, Azure SQL, Oracle Database@Cloud)
• Develop migration sequencing, tooling standards, and reference architectures that minimize risk and disruption while accelerating delivery timelines
• Architect conversion strategies to transition proprietary database platforms to cost-effective open-source alternatives, eliminating significant annual licensing costs
• Establish database engineering standards covering high availability, replication, performance tuning, schema governance, and observability across cloud-managed and self-managed database services
• Define and implement database disaster recovery and resiliency frameworks with automated failover, backup validation, and compliance-aligned retention policies
• Responsible for the enterprise data migration strategy for transitioning on-premises data stores—including block storage, file systems, archive repositories, and backup platforms—to cloud-native solutions (AWS S3, EFS, Glacier, FSx, Backup)
• Architect end-to-end data platform solutions spanning ingestion, storage, processing, transformation, and consumption layers across hybrid and cloud environments
• Architect enterprise block storage solutions for cloud environments, including high-performance EBS volumes, storage tiering strategies, snapshot lifecycle management, and performance optimization for database and transactional workloads
• Design file storage architectures supporting both cloud-native (AWS EFS, FSx for Windows File Server, FSx for NetApp ONTAP) and hybrid use cases, including protocol compatibility (NFS, SMB), access control, and high-availability configurations for shared workloads
• Define storage platform standards covering provisioning, capacity management, encryption at rest, replication, and cost optimization across block, file, object, and archive tiers
• Develop FinOps discipline for data platform decisions—modeling TCO for migration scenarios, quantifying licensing and infrastructure savings, and optimizing storage tiering strategies
• Drive continuous technology transformation to minimize technical debt.
• Conduct hands-on prototyping of new technology solutions.
• Architect cloud-native data and database solutions primarily on AWS, with knowledge of Azure and GCP as a plus for multi-cloud and hybrid scenarios
• Define infrastructure-as-code (IaC) standards, SLAs/SLOs, and platform reliability engineering practices across data and database services
• Evaluate and adopt emerging cloud-native data technologies aligned with organizational needs—including managed database services, streaming platforms, lakehouses, and vector/graph databases
• Drive platform security posture including encryption, secrets management, IAM governance, and network isolation for data workloads
• Strategic Accountability:
• Partner with Lines of Business (LOB) and technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into platform capabilities that directly enable digital transformation and strategic initiatives
• Collaborate with ETS teams—infrastructure, security, operations, and application development—to align platform architecture with enterprise standards and ensure seamless service delivery
• Mentor and develop engineers and DBAs, building cloud and open-source competencies while fostering a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning
• Provide strong thought leadership in pursuit of modern architecture principles and technology modernization.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

• Technical Expertise & Education:
• Bachelor’s degree in technology-related field or equivalent, with 8 to 10 years of architecture experience.
• Advanced level architecture and recent hands-on strong engineering experience with modern technologies.
• Successful execution of complex, large scale technology strategies.
• Leadership & Influence:
• Advanced leadership skills with the ability to leverage cross-functional networks to collaborate with architecture and engineering leaders on problem-solving, build company-wide credibility, prioritize critical architectural challenges, and strengthen the Architecture organization through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and creating development opportunities for team members.
• Strategic & Business Acumen:
• Extensive experience working in an agile operational model.
• Advanced experience supporting transformational change. Able to adjust plans, priorities and strategies in response to changing circumstances.
• Experience developing technology target states and roadmaps that align to short- and long-term business goals.
• Insurance technology experience preferred.
• Strong understanding of value creation and business capability models.
• Strong knowledge of the insurance industry.
• Advanced experience identifying and analyzing current/future problems and opportunities, evaluating information to understand root causes, and exploring alternative solutions for effective decision-making.
• Proven ability to work collaboratively with colleagues to achieve mutually responsible results.
• Extensive experience exercising sound judgment, making decisions and committing to a position.
• Advanced and effective verbal, written and listening communication skills.

What is a Must Have?

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
• 7 additional years of architecture/software engineering experience.
• 2 years of technical leadership experience.

What Is in It for You?

• Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
• Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
• Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
• Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
• Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

Your Impact

Lowe’s is committed to solving problems and fulfilling dreams for the home. As a Manager on the Brand Public Relations team, you’ll bring Lowe’s to the forefront of national and local conversations through strategic storytelling and breakthrough moments that drive headline-grabbing attention, shape perceptions and build lasting relationships with customers and communities through the power of earned media.

We are seeking a media relations powerhouse and strategic storyteller with a proven track record of securing needle-moving coverage of brand initiatives to join our team. This is a highly visible role at the heart of our brand — perfect for a PR professional who is equal parts creative, strategic and collaborative.

• Own and execute areas of the overarching PR strategy across consumer news, trade and lifestyle verticals to build consistent, strategic brand presence and maximize every brand moment.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key media contacts, journalists and content creators.

• Proactively secure earned media coverage through storytelling, press releases, pitches, product sampling and creative moments that are always within Lowe’s brand standards.

• Collaborate with the brand marketing, social media and creative teams across Lowe’s to ensure messaging alignment and to capitalize on brand moments.

• Proactively spot trends, news moments and culture shifts and craft smart pitches that put Lowe’s at the center of that story.

Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion.
