jobs.title: Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Für Airbus Defence and Space in Ulm suchen wir für den Bereich „Engineering Defence Digital” einen

Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer (d/f/m)

Unsere Abteilung in Ulm entwickelt komplexe militärische Systeme, welche komplette Funktionsketten von zielerfassenden Sensoren über die Lagebilderstellung bis hin zu Effektoren der bodengebundenen Luftverteidigung integrieren.

Wir bieten Senior Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer (d/f/m), die bereits Berufserfahrung gesammelt haben und sich für Softwareentwicklung im militärischen Kontext interessieren und begeistern können, spannende Perspektiven innerhalb unserer Teams.

Dein Standort

Zwischen Stuttgart und München gelegen, ist Ulm eine Stadt, die ein breites Spektrum an Freizeit- und Kulturangeboten bietet. Hier kannst du die Lebensqualität unter dem höchsten Kirchturm der Welt genießen und Teil einer Stadt sein, die sowohl ihre historischen Sehenswürdigkeiten bewahrt, als auch die Zukunft entlang der Donau aktiv gestaltet.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Airbus Defence and Space in Ulm sucht einen Entwickler oder Entwicklerin für unser AI-Team. Gestalten Sie unsere AI-Roadmap mit und entwickeln Sie souveräne, auf Artificial Intelligence basierende Lösungen für unsere sicherheitsrelevanten Systeme – von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zum Test. Im Fokus: AI-Systeme, die Bedrohungen erkennen und Schutzmechanismen stärken.

Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

• Konzipierung, Entwicklung und Betrieb von AI-Modellen auf Basis von Supervised, Unsupervised und Reinforcement Learning für sicherheitsrelevante Anwendungen
• Auswahl, Vergleich und Validierung von Modellarchitekturen sowie Optimierung von Algorithmen, Hyperparametern und Trainingspipelines
• Aufbau und Pflege von ML-Pipelines (Feature Engineering, Training, Evaluierung, Deployment) entlang des ML-Lifecycles
• Analyse von Daten, Ableitung von Merkmalen und Sicherstellung von Datenqualität sowie Datenverarbeitungskonzepten
• Entwicklung von Lösungen zur Bedrohungserkennung, Anomalieanalyse und automatisierten Entscheidungsunterstützung
• Implementierung von Reinforcement-Learning-Ansätzen für adaptive Systeme und optimierte Entscheidungsprozesse
• Durchführung von Modelltests, Metrikbewertung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Modellleistung (Accuracy, Robustheit, Fairness, Erklärbarkeit)
• Integration der Modelle in bestehende Softwaresysteme sowie Bereitstellung von APIs und Services
• Sicherstellung von Nachvollziehbarkeit, Dokumentation und Compliance mit den internen Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards
• Technische Beratung der Fachteams, Review von Lösungen und Mitgestaltung der AI-Roadmap
• Mentoring von Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie Beitrag zu internen und externen Fachforen

Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, AI, Data Science, Mathematik oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung.
• Einschlägige Berufserfahrung >5 Jahre
• Programmierung: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python; Erfahrung mit ML-Frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, Rllib, …).
• Machine-Learning-Expertise: Fundierte, nachweisbare Erfahrung in Supervised, Unsupervised und/oder Reinforcement Learning. Fundiertes Verständnis von Modellarchitekturen, Trainingsalgorithmen, Hyperparameter-Optimierung und Evaluierungsmethoden. Erfahrung mit klassischen ML-Algorithmen sowie Deep-Learning-Architekturen (CNNs, Transformers, …). Up-to-date mit allen Entwicklungen im AI-Umfeld.
• Reinforcement Learning: Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Bewertung von RL-Agenten (Policy-/Value-based, Umgebungsmodellierung, Reward Design).
• Data Science & Engineering: Sicheres Arbeiten mit Datenaufbereitung, Feature Engineering und Validierungspipelines.
• Netzwerk-Grundlagen: Verständnis für Netzwerkkonzepte in Container-Umgebungen.
• Versionskontrolle: Sichere Anwendung von Git (Branching Strategies, Code Reviews).
• Sprachen: Fließendes Deutsch und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Wünschenswerte Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung mit ML-Pipelines und MLOps-Tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, …)
• Kenntnisse in CI/CD-Pipelines
• Grundkenntnisse in Cybersecurity für AI-Systeme
• Erfahrung mit Modell-Evaluierungsframeworks und Experiment-Tracking
• Wissenschaftliches Arbeiten bzw. Publikationen im Bereich ML/RL von Vorteil
• Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Deine Vorteile

• Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen
• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
• Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und tolle internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
• Sonderleistungen: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Autoleasing, Sonderkonditionen bei Versicherungen, Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen, Ferienbetreuung für Schüler
• Einrichtungen vor Ort: Kindergartenkooperation, Arzt für Check-Ups und andere gesundheitsbezogene Leistungen, Kantine und Cafeteria, Fitnesscenter
• Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Jobsharing, Teilzeitmodelle, flexible Arbeitszeiten, individuelle Auszeit)
• Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem jede Stimme gehört wird

Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Grund zur Sorge! Airbus unterstützt deine persönliche Entwicklung mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungslösungen.

jobs.title: STAGE 2027 - Stage en gestion de projet IA  & Innovation Qualité  (H/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?

Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.

Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium.

Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Stage en gestion de Projet IA & Innovation Qualité(H/F) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

Cette mission débutera en janvier 2027 (date sujette à flexibilité) pour une durée de 6 mois.

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 30 personnes au sein du département  « Qualité A350 Equipement & Test » en charge de la Qualité Produit de l'unité de production A350 Equipement.

Encadré par votre tuteur, vous interviendrez sur les activités suivantes :

• Stratégie et feuille de route IA : Définir et déployer la roadmap métier d'intégration de l'IA, explorer les opportunités de digitalisation et co-animer le « Tech Bar Qualité IA ».
• Pilotage de Proofs of Concept (PoC) : Déployer des preuves de concept ciblées par métier pour valider l'efficacité des solutions et favoriser leur adoption opérationnelle.
• Excellence opérationnelle par la data : Optimiser la surveillance qualité grâce à la clusterisation des non-conformités (NC) et renforcer le ciblage des risques lors des mini-audits.
• Conformité et amélioration continue : Garantir l'alignement des évolutions liées à l'IA avec les référentiels qualité et collaborer avec la production et l'ingénierie de fabrication pour enrichir le système de management de la qualité (SMQ).
• Acculturation et tutorat innovant : Accompagner la montée en compétences de l'équipe qualité sur les outils et usages de l'IA via un format de formation ludique.

Durant votre stage, vous développerez les compétences suivantes en lien avec votre formation :

• Déploiement de solutions Data/IA en milieu industriel : traduction d'un besoin métier complexe en solutions digitales (algorithmes, data analytics).
• Pilotage de projets Innovation & IA : de la construction d'une roadmap stratégique au déploiement de preuves de concept concrets sur le terrain.
• Conduite du changement et Leadership : vulgarisation technique, animation d'ateliers (Tech Bar) et transfert de compétences pour embarquer les équipes.
• Management de la Qualité & Excellence Opérationnelle : maîtrise des référentiels aéronautiques et utilisation de l'analyse de données pour optimiser la résolution de problèmes (clusterisation des non-conformités).

Parlons de VOUS !

Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 (ou équivalent) dans le domaine de l'Intelligence Artificielle, de la Data Science, de l'Informatique  ou une discipline apparentée.

Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :

• Vous êtes passionné par les nouvelles technologies et l'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle (IA).
• Vous avez des notions de conduite du changement.
• Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse face à des situations complexes et faites preuve d'esprit de synthèse.
• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation

Langues

• Anglais : courant
• Français : courant

Vous pourrez être amené(e) à vous déplacer avec votre tuteur.

Parlons de NOUS !

Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Participer à des projets ambitieux, à la pointe de la technologie, visant à construire l’avion de demain tout en répondant aux défis environnementaux,
• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

Notre processus de sélection

Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous serez invité à réaliser un entretien vidéo afin de vous présenter.

Après évaluation, les candidats retenus seront contactés pour un entretien avec le manager ou le tuteur qui procédera alors à la sélection finale.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a Product Manager for Quality Digital Solutions has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join the Quality Digital Team, an international, multicultural, and cross-functional group spread across Spain and Germany. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Services, the department is responsible for defining, developing, and rolling out innovative digital solutions (including AI-driven tools) to address quality processes and operational pain points across major aerospace programs.

In this role, you will lead individual digital projects while collaborating on broader transverse initiatives, acting as the Integrated Project Team (IPT) lead for Quality.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:

• Define and manage project roadmaps, budgets, and requirements, gathering business needs and user stories alongside key users and business architects to ensure alignment with Quality digital strategy and program schedules.
• Lead vendor assessments and solution exploration, conducting fit/gap workshops to evaluate out-of-the-box software versus custom developments with digital partners.
• Oversee the end-to-end delivery and integration of digital solutions across Design, Production, and Programs, ensuring strict compliance with data governance guidelines.
• Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and deployment, supporting the creation of operational guides, training documentation, and IT support workflows (such as MyITSM).
• Drive process standardization and continuous improvement, triggering updates to Business Management System (BMS) methods in coordination with process owners.
• Act as a key cross-functional liaison, challenging traditional ways of working to add business value and representing Quality within international project teams.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:

• Education: Degree in Engineering (Aeronautical, Industrial, or related) or Information Technology (IT).
• Experience: 5 to 7 years of proven experience in Industrial/Engineering, Manufacturing, or Digital environments, with a strong background in project/product management.
• Skills: Technical knowledge: Strong project management capabilities, familiarity with Agile, SAFe, or Waterfall methodologies, and solid understanding of digital product lifecycles.Soft skills:Customer-centric, proactive, and innovative mindset.High adaptability to navigate uncertainty, challenge the status quo, and collaborate effectively in cross-functional, international teams.
• Languages: Fluent level in English and Spanish (both written and spoken).
• Travel: Willingness to travel occasionally (approx. 2–3 times per quarter to sites such as Toulouse, Seville, or Manching).
• Valuable / Nice to have:Background: Previous experience in Quality Management.Sector: Aerospace sector will be desired, although automotive sector is considered.Languages: Knowledge of German will be highly valued.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Introduction: An opportunity for a Systems Integration Engineer – Eurodrone has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

Brief description of the department’s mission: The selected candidate will join the Systems Integration Team within Engineering / Design Office, working on the Eurodrone Programme, specifically on the Audio/Voice Communication System.

The team is responsible for the end-to-end system design and integration activities throughout the complete product development lifecycle. The jobholder will work in an international and multidisciplinary environment, interacting with different engineering disciplines, suppliers, customers and programme stakeholders.

The successful candidate will contribute to the complete systems engineering V-cycle, from feasibility studies, requirements capture and system definition to integration, verification, validation, qualification and final certification of the product.

The position also involves close coordination with suppliers and transversal areas such as Production, Services, Procurement and Technical Publications, as well as support to integration and testing activities when required.

RESPONSIBILITIES: The selected person will take the following main activities as System Design Engineer for Audio-Communication Department,

• Be responsible of ASECS integration activities (Airborne Secutity System) for EURODRONE
• Support feasibility studies for new products/user needs, etc.
• Elaborate and validate equipment specifications based on RBE (Requirement Based Engineering) or MBSE (Model Based System Engineering).
• Allocate these requirements to the Communication & Avionics System.
• Elaborate engineering design documentation.
• Prepare Test Requirement for Lab, Ground and Flight.
• Release test analysis & correlation reports after test completion.
• Integration, validation, and verification of systems.
• Support the whole design process including design review meetings (internal, supplier and customer milestones).
• Certification and Qualification process.
• Support Technical Publications (AFM, FCOM, etc.).
• Support transversal areas such as Services, Production, Procurement, etc.
• Be at the state of the art of international regulations: ICAO, FAA, EASA, EUROCONTROL, etc.
• Provide technical support across the product lifecycle, collaborating with areas such as Production, Services, Procurement and Technical Publications (AFM, FCOM, etc.), as well as supporting integration and testing activities at the Final Assembly Line (FAL) when required.
• Occasional business travel may be required, mainly within Spain and Europe (up to approximately 10%).

SKILLS: Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:

• Telecommunications/Aeronautical Engineering Master Degree,
• More than 5 years of experience in systems engineering/development for military aircraft in Aeronautical sector. (Airborne Security System, Audio & COMSEC communication as a plus),
• Deep Knowledge on; System Engineering & Integration, SW specification, Verification & Validation, Airworthiness and Audio Technology domain,
• More than 3 years system knowledge: Audio and Airborne Security Systems and full chain Communication systems in different Aircrafts (Military, Combat),
• Experience in Modification Processes and Certification,
• Systems requirement definition using DOORS and CAMEO,
• Experience as CVE, even in a different discipline,
• Use of Agile Methodology (SCRUM, Jira, Confluence, DeMAT) and Plateau attendance way of working experience,
• Strong English skills, both verbal and written.
• MBSE using tools as CAMEO, ICDMS, Matlab/Simulink and Stakeflow,
• Knowledge of AIRBUS D&S Design Procedures for EURODRONE Program and others,
• Digitalization skills for System design activities,
• Problem solving and decision making,
• Open minded and active to new challenges,
• Assertiveness.

• Lead Audio/Voice Communication System design and integration activities for Eurodrone, supporting feasibility studies for new products and user needs, capturing high-level requirements and allocating them to the Communication & Avionics System.
• Elaborate and validate system and equipment specifications following Requirement Based Engineering (RBE) and/or Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies, ensuring requirements traceability throughout the complete engineering V-cycle and producing the associated engineering design documentation.
• Manage technical interfaces and coordinate with suppliers and customers, supporting the complete design process and participating in internal, supplier and customer design reviews and programme milestones.
• Define and support system integration, verification and validation activities, preparing test requirements for laboratory, ground and flight testing, and releasing test analysis and correlation reports after test completion.
• Support qualification, airworthiness and certification activities, including modification processes and the preparation of the required technical evidence, while ensuring compliance with applicable international regulations and standards from organizations such as ICAO, FAA, EASA and EUROCONTROL.
• Provide technical support across the product lifecycle, collaborating with areas such as Production, Services, Procurement and Technical Publications (AFM, FCOM, etc.), as well as supporting integration and testing activities at the Final Assembly Line (FAL) when required.

jobs.title: Quality Director (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott’s Vascular Division (AVD) is looking to recruit an

Quality Director (m/f/d)

Based in San José, Costa Rica

PRIMARY JOB FUNCTION

Responsible for directing quality functional activities at a site or divisional focus. Primary functional areas may include but not limited to: quality control and engineering. microbiology, calibration, records management, documentation change and control, supplier controls, and compliance. This individual develops and executes the required strategies and plans to improve product and process quality to deliver planned business results and assure compliance with Abbott Quality System, standards, and country specific regulations where product is distributed.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBLITIES

• Provide overall Quality functional leadership including Management Representative to all external entities interacting with the Costa Rica site for the business unit.
• Direct responsibility for Costa-Rica based Product and Process Quality Managers and their teams.
• Provide Quality functional leadership in support of the objectives of sites' General Management.
• Ensure that the Quality Function supports both compliance (priority) and business objectives.
• Provide expert-level guidance and direction of the Quality Function.
• Define Quality Objectives and oversight processes (management review, interna! auditing, Risk Indicator Review) for sites.
• Develop Quality Plans to define strategy and approach to personnel, budget, and location to achieve Quality Objectives.
• Aggressively identify opportunities to proactively assure compliance to all applicable internal, domestic and international quality regulations, US 21 CFR 820 (QSR), ISO 13485, etc.
• Aggressively identify and manage activities related to adding value to the organization through risk reduction, cost improvement, and budgetary responsibility.
• Represent the Quality Function In the Product Transfer Management process and assist in the development and execution of product transfers.
• Identify Quality Initiatives and lead cross-functional teams to complete them.
• Provide diligent and fact-based communication to Executive Management team, peers, and team.
• Assess resource needs to assure that the accurate level of competent quality support ls provided when needed.
• Define and oversee compliance with the Overall Quality function budget.
• Oversee the locally based CAPA, Non-conformance, Qualification and Validation, Real-time data management portions of the Quality System.
• Champion post-production risk management activities to include complaint investigation, risk analysis, and action deployment to resolve any issues.
• Provide active management and development of the Quality staff.
• Be an effective member of the site and division cross-functional Director organization to foster continuous quality compliance, cost, and predictive measures improvements.
• Maintain effective Quality Metrics and define and execute activities to resolve decreases in performance.
• Be a champion of Quality, Six Sigma, Lean and disciplined problem-solving throughout the organization.
• Act as key contact for regulatory inspections of the site.

PROFILE REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or Technical Field or Business Administration; Master's degree preferred.
• Quality or Lean Certifications (i.e. Six Sigma Belt, ASQ CQE/CRE/CQM) preferred.
• Lead Auditor/Auditor Certification preferred.

Experience & Skills

• 15+ years of experience with at least 7+ years in a Manager role.
• Class IIa or IIb or III medical device experience.
• Demonstrated extensive experience with Domestic and international regulatory requirements and regulating bodies required.
• Demonstrated organizational influence to include, but not limited to compliance excellence, organizational improvement, product-related risk mitigation, and/or manufacturing cost reduction.
• Solid knowledge of and experience working with international quality regulations, including US 21 CFR 820 (QSR) and ISO 13485.
• Demonstrated and impactful experience with product and process qualification and validation, process improvement, lean and six sigma methodologies, process control and monitoring (SPC).
• Demonstrated results in non-conformance management and reduction, value improvement, risk reduction, and cost containment.
• Ability to travel to support domestic and international manufacturing sites (up to 25%).
• Language Proficiency: Fully Bilingual in English and Spanish required

Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Senior Engineer Facilities, this position is on-site at our Vascular manufacturing facility in Barceloneta, Puerto Rico.

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
• Health Insurance (starting on Day 1 of employment), Savings Plan (401K) with company match, Life insurance for you and your spouse/children, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Education Assistance, Employee Assistance Program, Vacation, Sick, Personal Days.
• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
• A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity ​

This position will provide support to our Medical Devices, Vascular manufacturing facility in Barceloneta, Puerto Rico. Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks and Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive, and cost-effective products for treatment of vascular disease.

This role will work under the direct supervision of the Lead Facilities Engineer is directly responsible for the site infrastructure to be operational at all times (this includes: the utilities and equipment, including the preventive maintenance of all equipment under the building and support equipment to operations).  In addition, the Sr. Facilities Engineer will manage and support all projects related to clean room and manufacturing areas on projects execution/turn-key for the completed Barceloneta site.  Performs a variety of Facilities Infrastructure Engineering scope related assignments and routine tasks by developing and implementing processing methods, controls and metrics to deliver full quality system compliance standards, best cost-effective alternatives and optimal customer service satisfaction based on this scope.  Provide direction and direct supervision to Facilities Technician.  Have full accountability for all quality issues (CAPA's, NCMR's, ECAR's) related to the complete Facilities scope Equipment and Infrastructure.  Also will be responsible for developing and administrate the budget under the department of Facilities.

What You’ll Do

• Applies fundamental building infrastructure related engineering concepts, practices and procedures to accomplish assigned and routine tasks as required so that the site utilities and facilities equipment infrastructure can perform uninterrupted.
• Direct interface with our external and internal clients on the scope of management, execution and turnkey of infrastructure scope related projects, equipment maintenance and proper utilities equipment technical operation for full compliance of the facilities Infrastructure scope with the complete Abbott businesses and their necessities and expectations.
• Use engineering and other continuous improvement methodologies so the complete site infrastructure, utilities and facilities equipment infrastructure (maintenance and technical support/operation) can perform uninterrupted, at the best cost possible and in full compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Use engineering and other continuous improvement methodologies so all site Infrastructure related scope projects can be performed, from conceptual to validation/turn-key, at the best cost possible, on a timely basis and in full compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Report the results by means of metrics as established by our clients, management and business expectations.
• Ensure all predictive and preventive maintenance activities are completed by the assigned due date and ensure continuous revision of these activities utilizing continuous improvement methodologies to ensure equipment, infrastructure and systems can operate uninterruptible during the entire lifespan.
• Participates as a liaison between outside contractors, government and regulatory agencies and the engineering department facilities scope.
• Ensure compliance with all Abbott procedures and all applicable regulatory agency requirements.
• Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree, Engineering (preferably in Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering).
• Minimum 8 years in the infrastructure administration scope in a regulated industry (e.g. Pharmaceutical, Electronics or Medical Device).
• Solid experience in the Infrastructure Project Management scope in all disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, Architectural, Structural, and Security).
• Solid Experience in the Infrastructure Equipment and Systems Maintenance, Operation and Troubleshooting under the scope of Utilities and Facilities Engineering (Compressed Air, Power (Primary and Distribution), Process and City Water, Vacuum, Air Conditioning Systems, Chilled Water, Fire Protection).
• Sound knowledge OSHA Standard, EPA, EQB, GMP’s.
• Fully bilingual in both written and verbal communication.
• Knowledge in the following software: Windows, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, AutoCAD, MP2 and Microsoft Project.
• Demonstrate strong leadership, supervisory, decision making and project management skills. (Influencing skills).

EIT or P.E. and required to be a member of the College of Engineers & Surveyors of Puerto Rico desirable.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Starte deine Zukunft bei Airbus Friedrichshafen!

Bist du neugierig auf Technik und möchtest die Welt von morgen mitgestalten? Dann ist eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium bei Airbus genau das Richtige für dich!

Bei uns hast du die Gelegenheit Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen zu studieren – eine spannende Kombination, die dir ermöglicht, sowohl technische als auch betriebswirtschaftliche Kompetenzen in Einklang zu bringen.

Damit kannst du in vielen Bereichen unseres Unternehmens tätig sein, in denen sowohl kaufmännisches als auch technisches Denken gefragt sind. Du planst, organisierst, gestaltest und realisierst Arbeits- und Geschäftsprozesse mit dem Ziel, sie technisch und wirtschaftlich optimal und effizient zu gestalten.

Wenn du dich im Studienschwerpunkt Elektrotechnik spezialisierst, bereitest du dich auf zukünftige Einsätze in Bereichen wie Raumfahrt oder Verteidigung vor, wo Elektronik und Informationstechnik eine zentrale Rolle spielen.

Dein Standort: Airbus Friedrichshafen (Immenstaad) – Innovation trifft Lebensqualität

Am Airbus-Standort Friedrichshafen gestaltest du die Technologien von morgen – mit Blick auf den Bodensee. Während du mittags in unserer Kantine entspannst, genießt du das Alpenpanorama. Nach der Arbeit bieten dir unsere vielfältigen Betriebssportgruppen den perfekten Ausgleich – ob beim Joggen, Segeln oder Skifahren. Der Campus der Dualen Hochschule ist mit dem Fahrrad in nur 15–20 Minuten erreichbar.

Friedrichshafen ist das Zentrum für bahnbrechende Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Satelliten, Sonden und Instrumente für Erdbeobachtung, Navigation, Meteorologie und Weltraumforschung. Darüber hinaus sind wir führend in der Entwicklung von Aufklärungs- und Überwachungssystemen, Avioniklösungen, unbemannten Flugsystemen, Hinderniswarnsystemen, Gefechtsführungs- und Kommunikationssystemen sowie mobilen Krankenhäusern und Sensorik für die Luft- und Raumaufklärung.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

In unseren modernen Ausbildungslaboren erhältst du eine fundierte und vielseitige fachliche Grundlage, die du direkt in den jeweiligen Fachbereichen praxisnah vertiefen kannst. Ergänzt wird deine Ausbildung durch ein individuell gestaltetes Studium mit Kompetenz- und Projekttagen, in denen du gezielt Schlüsselqualifikationen aufbaust. Dank kleiner Teams und persönlicher Betreuung kannst du dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und deine individuellen Stärken optimal entfalten.

Deine Vorteile auf einen Blick

• Attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung inkl. tariflicher Sonderzahlungen (Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld)
• Übernahme der Studiengebühren sowie weitere finanzielle Unterstützung (z. B. Wohngeldzuschuss, Busfahrkarte, Kantinenzuschuss)
• Umfangreiche Zusatzleistungen wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung, Aktienprogramm
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten & optional mobiles Lernen
• Fachliche & persönliche Weiterbildungen inkl. sozialpädagogischer Seminare
• Optionale Auslandsaufenthalte (z. B. in Frankreich, Spanien, Irland)

Das bringst du mit

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife (Abitur) oder Fachhochschulreife
• Ausgeprägtes Interesse an naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern (besonders Physik und Mathematik)
• Technisches Verständnis und sicherer Umgang mit Computern und moderner Software

Dein Studium an der DHBW

• Studienort: DHBW Ravensburg, Campus Friedrichshafen
• Studiendauer: 6 Semester (3 Jahre)
• Beginn: Im September mit dem Dualen Orientierungsstudium (DuO). Ab Oktober startet das reguläre duale Studium.

So bewirbst du dich

Bitte lade dein Anschreiben, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf sowie deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse direkt in unserem Bewerbungsportal hoch.

Du hast noch Fragen? Unser Ausbildungsteam hilft dir gerne weiter. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain?

AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain - #Discover I 2027/2028 - Starting date March 2027 until February 2028.

We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating.

The selection process will be during October 2026 until January 2027.

What does this internship consists in?

Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.

You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background.

The start of the internship will be in early October 2026, and will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full-time experience (40h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant.

Role Overview

Support the Production and Operations team in tracking daily execution while driving the transition from manual, paper-based records to streamlined digital workflows for ongoing projects and work-in-progress (WIP).

Key Responsibilities (Tasks to Perform)

• WIP Data Collection & Digitization: Gather, standardize, and digitize real-time data on work-in-progress—including milestone completion, material consumption, labor hours, and quality checks.
• Production Tracking & Reporting: Assist in updating daily and weekly production schedules, tracking deliverables against target timelines, and flagging bottlenecks or deviations.
• Process Automation & AI Workflows: Leverage AI tools to extract data from field/floor reports, summarize operational logs, clean datasets, and automate repetitive administrative tasks.
• Dashboard Maintenance: Build and update visual KPI dashboards to give stakeholders clear visibility into WIP status, resource allocation, and production efficiency.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as a bridge between on-site/shop-floor teams and back-office departments (Planning, Procurement, Cost Control) to ensure accurate data flow.

What You Will Learn (Knowledge to Acquire)

• End-to-End Production Management: Hands-on understanding of how production planning, execution, cost control, and WIP valuation operate in a real-world environment.
• Operational Digital Transformation: Practical experience designing and implementing digital data-capture workflows that replace legacy tracking methods.
• Applied AI in Operations: How to deploy generative AI and automation tools safely and effectively to solve operational and data-structuring challenges.
• KPI Analysis & Decision Support: How raw operational metrics (lead times, yield, progress rates, cost variances) translate into actionable management insights.
• Cross-Departmental Workflows: Exposure to ERP systems, supply chain coordination, and quality assurance standards.

Tools & Technologies

• Spreadsheets & Data Management: Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (advanced formulas, PivotTables, data validation, and basic scripting/macros).
• Business Intelligence & Visualization: Power BI, Looker Studio, or Tableau for real-time WIP and production dashboards.
• AI & Productivity Assistants: Generative AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot) for document parsing, report drafting, formula generation, and workflow optimization.
• Digitization & Low-Code Tools: Digital forms, OCR/scanning tools, and workflow automation platforms (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate, AppSheet, or Notion/SharePoint).
• Enterprise & Project Software: ERP production modules (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Odoo, or industry-specific ERP) and project tracking tools (MS Project, Asana, or Jira).

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Civil/Construction Engineering, Operations Management, Business Analytics, or a related technical field.
• AI Proficiency (Must-Have): Practical fluency with AI tools—including prompt engineering, structuring unstructured text/images into clean tables, troubleshooting formulas/scripts, and verifying AI outputs for accuracy.
• Analytical & Data Mindset: Strong comfort working with numbers, spotting data inconsistencies, and organizing messy information into clear, structured formats.
• Digital Agility: Quick learner capable of picking up new software, mobile data-capture apps, and cloud collaboration platforms with minimal ramp-up time.
• Proactive Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with both technical/field personnel and management to gather accurate updates without disrupting daily operations.
• Languages: Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish (written and spoken).

jobs.title: IVV Systems Engineer (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

For Airbus Defence & Space in Taufkirchen, we are looking for an

IVV Systems Engineer (d/f/m)

to join the Systems Engineering MILSATCOM team. The department is developing satellite communication systems for military customers.

As an IVV System Engineer (d/f/m), you will work on the IVV & test concept of SBMD, Satellite Communication Systems and the associated Ground- & User Segments, as well as their extensions and modifications. You will be responsible for the IVV and test concept during the implementation phase as well as to be applied after start of routine operations.

In the frame of the IVV activities, you will follow the development and acceptance phase from the Request for Proposal (RFP) up to the final acceptance of the ground infrastructure. After acceptance, you will accompany the in-orbit testing of the satellites and the commissioning of the ground- and space segment, i.e. the overall satellite communication system, until it goes live in operations. During the operational phase, you are the technical IVV point-of-contact for any anomalies that might occur and support the technical resolution of the issues.

This job combines knowledge of several disciplines with the ability to think outside the box.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

• Attractive salary and special payments;
• 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions;
• Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects, group wide development prospects;
• Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies;
• On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
• Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout);
• Working in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• Requirements engineering with DOORS in the area of IVV for satellite communication systems, theirground segments and lower levels;
• Conduct and follow-up conceptual IVV activities in the area of satellite communication systems engineering, including but not limited to requirement, interface, user data and management data flow within the ground segment as well as TM/TC interfaces;
• Establishment of IVV requirement for ground segment items, e.g. ground stations, mission operation center, spacecraft control center, payload control center, networks incl. IT infrastructure as well as data centers;
• Elaboration of system trade-offs in the area of ground segment IVV engineering and support the overall system architecture IVV definition;
• Elaboration of verification and validation concept at ground system level and support of relevant testing;
• Collaborate to and review of the operations concept as well as preparation of operational requirements for the ground segment;
• Provide technical IVV support to the project managers on planning, contractual changes and risk & opportunities identification.

Desired skills and qualifications

• Diploma/Master degree in Telecommunications, Electronics or other related Engineering disciplines;
• Profound knowledge of ground segment IVV engineering, i.e. technical interface, data flow (for user and management data) as well as TM/TC engineering (secure and unsecured)
• Strong knowledge of satellite communication engineering including data flows within the ground segment and between ground and space segment
• Strong experience in software based systems, networks and IT infrastructure
• Experience in Ground Station and Satellite Control Center (SCC) IVV engineering;
• Experience in design, development, integration, verification, and operations of Satellite Communicaton Systems and associated processes and operational procedures
• Business fluency in English and German.

This position will require a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

This Job Request will be allocated to the projected Joint-Venture scope towards a leading European player in space.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Program Description

Airbus Defence & Space is working on a new satellite based communication system. The constellation of satellites will offer connectivity to the customer, allowing connecting elements through satellite RF and optical links.

In order to actively monitor and control the Mission configuration for the communication chain a set of new tools is under development at Airbus DS.

Such tools will allow actively managing the overall communication chain, including Space and Ground assets, in order to reach the needed coverage and performances.

Task Description:

As a AI Software & Systems Engineer, you are contributing to the design, development, integration and validation of the AI Applications which will allow the Mission and Ground Stations Management by making use of AI technologies. You will be in charge of contributing to the definition of the Software requirements as well as performing general Software Design, Development and IVV tasks.

As a cross-department figure you will also be responsible to ensure the transversal know-how and usage of AI Applications for the SATCOM ongoing projects between several System and Software Teams.

Your range of tasks will cover the entire System and Software Development lifecycle, from Requirements definition, System and Software Design and IVV. Your activities will be performed in close cooperation with the System Engineers, the SW Architect, the SW developers and the sub-contractors.

The holder of this position will be located at Ottobrunn and reports to the Team Lead.

Your tasks:

• Analyse customer requirements and contribute to the definition of the adequate internal System, subsystem and Software requirements.
• Coordinate the cross-department alignment on the use and implementation of AI products in the Business.
• Support the definition of the Software Architecture, ensuring robustness and compatibility with already existing software modules and AI engines, where needed.
• Develop AI-empowered solutions to enable smooth Mission and Ground Station Management, making use of Airbus internal / external AI services

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Aerospace or other related Engineering

jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer, DCC Communities
jobs.description:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.
- Operate independently with limited direct management
- Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
- Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
- Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
- Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
- Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows
- Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience
- Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.
- Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and providing mentorship in developing solutions.

Physical Requirements:
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
- Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work at depths, such as under raised floors

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- 4+ years of data center experience including industrial electrical and mechanical systems
- 4+ years of administrative experience including Microsoft Office products
- Experience leading technical teams through daily operations, maintenance evolutions, and complex troubleshooting

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in construction or project management
- Associates or higher in engineering field or mechanical or electrical trades
- PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent certifications
- Training-lead informal training
- Must be able to work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment.

You'll design and deliver services that process high-volume device telemetry, evaluate network linkages in real time, and provide operators with clear, actionable insights across thousands of sites worldwide.

We're an agile development team within Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS), part of Amazon Robotics, assisting fulfillment centers, delivery stations, and sortation centers globally. Our monitoring product gives operators a single, reliable view of device and network health—from live infrastructure telemetry to reliance-aware alarming that points to root causes instead of overwhelming teams with duplicate alerts. You'll have the opportunity to apply modern AI technologies, from AI-assisted incident detection to generative AI tooling that accelerates how we build and operate our network.

You might start your day reviewing a design for integrating metrics from a new device type being onboarded across OIS sites worldwide, then inspect runtime metrics to tune collection thresholds and data quality before shipping a monitoring improvement operators experience immediately. You'll partner with teammates on design reviews, participate in quick feedback loops, and own features end-to-end — working alongside infrastructure teams to deliver the monitoring experience needed to reduce building downtime and assistance. Throughout the day, you'll balance designing scalable monitoring solutions with hands-on implementation, working across back-end services and data pipelines while assisting each other's growth and bringing your authentic perspective to the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate scalable monitoring infrastructure on AWS that ingests and processes high-volume device telemetry and network topology data
- Own systems end-to-end across monitoring tooling and data pipelines, from build through deployment, operation, and ongoing maintenance
- Partner with infrastructure and operations stakeholders to grasp monitoring gaps and translate them into reliable, automated solutions that reduce manual intervention
- Apply AI/ML and generative AI techniques to improve detection quality, reduce alarm noise, and streamline operational workflows
- Raise the bar on system reliability, operational excellence, and automation through thoughtful design, thorough testing, and continuous improvement

A day in the life
You might start by reviewing a design for integrating metrics from a new device type being onboarded across all Robotics buildings worldwide, then inspect runtime metrics to tune metric collection and quality before shipping a service improvement our operators experience immediately. Our team values partnership, quick feedback loops, and clear ownership.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that assist you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We're a close-knit, agile team that owns infrastructure monitoring for OIS within Amazon Robotics and ships to a worldwide operational fleet. We care deeply about the craft of software and foster each other's growth. Our vision centers on delivering reliable, intelligent monitoring that helps operators grasp their infrastructure at scale. You'll work with product and operations stakeholders to turn complex monitoring challenges into simple, elegant solutions. We're excited to welcome someone who align with our standards for well-architected software and collective problem-solving.

- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

jobs.title: Data Center Technician, DCC Communities
jobs.description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.ures.

Key job responsibilities
-  Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members
Physical requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs. in scheduled maintenance and change management activities

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Fuse
jobs.description:
Are you interested in using data to drive the next phase of Amazon’s growth?

Amazon Fuse (https://www.amazonfuse.com/) helps subscription-based businesses better serve their customers by offering the selection, convenience and value customers have come to know and love from Amazon, including millions of Prime products and our full catalog of Prime Video.

The Fuse Data & Analytics (D&A) team is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to influence Fuse's direction using data insights. The ideal candidate is data-curious and possesses a strong analytical mindset. They excel at communicating with stakeholders and turning ambiguity and conjecture into actionable recommendations. They find opportunities where data will lead to better outcomes and mobilize the D&A team to meet them.

In this role, you will work with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Finance and Marketing Managers, as well as other data experts to build new decision models that optimize customer experience. We are seeking someone who can thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy work environment where we add value incrementally and frequently. We value highly technical people who know their subject matter deeply and are willing to learn new areas. We look for individuals who think like owners to develop themselves, their colleagues, and their team.

Key job responsibilities
- Measure and report on the customer lifecycle funnel to improve customer targeting and signup experience.
- Define and instrument new metrics in conjunction with Product Management.
- Be customer-obsessed on behalf of our reporting customers. Set and enforce high reporting standards across the team.
- Partner with Program Management to engage disparate stakeholder groups, distill ambiguous requests into estimates and crisp deliverables, and deliver effectively to schedules.

A day in the life
Every day you learn more about the subscription business and its metrics: signups, activation, engagement, and churn. You look in the data for business problems and opportunities, and you bring them to the teams that can act. You send a code review for a new dashboard dataset, and it deploys through our CI/CD pipeline. You use AI tools to draft queries, tests, and documentation. Your stakeholders are the Product, Finance, Marketing, and Business Development teams. You work next to Data Engineers and other BI Engineers.

About the team
Fuse Data & Analytics (D&A) is a team of Data Engineers and Business Intelligence Engineers in Seattle. We own the data lake, the metrics, and the reporting for Amazon Fuse, a subscription business that works with partner companies worldwide. We treat analytics as software: we plan in sprints, review each other's code, and deploy through CI/CD. We build our own AI agents to remove repeat work, and BI Engineers contribute to them. We write our findings down, share on-call for data quality, and help each other learn.

Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
- Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
- Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

jobs.title: Sales Operations & Business Analyst
jobs.description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Sales Operations & Business Analyst - UKI

Location: Reading (3 days per week onsite)

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and proactive Sales Operations & Business Analyst to support the growth of our UKI business.

This role will play a key part in delivering business insights, commercial reporting, sales analytics, and operational support that help drive informed decision-making across the organization. Working closely with Commercial, Finance, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners, you will transform complex data into meaningful insights and help optimize business performance.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, identifying trends, improving processes, and influencing commercial decisions.

Core Responsibilities

Sales Operations & Business Analytics

• Produce and maintain sales KPI reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
• Analyse sales, customer, and market data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.
• Utilise IQVIA and other external data sources to generate actionable business insights.
• Monitor sales performance across distributors and customers within the UKI market.
• Support forecasting, business planning, and performance tracking activities.
• Prepare regular business reviews, reports, and presentations for stakeholders.

Commercial Operations

• Support reporting reconciliation activities with distributors, wholesalers, and commercial partners.
• Manage rebate administration and claims processing.
• Review and investigate pricing discrepancies and off-contract claims.
• Ensure accuracy and consistency across commercial reporting and data sources.
• Support the Commercial Manager with analysis and reporting aligned to business priorities.

Development Opportunities

As you develop in the role, you will have opportunities to gain experience in:

• Wholesaler and distributor management.
• Internal supply chain collaboration and stock management.
• Tender and contract support.
• Commercial programs and grant-funded initiatives.
• Customer and product support activities.
• Process improvement and business transformation projects.

What You'll Bring

• Degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, Marketing, or equivalent experience.
• Experience in sales operations, business analytics, commercial operations, or a similar role.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large datasets.
• Experience with Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI experience is advantageous.
• Experience using IQVIA or similar external data sources is desirable.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to turn data into clear business insights.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to play a visible role within the UKI commercial organization, helping shape business decisions through data, insights, and analytics while gaining exposure to broader commercial and operational activities. You will work with a collaborative team and have the opportunity to develop your skills across multiple areas of the business.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Clinical Science - Neuroscience
jobs.description:

Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

The Senior Manager, Global Clinical Scientist provides scientific expertise necessary to design and deliver clinical studies and programs

• Will be responsible for design and execution of assigned clinical trial activities and work closely with clinical team members within the assigned project to execute activities associated with the conduct
• May serve as Clinical Trial Lead for one or more trials
• May lead or support trial level activities for one or more trials with the necessary supervision
• May co-lead study team meetings in partnership with GDO protocol manager and collaborate with cross-functional study team members

Duties and Resonsibilities

• Collaborate and liaise with external partners (e.g., KOLs)
• Seek out and enact best practices with instruction
• Provide regular and timely updates to manager/management as requested
• Develop Protocol and ICF documents / amendments and present these to governance committee and development team meetings as required
• Conduct literature review
• Submit clinical documents to TMF
• Develop site and CRA training materials and present these at SIVs and Investigator meetings
• Review clinical narratives
• Monitor clinical data for specific trends
• Develop Data Review Plan in collaboration with Data Management
• Ensure CRF design adequately supports data collection in alignment with the protocol in collaboration with Data Management/Programming
• Submit clinical contributions to clinical study reports (CSRs) and clinical portions of Regulatory Documents (e.g., IB, DSUR, PSUR, Orphan Annual Reports, HA, EC, IRB responses and contribute to regulatory submission.)

Requirements

• Degree in Life Sciences (MD, PhD, Pharm D, MS, RN or other scientific field preferred).
• Basic knowledge of GCP/ICH, drug development process, study design, statistics, clinical operations
• Ability to understand assigned protocol(s) and their requirements
• Basic knowledge skills to support program-specific data review and trend identification
• Intermediate medical writing skills and medical terminology
• Basic planning/project management skills (develop short range plans that are realistic and effective)
• Detail-oriented with commitment to quality• Basic knowledge of disease area, compound, current clinical landscape• Basic knowledge of the establishment and operation of data monitoring committees,dose review teams, and independent response adjudication committees

• Domestic and International travel may be required.

Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Job Description

Your Role at Baxter

This is where my hands make life-sustaining products

You are driven by the knowledge that the products you help make saves and sustain lives. You can move quickly, address questions, and encourage teammates, all while getting quality products out on time. You are calm, positive, and a key part of a fast-paced environment that emphasizes camaraderie and teamwork. As a Material Handler, Packing, you are happiest when you are moving, and we will not disappoint!

Baxter is known for its speed and high-quality product. Our manufacturing operations are around-the-clock to meet the needs of our customers. Our high-caliber talent works through the challenges at hand while pushing toward meeting client order needs. Different shift assignments allow for flexibility and safety.

In this role you are responsible for performance of tasks related to drug formulation, weighing raw materials, cleaning, mixing sophisticated tanks and equipment, distilled water sanitization, filter integrity testing, and documentation. Working in a cleanroom is essential to delivering life-saving therapies. Watch this video to understand the garbing process (your required attire on the job) and what it means for patient safety.

Your team

Baxter is focused on saving and sustaining lives by manufacturing high-quality products. We strive to create quality products for our customers each day.

Delivering life-saving products is about getting them right, and attention to detail is how we make sure we meet that challenge. We are a team that supports each other throughout each shift. Working together in a supportive and open culture makes our processes evolve for the better and engages our workforce.

You'll be offered extensive training, and the tight-knit working environment within the Manufacturing team means employees get additional training from their direct manager and peers when needed.

What we offer from Day One:

• Shift flexibility to trade shifts and leverage overtime opportunities
• Medical, Dental and Vision coverage
• 160 hours of Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
• 401K match
• Employee Stock Purchase Program
• Paid Parental Leave
• Tuition Reimbursement

What You'll Be Doing

The Material Handler, Packing contributes to our mission of saving and sustaining lives by transporting, visually inspecting, and packing IV therapies, premixed drugs, renal therapies and other sterile solutions into cartons for distribution.

Duties performed on a rotational basis:

• Transport sterilized bags using a powered industrial truck from the cooling area to the packing line and remove previously unloaded trucks.
• Inspect and change out batteries on the powered industrial truck (if required).
• Keep the truck unloader continuously supplied with trucks to be unloaded.
• Operate and maintain automated packaging equipment and ensure the carton erector is continuously supplied as indicated on the Bill of Material (BOM).
• Visually inspect each bag for defects, ensure proper orientation and categorize and log any defects identified.

Duties performed on a continual or intermittent basis:

• Manually unload trucks and package bags when necessary.
• Unpackage product and reinspect when necessary.
• Assist in performing line clearance.
• Notify the supervisor and take appropriate action if any safety, quality, mechanical or discrepancy issues occur.
• Sustain a clean and safe work area using 6S principles.
• Learn, understand, and apply rigorous quality standards, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).

What You'll Bring

• High School Diploma or GED and must be at least 18 years of age.
• One year of manufacturing experience, preferred.
• Possess or be able to obtain PIT Operator Certification.
• Possess or be able to obtain Inspector Certification.
• Basic English written and oral communication skills adequate to communicate with other team members.
• Understand verbal and written safety and quality instructions and read and comprehend written work instructions including words and drawings.
• Ability to perform basic mathematics.
• Basic computer skills required.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 40 pounds at a height up to 40 inches and carry up to 40 pounds at a distance of up to 25 feet occasionally throughout the shift.
• Must be able to push and pull up to 48 pounds at a distance of up to 15 feet occasionally throughout the shift.
• Normal visual acuity and the ability to distinguish color are necessary.
• Pass the Powered Industrial Truck (P.I.T.) physical.
• Stand, walk, climb stairs, reach forward, reach overhead, balance, stoop, crouch.
• Handle objects and operate controls using fine/simple/firm grasping and fingering.
