jobs.description:
Job Description

Every day, our teams help shape the future of finance. We collaborate, innovate, and solve complex challenges together. We foster an environment where every voice is valued, fresh ideas are encouraged, and people can do their best work. And we celebrate our success as one team. If you want to make an impact in fintech, we'd like to know: Are you FIS?

Join the 2027 FIS University Program!

As a full-time employee in the FIS University Program, you will have the opportunity to participate in team projects, community service activities, professional development seminars and work with a team that is invested in your growth, development, and success.

This two-year full-time program begins 2027 with a series of AI-Enabled Learning Sprints designed to help you accelerate your impact from day one. Through this immersive experience, you will:

• Learn how to leverage AI alongside human judgment to solve real business challenges and create value in your role.
• Explore the financial technology industry, gain insight into FIS's business, and understand how innovation is shaping the future of fintech.
• Engage directly with senior leaders and industry experts to learn about their career journeys, leadership philosophies, and perspectives on the future of work.
• Build practical AI-enabled tools, including a personal prompt library and role-specific use cases that you can immediately apply in your daily work.

This position is for a January 25, 2027 start.

About the Role

In this role, you will support business, financial, and technology teams by helping analyze data, document requirements, and assist with forecasting and pricing-related activities. You will gain exposure to how financial models and pricing structures are evaluated and used to support business decisions. This role provides hands-on experience while building foundational analytical, financial, and communication skills.

About The Team

You will join a team that supports business decision-making through analysis of operational, financial, and pricing-related information. The team works closely with product, finance, technology, and operations partners to help evaluate solutions, costs, and business impacts. Team members collaborate to identify risks, gaps, and opportunities that support the successful delivery of financial technology initiatives. You will work alongside experienced professionals who provide guidance and mentorship.

What you will be doing:

• Assist with gathering, documenting, and organizing business, financial, and vendor requirements

• Support basic financial analysis, including reviewing cost data, pricing inputs, and forecasts
• Coordinate with stakeholders across product, finance, technology, operations, and vendor teams to support timely completion of activities

• Help analyze pricing models or fee structures to understand assumptions, drivers, and impacts
• You will support coordination of various aspects of program activities from initiation through delivery.

Job Description Summary

GE Vernova est une entreprise mondiale du secteur de l’énergie, organisée en trois segments : Power, Wind et Electrification. Fort de plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, GE Vernova est idéalement positionnée pour jouer un rôle de leader dans la transition énergétique, en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en travaillant à sa décarbonation, avec plus de 70 000 employés répartis dans plus de 100 pays. Le secteur Grid Solutions de GE Vernova fournit des technologies et systèmes de réseau avancés, permettant la transmission et la distribution d'énergie depuis le point de génération jusqu'au point de consommation, et soutient une transition énergétique décarbonisée et sécurisée.

Sur son site industriel situé à Villeurbanne (France), le secteur Grid solutions conçoit, teste et fabrique des disjoncteurs haute tension destinés à ses clients nationaux et internationaux.

Job Description

Présentation du poste

Le stage s’effectuera sur le site industriel de Villeurbanne au sein du département R&D Eco-Conception et Matériaux.

Ce département fait partie de la ligne de produit HVS (High Voltage Switchgear) qui propose un ensemble de matériel permettant la mise sous, ou hors tension, des portions d'un réseau électrique tels que des disjoncteurs et sectionneurs. HVS comporte au total 12 unités réparties entre la France, Allemagne, Italie, Suisse, USA, Brésil, Chine et Inde.

Pour soutenir nos efforts R&D, nous souhaitons recruter une/un stagiaire afin d’homologuer de nouveaux matériaux hautes performances pour ces disjoncteurs haute tension. Afin d’intégrer ces nouveaux polymères, il est nécessaire de les caractériser mécaniquement, thermiquement et diélectriquement, et de comparer leurs propriétés à celles requises par nos cahiers des charges internes.

Missions

Le/La stagiaire aura pour mission

•Etat de l’art des matériaux testés

•Identifier les propriétés clés des lubrifiants et définir un plan d’expérience

•Réaliser des essais rhéologiques et/ou tribologiques, ainsi que des études de vieillissement sur les lubrifiants identifiés

•Être organisé, faire preuve de curiosité, esprit d’innovation, adaptabilité et autonomie, persévérance et esprit d’équipe

•Travailler en respectant strictement les règles de sécurité en vigueur au laboratoire et sur le site industriel

Etudiant de niveau BAC+5 ou équivalent école d’ingénieur

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

Votre mission

Vous améliorez prioritairement le fonctionnement du magasin de GE Vernova Gas Power à Belfort : réception, gestion des stocks, expédition et gestion de production magasin. Vous écoutez les utilisateurs, les clients du processus, le management, repérez ce qui freine leur productivité et transformez ces constats en projets concrets, du cahier des charges fonctionnel jusqu'à leur mise en place durable. Votre travail aide les équipes à livrer plus vite et mieux, pour bâtir un monde qui fonctionne.

Vos responsabilités

• Accompagnez les utilisateurs dans la résolution des problèmes liés aux outils et aux processus. Analysez les causes des problèmes récurrents et suivez leur résolution.
• Formez les utilisateurs aux process existants ou révisés
• Mettez en place des rapports suivants les besoins des utilisateurs
• Définissez et suivez les indicateurs de performance des processus, identifiez les opportunités d'amélioration et construisez les plans d'actions.
• Documentez et mettez à jour les instructions de travail standard. Partagez les bonnes pratiques avec l'équipe Magasin, Planification et Approvisionnement et toutes les parties intéressées.
• Communiquez l'avancement des programmes, les difficultés, les plans d'actions et les résultats au management et aux équipes concernées.
• Proposez des optimisations pour les processus de planification, d'approvisionnement et de magasin. Recueillez les besoins des utilisateurs, des clients et du management, puis défendez les besoins de l'usine auprès des organisations partenaires.
• Représentez l'usine auprès de l'équipe Digital Process Excellence (DPE, excellence des processus digitaux). Remontez les points d’amélioration nécessaires pour l’usine d’EPF. Analysez les standards et proposez des adaptations, notamment pour les évolutions multi-sites.

Votre profil

Vous aimez fédérer des équipes de plusieurs sites et pays autour d'améliorations mesurables, et vous avez une vraie curiosité pour comprendre les causes des problèmes.

Requis

• Formation Bac+5 ou niveau ingénieur
• Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en Supply Chain (chaîne d'approvisionnement) en milieu industriel
• Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet dans un contexte international
• Connaissance des processus de planification, d'approvisionnement et de magasin, et pratique des méthodes de gestion de projet et d'amélioration continue (Lean)
• Connaissance d'un ERP (progiciel de gestion intégré), idéalement SAP
• Expérience de coordination de projets informatiques avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires, et capacité à influencer et à accompagner le changement
• Aisance pour travailler avec des équipes multi-sites et des partenaires internationaux
• Maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais (lu, parlé, écrit)

Préféré

• Connaissance d'un MES (Manufacturing Execution System, outil d'exécution de production)
• Connaissance des outils Lean
• Maîtrise de Power BI et Power Query
• Certification PMP (Project Management Professional)

Ce que nous offrons

Chez GE Vernova, nous proposons des avantages variés et compétitifs. Ils vous aident à concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle. Vous développez aussi votre carrière grâce à un apprentissage continu en situation de travail.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap. Un référent handicap est présent sur chaque site.

What impact you’ll make
Many of our high-voltage dead tank circuit breaker orders match, or closely resemble, configurations we have engineered before, yet each one still requires engineers to rebuild BOMs and drawings by hand. In this role, you will analyze historical order data, define which designs qualify as repeatable, and build a working prototype that automates the path from BOM generation to drawing creation. • Analyze historical customer orders, BOMs, and drawings to identify and categorize repeat and near-repeat designs.
• Develop a repeatability classification method, with clear criteria for which jobs qualify for automation.
• Measure baseline engineering cycle times for a representative set of repeat jobs.
• Map the current engineering workflow and identify the manual activities best suited to automation.
• Build a functional prototype that automates BOM generation through engineering drawing creation, using Python, CAD automation, and system APIs as appropriate.
• Validate automated outputs against engineering requirements in review sessions with design engineers.
• Measure achieved productivity gains against the baseline, working toward a 70% cycle-time reduction target for qualifying repeat jobs.
• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing technology, and IT partners to align the prototype with product configuration, CAD, and SAP workflows.
• Document the solution, assumptions, and limitations to support future deployment, and present results to engineering leadership.

• Experience documenting and presenting technical work through coursework, projects, or prior roles.

Operators who assemble low-voltage control cabinets for high-voltage circuit breakers interpret dense wiring drawings and manually highlight wire gauges and other critical details before they can wire. • Quantify the manual highlighting and drawing-interpretation effort for representative 362 kV cabinet jobs.
• Establish a baseline for true first-pass yield (FPY) and rework frequency.
• Analyze recurring wiring errors and rework records to identify documentation-related root causes.
• Develop an automated wire gauge highlighting or improved drawing presentation prototype using E3.series, Python, or comparable tools.
• Evaluate alternative visual and digital work instruction formats and recommend a preferred approach.
• Pilot improvements with production operators, gather their feedback, and measure resulting changes in FPY and rework.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description Summary
Shape the Controls Behind the Energy Transition

Your algorithms could help keep the world's power grids stable, wind turbines efficient, and gas power plants cleaner. At GE Vernova Advanced Research, you will invent the control technologies that move from lab concept to real products. These products power homes, businesses, and communities around the world.

About the Team

GE Vernova Advanced Research leads research and development for GE Vernova's mission to power the energy transition. We work with more than 420 technology partners, GE Vernova's businesses, and the U.S. government on over 150 energy projects. Our researchers come from nearly every science and engineering field. Together we solve near-term technical challenges and pursue long-term breakthroughs. Our goal is energy that is more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure.

Job Description

What You Will Do

As a Controls Research Engineer, you will build models and advanced control, optimization, estimation, and detection technologies. You will support research programs for GE Vernova's Renewable Energy, Gas Power, Grid Solutions, and Power Conversion businesses. You will also support programs for U.S. government agencies such as the Department of Energy and the Department of Defense.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and apply advanced control, optimization, estimation, and detection solutions that improve GE Vernova products and services.
• Test how well your solutions perform. Use simulations and trials on target systems.
• Share your work through patent applications, technical reports, and publications.
• Follow new developments in system technologies, and look for new ideas and uses.
• Work on your own and as part of diverse teams. Your teammates include colleagues across GE Research and GE Vernova, and partners in industry, academia, and government.

Who You Are

You are a curious, hands-on problem solver. You enjoy turning complex physical systems into smart algorithms, and you want to see your ideas used in the real world.

Required Qualifications

• A Doctorate in Engineering or a related field, with experience designing advanced controls, optimization, estimation, or detection algorithms or a Master's degree in Engineering or a related field with 3+ years of that experience also qualifies.
• Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and in C, C++, or Python.
• Experience developing algorithms and software for complex physical systems. Examples include mechanical systems, chemical plants, power systems, transportation, and aviation.
• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor employment visas, now or in the future, for candidates at the Master's level for this opening.
• Willingness to work onsite in Niskayuna, NY. You must be 18 or older.

Preferred

• Experience with machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) in a controls context.
• Experience running real-time solutions on different hardware platforms, or developing controls for industrial applications.
• Experience with Git/GitHub, cybersecurity algorithms, industrial control hardware or software, grant or proposal writing, program management, or taking an idea from concept to product.

jobs.title: Lean Manufacturing Excellence Leader
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GSI Manufacturing Lean Leader is responsible for driving the strategic implementation and operationalization of Lean roadmap across the Manufacturing Function units located in UK, Vietnam and India. This role is critical in driving continuous improvement to achieve strategic and operational business objectives in transactional environment.
This role focuses on:
Driving Lean continuous improvement through successful & sustainable Kaizen, Hoshin Kanri improvement priorities and workshops
Cultivating a Lean culture: embedding core lean principles (e.g. 5S, Standard Work, Daily Management) into daily operations, fostering a mindset of continuous improvement throughout the organization.
Ensuring through training & coaching the effective application of lean tools, which involves understanding when and how to use each tool to drive continuous improvement and eliminate the waste
Deploying action plan to increase Lean maturity level (MOR, Kaizen, Lean Roadmap, Daily management) of each regions & Product delivery Group
Creating & animating lean leaders across the production units
This role requires around 30% of travel between UK and India/Vietnam.

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities:

1. Lean Roadmap Deployment:

• Operationalize the Lean Roadmap (Hoshin Kanri improvements priorities, Projects, Kaizen events) ensuring continuous improvement actions with direct sustainable business impact.
• Specifically for Kaizen events, ensure efficient pre work to enable a real impact during the Kaizen & sustainable results
• Ensure cross fertilization among the units in improvement actions to ensure that all are supporting the overall Manufacturing function priorities and SQDC KPI’s.

2. Cultural Transformation and Lean Principles Embedding:

• Encourage a mindset shift to a lean culture by identifying waste valuing continuous improvement
• Make 5 S, Standard Work, Visual Daily management Lean foundation tools among the units.
• Involve employees at all levels in the lean transformation through training, workshops, and idea contribution opportunities

3. Lean Competencies:

• Based on lean competencies assessment, contribute to develop & deliver training programs to educate employees about lean principles, tools, and methodologies for immediate application.

4. Performance Metrics and Accountability:

• Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that align with lean objectives.
• Encourage leaders to conduct Gemba walks to observe processes, engage with employees, and identify improvement opportunities

5. Sustaining the Lean Culture:

• Conduct regular reviews of lean practices and their effectiveness.
• Recognize and celebrate lean achievements to maintain enthusiasm and commitment to continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

• Significant experience in business operations in project environment with a proven track record of results in continuous improvement.
• Impactful & influencing communicator with experience working and leading cross-culturally in large, matrixed organizations.
• Proven mentoring and coaching abilities; demonstrated ability to motivate and inspire others and to lead with humility, transparency, and focus.
• Ability to effectively "go to Gemba" and gather relevant inputs for problem-solving and process improvements.

Desired Qualifications:

• Master’s degree or equivalent knowledge or experience in Engineering, Supply Chain, or another technical field.
• Additional cross-functional leadership experience in the areas of Project Management, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Construction and/or Quality is preferred.
• Skilled level of lean tools and methodologies and demonstrated Kaizen facilitation experience will be a plus.
• Good business and financial acumen.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Application Contrôle et Protection HVDC (F/H)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

La transition énergétique entraîne une croissance sans précédent de la demande et de la production d'électricité. Les systèmes de transmission en courant continu à haute tension (HVDC) jouent un rôle clé dans le raccordement des énergies renouvelables éloignées et offshore ainsi que dans le renforcement des réseaux à courant alternatif (CA).

L’activité "Grid Systems Integration" de GE Vernova propose des solutions de contrôle et de protection pour les technologies de convertisseurs commutés par le réseau (LCC) HVDC.

Le « cerveau » de ces stations est constitué de systèmes de contrôle et de protection qui garantissent un fonctionnement efficace, sûr et fiable.

Le système de contrôle est modélisé et mis en œuvre dans MATLAB/Simulink, en respectant les exigences fonctionnelles existantes et les normes de développement internes.

Le développement suit une méthodologie agile (cadre Scrum) avec JIRA pour la gestion du backlog et GitHub pour la gestion des configurations.

Job Description

Responsabilités essentielles :

• Capturer les exigences au niveau du système et des spécifications de test.
• Développer, mettre en œuvre et déboguer des algorithmes de contrôle pour les fonctions de convertisseur HVDC (par exemple, contrôle de la puissance, contrôle du convertisseur, contrôle de la puissance réactive et contrôle de démarrage/arrêt) dans MATLAB/Simulink conformément aux directives de modélisation de GE Vernova.
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des bancs de test (test harness) avec évaluation automatique pour valider au niveau unitaire et au niveau Model-in-the-Loop (MIL).
• Intégrer les blocs fonctionnels dans les unités de contrôle du convertisseur sur la base d'exigences de contrôle et de spécifications d'interface prédéfinies.
• Participer aux flux de travail de génération de code en utilisant MATLAB Embedded Coder, en garantissant la conformité avec l'architecture logicielle interne et les normes de codage.
• Effectuer des tests de type Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) et Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) pour valider l'intégration des fonctions conformément au plan de projet.
• Collaborer avec les ingénieurs système, les concepteurs fonctionnels et les testeurs dans le cadre de "sprints" agiles, en veillant à ce que les tâches soient suivies et documentées dans JIRA.
• Contribuer aux revues par les pairs, aux tests unitaires et aux sessions d'intégration pour garantir la qualité et la maintenabilité du modèle.
• Gérer le contrôle de version et les activités de branches via GitHub Enterprise.

Qualifications requises :

• Diplôme d'Ingénieur ou de Master (ou équivalent) en génie électrique, automatique ou logiciel.
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans la conception axée sur les modèles (model-based design) pour les systèmes de contrôle utilisant MATLAB/Simulink.

Caractéristiques souhaitées :

• Expérience avérée avec les systèmes HVDC ou le contrôle de l'électronique de puissance, idéalement avec la technologie LCC (CSC).
• Familiarité avec les concepts de contrôle HVDC (contrôle de l'angle d'allumage, contrôle de la puissance, contrôle de la puissance réactive, méthodes de protection).
• Expérience dans la génération de code (Embedded Coder ou TargetLink) et l'intégration du code généré dans des plates-formes de contrôle en temps réel, avec des connaissances de la norme IEC61850.
• Maîtrise des outils de contrôle de version (Git/GitHub) et des flux de travail collaboratifs (branching, pull requests, gestion des fusions).
• Expérience au sein d'équipes agiles utilisant JIRA ou des outils similaires.
• Solides compétences en analyse et en débogage, souci du détail dans la mise en œuvre des modèles.
• Bon esprit d'équipe avec une approche collaborative, capacité à travailler efficacement au sein d'équipes de taille moyenne à grande.
• Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et oral).
• Participation préalable à des projets de développement de contrôle/protection HVDC ou FACTS.
• Familiarité avec la simulation en temps réel (plates-formes HIL telles que RTDS, OPAL-RT).
• Expérience avec les pipelines d'intégration continue (MATLAB GitHub Actions, Jenkins ou similaires).
• Modèles Simulink approuvés pour les fonctions assignées, conformes aux directives internes.
• Preuves de tests unitaires et rapports de vérification (MIL/SIL).
• Contribution aux constructions d'intégration au niveau du système et aux revues de sprint.
• Mises à jour hebdomadaires de l'avancement via les tableaux de bord de sprint JIRA.

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap. Un référent handicap est présent sur chaque site.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Operations Lead is a vital member of the Customer Success Operations team, serving as a hybrid resource combining business analytics with financial and operational planning support. This role is responsible for translating customer success, operational, and financial data into actionable insights that support decision-making, drive process efficiencies, and support planning, forecasting, and budgeting cycles for the Customer Success organization.

Job Description

Key Accountabilities/ Execution:

The Operations Lead will work directly with Customer Success Managers, Renewals, Sales, Commercial Operations, Finance, CS Region Leaders, the PM Director, and support functions to build reporting frameworks, analyze trends, and support strategic and operational planning.

Responsibility:

• Support monthly/quarterly planning cycles, including revenue forecasting, budget tracking, and variance analysis for the Customer Success organization
• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs to track customer health, retention, renewals, and operational performance
• Analyze churn, renewal, and expansion trends to identify risks and opportunities for the business
• Support monthly close activities by reconciling operational metrics against financial and revenue targets
• Build and maintain data models to support scenario planning, headcount planning, and business case development
• Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and Finance teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into analytical solutions
• Automate recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort

• Support annual planning cycles including budget preparation and target-setting inputs for the Customer Success team

• Data Integrity Ownership: Audit, validate, and recommend corrections for operational and financial data across core systems (e.g., SFDC, ERP/Fusion, BI tools) to ensure consistency.
• Process Improvement Implementation: Identify operational bottlenecks and independently design, recommend, and implement workflow and reporting process improvements within Customer Success operations.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, Economics, or related field or equivalent experience

• Experience working with ERP/CRM systems (e.g., SFDC, Fusion, SAP, or similar)

Desired Characteristics:

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to translate data into clear business insights
• Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management skills
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to non-technical stakeholders
• Comfortable working within a cross-functional, global matrix organization

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova est une entreprise mondiale du secteur de l’énergie,
organisée en trois segments : Power, Wind et Electrification. Fort de plus de 130 ans
d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, GE Vernova est idéalement positionnée
pour jouer un rôle de leader dans la transition énergétique, en continuant à électrifier le
monde tout en travaillant à sa décarbonation, avec plus de 70 000 employés répartis dans
plus de 100 pays.

Le segment Electrification de GE Vernova fournit des technologies et
systèmes de réseau avancés, permettant la transmission et la distribution d'énergie depuis le
point de génération jusqu'au point de consommation, et soutient une transition énergétique
décarbonisée et sécurisée.

Sur son site industriel situé à Villeurbanne (France), conçoit, teste
et fabrique des disjoncteurs haute tension destinés aux opérateurs de réseaux et industriels
nationaux et internationaux.

Job Description

Le stage s’effectuera au sein du Centre de Recherche & Développement des disjoncteurs haute-tension, dans le cadre d’un projet de développement visant à se défaire du SF6 dans les appareillages, gaz le plus polluant au monde (1kg = 22.5t équivalent CO2 - 1% des émissions mondiales). Le stage portera sur la modélisation des phénomènes physiques dans une nouvelle chambre de coupure de disjoncteur haute-tension afin de dimensionner et optimiser les performances mécaniques et électriques de l’appareil.

Le sujet sera articulé autour de 3 axes principaux :

•Définition des paramètres de calculs, simulations numériques

•Compréhension / analyse des résultats, présentation à l’équipe projet

Propositions d’amélioration des performances selon contraintes design

Selon le profil, le sujet pourra aussi s’orienter sur des sujets annexes en relation avec les besoins du projet (traitement base de données, critères de design)

Profil recherché :

•Ecole d’ingénieur 4 / 5ème année : Génie Mécanique – Energétique – Electrique

•Français / Anglais : parlé et écrit – Curiosité, Esprit d’innovation et d’équipe, Adaptabilité

•Connaissances : Mécanique – Mécanique des fluides – électrotechnique – Energétique

•Compétences : Simulation numérique par éléments/volumes finis – Programmation

•Outils appréciés : AMESIM – ANSYS Fluent – COMSOL – Python – Flux 2D – Maxwell - #C

R&D Engineering Internship – High-Voltage Circuit Breakers

Position Overview

The internship will take place within the Research & Development Centre for High-Voltage Circuit Breakers, as part of a development project aimed at eliminating the use of SF6, one of the world's most polluting gases (1 kg = 22.5 tonnes of CO₂ equivalent, accounting for approximately 1% of global emissions).

The internship will focus on modelling physical phenomena within a new high-voltage circuit breaker interruption chamber, with the aim of sizing and optimising the equipment's mechanical and electrical performance.

Main Responsibilities

The internship will focus on three main areas:

• Defining calculation parameters and conducting numerical simulations.
• Understanding and analysing simulation results, and presenting findings to the project team.
• Proposing performance improvements while taking design constraints into account.

Depending on the candidate's profile, additional topics may also be covered according to project needs, such as database processing and design criteria.

Required Profile

• Education: 4th or 5th-year Engineering student specialising in Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
• Languages: Good written and spoken French and English.
• Personal attributes: Curiosity, innovative mindset, team spirit and adaptability.

Technical Knowledge and Skills

• Knowledge: Mechanics, fluid mechanics, electrical engineering and energy systems.
• Skills: Numerical simulation using finite element/finite volume methods and programming.
• Preferred tools: AMESIM, ANSYS Fluent, COMSOL, Python, Flux 2D, Maxwell and C#.

GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE : GEV) est une entreprise mondiale dédiée au secteur de l'énergie, structurée autour de ses segments Power, Wind et Electrification, et soutenue par ses activités d'accélération. Forte de plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, GE Vernova occupe une position unique pour mener la transition énergétique : elle continue d'électrifier le monde tout en s'efforçant simultanément de le décarboner. GE Vernova aide ses clients à alimenter les économies et à fournir une électricité vitale à la santé, à la sécurité et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie. Le siège social de GE Vernova est situé à Cambridge, dans le Massachusetts (États-Unis), et l'entreprise compte environ 75 000 employés répartis dans une centaine de pays à travers le monde. Guidée par sa raison d'être, « The Energy to Change the World » (L'énergie pour changer le monde), la technologie de GE Vernova contribue à bâtir un avenir énergétique plus abordable, plus fiable, plus durable et plus sûr.

Additional Information

• Review and assess contracts, specifications, schedules, and other contractual documentation to identify risks, opportunities, ambiguities, and potential commercial exposures.

jobs.title: Senior Scrum / Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You work with the information security team as a competent and experienced information security and compliance leader.

How you will contribute

You will assess information security risks in line with internal policies and external best practices and determine requirements how to secure Mondelēz International information and IT assets. In addition, you will develop security standards and policies; advise technical teams when developing relevant procedures or have operational security questions; review and consulting them on compliant and effective use of common tools. You will also keep business stakeholders apprised on the overall security and compliance roadmap, provide training on information security to appropriate teams, and develop security strategies, architectures and roadmaps across process and technologies.

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Project Manager to lead cyber defence projects from initiation to completion. This role demands exceptional leadership, organisational skills, and a strong analytical mindset. You will be responsible for orchestrating project activities across the Cyber Defence Operations function, facilitating critical discussions with security and business stakeholders, and leveraging data and analytics to drive informed decisions and ensure successful project delivery within scope, budget, and timeline.

Many of the projects drive digitalisation and operational maturity within the CISO function - including threat detection, incident response tooling, vulnerability management, and security automation. A digital mindset, familiarity with cyber defence operations, and strong technical competencies are key to role delivery.

This is a project management role at heart, but you will need enough cyber and technology knowledge to hold your own with security specialists, SOC analysts, and engineering teams.

What you'll be doing

• Lead and deliver projects within the Cyber Defence Operations portfolio, including security infrastructure, tooling, automation, and Security for AI initiatives.
• Apply proven project or programme management practices within the Technology, Transformation, and Security space, maintaining tight timelines and proactive risk management.
• Drive consistency and quality in execution using the appropriate methodology and tools (Agile, Scrum, or Tollgate/Waterfall as required).
• Translate cyber defence requirements — such as detection engineering, SIEM/SOAR enhancements, vulnerability remediation, and AI security risk mitigation — into clear, actionable work items.
• Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them when needed.
• Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports, monthly review meetings, and stakeholder forums.
• Lead budget management, resource planning, and utilisation across CDO projects.
• Own relationships with external vendors and managed security service providers where applicable.
• Drive continuous improvement within the function, embedding lessons learned and operational efficiencies.
• Bridge the gap between technology and business, ensuring cyber defence initiatives align with enterprise risk priorities.
• Maintain a digital mindset and act like an owner.

What you'll bring

• Proven project or programme management experience within Technology, Cyber Security, or Security Operations.
• Experience delivering information security and cyber defence initiatives (e.g., SOC transformation, threat intelligence platforms, incident response tooling, vulnerability management programmes).
• A solid grasp of security, compliance, and risk frameworks, and of core cyber concepts (NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001; CISSP or CISM aspirations welcome).
• Awareness of Security for AI principles, including securing AI/ML pipelines, understanding adversarial AI threats, and applying governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, OWASP AI Security) to protect AI-driven systems and data.
• Strong communication skills, from the delivery team up to steering committee and CISO level.
• Stakeholder management ability and the capacity to influence decisions across technical and non-technical audiences.
• Budget and resource management experience.
• Comfort with data, metrics, and KPIs — and using them to drive decisions and demonstrate security posture improvements.
• A track record of working well with internal teams and external partners.
• Commercial awareness, leadership skills, and a passion for problem-solving.

Tools & methods

Tollgate Methodology (Waterfall) · Agile / Scrum · JIRA · Asana · MS Project Online · Security for AI (AI/ML threat modelling, adversarial AI risk assessment, secure AI deployment frameworks) · Security tooling familiarity: SIEM, SOAR, EDR, vulnerability scanners

Why this role

This is a high-visibility cyber defence programme spanning the entire company, with real ownership of governance, numbers, and people. You will sit at the intersection of security strategy and operational delivery - a strong move if you want to grow your career in cyber security project leadership.

Interested?

Get in touch and we’ll talk it through.

Salary and Benefits:

The base salary range for this position is $122,000 to $167,750; the exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education and location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results.

In addition, Mondelez International offers the following benefits: health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, paid holidays and vacation time. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

The United States is the largest market in the Mondelēz International family with a significant employee and manufacturing footprint. Here, we produce our well-loved household favorites to provide our consumers with the right snack, at the right moment, made the right way. We have corporate offices, sales, manufacturing and distribution locations throughout the U.S. to ensure our iconic brands—including Oreo and  Chips Ahoy! cookies, Ritz, Wheat Thins and Triscuit crackers, and Swedish Fish and Sour Patch Kids confectionery products —are close at hand for our consumers across the country.

Job Description Summary

Be at the heart of a highly specialized supply chain where precision, timing and reliability truly matter. As a Supply Chain Specialist, you will support end-to-end supply chain activities for our radioligand therapy and isotope production site, helping ensure material and isotope availability, effective inventory management, compliant logistics, accurate master data and reliable order fulfilment.

You will coordinate activities across the reactor-to-patient supply chain, connecting target materials, reactor and irradiation interfaces, isotope supply, radioactive-material transportation, radioligand therapy production requirements and isotopes distribution.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure availability of raw materials, target materials and consumables in line with production plans.
• Manage material requirements planning, purchase order follow-up, inventory levels and safety stocks to maintain supply continuity.
• Coordinate irradiation schedules, target availability and delivery timing with irradiation partners.
• Translate reactor schedules and demand input into site production requirements.
• Identify and mitigate supply risks related to reactor outages, capacity, production yield, suppliers and material availability.
• Coordinate inbound and outbound flows of raw materials, irradiated targets, and isotopes.
• Manage time-critical radioactive shipments, balancing irradiation timing, radioactive decay, transport lead times and required activity at receipt.
• Ensure logistics comply with applicable regulations for good manufacturing, distribution, and dangerous goods
• Manage order fulfilment, delivery priorities and accurate planning, material, inventory and logistics data within enterprise resource planning systems.
• Develop contingency plans and drive improvements in supply reliability, inventory, logistics performance, compliance and cost efficiency.

Essential Requirements

• Bachelor or master degree in a relevant field, preferably Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Engineering or a related discipline.
• Experience in Supply Chain, Planning, Logistics or Materials Management, preferably in a pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing environment with knowledge of GMP/GDP.
• Strong ERP/MRP and inventory-management knowledge.
• Understanding of radioligand therapy and isotope supply chains, reactor irradiation interfaces and radioactive decay or the ability to learn this rapidly.
• Relevant dangerous-goods and airfreight-security certification/expertise, or ability to obtain and maintain required qualifications.
• Strong cross-functional coordination, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

This is a shift-based role that includes rotating weekend coverage. As part of the shift schedule, you may be required to work occasional Saturdays or Sundays to support continuous site operations and the timely supply of isotopes.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Medical Science Liaison

#LI-Hybrid

As a Medical Science Liaison at Novartis, you will serve as a trusted scientific partner in the field—building peer-to-peer relationships with medical experts, key stakeholders, and members of the scientific community. Leveraging evidence-based, non-promotional materials, you will facilitate meaningful scientific exchange that informs and advances patient care.

From as early as two years before a new product launches, you will play a strategic role in preparing for and supporting product development, launch, and commercialization. By gathering external insights, you will help shape Novartis’ understanding of the therapeutic landscape. Additionally, you will respond to unsolicited scientific inquiries and provide clinical trial support.

Job Description

Major accountabilities:

• Build and maintain scientific relationships with Medical Experts, Key Stakeholders, and Healthcare professionals; respond to unsolicited scientific inquiries using approved, evidence-based materials.
• Identify and map Medical Experts and key stakeholders in alignment with local strategies, document interactions and advocacy levels per Field Medical Excellence standards.
• Provide accurate scientific information on Novartis products and therapeutic areas to ensure informed clinical decisions and adherence to medical guidelines.
• Deliver medical support and education to external groups, promoting evidence-based understanding of Novartis products and relevant health economics data.
• Support clinical research activities, including site feasibility assessments, trial recruitment education, and collaboration with internal teams to ensure compliance with protocols and regulations.
• Facilitate scientific exchange and gather insights on emerging research trends, therapeutic challenges, and unmet needs; report findings to shape development plans and launch strategies.
• Implement and manage scientific projects such as registries, epidemiology studies, and cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving patient diagnosis and treatment outcomes.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Clinical, Market Access, and other teams to translate insights into actionable strategies that accelerate access to Immunology therapies.

​Requirements:

• Degree in life sciences or healthcare. Additional qualifications in pharmacology, clinical research, or related fields are an advantage
• Proven experience in building peer-to-peer relationships with medical experts, key opinion leaders, and healthcare stakeholders
• Familiarity with clinical trial processes, including site feasibility, recruitment support, and adherence to regulatory guidelines.
• Strong analytical skills to collect, interpret, and report scientific insights that inform medical strategy and product lifecycle planning.
• Skilled in delivering evidence-based, non-promotional scientific information to healthcare professionals.

Skills Desired

Biostatistics, Clinical Protocols, Clinical Research, Clinical Study Reports, Clinical Trials, Curious Mindset, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Software, Disease Management, Drug Development, Epidemiology, IT Tools, Medical Information, Medical Research, Medical Writing, Product Placement, Research Support

jobs.title: Consultant expérimenté en stratégie et en relation client - Experience Center Paris - F/H
jobs.description:
Job Description & Summary

Qui sommes-nous ?

Cabinet d’audit et de conseil, PwC est un réseau international de 370 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, dont 6 400 en France et en Afrique francophone.

Au sein de l'équipe Customer, nous aidons nos clients à réinventer leurs offres de services et expériences clients / usagers grâce à nos méthodes combinant les approches centrées utilisateurs (recherche utilisateur, co-design, prototypage…) et l’approche Conseil.

Avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire intégrée et liée aux multiples compétences du Consulting, nous imaginons, concevons et réalisons les expériences de demain et le parcours des utilisateurs sur tous les points de contact : écrans, lieux, objets connectés, interactions humaines… et nous accompagnons nos clients dans leur réflexion stratégique et dans la construction des transformations des dispositifs, outils, organisations et des métiers de la relation client, et dans les feuilles de route associées.

Présentation de l'offre :

Au sein du Consulting, notre équipe accompagne les acteurs de la Santé, des Mobilités, du Secteur Public et des Services dans leur transformation digitale de la stratégie à l’exécution :

• Réflexion et accompagnement à la décision stratégique

• Construction des nouvelles offres et des catalogues de service

• Définition du plan de transformation

• Transformation des métiers

• Feuille de route métier/IT

• Conception d’expérience utilisateur

• Product Management

• Pilotage de projet pour accompagner la mise en œuvre des solutions

En tant que consultant expérimenté, vous exercerez également des responsabilités variées :

• Accompagnement au changement

• Gestion du delivery de vos missions et encadrement des profils plus juniors

• Contribution au développement commercial et à la relation client

• Participation à la production de thought leadership (offres, points de vue, articles)

• Animation et développement de l’équipe dans le cadre de chantiers internes

Nos sujets de prédilection couvrent les domaines suivants :

• La définition du modèle de relation omnicanale, la conception et le déploiement d’expérience client/usager digitalisée, et l’amélioration de la satisfaction client

• La conception et le lancement de nouvelles offres de services (études d’opportunité, la conception d’offres, pilotage du lancement de l’offre)

• Le design d’organisation des fonctions Marketing, Relation Client/Usager et commerciales (process, gouvernances, pratiques, outils…)

• La définition de schéma directeurs IT pour le domaine « Customer » (marketing, ventes, relation client)

• La conception d’expériences clients innovantes, intégrant les potentialités de la technologie (en particulier l’IA générative)

• La conception ou la refonte de plateformes digitales

• La collecte et l’analyse de retours clients par une approche qualitative comprenant des études utilisateurs et des ateliers de réflexion

Notre équipe accompagne nos clients issus des multiples secteurs :

• Acteurs publics : CNAM, collectivités territoriales (régions, métropoles, départements, …), CNSA, Ile de France Mobilités, Ministères (Armées, Culture, Finances…), RATP, Région Île-de-France, …

• Audiovisuel : INA, TF1, …

• Bancassurance : Allianz, Axa, BNP Paribas, Europ Assistance, Generali, Macif, MACSF, Malakoff Humanis, …

• Énergie, utilities et services : Accor, Bouygues Immobilier, Club Med, EDF, Enedis, Orange, Suez, …

• Retail : Carrefour, Dior, Etam, Guerlain, Kering, La Redoute, E.Leclerc, Pernod Ricard, Salomon, …

Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous :

• Opérer et vous développer auprès de clients dans différents secteurs d’activité

• Être acteur de transformations impactantes et gérer des projets de bout en bout

• Intégrer une équipe dynamique, à taille humaine avec un Management qui vous guide dans vos choix de développement et de carrière

• Travailler avec les autres expertises de PwC : Strategy&, Opérations, Data & AI, Operations, Workforce

Le profil que nous recherchons :

• Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou de commerce, ou diplôme universitaire

• 3 à 6 ans d’expérience dans le conseil, dans des environnements digitaux, dans la stratégie en relation client, en marketing, en transformation digitale ou en design et vous souhaitez imaginer et concevoir des stratégies dans des secteurs variés et sur tous les points de contact.

• Vous êtes déjà intervenu(e) sur des problématiques de développement de nouveaux services, de réflexion stratégique, d’amélioration de la relation client, de transformation IT ou de Design Thinking

• Envie de faire la différence et d’avoir de l’impact en interne, auprès des équipes et des clients

• Grande sensibilité à la gestion de la relation client et volonté d’intégrer une dynamique commerciale

• Compétences analytiques, synthétiques, créatives, prise de recul, impact à l’oral et esprit d’équipe

• À l’aise dans des environnements exigeants, complexes et innovants

• Maitrise de la gestion de projet (animation de comité, construction de feuille de route projet…)

• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais

• Habitué à encadrer des consultants ou des designers moins expérimentés en les guidant, en organisant le travail, avec pour objectif de toujours les faire monter en compétences et d’assurer la qualité de la production

Votre quotidien

Vous travaillez à l’agence dans des locaux privilégiés (un hôtel particulier de 1400 ㎡ au coeur de Paris), en war room chez le client, ou bien en distanciel sur certains projets,  au sein d’une équipe de 2 à 4 personnes dédiée au projet. Vous apportez vos compétences sur les phases de recherche, d’idéation, de cadrage, de prototypage, de tests ou de réalisation pour le compte de nos clients ou pour des projets internes.

Rejoindre notre agence, c’est la garantie d’avoir de vraies responsabilités au sein d’une équipe de talents. La méthodologie de l'Experience Center, qui repose sur le Design Thinking, fait sa particularité pour ses employés et ses clients.

Vous serez évalué sur :

• Votre créativité : l’originalité de vos idées et la qualité dans leur mise en oeuvre
• Votre maîtrise : des outils de Design Thinking, des outils de conception et de création numérique
• Votre discours : savoir raconter une histoire et nous surprendre par votre discours
• Votre personnalité : votre originalité, votre force de caractère, vos convictions
• Votre énergie : votre capacité à prendre des initiatives et à changer les choses
• Vous capacité à faire progresser les équipes, les méthodes UX et l’offre de l’agence.

Votre candidature

Si vous êtes intéressé, merci de nous envoyer :

• Votre C.V.
• Si vous en avez un à présenter, l’accès à votre book (site web, PDF, Behance, Vimeo…) ou bien à défaut un accès téléchargeable à vos dernières réalisations (Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer…) est un plus, de même que les recommandations de vos précédents clients ou employeurs.

Vos avantages

• Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain.

• Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu.

• Un cycle de performance stimulant, aligné avec le référentiel PwC Professional, pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs et viser l’excellence jour après jour.

• Un cadre de travail positif et inclusif pour vous permettre d’être pleinement vous-même et de collaborer efficacement au service de nos clients (programmes de parentalité, d’équité femmes-hommes, de santé et bien-être Be Well, Work Well, d’inclusion LGBT+ et de maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap).

Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages, rendez-vous sur notre page dédiée.

Notre processus de recrutement

Pour vous permettre de vivre une expérience fluide et transparente, notre processus de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes :

• Évaluation en ligne avec un test de compétences et/ou un test d’anglais

• Entretien RH

• Rencontres avec les équipes opérationnelles (un ou plusieurs entretiens en physique)

• Vérification des informations : avant l’embauche, un organisme spécialisé procédera à la vérification des éléments figurant sur votre CV

jobs.title: P&G PEAKathon 2026: The Ultimate Student Business Challenge  Challenge Assumptions. Reach Your PEAK.
jobs.description:
Job Location

CAIRO BUSINESS OFFICE

Job Description

Location: Egypt - Cairo
Eligibility: Currently enrolled university students graduating June2028 or December 2028 | Teams of 3 - 4 members

Are you ready to take your ideas to the global stage?

Welcome to PEAKathon 2026! P&G’s flagship student competition across Africa, the Middle East, and Asia. This isn't your average textbook case study. We are handing you the keys to one of our most iconic, multi-million-dollar global brands and challenging you to disrupt the market.

Out-think the competition, claim national glory, and earn a chance to fast-track an internship application with us!

How the Competition Works

After applications close, eligible teams will be reviewed and shortlisted. Shortlisted teams will then progress through the following stages:

• ROUND 1: Complete your online application & online assessments Deadline 25 December 2026.
• ROUND 2: Business Case Challenge will take place in Cairo Business Office Week two January 2027 — Teams that advance will solve and present a business case. The strongest team will be named the Egypt National Champion.
• REGIONAL FINALE — The Egypt National Champion will compete live in Singapore against winning teams from across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa for the title of Regional PEAKathon Champion.

BUSINESS CONTEXT & THE CHALLENGE

Vicks has more than 60 years of heritage and is a trusted household name for cough and cold. Vicks Cough Drops/Vicks VapoDrops wants to become the instinctive choice for younger consumers whenever they experience throat irritation.

For markets where Vicks cough drops/VapoDrops exist Throat/Cough lozenges operate in the impulse purchase category making driving top of mind awareness critical for consumers. A consumer would use lozenges when they have throat irritation and for casual consumption (freshness/cooling). Vicks wants to strengthen top-of-mind awareness among younger consumers and become the brand people instinctively think of whenever they experience throat irritation.

While medicated lozenges like Strepsils have strong equity in Pharmacy for more serious sore throat relief, Vicks is a brand that consumers consume for minor throat irritation throat + casual consumption (“soothes the throat, clears the nose”). In markets where VapoDrops exist (example India), these are used for throat irritation + blocked nose relief as that is a POD for Vicks in this category vs Strepsils, coming from the mother brand of Vicks VapoRub, which has been present in most markets for nearly a century.

THE CHALLENGE: How would you make Vicks the first brand that young consumers think of when they experience throat irritation?

Ready to Enter? Here’s What to Do

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Join our diverse, agile team in Subang Jaya, Malaysia, where your analytical expertise directly protects ethical integrity across our regional healthcare operations. As a Healthcare Compliance Analyst, you will evaluate interactions with healthcare professionals and organizations, ensuring adherence to industry codes and regulatory standards while contributing to continuous process improvement.

In this impactful role, you will:

• Conduct Compliance Reviews: Assess documentation and evidence for interactions with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and Healthcare Organizations (HCOs)—such as grants, sponsorships, and advisory boards—to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.
• Identify Risks & Process Gaps: Evaluate business processes across divisions to identify potential compliance risks, document assessment findings accurately, and recommend practical resolution plans.
• Manage Reporting & Action Trackers: Maintain compliance trackers, follow up with stakeholders to resolve open queries promptly, and deliver finalized quarterly compliance reports on schedule.
• Maintain Governance Standards: Continuously monitor and update compliance checklists to reflect evolving industry codes, corporate directives, and local regulations.
• Drive Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with your team and leadership to enhance compliance manuals, refine review workflows, and implement process improvements.
• Foster Collaborative Partnerships: Build productive relationships with regional partners and internal stakeholders, prioritizing risk identification and solution-focused support.

Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented, analytical professional with strong professional skepticism and a collaborative mindset. You communicate clearly across cultures, take ownership of your personal growth, and thrive in a flexible, fast-paced environment.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational & Professional Background: You hold a University Degree (preferably in Accounting, Finance, Law, or a related field) with at least 2 years of experience in internal audit or compliance within a regulated industry. (Candidates with less than 2 years of experience may be considered for a Healthcare Compliance Associate role).
• Language Capabilities: You possess professional fluency in both written and spoken English and Japanese to support regional affiliates effectively.
• Analytical & Reporting Acumen: You bring strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and proven experience in preparing clear, accurate business and audit reports.
• Interpersonal & Problem-Solving Skills: You demonstrate strong teamwork, effective conflict resolution skills, and the ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
• Work Eligibility: This role is based in Subang Jaya, Malaysia, and requires existing legal eligibility to live and work in Malaysia.

Let’s thrive together in a culture built on trust, collaboration, respect, and high performance.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: National Brand Manager
jobs.description:
National Brand Manager

Country: Denmark

Vil du være med til at styrke vores samarbejde med bilimportører og forhandlere på det danske marked?

Motiveres du af at skabe kommercielle resultater, udvikle stærke partnerskaber og omsætte muligheder i markedet til konkrete resultater?

Som National Brand Manager har du det kommercielle ansvar for ét eller flere bilmærker og bliver en central samarbejdspartner for både importører og deres forhandlernetværk. Du har en afgørende rolle i at udvikle samarbejdet med vores partnere og sikre, at vores produkter, kampagner og øvrige kommercielle aktiviteter understøtter deres ambitioner og bidrager til vækst.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med importører, forhandlere og kolleger på tværs af organisationen. Med en kombination af stærke relationer, kommerciel forståelse og analytisk indsigt identificerer du nye muligheder og sikrer, at de bliver omsat til konkrete resultater i markedet. Dit mål er klart: At gøre finansiering til en integreret del af bilbrandets kommercielle strategi og bidrage til øget salg, loyalitet og lønsomhed.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder:

Du får et bredt kommercielt ansvar og vil blandt andet:

• Have det overordnede ansvar for relationen og det kommercielle samarbejde med én eller flere bilimportører og deres brands.
• Opbygge og udvikle stærke, langsigtede relationer til importører, forhandlere og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.
• Drive vækst og øge markedsandelen hos de bilmærker, du har ansvar for ved at levere finansierings- og leasingløsninger, der understøtter importørens produkt-, pris- og salgsstrategi.
• Arbejde tæt sammen med importøren om lanceringer af nye modeller og sikre, at relevante finansieringsprodukter og kampagner er på plads fra start.
• Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på salgs- og marketingplaner, budgetter og målsætninger samt løbende følge udviklingen i markedet og den kommercielle performance for det enkelte brand.
• Analysere marked, konkurrenter og performance og omsætte data til konkrete kommercielle initiativer

Du trives i en rolle, hvor kommercielt ansvar, opbygning af relationer og forretningsudvikling går hånd i hånd. Du tager naturligt ejerskab, arbejder struktureret og motiveres af at skabe fremdrift og resultater sammen med både kunder og kolleger.

The Position

About the Role

We are looking for a versatile and technically strong Data Scientist to lead the training, optimization, and evaluation of advanced foundation models across diverse biomedical and healthcare R&D initiatives. Operating at the intersection of computational biology, clinical AI, and natural language processing, you will work across multiple high-impact projects—ranging from large-scale sequence models for longitudinal health data and bioinformatics to Large Language Model (LLM) pipelines for automated technical and scientific document generation.

Key Responsibilities

• Foundation Model Training & Optimization: Lead the end-to-end pre-training, fine-tuning, and computational optimization of large-scale foundation and sequence models (such as transformer and state-space architectures) on complex, high-dimensional datasets.
• Rigorous Model Evaluation: Design and implement comprehensive benchmarking frameworks to assess predictive performance, out-of-distribution generalization, uncertainty, and algorithmic fairness across diverse populations.
• LLM-Driven Document Generation: Build, adapt, and evaluate LLM workflows (including Retrieval-Augmented Generation, fine-tuning, and structured prompting) to automate the drafting and verification of complex technical, clinical, and regulatory documents.
• Bioinformatics & Molecular Assay Optimization: Apply machine learning, statistical modeling, and sequence analysis to bioinformatics and multi-omics datasets to support biomarker discovery as well as computational design and optimization workflows for PCR and molecular diagnostic assays.
• Collaboration & Reproducibility: Partner closely with data engineers, bioinformaticians, and clinical/scientific domain experts to translate experimental prototypes into scalable, reproducible pipelines in high-performance computing (HPC) or cloud environments.

Must-Have Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline.
• Python, Data Science & Deep Learning: Strong proficiency in Python—including commonly used data science libraries (such as NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn)—and PyTorch, with proven hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and optimizing deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers, state-space models, or other large-scale sequence models).
• Evaluation & Benchmarking: Solid statistical foundation and practical experience designing rigorous validation frameworks to measure model accuracy, generalization, and robustness.
• LLM Development: Hands-on experience building and evaluating Large Language Model applications (such as RAG, domain adaptation, or structured text generation).
• Software & Cloud Infrastructure: Proficiency with version control (Git), containerization (Docker), experiment tracking, and executing workloads on GPU clusters or cloud platforms.
• Communication: Strong command of English (both written and spoken), with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts across multidisciplinary teams.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

• Advanced Education: Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative field.
• Healthcare & Bioinformatics Domain Experience: Prior experience working with longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs), clinical registries, or bioinformatics/multi-omics workflows.
• Federated Learning: Familiarity with federated learning architectures, decentralized model training, or privacy-preserving machine learning workflows.
• Large-Scale Distributed Training: Experience with multi-GPU or multi-node distributed training frameworks (e.g., FSDP, DeepSpeed).

Summary

The Manager Maintenance Services is responsible for overseeing operations and personnel across assigned locations. This role includes direct supervision of a Supervisor, Maintenance Services, as well as up to two office support staff. This position is responsible for the management of the location(s) performance against metrics to meet and/or exceed assigned objectives. This position is also responsible for ensuring that the location is in compliance with and properly executing all key company processes, Standard Operating Procedures and Standard Repair Practices. The Manager, Maintenance Services is responsible for adhering to all Ryder Maintenance Operations policies and procedures. This may also be a development position to prepare incumbents for the Senior Manager, Maintenance Services I role.

Essential Functions

• Operations Management: • Responsible for the execution of work analysis, vehicle planning and scheduling, scheduling and assigning work to technicians, productivity tracking and optimization, shift meetings, and RO review and approval. • Ensure proper work is scheduled, which may include assigning work to technicians • Directly involved in Labor Planning by evaluating incoming work and allocating resources, balancing shift schedules, and level loading work load to maximize efficiency and productivity. • Responsible for optimizing labor and ensuring the optimal mix of straight time and O/T. • Responsible for optimizing shift patterns to match supply of qualified tech hours versus the availability of equipment based upon customer operating hours.
• Labor Management: • Provides management, training and development of all personnel assigned. • Responsible for Performance Management of all assigned personnel. • Responsible for successful development and execution of the Technical Training Plan in coordination with the Field Training Team. • Ensure plan is prioritized based upon Breakdown, Rework and Running Cost trends. • Makes recommendations for future staffing based on changes to the business environment. • Responsible for Recruiting, Hiring, On-boarding, Payroll, and Succession Planning.

Responsible for Payroll, Purchase Order approval and invoice reconciliation, and fuel reconciliation, all liquid inventories to include fuel, DEF and oil. • Responsible for the successful execution of the customer bill back process to include identification, review and approval of bill back opportunities. • Responsible for ensuring proper documentation and explanation/ reporting of re-billable activity. • Responsible for the successful execution of the Warranty process and maximizing warranty recovery. • Ensure data integrity in Salesforce.

• Quality Management: • Responsible for successful execution of Quality Inspections of PM & repairs, including In Process Reviews of non-PM work. • Lead breakdown root cause analysis process, implement corrective actions locally, and when necessary, communicate issues to upper management. • Maintain control/visibility over activities to ensure proper root cause diagnosis by technicians and that the yield on all parts/components is optimized. • Responsible for all Mandatory Compliance items. • Accountable for all Quality Metrics of the business. • Develop and ensure implementation of Quality Assurance Audit Corrective Action plans and Continuous Improvement programs. • Accountable for maintenance of all relevant documentation required to meet and/or exceed local, state, federal, as well as customer requirements. • Responsible for ensuring a safe workplace and providing guidance for all safety efforts and initiatives. • Ensure Cleanliness and quality of repair for all maintained vehicles. • Comply with Safety, State, and EPA regulations and requirements.

• Capacity to understand labor, financial, operating, quality, safety and asset processes and related metrics, Required

About the job

As a Data Visualization & Process Tooling Intern, you will join Sanofi's Downstream Processing team and support the development of digital tools that help scientists and laboratory teams analyse data, design purification processes and make informed decisions. You will work on business intelligence dashboards, data integration and calculation tools, with the opportunity to shape your project based on your skills and interests while contributing to ongoing research and development activities.

Please note: This is an unpaid internship designed to provide students with hands-on experience in pharmaceutical marketing, exposure to a global healthcare organization, and opportunities for professional development through practical projects, coaching, and mentorship.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main responsibilities:

• Gather requirements from scientists and laboratory staff to understand their data and reporting needs.
• Design, develop and test dashboards and calculation tools to compare data across studies and support process development.
• Collect, clean, organise and integrate data from different sources, including electronic laboratory notebooks and equipment records.
• Support the development of standardised calculation methods for process scaling.
• Analyse equipment usage, consumable consumption and equipment operating history.
• Explore opportunities to automate reporting and introduce AI-supported tools where appropriate.
• Document developed tools and processes, follow version control practices, and present results to end users to gather feedback.

About you

To excel in this role you will need to have:

• Be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Bioengineering, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science or a related field.
• Have an interest in data visualisation, business intelligence tools and/or Python programming.
• Have an analytical mindset and a structured approach to problem-solving, with attention to data quality.
• Be curious about AI-supported development and willing to learn new tools independently.
• Have good communication skills and enjoy collaborating with both laboratory and technical teams.
• Be fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Nice to have:

• Basic understanding of bioprocessing or protein purification.

• Previous experience with data visualisation, dashboard development or Python programming.

• Exposure to data integration, automation or version control tools.

• Being fluent in French, Dutch or German.

Why choose us?

• Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.
• Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.

• Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
